text.body: || maṅgalācaraṇam|| dhyāyaṃ dhyāyaṃ paraṃ brahma smāraṃ smāraṃ gurorgiraḥ| siddhāntakaumudīvyākhyāṃ kurmaḥ prauḍhamanoramām|| || atha saṃjñāprakaraṇam|| "hayavaraṭ" hakāropadeśaḥ, aṭ-aś-haś-iṇgrahaṇeṣu hakāragrahaṇārthaḥ| "arheṇa" "aḍvyavāye'pi" iti ṇatvam| "devā hasanti" "bhobhago" iti roryatvam| "devo hasati" "haśi ca" ityutvam| "lilihiḍhve" "lilihidhve" "vibhāṣeṭaḥ" iti vā ḍhaḥ| "hal" idaṃ sūtraṃ val-ral-jhal-śalṣu hakāragrahaṇārtham| "rudihi" "svapihi" "rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke" iti valādilakṣaṇa iṭ| "snihitvā" "snehitvā" "ralo vyupadhād" iti vā kittvam| "adāgdhām" "jhalo jhali" iti sakāralopaḥ| "alikṣat" "śala igupadhāt" iti ksaḥ| sūtre'ntyamiti| hali antyamiti vigrahe "saptamī" iti yogavibhāgāt "supsupā" iti vā samāsa iti bhāvaḥ| yadvā ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'yam| syādetat, halityekaśeṣasyaiva tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣānyatamamastu| hasya l iti ca vyākhyāsyate| sāmīpyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ| yadvā, māstu tantrādi, astu samāhāradvandvo hal ca l ceti|lakārasya saṃyogāntasya lopa iti cet ? maivam, ādye samāsasya kliṣṭatvāt| na hi "brāhmaṇakambala" ityādau brāhmaṇasamīpavartyanyadīyaḥ kambalaḥ pratīyate, na vā citraguśabdāccitragavīṇāṃ samīpavartī vṛkṣādiḥ pratīyate| ata eva anantarādiṣu na samāso'nabhidhānāditi spaṣṭamākare| kiṃ bahunā "brāhmaṇasya kambalaḥ' "citrā gāvo'sya' iti vyastaprayogo'pi tatrāniṣṭaḥ| dvitīye'pi saṃyogāntalopo durlabhaḥ, yaṇaḥ pratiṣedhārambhāt| tatpratyākhyānapakṣe'pi "jhalo jhali" ityato jhalgrahaṇamapakṛṣya jhalo lopavidhānācca| kiṃca padārthabodhaṃ vinā vākyārthabodhāsambhavena halpratyāhārasiddheḥ prāgetatsūtrārthābodhe prasakte taduddhārārtho'yaṃ yatnaḥ| asyāṃ cāvasthāyāṃ halśabdārthāprasiddhau dvandva eva durlabhaḥ sahavivakṣāyā asambhavāt| tasmādyathoktameva nyāyyam| madhyagānāmiti| ādyantābhyāmavayavābhyāmavayavī samudāya ākṣipyate; tasya ca yugapallakṣye prayogāsambhavāttadavayaveṣvavatarantī saṃjñā madhyageṣu viśrāmyati, natvādyantayoḥ, saṃjñāsvarūpāntarbhāveṇa tayoḥ pārārthyanirṇayāditi bhāvaḥ| svasya ceti| "svaṃ rūpamityanuvṛteḥ | svaṃ rūpaṃ cādereva gṛhyate, nāntyasya antyenetyapradhānatṛtīyānirdeśāt| sarvanāmnāmutsargataḥ pradhānaparāmarśitvāt| ādyoccāraṇamiti| yadyapyupadiśyate'neneti karaṇavyutpatyā śāstramupadeśa iti bhāṣyavṛttyādiṣu vyākhyātaṃ tathāpi tatprauḍhivādamātram| karaṇe ghaño durlabhatvāt, lyuṭā bādhāt| na ca ghaḥ, asaṃjñātvāt| "prāyeṇa saṃjñāyām" iti vyākhyānasya kliṣṭatvāt| nahyupādherupādhirbhavatītyādinā bhāṣyakṛtā'vahelanācca| ata eva ghāpavādo halaśceti ghañapīha na| bāhulakantvagatikagatiḥ| ata eva "prakriyante śabdā yābhiḥ" iti karaṇavyutpattirapi parāstā| tathā ca vārtikam- "ajabbhyāṃ strīkhalanāḥ striyāḥ khalanau vipratiṣedhena" iti| ato bhāva eva pratyayo nyāyya iti bhāvaḥ| yattu dhātusūtretyādi paṭhanti| yacca vyācakṣate- "karaṇavyutpattyā pūrvārdhopāttānāmupadeśatvaṃ, karmavyutpattyā tvāgamādīnām| uṇādiliṅgānuśāsanayorapi sūtratvātsiddhe pṛthagupādānaṃ gobalīvardanyāyena| evaṃ gaṇatvādeva siddhe dhātorapi" ityādi| atredaṃ vaktavyam-- kimeṣāmupadeśasaṃjñā, uta yogamātram ? nādyaḥ, saṃjñāyāḥ śāstrakārairanukteḥ, asaṃjñātvāt ghapratyayo neti bhāṣyokteśca| asmadādikṛtasaṃjñāyāḥ śāstravyavasthāpakattve'tiprasaṅgācca| "āmo'mittvamadantatvāt" ityādisvaparagranthavirodhācca, na hyutsṛṣṭānubandhasyāmo na pratyayatvaṃ, yena mittvaṃ na bhavet| kiñcaivaṃ pratyayavidhau pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīprakalpakatve sanaḥ sanevādeśo'stvityāśaṅkyopadeśābhāvātsaṃjñā na syāditi bhāṣyakaiyaṭoktaṃ vyākupyeta| kiñca "na dhātulopa" iti sūtre "dhātugrahaṇaṃ kim ? lūñ lavitā, pūñ pavitā" iti bhāṣyam, "upadeśa evānubandhalope kṛte tato dhātusaṃjñā" ityevaṃparaḥ kaiyaṭagranthaśca virudhyeta| api ca, "ghvasoreddhau" iti sūtre lopaśśceti dviśakārako nirdeśaḥ, dvitīyaḥ śakāra iditi alontyasūtrasthabhāṣyakaiyaṭādikamapi virudhyeta| na dvitīyaḥ, yogasyaiva puraskāre parigaṇanasya vyarthatvāt| dhātvādiṣu karaṇavyutpattirāgamādiṣu neti vaiṣamyasya durupapādatvācca| upadeśatāprayojakadhātutvādi-rūpopādhyavacchinnasamudāyāntyaṃ hal it ityartha iti svagranthavirodhācca| pakṣadvaye'pi liṅgānuśāsanasya prakṛtānupayogāt| lopaśśceti śakārasyāsaṃgrahācca|"ādeca upadeśe" "upadeśe'tvataḥ" ityādāvādyoccāraṇascaivopadeśapadārthatāyāḥ sarvasaṃmatatvācceti dik|| "upadeśe'janunāsika it" || yadyapyatropajīvyatvādanunāsikasaṃjñā prathamaṃ vaktumucitā, tathāpi nāsikāmanugata iti yogāśraṇenaiva gatārthatvād "anunāsikasaṃjñāsūtraṃ mandaprayojanam" iti dhvanayituṃ nehopanyastam| upadeśe kim ? "abbhra ām̐ apaḥ"| yadyapīha "uñaḥ" "ūm̐" ityatreva vidhānasāmarthyānnetvamiti suvacam, tathāpyuttarārthamavaśyaṃ kartavyamupadeśagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭapratipattaye ihaiva kṛtam| ac kim ? manino makārasya mā bhūt| "pratijñāyate iti pratijñā"| "ātaścopasarge" iti karmaṇyaṅ| pratijñā ānunāsikyaṃ yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ| evaṃ ca "praratijñāsamadhigamye pratijñāśabdasya lakṣaṇā' iti kliṣṭaṃ vyākhyānaṃ nāśrayaṇīyam, "pāṇinyupajñaṃ vyākaraṇam" ityādiṣviva lakṣaṇāṃ vinaiva nirvāhāt| yadyapi sūtrakārakṛto'nunāsikapāṭha idānīṃ paribhraṣṭastathāpi vṛttikārādivyavahārabalena yathākāryaṃ prāk sthita ityanumīyata iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ralayoriti nyūnaṃ, ṭakārasyāpi madhyagatatvādityata āha-- pratyāhāraṣviti| vyavahriyante iti| pratyāhriyante- saṃkṣipyante varṇā yatreti bāhulakādadhikaraṇe ghañ| yadyapi yogamātramakārādisaṃjñāsvatiprasaktaṃ tathāpi yogarūḍhiriti bhāvaḥ | pratyāhārāścaikacatvāriṃśaditi prāñcaḥ| caturdaśasūtrīsthairhalbhiridbhiḥ kṛtā aṣṭādhyāyyāṃ vyavahṛtā ekacatvāriṃśaditi tasyārthaḥ| tena suptiṅādīnāṃ, rapratyāhārasya, "cayo dvitīyāḥ" iti vārtikasthastha"cay"pratyāhārasya cādhike'pyadoṣaḥ| yattu "ñamaṅantāḍḍaḥ" "yamirñamanteṣvaniḍeka iṣyate" iti ca "ñam" vārtikakṛtā vyavahṛta ityāhuḥ, tadrabhasā'bhidhānam, ādyasyoṇādisūtratvāt , dvitīyasya vyāghrabhūtikārikāsthatvāt; ityāstāṃ tāvat| eṣa ca saṃkhyāniyamo nātīvopayujyata ityupekṣitaḥ| ūkālo'c hrasvadīrghapluta iti samāhāradvandvaḥ| sautraṃ puṃstvam| vāṃ kāla iveti| phalitārthakathanamidam| vigrahastu vaḥ kālo yasyeti bodhyaḥ| ūśabdena svoccāraṇakālo lakṣyate| āye iti| "nipātā ādyudāttāḥ" ityākāra udāttaḥ, yacchabdastu phiṭsūtreṇa| arvāṅ iti| akāro'nudāttaḥ| tasyāditaḥ atantramiti| "upeyivān" ityatropasarga ivāvivakṣitamityarthaḥ| nanu tatra "īyivāṃsamatisridhaḥ" ityādiprayogadarśanādavivakṣā'stu, iha tvavivakṣāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ kim ? iti cellakṣyadarśanaṃ prātiśākhyādikaṃ ceti gṛhāṇa| tathā hi-- "yerāḥ' ityatraikāraḥ, "tanūnapāt' "śacīpatim' ityatra padapāṭhe ūditau cārdhodāttau iti sakalabahvṛcprasiddham| tanūnapācchacīpatiśabdayoḥ "ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat" iti pūrvottarapadayorādyudāttatve kṛte "anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam" iti śeṣanighātaḥ| pūrvapadabhūtayosnūśacī-etayorantyasya pākṣikaṃ svaritatvaṃ prātiśākhye uktam| "jātyavadvā tathāvantau tanūśacīti pūrvayoḥ" iti| tathāsvaritārdhasyodāttatve prātiśākhyamapi-- "ekākṣarasamāveśe pūrvayoḥ svaritaḥ svaraḥ| tasyodāttatarodāttādardhamātrā'rdhameva vā|| anudāttaḥ paraḥ śeṣaḥ sa udāttaśrutirna cet| udāttaṃ vocyate kiñcitsvaritaṃ vā'kṣaraṃ param||" iti| asyārthaḥ-- pūrvayoḥ-- udāttatvānudāttatvayoḥ, ekatra samāveśe sati svarito bodhyaḥ| tasya- svaritasya, svatantrodāttāpekṣayodāttatarā'rdhamātrā bodhyeti | "kva vo'śvāḥ' ityādi hrasvābhiprāyam| "ardhaṃ vā" iti dīrghābhiprāyam| anenaiva hrasvasyāpi saṅgrahād vyāpakatvādidamevādartavyamiti sūcayitumevakāraḥ| "anudāttaḥ' ityādi pariśeṣasiddhārthakathanam| saḥ- śeṣaḥ, udāttaśrutiḥ syāt| kimaviśeṣeṇa? netyāha- nacedityādi| udāttasvaritaparaṃ vihāyetyarthaḥ| śākalyo'pyāha-- "aprākṛtastu yaḥ svāraḥ svaritodāttapūrvagaḥ| udādāyārdhamasyātha śiṣṭaṃ nighnanti kampitam"|| iti| udādāya- udāttaṃ kṛtvā| "ardhahrasvaśabdenārdhamātrā lakṣyate' iti haradattādigranthāstu matāntaraparatayā kathañcinneyāḥ| kveti| kimo't, tit svaritam| va iti| "anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau" ityadhikārādanudāttam| aśvā iti| aśeḥ kvani nitsvareṇādyudāttam| saṃhitāyāṃ tu "ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ" ityokāra udāttaḥ| ye arā iti| dvayamapi phiṭsūtreṇāntodāttam| ekādeśastu pakṣe svaritaḥ| "svarito vā'nudātte padādau" ityukteḥ| "mukhaṃ ca nāsikā ca" iti vigrahe prāṇyaṅgatvādekavadbhāve "mukhanāsikam' iti syādata āha-- mukhasahiteti| "tulyāsya" āsye bhavamāsyaṃ "śarīrāvayavādyat" ityabhipretyāha-- tālvādīti| ābhyantareti| etacca praśabdabalāllabhyate| tulyāsyaṃ kim ? tarptā| atra pakārasya takāre pare "jharo jhari" iti lopo mā bhūt| prayatnagrahaṇaṃ kim ? vāk ścotati| śasya lopo na| ñamaṅaṇanānāmiti| "nāsikā ca' iti cakāreṇa svasvavargānukūlaṃ tālvādi samuccīyate| "anusvārottamā anunāsikāḥ" iti taittirīyāṇāṃ prātiśākhyam| "yamānusvāranāsikyānāṃ nāsikā, anunāsikāścottamāḥ" iti kātyāyanaprātiśākhyam|"vargottamā ñamaṅaṇanā anunāsikā bhavanti, caśabdātsvasthānādyaparityāgena nāsikāsthānaṃ dvitīyameṣāmityarthaḥ" iti tadbhāṣyaṃ ca| "edaitoḥ" ityādau taparatvamasandehārthaṃ, na tu tatkālagrahaṇārtham| tena plutasyāpi saṃgrahaḥ| pūrvatrāsiddham yadyayaṃ svatantro vidhiḥ syāt, tarhi "tripādī pūrvaṃ pratyasiddhā' ityeva labhyeta, traipādikama tu pūrvaṃ prati paraṃ nāsiddhaṃ syādata āha-- adhikāro'yamiti| yadyatra kāryāsiddhatvamiṣyeta, tarhi pūrvatrāsiddhamiti "manorathaḥ' ityādāvutvaṃ na syāt, paratvāt "ro ri" ityasya prasaṅgāt| tathā ca "pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedho'bhāvāduttarasya" iti siddhānto vyākupyeta| amū, amī ityādi ca na sidhyedata āha-- tripādīti, paraṃ śāstramiti ca| etena tripādyāṃ vihitaṃ kāryamityādiḥ prācāṃ granthaḥ parāstaḥ| vivṛṇvate kaṇṭhamiti|| vivāra eṣāṃ prayatna iti bhāvaḥ| vargayamagā iti|| vargagā yamagāścetyarthaḥ| kādaya iti|| lokaprasiddhapāṭhāpekṣamidam, caturdaśasūtryāṃ māvasānatvāyogāt| ardhavisargeti|| sādṛśyamuccāraṇe lekhane ca bodhyam| ṛlṛvarṇayoriti|| ā ca ā ca ralau, tau ca tau varṇau ceti vigrahaḥ, uśca ul ca ṛloḥ, tayoḥrvarṇayoriti vā; prathamāntena, pariniṣṭhitavibhaktyā vā vigraha iti siddhāntāt| "ṛtyakaḥ" iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| nā''jjhalau ākārasahita iti|| atra ca "kālasamayavelāsu" ityādinirdeśāḥ praśleṣe liṅgam| na caivamapi yiyā3so, ityādau "guroranṛta"iti plutādakārātparasya sanaḥ sasya ṣatvaṃ syādeveti vācyam, āśca āśceti dvandve savarṇadīrgheṇa dīrghātparatra plutādapi praśliṣyata iti vyākhyānāt| yaṇādikamiti| śītalaśabde savarṇadīrgha ādiśabdārthaḥ| atreti| atraivetyarthaḥ| yadyapīti| grahaṇakaśāstrasyādyāpyaniṣpatteriti bhāvaḥ| "ho ḍhaḥ" ityupalakṣaṇaṃ- ramāsvityatra ṣattvaṃ, vāgaśīrityatra "jhayo haḥ" ityākārasya ghakāraḥ, dāsīṣṭetyādau "dādeḥ" iti ghatvaṃ ca neti bodhyam| yadi tu vivṛtamūṣmaṇāmityatra īṣadityanuvartya svarāṇāṃ cetyatra nivartya prayatnabhedo vyākhyāyate, tadā "nājjhalau"iti sūtraṃ māstviti bhāṣye sthitam| vṛddhirādaic aijiha dvimātra eva, tātparatvāt| tena kṛṣṇaikatvamityatra trimātro na| evamuttarasūtre'pi| tena gaṅgodakamityādau trimātro na|| bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ|| bhūśca vāśceti dvandvaḥ| ādiśabdayorvyavasthā-prakāravācinorekaśeṣaḥ| bhūvau ādī yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| bhūprabhṛtayo vāsadṛśāḥ| sādṛśyaṃ ca kriyāvācakenetyabhipretya āha-- kriyāvācina iti| kriyāvācinaḥ kim ? "yāḥ paśyasi' ityādau dhātutvaṃ mā bhūt| sati hi tasmin "āto dhātoḥ" iti syāt| bhvādayaḥ kim ? hiruk, pṛthagityādīnāṃ, śiśye iti bhāvārthatiṅantasya ca mā bhūt| stambhvādīnāmuditkaraṇena sautrāṇāṃ dhātutvaṃ jñāpyate| culumpādīnāṃ tu "bahulametannidarśanam" iti gaṇasūtreṇa saṃgrahaḥ|| cādayaḥ adravyārthāḥ kim ? paśuḥ| liṅgasaṅkhyānvitaṃ dravyam| iha tu syādeva--lodhaṃ naśyanti paśu manyamānāḥ| "paśu" iti samyagarthe| upasargāḥ nis dur iti sāntau, "nisastapatau" iti nirdeśāt "ayogavāhānāmaviśeṣeṇa" iti prakaraṇe niṣkṛtaṃ duṣkṛtamityudāhṛtya "idudupadhasya sakārasya yo visarjanīyaḥ" iti bhāṣyakārokteśca| "upasargasyāyatau" iti sūtre vāmano'pyevam| "niraḥ kuṣaḥ" "suduroradhikaraṇe" iti nirdeśādrephāntāvapīti tatraiva sūtre haradattaḥ|| || || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāṃ saṃjñāprakaraṇam|| || atha paribhāṣāprakaraṇam|| iko guṇavṛddhīḥ guṇavṛddhiśabdābhyāmiti| etacca pūrvasūtrābhyāṃ guṇavṛddhipade anuvartya guṇo vṛddhiriti ye guṇavṛddhī iti yojanayā labhyate| teneha na-- "diva aut" dyauḥ, "tyadādīnāmaḥ" saḥ, imam| ṣaṣṭhyantamiti| sūtre ṣaṣṭhyantasyānukaraṇācchabdasvarūpaparatayā napuṃsakātsorlugiti bhāvaḥ| padamiti| tacca sambhavati sāmānādhikaraṇye igantasyāṅgasyetyādikrameṇa sambadhyate| "miderguṇaḥ" "mṛjervṛddhiḥ" ityādau tu sāmānādhikaraṇyā-sambhavānmidimṛdajyoravayavasyeka iti saṃbadhyate| yattu ika eva sthāne sta iti prācā vyākhyātam, yacca taṭṭīkākṛtoktamaniyamaprasaṅge niyamārthamidamityādi, tatsarvaṃ bhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam| taccheṣapakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā padopasthitipakṣasyaiva bhāṣye samarthitatvādityāhuḥ| taccheṣapakṣe'pi dūṣaṇoddhārastu śabdakaustubhe spaṣṭīkṛto'smābhiḥ| acāṃ madhya iti|| yattu prācoktamantyādacaḥpara iti| tanna, "śe mucādīnām" ityādāvantyasyāco'sambhavāt| tasyaivāntāvayava iti| tena trapūṇītyādau aṅgasya nāntatvena dīrghaḥ siddhaḥ| parāditve sa na sidhyet| abhaktatve tu vahaṃliha ityatra "vahābhre lihaḥ" iti khaśi "arurdviṣad" iti mumo'nusvāro na syāt, apadāntatvāt| yattu abhaktatve dīrgho na syāditi, tat "tadādigrahaṇaṃ syādinumartham" ityaṅgasaṃjñāsūtrasthavārtikenaiva dūṣitaprāyam| sthāneyogeti|| sthānena yogo'syā iti vigrahaḥ| nipātanādetvam| anekavidhamiti|sthānārthaguṇapramāṇakṛtamityarthaḥ| balīya iti| tena cetā stotetyatra pramāṇata āntaryavānakāro neti bhāvaḥ| tasminniti saptamyantāmanukaraṇam| niḥśabdo nairantaryaparaḥ| diśiruccāraṇakriyaḥ| aci yaṇityukte vyavahite'vyavahite ca sati prāptamavyavahite eveti, pūrvasya parasya ca prāptaṃ pūrvasyaiveti ca niyamyate | avyavahitasyeti tu phalitārthakathanam| parasya yaditi|| "tasmādityuttarasyādeḥ" iti tu na sūtritam| āderityaṃśasya sarvādeśabādhakatvāpatteḥ| siddhānte tu paratvātsarvādeśatvaṃ bādhakamityanupadameva vakṣyati|| anekāl śitsarvasya śita udāharaṇam "idama iś" itaḥ| yattu vṛttikṛtā "jaśśasoḥ śiḥ" ityudāhṛtam| tanna, sarvādeśatāyāḥ prāk śittvasyaivālābhāt| tatra hi ḍāṇalorivānupūrvyādanenaiva sarvādeśatvamiti siddhāntaḥ| ityādāviti| ādiśabdena "ato bhisa ais" iti gṛhyate| paratvāditi| ata eva "ādeḥ parasya" iti pṛthak kriyate ityuktam| "uttarasya" ityaṃśastu auśaisorapi pravartata eva| yattu prācā "ādeḥ" iti sūtraṃ vivṛṇvatā pañcamīnirdeśenetyādyuktaṃ, tadasambaddhamiti spaṣṭameva| paranityeti| parānnityaṃ yathā-- tudati,ruṇaddhi| paramapi laghūpadhaguṇaṃ bādhitvā "radhijabhoḥ" iti num| na ca so'pi śabdāntaraprāptyā'nitya iti vācyam, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgamātreṇāpi kvacinnityatābhyupagamāt| antaraṅgaṃ yathā-- ubhaye devamanuṣyāḥ| iha "prathamacarama"iti paramapi vikalpaṃ bādhitvā "sarvādīni" iti sarvanāmasaṃjñā vibhaktinirapekṣatvenāntaraṅgatvāt| apavādo'pi yadyanyatra caritārthastarhyantaraṅgeṇa bādhyata eva| tadyathā-- ayaje indraṃ, grāme iha, sarve ittham| atrāntaraṅgeṇa guṇena savarṇadīrgho bādhyate| sa ca yadyapi yaṇguṇayorapavādastathāpi samānāśraye caritārthaḥ| tathā ca vārtikam-- "iṇṅiśīnāmād guṇaḥ savarṇadīrghatvāt" iti|| asiddhamiti|| tena pacāvedamityādāveta aitvaṃ na| akṛtavyūhā iti|| yadyapi "kṛtamapi kāryaṃ nivartayanti" paribhāṣāntaraṃ paṭhyate, phalaṃ ca tulyam, tathāpi "akṛta" ityeva laghu| "prakṣālanāddhi paṅkasya dūrādasparśanaṃ varam" iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ| na kurvantīti| yathā "niṣeduṣīm" ityādau kvasoriṭamantaraṅgatvātprāptamapi bhāvinā samprasāraṇena valāditvaṃ naṅkṣyatītyālocya na kurvantītyarthaḥ|| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāṃ paribhāṣāprakaraṇam|| || atha acsandhiprakaraṇam|| iko yaṇaci pratyāhāregrahaṇeṣu tadvācyavācye nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā, "dīrghājjasi ca" iti jñāpakāt "lvādibhyaḥ"iti nardeśācca| tenekśabdena ṣaṭṣaṣṭirgṛhrante, yaṇśabdena sapta| bhāvyamānatvena savarṇāgrāhakatve'pi guṇānāmabhedakatvenānunāsikānāmapi yavalānāṃ grahaṇāt| ato nāsti yathāsaṅkhyam| na ca lakṣyārthabodhātpūrvabhāvinaṃ śakyārthabodhamādāya yathāsaṅkhyamastviti vācyam| evamapi tṛtīyacaturthābhyām ṛkāralṛkārābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ triṃśadupasthitau lṛvarṇānāṃ rephādeśasya, ṛvarṇānāṃ lādeśasya ca prasaṅgāt| tasmādiha "sthānentaratama" sūtreṇaiveṣṭasiddhirityabhipretyāha-- sthānata āntaryāditi| anaci ca dve veti|| "yaro'nunāsika" iti sūtrād vāgrahaṇamanuvartate iti "nājjhalau" iti sūtre kaiyaṭaḥ| evaṃ ca "sarvatra śākalyasya" iti sūtraṃ tatprapañcabhūtaṃ pūrvottarasūtradvayaṃ ca nārambhaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ| yattu "dīrghādācāryāṇām" iti sūtre ācāryagrahaṇaṃ pūjārthamityabhipretya vākk iti bhāṣyodāhṛte vikalpe upapatticintārthaṃ kliśyante, tanmudhaiva; pūjārthatāyāḥ prāmāṇikairanukteḥ| "triprabhṛtiṣu" iti sūtre śākaṭāyanagrahaṇasyāpi tathāpatteḥ| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, saṃskarteti trisakāraparakaiyaṭaharadattādigranthavirodhāt svagranthavirodhācca| ata eva prātiśākhyabhāṣye'pi "ā tvā ratham" iti mantre takārasya dvitvavikalpa udāhṛtaḥ| mādhavena cāste ityatra sakārasya dvitvavikalpa uktaḥ| evaṃ ca dhātraṃśa ityatra takārasya dvitvamasadityuktirevāsatīti dik|| sthānivadādeśaḥ "dhātvaṅgakṛttaddhitāvyayasuptiṅpadādeśā" iti prācoktam| tat parigaṇanamudāharaṇamātraṃ vā ? nādyaḥ| sicksacaṅaṅādīnāṃ śnādeśasya śānacaścāsaṅgrahāpatteḥ| nāntyaḥ| avyayasyāṅgapadābhyāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇavaiyarthyāt| prastutyeti vṛttikāroktaṃ tadudāharaṇamapi mandam| ktvāmātrasyānavyayatvāt, kṛttvena siddhatvāccetyāśayenāha-- ādeśa iti| analvidhāviti kim ? tena, tasmāt, tasya,taÏsmaśca vidhau mā bhūt| tatra alā vidhau yathā-vyūḍhoraskena| atra sakārasya sthānivatvena visargavadaṭtvamāśritya "aḍvyavāye" iti ṇatvaṃ prāptam| alaḥ parasya-- dyauḥ, panthāḥ| halṅyādilopo na| alo vidhau dyukāmaḥ| vali lopo na| ali vidhau--yajeḥ ktaḥ, ka iṣṭaḥ| "haśi ca" ityutvaṃ na| al ceha sthānyavayava eva gṛhyate| tena rāmāyetyādau "supi ca" iti dīrghaḥ siddhaḥ| tadvidhau hi yañāditvamāśritaṃ, yañcādeśāvayavo na tu sthānyavayava iti| tadetatsakalamabhipretyāha- na tu sthānyalāśraya iti| āśrayaṇaṃ ceha yathākathañcinna tu prādhānyenaivetyāgrahaḥ| tena prapaṭhyetyatra valādilakṣaṇa iṇ na| tanniṣedhāditi| sthānivattvaniṣedhādityarthaḥ|| acaḥ alvidhyarthamiti| tena vavraścetyatra vasya samprasāraṇaṃ na | uradatvasya sthānivatvena saṃprasāraṇatayā "na saṃprasāraṇa-" iti niṣedhāt| na coradatvaṃ paranimittaṃ neti vācyam| aṅgākṣipte pratyaye pare tadvidhānāt, "prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'ṅgādhikāraḥ" iti pakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā "āsapātamasamāpteḥ" iti pakṣasyaiva ākare siddhāntitatvāt| kiṃ ca pūrvasūtreṇa sthāniprayuktamatidiśyate natvādeśaprayuktaṃ vāryate, "nāyakaḥ" "pāvakaḥ" ityādau "eco'yavāyāvaḥ" ityādīnāmapravṛttiprasaṅgāt| anena tu vāryate, śabdādhikāramāśritya bhāvābhāvayorubhayorapyatideśo'yamiti svīkārāt| "na padānta" iti sūtre yalopadīrghādigrahaṇaṃ ceha liṅgam| ata eva "gaṇayati" ityādau na vṛddhiḥ| sthānini satyabhavantyāstasyā ādeśe'pyabhāvātideśāt| uktaṃ ca "kāmamatidiśyatāṃ vā saccāsaccāpi neha bhāro'sti" iti| syādetat| pūrvatvasya sāvadhitvena sannihitasyaiva avadhitvamucitam| sannihitaṃ ceha trayam sthānī, ādeśo, nimittaṃ ca| tatra na tāvat sthānī avadhistasyādeśenāpahārāt| nāpyādeśanimitte, "vaiyākaraṇa" ityatra aikārasyāyādeśāpatterityāśaṅkyāha-- acaḥ pūrvatvena dṛṣṭasyeti| pūrvatvamupalakṣaṇaṃ na tu viśeṣaṇamati bhāvaḥ| etena "acaḥ pūrvatvavijñānādaicoḥ siddham" iti vārtikaṃ vyākhyātam|| na padānta padasya caramāvayava iti| vṛkṣaṃ vetīti vṛkṣavīḥ, vātīti vṛkṣavāḥ, tamācaṣṭe vṛkṣav, vic| iha "lopo vyoḥ---" iti valopo na, sthānivattvāt| na ca "na padānta--"iti niṣedhaḥ, iha vidheyasya lopasya padānavayavatvāt| padāntasya sthāne vidhau neti vyākhyāpane tu nedaṃ sidhyet| "subantāṇṇic" iti haradattādimate'ntarvartisupā padatvāt| na ca "iṣṭhavat" ityatidiṣṭena ṇici bhatvena padatvabādhaḥ; ṇerluptatvāt; na ca pratyayalakṣaṇam, varṇāśrayatvāditi bhāvaḥ| dvirvacanādau ceti| yalopādaya ādiśabdagrāhyāḥ| "vare" iti tu vare yo'jādeśaḥ sa na sthānivaditi vyākhyeyam| sahavivakṣā'bhāve'pi nipātanād dvandvaḥ saptamyaluk ca| athodāharaṇāni, padānte-- kāni santi, kau staḥ| dvirvacane-- suddhayupāsyaḥ| vare-- yāyāvaraḥ| "yaśca yaṅaḥ" iti varac, ato lopaḥ| sa ca "āto lopa iṭi ca" ityālope kartavye na sthānivat| yalope-- yātiḥ| yāteryaṅantāt ktic, ato lopaḥ, yalopaḥ, allopasya sthānivatvādāto lopaḥ, yalopaḥ| na ca punarālopaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, ciṇoluṅnyāyenā''tolopasyāsiddhatvātsthānivadbhāvācca| svare-- cikīrṣakaḥ| sano'to lopo "liti" itikakārekārasya udāttatve kartavye na sthānivat| savarṇānusvārayoḥ-- śiṇḍhi| dīrghe-- pratidīvnā| jaśi-- sagdhiśca me| adanaṃ gdhiḥ| adeḥ ktini "bahulaṃ chandasi" iti ghaslādeśaḥ, "ghasibhasorhali-" ityupadhālopaḥ, "jhalo jhali" iti salopaḥ, ghatvam, ghasya jaśtvam| "sahasya saḥ" iti sūtrāt sa ityanuvartamāne "samānasyacchandasyamūrdhaprabhṛtyudarkeṣu"iti sūtreṇa saḥ| cari-- jakṣatuḥ|| saṃyogāntasya tadantasyeti| alo'ntyaparibhāṣayeti bhāvaḥ| yadyapi viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhilābhāt saṃyogasyetyeva sūtrayitumucitaṃ tathāpi pratyekaṃ saṃyogasaṃjñeti pakṣe dṛṣatkarotītyādau lopaṃ vārayituṃ saṃyogāvantau yasyeti dvivacanāntena samāsalābhārthamantagrahaṇam| vṛttau hi upasarjanānāmekatvasaṃkhyautsargikī dvitvādikaṃ tu prayatnalabhyamiti bhāṣye sthitam|| "yaṇa--" iti vācanikam| yadvā vācyo vyākhyeyaḥ| vyākhyā ca dvedhā-- "jhalo jhali" ityato jhalgrahaṇamapakṛṣya jhala eva lopo vidhīyate iti, antaraṅge lope kartavye bahiraṅgasya yaṇo'siddhatvamiti vā| na ca ṣāṣṭhī asiddhaparibhāṣā tripādīsthatvenāsiddhamantaraṅgaṃ lopaṃ na paśyatīti vācyam| kāryakālapakṣābhyupagamāt| na ca "nājānantarye bahiṣṭvapraklṛptiḥ" iti niṣedhaḥ| tasyānityatvāt, uttarakālapravṛtte lope ajānantaryābhāvācca| tathā ca vārtikam--"saṃyogāntasya lope yaṇaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ","na vā jhalo lopād", "bahiraṅgalakṣaṇādvā" iti| iha yathoddeśapakṣe ādyaṃ vārtikadvayam, tṛtīyaṃ tu kāryakālapakṣe iti vivekaḥ| yattvāhuḥ-- vārtikakṛto vacanaṃ, pratyākhyānaprakāradvayaṃ tu bhāṣyakṛta iti| tannirmūlam, matabhede pramāṇābhāvāt| yadapyāhuḥ--kāvyaṃ, kalatraṃ, śālvaṃ cācakṣāṇaḥ kāv, kalat, śāl; adabhrayateraghab iti, tadapi na, pakṣatraye'pi saṃyogāntalopasya durlabhatvāt| ādyapakṣasyaikarūpyārthaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvamantaraṅgaṃ paraṃ paraṃ bahiraṅgamityallopaṇilopayorasiddhatvasya suvacatvāt| ata eva kātantrapariśiṣṭe śuklayateḥ kvipi śukl ityudāhṛtam| vāntayoḥ kvipi ūṭho durvāratvāt| na ca sthānivatvam, kvau vidhiṃ prati tanniṣedhāt; vici "lopo vyoḥ--"iti lopasya prasaṅgācca| giriveśmayatestu kvipi yaṇaḥ pratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanārambhapakṣe giriveḍityucitam| pratyākhyānapakṣe tu māntameveti dik| iti pakṣa iti|| pakṣadvayasyāpi bhāṣye sthitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| catvāri rūpāṇīti| yattu vadanti-- dhakārayakārobhayadvitve ubhayoḥ punardvitve lopavikalpe'nyataradvitve ca nava rūpāṇi| tathā hi-- ekadhaṃ tridhā--ekayaṃ dviyaṃ triyaṃ ca| evaṃ dvidhaṃ tridhaṃ ca tridheti| na cāntaraṅge dvitve bahiraṅgasya yaṇo'siddhatvam, traipādike'ntaraṅge bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā na pravartata iti visarjanīyasūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayorvyavasthāpitatvāditi| atredaṃ vaktavyam-- punardvitvamaśudhdam, ekasyāṃ vyaktau ekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sakṛdeva pravartate iti "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" iti sūtre bhāṣye siddhāntitatvāt| anyathā dvitvānāmanantyāpatteḥ| na ca "jharo jhari" iti "halo yamām--" iti ca lopena nirvāhaḥ, lopasya vaikalpikatvāt| kathamanyathā tridhaṃ triyaṃ ceti bhavaduktiḥ saṅgaccheta| kiṃ caivaṃ sati "sarvasya dve" iti punaḥ punaḥ pravarteta| ata eva "liṭi dhātoḥ"iti sūtre'bhyāsagrahaṇaṃ bhāṣye pratyākhyātam| sannantādyaṅantādvā ṇici caṅi dvitvābhāvārthaṃ taditi tu kaiyaṭādibhiruktam| tasmādiha tyaja vā pañcamādīni rūpāṇi svīkuru vā rūpānantyamiti navatvoktirasaṅgataiva| sakāradvitvenāṣṭau, visargadvitvena ṣoḍaśeti tvanyadetat| yadapyuktaṃ traipādike'ntaraṅge ityādi, tadapi na, "nārkuṭa" "nārpatyaḥ" ityatra visargavāraṇāya vṛddherasiddhatvasya tatraiva bhāṣye spaṣṭatvāt| "saṃyogāntalope yaṇaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ" ityasya bahiraṅgatvena pratyākhyātatvāt| svayamapi tathaivānūditatvācca| tasmādiha yathoddeśapakṣo grāhyo bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā apravṛttaye| tathā ca bhāṣye mayaḥ parasya yaṇo dvitve "dadhyatra" ityudāhmatam| na caivamapi "iko'savarṇe--" iti śākalena rūpāntaranastviti vācyam| samāse tanniṣedhāt| na ca nityasamāsa eva tanniṣedha iti vācyam| bhāṣye nityagrahaṇasya pratyākhyātatvāt| yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyāt| nanviha yaṇeva durlabhaḥ, sudhīśabdasya dhyāyateḥ samprasāraṇena niṣpannatvena "samprasāraṇācca" iti pūrvarūpāpatteḥ; iti cet ? na, "samprasāraṇapūrvatve samānāṅgagrahaṇam" iti vārtikokteḥ, samprasāraṇasthānikasyātathātvācca| na caivamapi "nabhūsudhiyoḥ" iti yaṇniṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, āṅgatvena pratyaye parata eva tasya pravṛtteḥ, anantarasyeti nyāyena "eranekācaḥ--' iti "ossupi" iti ca sūtradvayena prāptasyaiva niṣedhācca| dhātraṃśa iti| atra rephasya dvitvaṃ na | dvitvaprakaraṇe rahābhyāmiti sākṣācchrutena nimittabhāvena rephasya kāryitvabādhāt| sudhyupāsya ityādau tu sthānitvena nimittatvamikaḥ "tasmādityuttarasya" ityādinirdeśājjñāpakānna bādhyata iti kaiyaṭaḥ| takārasya tu bhavatyevetyuktam, tacca vā; ityato'tra rūpadvayam| lākṛtiriti tvekameva| halo yamām lopaḥ syādveti| "jhayo haḥ--" ityato'nyatarasyāmityanuvṛtteḥ| etacca laṇsūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam| māhātmyamiti| atra malopo netyarthaḥ| "halo yarāṃ yari savarṇe lopaḥ" iti tu na sūtritam| ārdhnot, mūrdhnaḥ, śārṅgam, ārtnī ityādau rephātparasya lopāpatteḥ||halo yamām|| lopaḥ syādveti| "jhayo haḥ--" ityato'nyatarasyāmityanuvṛtteḥ| etacca laṇsūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam| māhātmyamiti| atra malopo netyarthaḥ| "halo yarāṃ yari savarṇe lopaḥ" iti tu na sūtritam| ādhrnot, mūdhrnaḥ, śāṅrgam, ārtnīḥ ityādau rephātparasya lopāpatteḥ|| vānto yi yakārādāviti| viśeṣaṇamātmāntasya sañjñā syādityetadarthakasya "yena vidhiḥ"iti sūtrasyāpavādabhūtena "yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe" iti vārtikenāyamartho labhyate| odautoriti| pūrvasūtre tayoreva vāntau prati sthānitvena nirṇītatvādityarthaḥ| nanu gavyūtirityatra "hali sarveṣām" iti, "lopaḥ śākalyasya" iti vā lopaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāha--vānta iti| lavyamiti| lunāteraco yat| "sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ" iti guṇaḥ| avaśyalāvyamiti| "orāvaśyake" iti ṇyat|| kṣayyamiti| "śaki liṅ ca" iti cātkṛtyāḥ| kṣeyamiti| "arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca" iti yat| hara ehīti| iha "omāṅośca"iti pararūpaṃ prāptam|| uraṇ raparaḥ āntaratamyāditi| rephaśiraskasyār ityasya rephadvārā ṛkāreṇa sthānasāmyādityarthaḥ| pakṣe dvitvamiti| ṛdherdhasyeti bhāvaḥ|| lopo veti| "jhayo honyatarasyām" iti sūtrādvikalpānuvṛtteḥ| etacca "nājjhalau" iti sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ spaṣṭam| prācastu vikalpānuvṛtteranukternyūnatā| yadapi vyākhyātṛbhiḥ "śaro'ci' iti jñāpakamabhipretya tatsaṃvādārthaṃ bhāṣyamupanyastam-- "anuvartate vibhāṣā śaro'ci yadvārayatyayaṃ dvitvam" iti, tanna, taduttarabhāṣye eva uktajñāpakasya dūṣitatvāt| lopasya hi nityatve "aco rahābhyām--" iti dvitvaṃ lopāpavādaḥ syāt| tathā ca "śaro'ci" ityasya sārthakyaṃ spaṣṭameva| tasmādvikalpānuvṛttau jñāpakāntaramanusartavyam, bhāṣyakārādivyākhyānameva vā śaraṇam| dvitvalopayoriti| yattu dvitvavidhānasāmarthyād dvāveva śiṣyete iti, tanna, lopasya vaikalpikatvena dvitvasya pakṣe caritārthatvāt| tridhamiti| "yaṇo maya" lakṣaṇāntareṇa punardvitve tu caturdhamapi bodhyam || etyedhatyūṭhsu atra ecītyanuvartate| tacca etereva viśeṣaṇaṃ natvedhateḥ, avyabhicārāt| nāpyūṭhaḥ, asambhavāditi prāñcaḥ| atra kaiyaṭaḥ-- edhaterapi viśeṣaṇam| mā bhavānpredidhadityatra vyabhicārāt| yadyapīdaṃ kaiyaṭapustakeṣu prāyeṇa na dṛśyate, tathāpi kvacid dṛśyata eva| na ca "ṇau caṅi--' iti hrasve kṛte nāyamedhatiriti vācyam| ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt| na caivamapi "ajāderdvitīyasya" iti dhiśabdasthāne dhidhiśabdādeśe sati vasnasoriva prakṛtipratyayavibhāgasammoha iti vācyam| dviḥprayogo dvirvacanaṃ ṣāṣṭhamiti ṣāṣṭhabhāṣye siddhāntitatvāt| anyathehaiva ṇilopo na syāt| jighāṃsatītyādau sanaḥ sakāreṇa viśiṣṭasya dvitve kṛte hyasvo na bhavatyeveti vācyam| oṇerṛditkaraṇena bahiraṅgasyāpi "ṇau caṅi--" iti hrasvasya prathamaṃ pravṛttiriti jñāpitatvāt| atra mādhavaḥ-- mā bhavānpredidhadityatra nātiprasaṅgaḥ| ṇyantasya śabdāntaratvādedhatigrahaṇenāgrahaṇāt| ata eva hi "na bhābhūpūkamigami--" ityatra " ṇyantānāṃ ca bhādīnāmupasaṃkhyānam" ityuktam| tatraiva śabdāntaratvādaprāptāvupasaṃkhyānamiti kaiyaṭanyāsakāraharadattādibhiḥ sarvairevoktam| kiṃ ca ṇyadhikasyāpi grahaṇe "upasargātsunoti--" ityatrābhiṣāvayatītyudāhṛtya ṇyantenābheryogātsunotiṃ pratyanupasargatvātkathaṃ ṣatvamityāśaṅkyābheḥ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣakatvena samādhānaṃ bhāṣyakārādyuktamasaṅgataṃ syāt| na ca "heracaṅi"iti liṅgāt "prakṛtigrahaṇe ṇyadhikasyāpi grahaṇam" iti bhramitavyam| jñāpakasya kutvamātraviṣayakatvāt| tathā ca vārtikam--"heścaṅi pratiṣedhānarthakyamaṅgānyatvāt| jñāpakaṃ tu caṅo'nyatra ṇyante'pi kutvabhāvasya" iti| tasmādyuktivirodhādbhāṣyavārtikavṛttinyāsādigranthaiḥ pūrvāparasvagranthena ca virodhādupekṣyo'yaṃ kaiyaṭa iti| atredaṃ vaktavyam| astu viśiṣṭasya śabdāntaratvaṃ tāvatā'pi prakṛtibhāgasyaidhrūpatvaṃ kenāpagatamityavadhāryatām| na hyupaidhata ityādau tiṅantasyaidhrūpatā nāstīti prakṛtyaṃśe sā hīyate| tathā ca "upasargātsunoti--"iti sūtre vārtikam--"siddhaṃ tvavayavānyatvāt"iti| yattvabhiṣāvayatītyatratyabhāṣyavirodhodbhāvanaṃ, tadviparītam| yataḥ prakṛteḥ sunotirūpānapāyāt kaiyaṭamate siddhā yathoktavyavasthā| tvanmate tu rūpāntaratvena ṇyadhikasyāgrahaṇādasaṅgataiva prāguktavyavasthā syāt| ko hyedhayatisāvayatyorviśeṣaḥ--yadedhateṇryadhikasyāgrahaṇaṃ sunotestu grahaṇamiti| yadapi ṇyantabhādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamupanyastaṃ tadapi nāsmākaṃ pratikūlam, viśiṣṭasya śabdāntaratvena prakṛtyaṃśasya tu ṇicā vyavadhānenopasaṃkhyānasyāvaśyakatvāt| ata eva na tatratyanyāsādibhiḥ svoktyā vā virodhaḥ| pratyuta tavaiva virodhaḥ, ṣāṣṭhe bhāṣyavārtikayoḥ "etyedhatyoḥ--" iti yogaṃ vibhajya "eci" iti viśeṣitatvāt| tasmādiha vṛttigrantho mādhavagranthaścāsaṅgata evābhipretya vyācaṣṭe--ejādyoriti|| akṣauhiṇīti| ūhostyasya ūhinī akṣāṇāmūhinīti vigrahaḥ| parimāṇaviśeṣaviśiṣṭā senā akṣauhiṇī| "pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām" iti ṇatvam| yattu prācā vigṛhītamakṣāṇāmūhaḥ samūhaḥ so'styasyā iti| tadapi uhinīśabdena ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa ityevaṃparatayaiva kathañcinneyam| ūhaśabdena samāse tata inau tu vṛdhdirna syāt, antaraṅgeṇa guṇena bādhāt| apavādabhūtāyā api vṛddherūhinīśabdena vigrahe caritārthatvāt| yathoktaṃ prāk-- "iṇ-ṅi-śīnāmād guṇaḥ savarṇadīrghatvāt" iti| svādīreriṇoḥ || ireriṇyoriti kvācitko'papāṭhaḥ| svairīti ṇinyantasyāstriyāṃ vṛddhyabhāvaprasaṅgāt|svairiṇītyatra tu ṅīpaḥ prāgbhāgamādāya vṛddhirbodhyā| yattu vyācakhyuḥ liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayeti tanniṣphalam|| "prādūhoḍhoḍhyeṣaiṣyeṣu"|| atrohaśabdaḥ kaiścitprakṣipto bhāṣyādau tu na dṛśyate iti prāñcaḥ| idānīntanapustakeṣu tu bhāṣyavārtikayorūhaśabdo dṛśyata eva| nānarthakasyeti| upasthitasyārthasya śabdaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvasaṃbhave tyāgāyogāditi bhāvaḥ| sīradevastvāha- "vraśca" iti sūtre rājeḥ pṛthag bhrājigrahaṇamiha jñāpakamiti| nanvetadayuktam, phaṇādinā rājinā sāhacaryāt tathābhūtasyaiva ṣatvārthatayā bhrājigrahaṇasyopakṣīṇatvāditi cet, vibhrāṭ, vibhrāgiti rūpadvayaṃ hi sādhyaṃ, tacca vraścādisūtre "rājṛ" iti paṭhitvā'pi sādhyam, ekasya bhrājaterṛkārasya prāgapi dātuṃ śakyatvāt- ṛbhrāja iti, bhrājabhāsa iti vikalpasya vācanikatayā ṛkārasya ātmanepadamātraphalakatayā vakṣyamāṇatvena tatsthāne'kārasya supaṭhatvācca| tasmāt sīradevoktaṃ jñāpakamapi samyageva| praiṣya iti| eṣasāhacaryādeṣyo'pi anavyayaṃ gṛhyate| tena ṇyantādiṣeḥ ktvo lyapi pararūpameva, na tu vṛddhiḥ| preṣya gataḥ| pravatsatareti| atra kālāpānusāriṇo vatsaraśabdamapi paṭhitvā vatsare deyamṛṇaṃ vatsarārṇamityudāharanti| apare tu vatsaśabdamapi paṭhanti, tatsarvaṃ bhāṣyādiviruddham|| antādivacca || ihaikaḥ pūrvaparayorityanuvartate yathāsaṃkhyaṃ cetyabhipretyāha- pūrvasyāntavaditi| sthānivatsūtreṇaiva gatārthamidaṃ sūtram| na cālvidhyarthamidamiti bhramitavyam, asyāpyanalvidhāvaniṣṭatvāt| anyathā ayaje indramityatra savarṇadīrghāpatteḥ| tathā ca vārtikam- "na vā atādrūpyātideśāt" iti| na visarga iti| etacca "sukhārtaḥ" ityādāvapi tulyam| atra ca kāryakālapakṣe bahiraṅgatvādasiddhatvamapi bodhyam| na ca "nājānantarya-" iti niṣedhaḥ, yatrāntaraṅge, bahiraṅge vā acorānantaryaṃ tatreti haradattapakṣe tatprāptāvapi yatra paścāt pravartamāne'jānāntaryamiti kaiyaṭamate niṣedhāprāpteḥ| bahvapekṣatvena bahiraṅgāyāṃ vṛddhāvajānantaryasattve'pi paścāt pravartamāne tadabhāvāt| upasargeṇeti| yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ pratyeva gatyupasargasaṃjñā ityuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ| prārṣabhīyatīti| "śaro'ci" iti dvitvaniṣedhaḥ| prejate iti| ejṛ dīptau| kampanārthastu parasmaipadī| ejate kampate iti tu prācāṃ vyākhyānaṃ prāmādikameva| eṅyeṅityeva siddhe paragrahaṇamuttarārthaṃ rūpagrahaṇaṃ tu cintyaprayojanam, "eṅi paraḥ" ityeva siddheḥ| yathā "ami pūrvaḥ" iti| niyogo'vadhāraṇamiti| yadāhuḥ- "anavaklṛptau yadā dṛṣṭaḥ pararūpasya gocaraḥ| evastu viṣayo vṛddherniyame'yaṃ yadā bhavet"|| iti| etena "niyojanaṃ niyogo vyāpāraḥ" iti vyākhyānaṃ parāstam, "yadaiva pūrvaṃ jvalane śarīraṃ" "mamaiva janmāntarapātakānām" ityādiprayogavirodhāt, udāhṛtavṛttisthaślokavirodhāt, "laṅaḥ śākaṭāyanasyaiva" "tapastapaḥkarmakasyaiva" ityādisautraprayogavirodhācca| yattu ślokavārtikamidamityāhuḥ, tadrabhasāt| śakandhvādiṣviti| śakandhvādiviṣaye tatsiddhyanuguṇaṃ pararūpaṃ vācyamityarthaḥ| ata evāha- tacca ṭeriti| yadi tu "āt" ityadhikārādakārasyaiveṣyeta tarhi manīṣā iti na siddhyeta| kecittu manaḥpatacchabdayoḥ pṛṣodarāditvādantyalope'kārasyaiva pararūpamāhuḥ| śakānāṃ- deśaviśeṣāṇāmandhuḥ - kūpaḥ-śakandhuḥ| karkāṇāṃ rājñāmandhuḥ| badarīvācī tu karkandhūśabdo dīrghāntaḥ, "andhūdṛmbhū-" ityādinā uṇādiṣu vakṣyate| aṭatītyaṭā pacādyac| kulasya aṭā kulaṭā| īṣa uñche, īṣa gatyādiṣu, ābhyāṃ "garośca halaḥ" ityapratyaye īṣā| manasa īṣā manīṣā| halasya īṣā halīṣā- lāṅgaladaṇḍaḥ, mūrddhanyopadhaḥ| yastu- "prabhuśaṅkarayorīśaḥ striyāṃ lāṅgaladaṇḍake||" iti rabhasakeśāt tālavyopadhastasmin pare "ād guṇaḥ ityeva bhavati, haleśā| patannañjaliryasman namaskāryatvāditi patañjaliḥ| mārtaṇḍaḥ| kecidatra savarṇadīrghamāhuḥ| parā mārtāṇḍamāsthat, punarmārtāṇḍamārabhat, viśvo mārtāṇḍo'vrajadityādi-vaidikaprayogāsteṣāmanukūlāḥ| otvoṣṭhayoriti| akārasya otvoṣṭhayoścaikatra samāse sthitau satyāmidaṃ pravartate, teneha na, vṛṣalasutauṣṭhavraṇaste iti| avyaktaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe- dhvaneriti| anukaraṇasyeti| parisphuṭākārādivarṇasyeti bhāvaḥ| tasya cānukaraṇatvaṃ kiñcitsāmyena bodhyam| yattu prācoktam- ataḥ kimॽ dakārānte mā bhūditi| yacca vyākhyātaṃ dakārānta iti rūpāntaropalakṣaṇaṃ vaṭak, marut ityāderapīti, tanniḥsāram, praśnasya, dānta ityuttarasya ca nirālambanatvāt| yattu vyācakhyuḥ- "ato guṇe" ityato'ta ityanuvartya śabdādhikārāśrayaṇāt siddhamiti praśnaḥ| yadā jaśtvavaśād dāntatvaṃ tadāpi syāt punaradgrahaṇe tu śrautatāntatvasya vivakṣaṇānnetyuttaramiti, taccintyam, jaśtvaśāstrasyāsiddhatvena pararūpasyaiva pravṛtteḥ, "nāmreḍitasya" iti niṣedhe paṭatpaṭaditītyudāharaṇasyāsaṃbaddhatvāpatteśca| tatra hi bhavaduktarītyā prāptireva nāsti, dāntatvāt| etenānukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣayā vibhaktyabhāvena gavityayamāhetivadapadatvāt paṭat itītyatra jaśtvaṃ neti grantho'pi pratyuktaḥ, uttaragranthavirodhāt, jaśtvasyāsiddhatayā pararūpaiṇaiva bādhācca| nanu tadapi nityaṃ tathā ca kathaṃ pararūpaviraheṇa prayoga iti cenna, alaukikaṃ prakriyāvākyamidamiti svayameva vyākhyātatvāt, saṃhitāyā avivakṣāyāṃ tatsambhavācceti dik| akaḥ savarṇe aci para iti| yadā tūṣmaṇāmīṣadvivṛtatvamāśritya "nājjhalau" iti sūtraṃ pratyākhyāyate tadā ihācīti nānuvartanīyam| ako'ki dīrgha iti suvacam| varṇadvayaṃ dvimātramiti| yattu prācā vyākhyātaṃ dīrghe prāpte hyasva ṛkāra lṛkāraśca vidhīyata iti tadbhāṣyakaiyaṭādivirodhādupekṣyam|| eṅaḥ padāntāt "ṅasiṅasośca" ityasyārambhādasya padāntaviṣayatve labdhe uttarārthaṃ padāntāditi spaṣṭārthamihaiva kṛtam|| sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ yadyapi chandasīti na prakṛtaṃ tathāpi "yajuṣyuraḥ" ityādiprakramācchandasyevedamiti sambhāvyeta, ataḥ sarvatretyuktam| tadvyācaṣṭe- loke vede ceti| iha "eṅaḥ" ityanuvartyaiṅantasya goriti vyākhyeyam| teneha na--citragvagramiti| pratipadoktasya eṅo grahaṇānneha-- he citrago'gram| prakṛtibhāva iti| "prakṛtyāntaḥ pādam" iti sūtrātprakṛtyetyanuvṛtteḥ| yadyapi bhāṣye "iko guṇavṛdhdī" iti sūtre "nāntaḥ padam" iti pāṭhaḥ sthitaḥ| ṣāṣṭhabhāṣye'pyevam| tathāpi śākalasūtre "hyasvaśca iti cakāreṇa prakṛtyā ityanukṛṣyate" iti bhāṣyadarśanāt "prakṛtyāntaḥ pādam" iti pāṭho'pi sādhureva| "na" iti pāṭhe tu " sarvatra" iti sūtreṇa pūrvarūpameva vikalpyetetyavadheyam| avaṅ sphoṭāyanasya atrāpyeṅantasya goriti vyākhyeyam| agiti sūtrayitumucitam| vibhāṣānuvṛtteḥ sphoṭāyanagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham| gavīti| yattu prācā gave iti pratyudāhṛtam| tanna| satyapyavaṅi- "ato guṇe"iti pararūpeṇa rūpasiddheḥ| na ca satyavaṅi ṅeryādeśaḥ syāt, striyāṃ tu ṭāp syāditi vācyam| sannipātaribhāṣayā yādeśaṭāpoḥ susamādhānatvāt| na ca sā'nityeti vācyam, tāvatāpyautsargikatatpravṛtyeṣṭasiddheḥ| gavākṣa iti| gavāmakṣīveti vigrahaḥ| "akṣṇo'darśanāt" ityac samāsāntaḥ| vātāyane rūḍho'yam| puṃstvaṃ lokāt|| indre ca ārambhasāmarthyānnityamidam| "indre ca nityam" iti pāṭhastu bhāṣyāsamatatvādupekṣitaḥ|| ehi kṛṣṇeti| "dūrāddhūte ca" iti plutaḥ| yattu kṛṣṇā3 ehīti prācoktaṃ, tanna, "dūrāddhūte ca" ityādau "vākyasya ṭeḥ--" ityadhikārāt| cakryatreti| iha "skoḥ--" iti kalopo na| yaṇaḥ kāryakālapakṣe bahiraṅgaparibhāṣayā'siddhatvāt, sthānivadbhāvācca| "pūrvatrāsiddhīye na--" iti tu nāsti, "tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopa--" ityādyukteḥ|| guroranṛtaḥ apiśabdo guroragurośca ṭeḥ plutārthaḥ| devadatteti| asyaihītyādiḥ| evamagre'pi| sarvaḥ pluta iti| tathā ca "agnītpreṣaṇe parasya ca" iti sūtre bhāṣyam " sarvaḥ plutaḥ sāhasamanicchatā'pi vibhāṣā kartavyaḥ" iti| sāhasaṃ śāstratyāgaḥ, tadanicchatā'pi--śāstramanurundhānenāpītyartha iti haradattaḥ| vaikalpikeṣvanuṣṭhānakleśaṃ dharmādhikyaphalakamapyaśakyatvādanicchatetyartha ityanye | etena "dvaipāyano virahakātara ājuhāva putreti" bhāgavataṃ vyākhyātam| plutasya vaikalpikatvāt| kiṃ ceha putraśabdasya vākyāntatvaṃ nāstītyapi suvacam, ākhyātaprāgvartino'pyanukaraṇasambhavāt| api ca astu plutaḥ, prakṛtibhāvastu vairalpikatvānmāstu| tathā ca "ī cākravarmaṇasya" iti sūtre bhāṣyam--"īgrahaṇena nārthaḥ vaśā iyaṃ vaśeyamiti"| plutaprakṛtibhāvaḥ sarvo'pi durlabha eva, "aplutavadupasthite" iti sūtrāt| upasthitaṃ nāmāvaidika itiśabdastasminpare pluto'plutavatsyāditi hi tasyārthaḥ| evaṃ caturdhāpi nirvāhe spaṣṭe ārṣaḥ prayoga iti śrīdharoktirnādartavyā|| dvivacanamiti|| "suptiṅantam" iti antagrahaṇena "sañjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇaṃ nāsti" iti jñāpitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| teneha na | kumāryorvadhvoścāgāraṃ kumāryagāraṃ vadhvagāramiti| spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ bhāṣyādau| dvivacanāntaṃ pragṛhyaṃ syāditi tu prācaḥ pramāda eva| harī etāviti| iha śākalaṃ na| "plutapragṛhya--" ityatra nityagrahaṇādityuktam| atra vṛttikāraḥ-- "maṇīvādināṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ" iti paṭhitvā maṇīva, rodasīva, dampatīva, jampatīvetyudājahāra| tacca munatrayānuktatvādapramāṇamiti kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| evaṃ sthite--- "maṇīvoṣṭrasya lambete priyau vatsatarau mama"|| iti bhārataprayogaṃ samarthayate-- ivārtha iti| vaśabda iti| "vaṃ pracetasi jānīyādivārthe ca tadavyayam" iti medinī|| "va vā yathā tathaivaivaṃ sāmye" ityamaragranthyākhyāvasare "śātravaṃ va papuryaśaḥ" iti kālidāsaprayogasyābhiyuktai-rudāhṛtatvāt| "kādambakhaṇḍitadalāni va paṅkajāni"ityādidarśanācceti bhāvaḥ| yattu pāṭhāntaraṃ "vadvā yathā tathā" ityādi; tadayuktam, nāmaliṅgānuśāsanaprakrame taddhitavaterananuguṇatvāt apatyasamūhādiparyāyamadhye'ṇphiñvuñādīnāmanukteśca| adaso māt || iha ekāro nānuvartate, asambhavāt ityabhipretyāha--īdūtāviti| nanu ukārānuvṛttirvyarthā, striyau phale vā amū āsāte ityatra pūrveṇaiva siddheḥ, mutvasyāsiddhatve'pyekārāntatvādata āha-- rāmakṛṣṇāviti| puṃsi pūrveṇa na sidhyati, aukārāntatvāditi bhāvaḥ| "adaso māt" iti sūtraṃ prati tu mūtvamītve nāsiddhe, ārambhasāmathryāt| ekāro'pīti| tathā ca ekārānanuvṛttitātparyagrahaṇaphalakaṃ mādgrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| atredaṃ cintyam- īdūtsaptamyarthe pragṛ hyam, adasaḥ, ecca dvivacanamityeva kuto na sūtritam| evaṃ hi pūrvasūtrasthamīdūdgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtasūtre mādgrahaṇaṃ ca māstu| ekadeśānuvṛttikleśo'pi neti|| śe chāndasamapīdaṃ saṃdarbhaśuddhyarthamuktam| vastutastvanukaraṇārthatayā lokārthapi sambhavatyeva ? tve rāyo me rāya ityādau tve iti, me iti, ityanukaraṇe prayojanābhāvāt| asme iti-- asmabhyamityarthaḥ| bhyasaḥ "supāṃ suluk" iti śe ādeśaḥ| "śeṣe lopaḥ"|| nipāta anāṅiti paryudāsādevājrūpanipāte labdhe nipātagrahaṇamuttarārthaṃ spaṣṭārthamihaiva kṛtam| ā evamiti| pūrvaṃ prakrāntasya vākyārthasyānyathātvadyotako'yamākāraḥ| pūrvamitthaṃ nāmaṃsthā idānīṃ tvevaṃ manyase ityarthaḥ| ā evaṃ kileti| smaraṇadyotako'yamākāraḥ| vākyetyādi| tathā ca bhāṣyam-- īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādābhividhau ca yaḥ| etamātaṃ ṅitaṃ vidyādvākyasmaraṇayoraṅit||1||iti| atra aṅillakṣaṇa eva tātparyaṃ lāghavāt| anyasya ṅittvaṃ tvarthasiddham| īṣadarthetyādistu avayutyānuvādaḥ| evaṃ ca abhra ām̐ apa ityatra saptamyarthavṛtterapyākārasya ṅitvāt "āṅo'nunāsikaśchandasi" iti pravartata iti bhāvaḥ|| ot nipātaḥ kim ? devo'si vāyavāhi| sambuddhau ṛṣirvedaḥ "taduktamṛṣiṇā" ityādau tathā darśanādityabhipretyāha- avaidika iti| sambuddhau kim ? aho iti| atra paratvādvikalpo mā bhūt| yattu "ot" ityatra nipātānuvṛtteriha ca saṃbuddhigrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ vṛtyādāvuktaṃ gavityayamāheti| tanna, tatra pragṛhrasañjñāsattve'pi prakṛtibhāvāprasakteḥ| "iko'savarṇe" ityatra hi padāntagrahaṇamanuvartata ityakare spaṣṭam| evaṃ ca "plutapragṛhyā" iti sūtre tatsambandha āvaśyakaḥ| gaviti ca na padam| anukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣayā arthavatvābhāvena vibhakteranutpādāt|| uñaḥ "nipāta ekāj" iti prāpte vibhāṣeyam|| ūm̐ anunāsika iti| tenāsmin pare "yaro'nunāsika-" iti vikalpaḥ| yadetanūm̐ iti paṭhasi, yadetanūm̐ iti vā taddīrghamityādi| etadarthameva tatrānunāsikagrahaṇam, anyathā yaro ñami ñamvetyevāvakṣyat|| maya uño vo vā mayaḥ parasyeti| parāditi tu prācaḥ pramādaḥ| "ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya hi ādeśā ucyante" iti bhāṣyāt ādeśavidhau sthāninaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā eva nyāyyatvācca| asiddhatvāditi| ata evedaṃ vatvaṃ tripādyāṃ vidhīyate| prakṛtibhāvamātrabādhanārthatve hi "iko yaṇ--" ityanantaraṃ maya uño vetyevāvakṣyat| yaṇaṃ cānvartayiṣyat| iha maya uña itau pare aṣṭāviṃśatirūpāṇi| tathā hi "uñaḥ" iti pragṛhyatve-- "kimu iti'| vatvapakṣe -- "kimviti'| ūm̐ ādeśe - "kimūm̐ iti'| ādeśasya sthānivatvena "maya uña--" iti prakṛtibhāvāpavādabhūte āntaratamyādanunāsike vakāre--"kimviṃti' | anunāsikānanunāsikayorvakārayoḥ " mayo yaṇa" iti dvitvasya makārasya "anaci ca"iti dvitvasya ca vikalpena vatvapakṣe rūpāṣṭakam| tadabhāve dvayamiti daśakam| prahagṛhyasañjñāvirahapakṣe "maya uña--" iti vatvasyāsiddhatvāt "iko yaṇ-" iti yaṇeva, tasya siddhatvānmo'nusvāre "vā padāntasya"iti parasavarṇapakṣe anunāsikānanunāsikavakāradvayopetamekādaśaṃ rūpam| anunāsikasya dvitve "halo yamām" iti lopasya vaikalpikatvādakaraṇe trivakāraṃ dvādaśaṃ rūpam| parasavarṇābhāvapakṣe anusvārasya yartvāttrvāpākṣike dvitve dve| saṃkalanayā caturdaśa| itiśabdekārasya "aṇo'pragṛhrasya" ityanunāsikavikalpā-daṣṭāviṃśatiriti|| || ityacsandhiḥ|| || atha halsandhiprakaraṇam|| stoḥ ścunā storiti samāhāradvandvaḥ| sautraṃ puṃstvam| ścuneti| "saha yukta--" iti sūtre vināpi tadyogaṃ tṛtīyeti vakṣyate| yoga ityetadadhyāhāralabhyam| atra sthānyādeśayoryathāsaṃkhyam| nimittakāryiṇostu na, "śāt" iti jñāpakāt| "alpāctaram" ityādau tu sautratvāt ścutvaṃ na| tajjñānamityādau tu bhavatyeva| "stoḥ ścau ścuḥ" iti suvacam| na ca "tasminniti nirdiṣṭe-- " iti paribhāṣopasthānena "yajñaḥ" "yācñā" ityādi na sidhyet| "śāt" iti liṅgena tasyā ihānupasthānāt|| ṣṭunā ihāpi kāryinimittayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ na | "toṣṣi" iti jñāpakāt| ṣṭau ṣṭuriti suvacam| īṭṭe, īṣṭe ityādau "na padāntāt--" iti jñāpakānna doṣaḥ| sarpiṣṭamamiti| "hrasvāttādau--" iti ṣatvam| pratyaye bhāṣāyāmiti| yattu prācā mayaṭi nityamiti paṭhitam, yacca halantaprakaraṇe ṣaṇṇāṃ, ṣaḍṇāmityudāhṛtam, yacca "yaro'nunāsika--" iti vā'nunāsika iti tatra vyākhyātaṃ, tatsarvaṃ bhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam| yavādigaṇa iti| "yaci bhaṃ tasau matvarthe" iti saṃhitayā pāṭhe tasāviti tātpūrvaṃ dakāraṃ praśliṣya bhatvenāpyetatsamādhātuṃ śakyam|| udaḥ sthā --" "anusvārasya yayi--" ityatra samastamapi savarṇagrahaṇamiha niṣkṛṣya sambadhyate, ekadeśe svaritatvapratijñānādityāśayenāha-- pūrvasavarṇaḥ syāditi| aghoṣasyetyādi| etena sasya takāra iti prācāṃ granthāḥ pratyuktāḥ| yadapīha "cayo dvitīyāḥ śari" ityasyopanyasanaṃ, tadatirabhasāt|| tacchiva iti| yattu prācā tat śiva ityatra jaśtve kṛte "khari ca" ityuktam| tanna, tado dāntatvena jaśtvopanyāsavaiyarthyāt| yattu tatpautreṇoktaṃ tado "vā'vasāne" iti cartve paścācchiva ityanena sambandhe "jhalāṃ jaśo'nte" iti jaśtve "khari ca" iti cartvamiti, tadatisthavīyaḥ| jaśtvaṃ prati avasāne cartvasyāpavādatvāt| jaśtve śivaśabdānapekṣaṇācca| bhāvinyavasānabhaṅge "vāvasāne" ityasya pūrvamapravṛtteśca| pravṛttasya vā nivṛttisambhavāt| uktaṃ ca "akṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ" iti, "kṛtamapi śāstraṃ nivartayanti" iti ca| anyathā harirayamityatrāpi tvaduktarītyā pravṛtto visargaḥ kena vāryatām| atha tanotīti taditi kvibantaṃ brūṣe evamapi jaśtvena dakāro'stu| cartve kṛte ścutvamiti tu na nyāyyam| ścutvaṃ prati cartvasyāsiddhatvāt| yattu "na mu ne" ityatra "na' iti yogaṃ vibhajyāsiddhatvamiha netyāhuḥ| tadapi na, asiddhatve'pi rūpasidhdau nirbādhāyāṃ yogavibhāgasyāgatikagatibhūtasyehāśrayaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt|| ākraṃsyata iti| "āṅa udgamane" iti taṅ| "snukramoḥ--" iti neṭ|| samasambandhī vidhiriti|| samakarmakaṃ vidhānamiti tu noktam| anuvādyayorapi yathāsaṃkhyasyeṣṭatvāt| "samūlākṛtajīveṣu hankṛñgrahaḥ" ityatra yathā|| ṅṇoḥ kukṭukoḥ pūrvāntatvātprāṅksāye ityatra "sātpadādyoḥ" iti ṣatvaṃ na| sugaṇṭsāye-- ityatra "na padāntāt--" iti ṣṭutvaṃ na | puṣkare tīrthaviśeṣe sīdatīti puṣkarasat, tasyāpatyaṃ pauṣkarasādirācāryaḥ| bāhvāditvādiñ| anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ|| ḍaḥ si dhuṭ "ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān" paratvāt, ityabhipretyāha-- sasyeti| sīti saptamīnirdeśastu lāghavārthaḥ| ṣaṭtsanta iti| dhuṭaścartvena takāraḥ| yattvāhuḥ- "cayo dvitīyā" iti pakṣe tasya tha iti| tanna, cartvasyāsiddhatvāt| ata eva dhuḍbhāve "ṣaṭ santa" ityatra ṭasya ṭho na| ṭakāranakāravisargāṇāṃ dvitvavikalpāt ṣoḍaśa| "khayaḥ śaraḥ" iti sakāradvitve dvātriṃśat| na ca tatra cartvasyāsiddhatvaṃ śaṅkyam, "pūrvatrāsidhdīyamadvitve" ityukteḥ| na ca "śaro'ci" iti dvitvaniṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, tasya sautradvitvamātraviṣayatvāt| ata eva "śaraḥ khayaḥ" iti vārtikasya vatsaḥ, apsarāḥ, ityudāharaṇaṃ bhāṣye sthitam| dhuṭaḥ parāditvaṃ "na padāntāt--" iti ṣṭutvaniṣedhārtham| ata eva vakṣyamāṇastugihaiva na kṛtaḥ| yattvāhuḥ-- evamapi prakriyālāghavāya tuḍeva kartumucita iti| tanna, "cayo dvitīyā" iti pakṣe thakārāpatteḥ|| "ścutvaṃ dhuṭi sidhdaṃ vācyam" aṭatītyaṭ ścotati, iha dhuḍ na | śi tuk śīti saptamī pūrvatra kṛtāyāḥ "naḥ" iti pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kalpayatītyāha- nasyeti| nanu prakṛto dhuḍevāstu kiṃ tukā ? maivam, "śaścho'ṭi" ityasya hi padāntājjhayaḥ parasya śasya cha ityartha ākare sthitaḥ| evaṃ ca dhuṭaḥ parāditvāt sañcchambhurityatra ccho na syāt| vipūrvādraperauṇādike śapratyaye "madhvaścotantyabhito virapśan" ityādau yathā| ataḥ pūrvāntastukkṛtaḥ| nanvevaṃ kurvañcśete ityatra "padāntasya" iti ṇatvaniṣedho na syāditi cenna, kāryakālapakṣe bahiraṅgatvena tuko'siddhatvāt| yathoddeśapakṣe "stoḥ ścunā" iti yogo vibhajyate| "na' iti vartate "ṇaḥ' iti ca| stoḥ ścunā yoge ṇatvaṃ na syāt| nakārārthamidam| sakāragrahaṇaṃ vargagrahaṇaṃ cottarārtham| tataḥ "ścuḥ'iti| pūrvamanuvartate| evaṃ "naśca" iti sūtre kurvantsīdatītyatra "padāntasya" iti ṇatvapratiṣedho dhuṭaḥ parāditve prayojanamiti prācāṃ grantho'pi yathoddeśapakṣe bodhyaḥ| yattu vadanti-- idaṃ prayojanaṃ bahiraṅgaparibhāṣayā gatārthatvāt pratyuktamiti| tatpākṣikam, tripādīsthe'ntaraṅge bahiraṅgaparibhāṣeyaṃ na pravartate iti suddhyupāsya ityudāharaṇe svoktyā saha viruddhaṃ cetyāstāṃ tāvat| sañcchambhuriti| iha ścutvatukorasiddhatāmāśritya "naśchavi" iti rutvaṃ na śaṅkyam| chatvasyāsiddhatvāt| ṅamo hrasvāt ṅam pratyāhāraḥ | sañjñāyāṃ ca kṛtaṃ ṭittvaṃ sāmarthyāt saṃjñibhiḥ sambadhyate| tena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ ṅuṭ-ṇuṭ-nuṭaḥ pravartante| nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham, "he mapare--" iti "maya uño vo vā" iti ca vikalpadvayasya madhye pāṭhādeva nityatvalābhāt| sugaṇṇīśa iti| ṇyallopau na sthānivat, pūrvatrāsiddhe tanniṣedhāt| ṅamuṭaḥ parāditvaṃ kurvannāste ityatra ṇatvaniṣedhārtham| ata eva "ṅamo hrasvādaci dve' iti nāsūtri| paraṃ ṇatvaṃ prati pūrvasya siddhatayā ṇatvāpatteriti prāñcaḥ| yattvāhuḥ-- bahiraṅgaparibhāṣayā gatārthatvādubhayamapyasaṅgatamiti| tadapi pākṣikam| rājña ityatreva yathoddeśe traipādike'ntaraṅgaparibhāṣāvirahasyoktatvena prācāṃ granthasya sauṣṭhavāt| kathamanyathā dviyaṃ triyaṃ ca svayamevoktamiti dik| nanu paramadaṇḍināvityādau antarvartivibhaktayā padatvānnuṭ syāditi cenna| "uttarapadatve cāpadādividhau" iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt| ata eva paramavācau, paramagoduhau, paramalihāvityādau kutvaghatvaḍhatvādīni na| yattu prācā "uñi ca pade" ityataḥ "pade' ityanuvartyājādeḥ padasyeti vyākhyānād ṅamuḍ netyuktaṃ, tadanena pratyuktam| ihaiva nalopaṃ vārayitumuktarītereva tenāpyanusartavyatvāt|| samaḥ suṭi yadyapi mo'nusvāreṇa siddhaṃ tathāpyanunāsikatva-trisakārakatvasiddhyarthamidam|| atrānunāsikaḥ ayamadhikāro vidhirveti dvaitam| ādye'tragrahaṇamanarthakam, adhikārādeva ruprakaraṇalābhāt| tuśabdastvadhikārapakṣe parasmātkāryiṇo viśeṣadyotanārthaḥ--parasya nityaṃ rutvaṃ, pūrvasya tu vā'nunāsika iti; vidhipakṣe vyarthaḥ| vāgrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| "anunāsikātpara--" iti jñāpakādeva siddheḥ| na hi vikalpaṃ vinā'nunāsikābhāvapakṣa iti sambhavati| idameva dhvanayituṃ vṛttau tu veti śabdau noktau|| anunāsikāt lyablope pañcamītyāha-- anunāsikaṃ vihāyeti| evaṃ ca saṃsargavad viprayogasyāpi viśeṣāvagatihetutvādavatsā''nīyatāmityatreva sambhāvitānunāsikyaguṇaka eva upasthitatvādākāṅkṣitatvāccāvadhitvena sambadhyata ityabhipretyāha-- roḥ pūrvasmāditi| anusvārāgama iti| āgamatvaṃ ca paraśabdenaiva labhyate "pūrvau tu tābhyāmaic" ityatra pūrvaśabdenaicoriveti bhāvaḥ|| visarjanīyasya kharīti| etacca maṇḍūkaplutyā "kharavasānayoḥ" iti sūtrādanuvartate| nanvanusvārasyānactvāttataḥ parasya dvitvaṃ na syādevetyata āha-- anusvāravisargetyādi| akāroparīti| yadi tvikāropari paṭhyeran tarhi payaḥsu, yaśaḥsu ityādau iṇaḥ parasyeti ṣatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| actvāditi| na caivaṃ hariḥ kartā, hariṃ smaredityādau yaṇādiprasaṅgaḥ, tripādīsthatvena visargādīnāmasiddhatvāt| anusvārasyāpi dvitva iti| apiśabdātkakārasya| vacanāntareṇeti| "aco rahābhyām" iti kṛte'pi "yaṇo mayaḥ" iti bhavatyeveti bhāvaḥ|| pumaḥ khayi puṃsaḥ saṃyogāntalope kṛte'vaśiṣṭabhāgasyedamanukaraṇam| paryudāsāditi| "idudupadhasya--" iti ṣatvavidhāyake sūtre iti bhāvaḥ| apratyayasya yo visarga iti vaiyadhikaraṇyena vyācakṣāṇānāṃ prācāṃ matenedam| vakṣyamāṇarītyā sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvaye tu ṣatvaprāptāviti bodhyam|| khyāñādeśa iti| ādeśo hi upadeśe khśādiḥ| asiddhaprakaraṇe ṇatvānantaraṃ khśāñaḥ śasya yatvaṃ vikalpyate| tena suprakhyena nirvṛttaṃ sauprakhyaṃ tatra bhavaḥ sauprakhyīyaḥ| yatvasyāsiddhatvāt "dhanvayopadhāt--" iti vuñnetyādi prayojanānyākare sthitāni| evaṃ ca yatvasyāsiddhatayā'mparatvābhāvāt "pumaḥ khayi" iti rutvaṃ netyarthaḥ| puṃkhyānamiti| cakṣiṅo lyuṭ| khyāñādeśaḥ| nanvādeśa iha durlabhaḥ| "varjane pratiṣedhaḥ" "asanayośca" iti vārtikāditi cet? satyam| "bahulaṃ taṇi" "annavadhakagātravicakṣaṇājirādyartham" iti vārtike bahulagrahaṇātsamādheyam| tathā ca khśāditvaprayojanagaṇanavārtikam ruvidhiḥ-- puṃkhyānamiti, ṇatvaṃ-- paryākhyānamiti, niṣṭhānatvamākhyātam iti ca| śakāreṇa vyavadhānāt "kṛtyacaḥ" iti ṇatvaṃ na, tathā ākhyātamityatra "saṃyogāderāta--" iti natvaṃ na, yatvasyāsiddhyā yaṇvattāvirahāt| evaṃ ca "na dhyākhyā--" iti sūtre khyāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ| na ca khyā prakathane, ityetadarthaṃ taditi vācyam| tasya sārvadhātukamātraviṣayatvāt| atra ca "sasthānatvaṃ namaḥ khyātre" ityuttaravārtikaṃ pramāṇam| sasthāna iti jihvāmūlīyasya prācāṃ sañjñā| sa iha na| "śarpare visarjanīyaḥ" ityasya pravṛtteriti bhāvaḥ| yadi svatantro'pi dhāturārdhadhātuke iṣyeta tadā jihvāmūlīyasya durvāratayedaṃ vārtikamasaṅgataṃ syāt| yattu haradattamādhavādibhiruktaṃ khyādhāturapi khśādiryatvavidhirapyubhayasādhāraṇa iti, taccintyam| bhāṣye cakṣiṅa evopakramātsārvadhātuke'pi khśādiprayogāpatteśca| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, mādhavenārdhadhātukeṣvevāyaṃ khśādirityuktatvāt, sārvadhātuke'nabhidhānasyaiva śaraṇīkartavyatvāpattyā gauravagrastatvetyāstāṃ tāvat| syādetat| bahavaḥ pumāṃso'smin kule bahupum khyātītyatra rutvaṃ syāt| uraḥprabhṛtiṣu pumśabdasyaikavacanāntasyaiva pāṭhānneha kap| sārvadhātuke ca khyāteḥ prayogo nirbādha eveti cet| iṣṭāpatteḥ| saṃhitāyā avivakṣāyāṃ tu rutvaṃ neti spaṣṭameva| yattu prācā "khyādhātau neti kecit" ityuktaṃ, tatra yadi khyāñādeśe ityarthastarhi kecidityanucitam| svatantre dhātau cettarhi sārvadhātukaviṣaye'pi niṣedhaḥ syāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ| nirmūlatvāt| cakrim̐strāyasveti| yattu prācā trāhītyuktaṃ, tatra parasmaipadamayuktam| trāyaterṅittvāt| trāyata iti trāḥ sa ivācaratītyarthe kartari kvibantādācārakvipi vā bodhyam| praśāniti| prapūrvācchāmyateḥ kvip| "anunāsikasya kvi--" iti dīrghaḥ| "mo no dhātoḥ" iti naḥ| tasyāsiddhatvānnalopo na|| nṝn pe pakāroparyakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| tena nṝḥ punātītyādi siddham| "ubhayatharkṣu" ityata "ubhayathā" ityanuvṛttervikalpaḥ phalita ityāśayenāha-- ruḥ syādveti|| kupvoḥ sūtre kharparatvādvisargaḥ jihvāmūlīyasya khartvāt| "kharpare śari" iti visargasya lopaḥ, jihvāmūlīyasya śartvāt| "vā śari" iti visarga eva vā| ādeśayoḥ kapāvuccāraṇārthau| cādvisarga iti| yattu prācā cādvikalpa ityuktam| tanna, kapābhyāṃ mukte visargasya satvaprasaṅgāt| kānāmreḍite kān kāniti vācye āmreḍitagrahaṇaṃ yatra dviruktiḥ tatraiva yathā syādiha mā bhūt| kān kān paśyasi | atraikaḥ kiṃśabdaḥ praśne, dvitīyaḥ kṣepe| kān kutsitān paśyasītyarthaḥ| kaskādiṣu ca atra prācā visarjanīyasya ka pau netyuktam| nāsau sūtrārthaḥ, ka payorasvaritatvāt, nañaścāprakṛtatvāt| kiṃ tvārthikārthakathanaṃ taditi dhvanayannāha-- ka payoriti| kautaskuta iti| kutaḥ kutaḥ āgata ityarthe'vyayāttyapi prāpte gaṇapāṭhasāmarthyādaṇ| sarpiṣkuṇḍiketi| "nityaṃ samāse" ityeva siddhe iha pāṭhasya prayojanaṃ tu tatraiva vakṣyate| "senāsurā--" iti | yadi hi cchasya tuk syāt tarhi cchasya cartve sati cadvayaṃ syāt| sannipātaparibhāṣayā cartvāpravṛttau tu cchakāropari cakāraḥ śrūyeteti bhāvaḥ|| || iti halsandhiḥ|| || atha visargasandhiḥ|| śarpare satvāderayamapavādaḥ| yadi tu śarpare netyevocyeta tarhi prakṛte satve niṣiddhe'pi kupvoḥ ka pau syātām| vāsaḥ kṣaumam, adbhiḥ psātamiti| visarjanīyavacanāttu vikāramātraṃ bādhyate ityāśayenāha-- na tvanyaditi| tadeva sphuṭayati--iheti| so'padādau apadādyoriti| sūtre tu vyatyayenaikavacanam| yadi tu khar viśeṣyate'padādau kharīti, tadā yathāśrutaṃ sādhu| kiṃ tu "khari' iti maṇḍūkaplutyā'nuvartyamiti kleśaḥ| na cānuvṛtteruttaratrāpyāvaśyakatā, kharaṃ vinā visargasya durlabhatvena tadanuvṛtterniṣphalatvāt| pāśakalpakakāmyeṣviti vṛttiḥ | sambhavapradarśanametanna tu parigaṇanam, anyasyāsambhavāt| prātaḥkalpamiti| adhikaraṇaśaktipradhānasyāpi prātaḥśabdasyeha vṛttiviṣaye śaktimatparatvam| doṣābhūtamahaḥ, divābhūtā rātriritivat| gīḥ kāmyatīti| iha "iṇaḥ ṣaḥ" iti ṣatvaṃ na, tatrāpi "kāmye roreva" ityasyānuvṛtteḥ| yadi tu tatrevedaṃ paṭhyeta tarhi ṣatvamātrapratiṣedhe'pi pūrveṇa satvaṃ syāt|| iṇaḥ ṣaḥ pūrvasyāpavādaḥ| idaṃ sūtraṃ, "saḥ' iti ca dvayamapi uttaratrānuvartate| yathāsambhavamiṇaḥ parasya ṣo'nyasya sa iti vivekaḥ| puraḥ praveṣṭavyā iti| pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ, "bhrājabhāsa--" ityādinā kvip| tadantājjas| jasantatāṃ sphuṭīkartuṃ pūḥ parāvityupanyastam|| idudupadhasya idutau upadhe yasya samudāyasya tasyāvayavo yo visarjanīya iti vaiyadhikaraṇyena sambandhaḥ| "apratyayasya' iti tu apratyayo yo visarga iti sambadhyate| sambhavati sāmānādhikaraṇye vaiyadhikaraṇyasyānyāyyatvāt| na ca visargasya pratyayatvamaprasiddhamiti vācyam, agniḥ karotītyādau sthānivadbhāvena tatprasiddheḥ| na cātideśaṃ prati tripādyā asiddhatvaṃ śaṅkyam, "apratyayasya" iti niṣedhenaiva siddhatvajñāpanāt| ata evāgnirityādau rorvisargaḥ sidhyati| anyathā'padāntatvānna syāt| visargavidhistu punarityādau caritārthaḥ| jñāpakaṃ ca viśeṣāpekṣam| tena "acaḥ parasmin-- " iti tripādyāṃ na pravartate| evaṃ ca "pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat" iti siddhānta uktayuktimūlako na tu vācanika iti prapañcitaṃ śabdakaustubhe'smābhiḥ| nanvevaṃ mātuḥ kāryamityādau ṣatvaṃ syāditi cet ? na, kaskādiṣu bhrātuṣputraśabdasya pāṭhena "ṅasiṅasorata ukārātparasya ṣatvaṃ na" iti jñāpanāt| evaṃ ca "apratyayasya' ityetadapi vyadhikaraṇameveti haradattenoktaṃ nātīvādartavyam| māturiti| atra hi "ṛta ut" ityekādeśaśāstraṃ visargaṃ prati paramparayā prayojakam| ākare tu "ekādeśaśāstranimittāt" iti pracuraḥ pāṭhaḥ| tatra ekādeśaśāstraṃ nimittaṃ yasya ukārasya tasmādityarthaḥ| muhuḥ kāmeti| iha "kupvoḥ ka pau" iti pravartate| vṛttau muhuskāmeti sakāraḥ kvacit paṭhyate, tatprāmādikamiti haradattaḥ| dvistriścaturiti iha dvitribhyāṃ sujantābhyāṃ sāhacaryāt catuḥśabdo'pi sujanta eva grahīṣyate| kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-- "sāhacaryaṃ na sarvatra vyavasthāpakam" iti| tena "dīdhīvevīṭām" ityatra dhātusāhacarye'pi āgamasyeṭo grahaṇam| ubhayatra vibhāṣā ceyam| caturityasya "idudupadhasya--" iti prāpte, itarayostvaprāpte| na ca tayorapi "isusoḥ sāmarthye" ityanena siddhiḥ śaṅkyā| ispratyayasya arthavataśca tatra grahaṇāt| catuṣkapāla iti| "idudupadhasya" iti nityaṃ ṣaḥ| vyapekṣāvirahe'pīti| tiṣṭhatu sarpiṣkuṇḍikāmānayetyādāvityarthaḥ| vyapekṣāyāmiti| idaṃ sarpiṣkuṇḍikāyā ityatretyarthaḥ| yattu pārāyaṇikā āhuḥ-- "kaskādiṣu sarpaṣkuṇḍikādīnāṃ pāṭha uttarapadasthatve'pi ṣatvārthaḥ" iti| tadbhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam| ayaḥsahiteti| na tvayaso vikāraḥ, "jānapada--" iti ṅīṣprasaṅgāt| ayaskarṇīti| aya iva karṇau yasyāḥ| "nāsikodarauṣṭha--"ityādinā ṅīṣ|| adhaḥśirasī etayoriti| sūtre tu ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne prathamā bodhyā| adhaspadamiti| mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ| śiraspadamiti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|| || iti visargasandhiḥ|| || atha svādisandhiḥ|| sasajuṣo ruḥ padasyetyanuvṛttaṃ sasajūrbhyāṃ viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhiḥ| na ca sajūḥśabdāṃśe "grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti" iti niṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ| tasya pratyayavidhiviṣayatvāt| sāntaṃ sajuṣśabdāntaṃ ca yatpadaṃ tasya ruḥ syāt, sa cālo'ntyasya| evaṃ sthite phalitamāha-- padāntasyeti| sajuṣśabdasyeti| tadantasya padasyetyarthaḥ, tena sajuṣa ityādau nātiprasaṅgaḥ| na ca sajūrityatrāvyāptiḥ "vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena" iti niṣedhāditi vācyam| "yena vidhiḥ" iti sūtre śabdakaustubhe'sya pratyākhyātatvāt| "vyapadeśivapadbhāvo'prātipadikena" iti, "grahaṇavatā-" iti ca paribhāṣādvayamapi pratyayavidhiviṣayakamiti diva utsūtre kaiyaṭaharadattābhyāmuktatvācca| evaṃ ca paramasajūrbhyāmityādyapi nirbādham| evaṃ sthite iha sajuṣśabdena tadantavidhirneti prācāmuktirāpātata ityavadheyam|| bho-bhago asandhiḥ sautra iti| bhagoaghośabdayorokāra-syākārasya ca pūrvarūpaṃ sautratvānnetyarthaḥ| yadi tu bhos, bhagos, aghos, iti sāntaṃ rāntaṃ vā'nukṛtya bho ityādīnāṃ trayāṇāmalo'ntyasya yaḥ syādapūrvasya rośceti vyākhāyate, tarhi asandhirnyāyya eva| yuktaṃ caitat| anyathā vibhoridaṃ, suprabhā gauryasya sa suprabhagustasya suprabhagoridaṃ, raghoridamityatrāpi yatvāpatteḥ, bhavati hyaṃ bhośabdādipūrvo ruḥ| na cātra bhośabdāderlākṣaṇikatvādagrahaṇam, "vibhāṣā bhavadbhagavadaghavatāmoccāvasya" iti vārtikena niṣpannānāṃ bhavadādiprakṛtikānāṃ bhośabdādīnāmapi lākṣaṇikatvāviśeṣāt| anarthakatvamapyubhayatra tulyam, ruviśiṣṭānāmevārthavatvāt| nanu rorukārasyānubandhatvādrephamātraṃ visargasya sthāni, tathā ca "analvidhau" iti sthānivadbhāvo na syādityāśaṅkyāha-- na hyamiti| yathā'grahīdityatra "graho'liṭi" iti dīrghasya sthānivadbhāveneṭtvāt "iṭa īṭi" iti pravartate, evamihāpi visargasya rutvādyatvaṃ pravarteteti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca sthānivatsūtre bhāṣyam "viśiṣṭaṃ hyeṣo'nalamāśrayate iṭaṃ nāma" iti| ito'pi hetordhātvaṅgetyādiparigaṇanamaśuddhamityavadheyam| nipātā iti| "bhobhago--" iti sūtre nirdiṣṭāścāderākṛtigaṇatvāttatra bodhyāḥ| tathā ca "vibhāṣā bhavadbhagavat--" iti vārtikaṃ nāśrayaṇīyam| anyathā pulliṅgaikavacanamātre bho hare ityādisidedhāvapi bho hariharau, bho vidvadvṛnda, bho gaṅge, ityādi na siddhyediti bhāvaḥ| etacca vṛttiharadattādimatenoktam| bhāṣyasvarasarītyā tu "vibhāṣā--" ityādi vārtikamārabdhavyameva| kiṃ tu nipāto'pi bhoḥśabdo'sti, tena dvivacanādau strīnapuṃsakayośca na doṣaḥ| yuktataraṃ caitat, he bhavannitivat he bho iti prayogasyāpīṣṭatvāt, tasya ca vārtikārambha eva siddheḥ| "syuḥ pyāṭpāḍaṅgahaihebhoḥ" ityamaroktānāṃ sambodhanārthānāṃ nipātānāṃ sahaprayogāyogāt| kiṃ cātra bhavān haristatrabhavān itivat tatrabho ityādyapi vārtike satyeva sidhyati| "itarābhyo'pi dṛśyante" iti sarvavibhaktyantāttratasorbhavadādiyoga eveṣṭatvāt| kiṃ cāmantritatve padātparasyāṣṭamikanighātaḥ, "āmantritaṃ pūrvam--" ityavidyamānavadbhāvaḥ "āma ekāntaram--" iti vidhiḥ, "vākyāderāmantritasya--" iti dvirbhāvaḥ, "subāmantrite--" iti parāṅgavadbhāvaścetyādi sarvaṃ sidhyati, na tvanyatheti dik| bhago, agho iti nipātāvapi yadi prāmāṇikau tarhi stāṃ nāma| āmantritakāryasiddhistu vārtikāyattaiveti sudhībhirākalanīyam| yattu vadanti--sakārāntānevaitān nipātānāsthāya rutvautve bhāṣye pratyākhyāte iti, tadatirabhasāt| syādetat| nipātānāmabhyupagame yatvavidhau ta eva gṛhayeran pratipadoktatvāt, na tu sambuddhyantāḥ lākṣaṇikatvāt, iti cet? maivam, "svaritenādhikāraḥ" ityatrādhikaḥ kāro'dhikāra iti vyākhyānamāśritya lakṣyānurodhena svaritatvamāśrityobhayagrahaṇāt, "bhuvaśca mahāvyāhṛteḥ" iti sūtre mahāvyāhṛtigrahaṇaṃ lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā anityatvajñāpanārthamiti haradattādyukteśca| na caivamapi prabhorityādāvativyāptiḥ| parasparasāhacaryeṇa nipātānāṃ vārtikoktānāṃ ca grahaṇe'pyanyeṣāmagrahaṇāt|| vyorlaghu laghuprayatnataraḥ, laghūccāraṇataraḥ| sa cāntaratamyād vasya vo yasya ya ityāha--vayāviti| oto gārgyasya okārāditi| yattvokārāntādaṅgāditi prācā vyākhyātaṃ tanna, aṅgasyāprakṛtatvāt, asambhavācca| nahyudāharaṇeṣvokārāntamaṅgamasti| hali sarveṣām yakārasyeti| vakārastu nānuvartate, bhobhagoaghopūrvasyāsambhavāt| apūrvastu yadyapi sambhavati vṛkṣav karotīti, tathāpi tatra lopāprasaṅgaḥ, aśītyanuvartyāśā halo viśeṣaṇāt| vṛkṣav hasatītyādi tu anabhidhānādasādhvityāhuḥ| gavyamityatra tu padāntatvaṃ nāsti, gavyūtirityatra tu vakārapraśleṣānna valopa ityuktam| nanu devā namyā ityādau "lopo vyoḥ--" ityeva siddham| maivam, taṃ prati yatvasyāsiddhatvāt; devā yāntītyatra valparatvābhāvācca| ahorātra iti| "rātrāhnāhāḥ--" iti puṃstvam| aharādīnāmiti| ubhayatrādiśabdaḥ prakāre| tena "svarcakṣo rathinaḥ satyaśuṣmaḥ"| "vipraḥ kaviḥ kāvyena svarcano" ityādi grāhyam| tṛḍho vṛḍha iti| udittvena veṭkatvāt "yasya vibhāṣā" iti niṣṭhāyāṃ neṭ| ḍhatvadhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopāḥ| yattu prācā pratyudāhṛtaṃ dṛḍha iti tanna| tatra ḍhalopasyaivābhāvāt| tathā hi, "dṛḍhaḥ sthūlabalayoḥ" iti sūtreṇa dṛṃhernakārahakārayorlopaḥ, takārasya ḍhatvaṃ ca nipātyate na tvasiddhakāṇḍasthaḍhatvasyeha pravṛttiḥ "dāderdhātoḥ--" iti ghatvena bādhāt| na ca iḍabhāvo ḍhatvaṃ ca nipātyatāṃ dhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopāstu bhaviṣyantyeveti vācyam, tathā sati paridraḍhayyetyatra "lyapi laghupūrvāt" iti ṇerayādeśo na syāt, pāridṛḍhī kanyetyatra "aṇiñoḥ--" iti ṣyaṅ ca syāt, ḍhalopasyāsiddhatvena gurūpottamatvāditi bhāṣye sthitam| yattu prācā vyākhyātaṃ dṛṃherevedaṃ nipātanaṃ, dṛha vṛddhāviti tu prakṛtyantaram, tasya niṣṭhāyāmāgamaśāstrasyānityatvādiḍabhāve "vā druha--" ityatra "vā" iti yogavibhāgāt pakṣe ghatvābhāve ḍhalope ca pratyudāharaṇamidaṃ draṣṭavyamiti| tanna| ubhayorapi nipātanābhyupagamāt| tadāha vāmanaḥ-- atha dṛhiḥ prakṛtyantaramasti tasyāpyetannipātanaṃ nalopavarjamiti| yuktaṃ caitat| anyathā hi asmād ṇeray na syāt, ṣyaṅ ca syāt| utvameveti|| siddhāsiddhayoratulyabalatvena "vipratiṣedhe param-- " ityasyāpravṛttau niṣpratipakṣatvādutvameva bhavatītyarthaḥ| taduktam-- "pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedho'bhāvāduttarasya" iti| etena "vibhaktikāryaṃ prāk paścādutvamatve" ityādi vyākhyātam| sūtre su iti pṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkamityāha-- etattadoryaḥ suriti| etattadarthagatasaṃkhyābhidhāyī yaḥ sustasyetyarthaḥ| etattadorvihita iti vyākhyāne tu paramasa dadāti, paramaiṣa dadātītyādau na syāt| arthadvārakasambandhāśrayaṇe liṅgaṃ tu "anañsamāse' iti bodhyam| akoḥ kimiti| sākackayoḥ śabdāntaratvādaprasaṅga iti praśnaḥ| eṣaka iti| "akoḥ' iti pratiṣedha eva "tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate" iti paribhāṣāṃ jñāpayatīti bhāvaḥ| bahulagrahaṇeti| ata eva lopaṃ vinā pādapūraṇe'pi kvacidbhavati-- sāsmā aram| saḥ asmai iti cchedaḥ| || iti svādisandhiḥ|| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāṃ pañcasandhiprakaraṇam|| || atha ajantapum̐lliṅgaprakaraṇam|| arthavadadhātuḥ pratyayaṃ pratyayāntaṃ ceti| sūtre tantrādinā ubhayaṃ vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ| tathā hi, pratyasyaiva paryudāse "kṛttaddhita" iti sūtreṇa taddhitāntasya saṃjñāvidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt| na ca tatrāpi tadantaṃ na grāhyamiti vācyam| "arthavat" ityanuvṛttisāmarthyāttadantagrahaṇam| praśaṃsāyāṃ hi matup| ekārthībhāvena laukike prayoge prasiddhatvaṃ ca praśaṃsāmūlam| na ca "arthavat" ityasya pūrvasūtre caritārthatā| dhātupratyayaparyudāsenaiva tallābhāt| tasmātpratyayāntaṃ ca varjayitvetyucitameva| yadi tu pratyayo na paryudasyeta tarhi "sātpadādyoḥ" iti sūtre sātigrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt| arthavat' iti kim ? dhanaṃ vanamityādau prativarṇaṃ saṃjñā mā bhūt| tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ svādayaḥ syuḥ| nanu saṃkhyākarmādyabhāvāt na bhaviṣyantīti cet? na, ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate iti siddhāntāt| huṃphaḍādibhya iva sordurvāratvāt| na ca arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā'narthake na syāditi vācyam| tasyā viśiṣṭarūpopādānaviṣayatvāt| adhātuḥ' ityādiparyudāsabalena yadyapyarthavatvaṃ labhyate, tathāpi uttarārthaṃ tadityuktam| etacca "suptiṅantam"iti sūtre bhāṣye dhvanitam| yattvāhuḥ--adhīte, yāvaka iti| adhipūrvasyaiveṅaḥ prayogāt viśiṣṭa eva arthavān, na tu kevalaḥ| 'iṅ adhyayane' ityādyarthanirdeśastu avayave samudāyārthāropāt| evaṃ kannapyanarthakaḥ| yāvaśabdādapi tadarthapratīteḥ| "oṣadheśca vibhaktāvaprathamāyām" "akartari ca kārake--" iti vibhaktikārakagrahaṇābhyāṃ nañivayuktanyāyasyānityatvakalpanācceti| atredaṃ vaktavyam| dhāturanarthaka iti tāvadvyāhatam| kriyāvācakatvaṃ vinā dhātutvāyogāt| āropitaṃ taditi cet? satyam, tāvataiveṣṭasiddheḥ| prakṛtipratyayavibhāgastadarthavibhāgaśca sarvaḥ kalpita eva| paramārthatastu sphoṭa evārthavāniti siddhāntāt| uktaṃ ca hariṇā--- upāyāḥ śikṣyamāṇānāṃ bālānāmupalālanāḥ| asatye vartmani sthitvā tataḥ satyaṃ samīhate ||iti| kathamanyathā iṅo dvirvacanamaḍādayaśca syuḥ| tathā ca pratyāhārāhṇike "arthavanto varṇā" iti praghaṭṭake adhyeti adhīta ityatrekāro'rthavāniti bhāṣye spaṣṭamevoktam| evaṃ kanpratyayo'pyarthavāneva, svārthikānāṃ prakṛtyarthenaivārthavatvāt| kalpanāmātramidamiti cet, na| uktottaratvāt| naiṣā kalpanā śāstrakṛtsaṃmateti cet, na| " dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthaturyāṇi--" iti sūtre pūraṇātsvārthe'npratyayasya pūraṇārthatāyā bhāṣyakārairevoktatvāt| pratyaya iti mahāsaṃjñāṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakṛto'pi saṃmatamevedam| yadapi "oṣadheśca--"ityādi| tadapi na| anityatve'pyautsargikapravṛttyeṣṭasiddheḥ, iṣṭasthale'pyapravṛttau nyāyasya nirviṣayatvāpātācca, anityatvajñāpanasya kathañcidāvaśyakatve'rthavadgrahaṇasyaiva jñāpakatvasambhavācca, uttarārthasyāpi "iha kiñcitrapo" iti nyāyena iha karaṇasya saphalatvaucityāt| "oṣadheśca--" ityādau vibhaktikārakagrahaṇayorevetthaṃ sati pratyākhyānasambhavācceti dik| "adhātuḥ" kim ? ahan| nalopo mā bhūt| na ca kāryakālapakṣe pratyayāntatvena paryudāso'stvati vācyam, pratyayalakṣaṇenoktaparyudāsāpravṛtteḥ "na ṅisambuddhyoḥ" iti niṣedhena jñāpitatvāt| kathamanyathā rājetyādau nalopaḥ syāt| apratyayaḥ kim ? hariṣu, karoṣi| atra supsipormā bhūt| apratyayāntaḥ kim ? tatraiva vibhaktiviśaṣṭayormā bhūt| na cāntavadbhāvena kāṇḍe, kuḍye ityādau prātipadikatvaṃ syādeva| tathā ca "hrasvo napuṃsake--" iti hrasvatvaṃ sorutpattiśca syāditi vācyam| kāryakālapakṣeṇeṣṭasiddheḥ| yathoddeśe'pi vibhaktyekādeśo nāntavat, "saptamyadhikaraṇe ca" ityādinirdeśāt| "hrasvo napuṃsake--" iti sūtre prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ vā uktārthe sāmānyāpekṣaṃ jñāpakamastu| yattu vadanti-- pratyayaparyudāso na kartavyaḥ, pratyayāntaparyudāsenaiva gatārthatvāt, vyapadeśivadbhāvena tasyāpi pratyayāntatvāditi | tanna, pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa vihitastadādergrahaṇāt| kevalasya ca atathātvāt| anyathā tvaduktarītyā suptiṅorapi tadantatvāt padatvaṃ syāt| tathā ca hariṣu, karoṣi, ityādau ṣatvaṃ na syāt "sātpadādyoḥ" iti niṣedhāt| adhātupratyayāviti siddhe nañdvayopādānaṃ spaṣṭārtham| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ śrutyanurodhāt| tathā cātharvaṇe paṭhyate--" ko dhātuḥ? kiṃ prātipadikam? kaḥ pratyayaḥ?" iti| ḍitthādīnyavyutpannānīhodāharaṇam| avyutpattipakṣasya cedameva jñāpakamiti prāñcaḥ| yattu vyutpattipakṣe'pi nipātārthamanukaraṇārthaṃ cedamiti haradattenoktam| taccintyam| tatrāpi prakṛtyādikalpanasambhavāt| vastutastu vyutpattipakṣe'pi bahupaṭava ityādyarthaṃ sūtram| na caivaṃ bahucpūrva ityeva sūtryatāmiti vācyam| 'mūlakenopadaṃśam' ityādau kṛdantatvenātiprasaṅgāt| na ca samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti nistāraḥ| arthavatsūtrārambhaṃ vinā samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvāyogāditi dik| kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca "arthavat" ityanuvartate, tatsāmarthyāttadantavidhiḥ| nahi jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau kṛtāṃ taddhitānāṃ cārtho'sti| bhūtapūrvagatilabhyastu na praśastaḥ| ajahatsvārthāyāmapi na pratyayamātreṇārthaparyavasānamityabhipretyāha-- kṛttaddhitāntāviti| liṭ, dhuk ityādau "adhātuḥ" iti, kartetyādau apratyayāntamiti paryudāse prāpte vidhirayam| niyamārthamiti| na ca pratyayāntatvena paryudāse prāpte vidhyarthamastviti śaṅkyam, vākyasyāpratyayāntatvāt, pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa vihitastadādereva grahaṇāt| nanu strīpratyaye tadādiniyamo niṣiddhaḥ, evaṃ ca rājakumārītyādau vidhyarthamastviti cet? maivam, antaraṅgasyāpi halṅyādilopasya lugviṣaye'pravṛtyā śrūyamāṇa eva supi samāsapravṛtteḥ| tatra cāpratyayāntatvena pravṛttāyāḥ saṃjñāyā ekadeśavikṛtanyāyena vibhaktilukyapi sulabhatvāt| ata eva gomatpriya ityādau numādayo na| lukaḥ prāgantaraṅgapravṛttau tu syureva| nanvevamapi asamarthasamāse daśadāḍimādivadanarthake vidhyarthamastviti cet? na, "arthavat" ityasyānuvṛtteruktatvāt| kathaṃ tarhi asamarthasamāse saṃjñeti ceddharmigrāhakamānādeveti gṛhāṇa| "asūryalalāṭayoḥ--" ityanena hi asūryaśabde upapade khaś vidhīyate| upoccāritaṃ padaṃ copapadam, padaṃ ca suptiṅantamiti| niyamaśarīramāha-- yatra saṃghāte ityādi| pūrvo bhāga ityupalakṣaṇam-- uttarastu pratyayo netyapi bodhyam| anyathā janmavānityādau saṃjñā na syāttaddhitagrahaṇasya aupagavādau kṛtārthatvāt| pūrvo bhāgaḥ padamiti kim? bahujviśiṣṭasya prātipadikasaṃjñā yathā syāt| tena bahupaṭava ityatra prathamajaso luki bahupaṭuśabdasya citsvare punarjasi upottamodāttatvaṃ sidhyati| yadvā prakṛtipratyayabhāvānāpannasaṃghātaviṣayako niyamo'stu| na cādyapakṣe rājapuruṣāvityādau puruṣāvityādeḥ saṃjñā syāditi vācyam, arthavatvenaiva vāraṇāt| pratyayārtho hi viśiṣṭa evānveti, na tūttarapadārthamātre yena puruṣāvityasyārthavatvaṃ syāt| niyamaphalamāha-- tenetyādi| nanvevamapi mūlakenopadaṃśamityādau vākyasya saṃjñā durvārā, kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇāt, iti cet ? maivam, samāsagrahaṇakṛtaniyamena paratvād bādhāt| evaṃ ca "kṛttaddhita--"iti sūtre kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhata eva niṣphalatvāditi tattvam| yattu vadanti--samāsagrahaṇaṃ na niyamārthaṃ kintu vidhyarthameva| arthavattvaṃ hi vṛttimattvaṃ| vṛttiśca dvidhā --śaktirlakṣaṇā ca| na ca sā samāse'stīti| atredaṃ vaktavyam| siddhānte tāvadekārthībhāvābhyupagamād vṛttirnāstīti bādhitameva| mīmāṃsakamate'pi lakṣaṇāstyeva| yadāhuḥ-- sarvatraiva hi vākyārtho lakṣya eveti ca sthitam|| iti| atha naiyāyikarītyocyeta ? tadapi na , bahupaṭava ityādyasiddheḥ| taddhitagrahaṇaṃ tadviśiṣṭaparamiti cet ? na, pacatakītyādāvativyāpteḥ| kiṃ caivaṃ kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā mūlakenopadaṃśamityadāvativyāptirdurvāraivetyāstāṃ tāvat| cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena "nipātasyānarthakasya prātipadikasaṃjñā vaktavyā' iti gatārtham| yeṣāṃ dyotyo'pyartho nāsti tadarthamidam| avadyati| anukaraṇeṣu tu anukāryeṇa sahābhedavivakṣāyāmarthavatvābhāvādeva na prātipadikatvam| "bhū"sattāyāmiti yathā| bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu saṃjñā syādeva| "bhuvo vuka--"iti yathā| liṅgaviśiṣṭasyeti| liṅgabodhakapratyayaviśiṣṭasyāpītyarthaḥ| paribhāṣāyāḥ prayojanaṃ tu-- ayaskumbhī "ataḥ kṛkami--"iti satvam| taddhi kaṃsādiṣūttarapadeṣu vidhīyate| kiṃ ca, kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārayati| "ṇāviṣṭavat"iti ṭilopaḥ| evaṃ yāminayantyahāni ityatra ācāre kvibapi phalam| ṅyābhyāṃ prāgiti| tena lohinikā, āryakā ca sidhyati| tathā hi, svārthikatvenāntaraṅgaḥ paraśca "lohitānmaṇau " iti kan ṅīpaṃ bādheta| tato lohitiketyeva syāt; iṣyate tūbhayam| ṅībgrahaṇasāmarthyāttu ṅyantātkani rūpadvayaṃ sidhdam, "varṇādanudāttāt--" ityasya vaikalpikatvāt| āryaśabdāttu "na sāmivacane" ityatra jñāpayiṣyamāṇo'tyantasvārthiko'pi kan ābgrahaṇasāmarthyāt pūrvaṃ na pravartate| tena "udīcāmātaḥ sthāne yakapūrvāyāḥ" iti itvavikalpaḥ sidhyati| syādetat | evaṃ sati bahugomatketi na sidhyet kapaḥ prāgugillakṣaṇaṅīpprasaṅgāt; iti cet ? maivam| akṛta eva samāse'laukikaprakriyāvakye eva uttarapadasyāvayavībhūya samāsāntaḥ pravartate iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| sa ca vibhakteḥ purastādityeke| parastāditi pakṣe tu taddhitāntatvāt subluki punaḥ supi cākṛte samāsa iti siddhāntaḥ| tasmādantarabhaṅgādapi taddhitātprāṅṅyāpoḥ pravṛttyarthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇamiti sthitam| yattvāhuḥ---ābgrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārthamiti, tadanena pratyuktam| vastutastu ṅyāpograhaṇaṃ māstu| subantāttaddhitotpattiriti niṣkarṣaḥ| supaḥ prāgeva ca ṅyāpau pravartete, svārthādiprayuktakāryāṇāṃ kramikatvasvīkārādityavadheyam| suṅasyoriti| sorukāraḥ "arvaṇastrasau" ityatra viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| asītyukte hyasakārādāvityarthaḥ syāt| tathā ca "vājamarvatsu paya usriyāsu" iti na sidhyet| ṅaserikāro "yuṣmadasmabhyāṃ ṅaso'ś" ityatra asya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi| yadi tu "ekavacanasya ca" ityatra "pañcamyā" ityanuvṛtteḥ pariśeṣādanyasya ṅaso'tra grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyucyate tarhi "ṭāṅasiṅasām--" ityetadarthaḥ| jaśśasorjakāraśakārau "jasaḥ śī" "tasmācchaso naḥ" ityanayorviṣayavibhāgārthau| anyatarasya niranubandhakatvamevāstu iti cenna| jaso jakārābhāve au ityasyā''v syāt| tataśca pratyayasya vakārāntatāpi sambhāvyeta| evaṃ śasaḥ śakārābhāve auṭo ṅitvaṃ sambhāvyeta| ato'sandehārthaṃ tatkaraṇaucityāt| auṭaṣṭakāraḥ suḍiti pratyāhārārthaḥ| ṭāṭakārastu "ṭāṅasi"iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| ṅeprabhṛtīnāṃ ṅakāro "gherṅiti" iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| pakārastu pratyāhārārthaḥ| evaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ saphalatve'pi saṃjñārthā iti prāco grantho'saṅgata eva| samyag jñānaṃ saṃjñā, tadarthāḥ viśeṣaṇārthā iti yāvat| iti bhaṅtvā vyākhyāne'pi kliṣṭatvamevetyupekṣitam| supaḥ "tiṅastrīṇitrīṇi" iti sūtrāt trīṇi trīṇi iti padaṃ "tānyekavacana" ityādī sūtraṃ ca sampūrṇamanuvartata iti vyācaṣṭe-- supastrīṇitrīṇyetyādinā| ekaśa iti| ekaikamityarthaḥ| "saṅkhyaikavacanācca" iti vīpsāyāṃ prathamāntāt śas| yattu prācā ekaikaśa ityuktam| tadayuktam, śasaiva vīpsāyā uktatvena dvirvacanāyogāt| yenanāprāptinyāyena dvirvacanāpavādaḥ śas iti siddhāntāt| yattvāhuḥ "sarvasya dve" ityatra ekaikaśo dadātīti bhāṣyaprayogāt "tānyeka---" iti sūtre ekaśa iti sūtrakāranirdeśāccobhayaṃ sādhviti| tanna, udāhṛtabhāṣyasyānyaviṣayatvāt| "yatra taddhitenānuktā vīpsā bhavati tatra dvirvacanam" ityupakramya hi "tadyathā ekaikaśo dadāti" iti bhāṣye udāhṛtam| vyākhyānaṃ ca kaiyaṭena- alpārtho'pyekaśeṣo'sti tasya vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacane "bahvalpārthāt--" iti śaspratyaya iti| na caiṣo'rthaḥ prakṛte sambhavatītyāstāṃ tāvat| rāma iti| saṃjñāśabdo'yamavyutpanna iti pakṣe'rthavatsūtreṇa prātipadikasañjñā, "karaṇādhikaraṇayośca" ityadhikāre ghāpavādena "halaśca" iti ghañā ramante'sminniti vyutpādane tu "kṛttaddhita--" iti sūtreṇeti vivekaḥ| | sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa ekavibhaktau ekavibhaktau yānīti| vibhaktiḥ sārūpye upalakṣaṇaṃ na tvekaśeṣe nimittam| evaṃ cānaimittikatvenāntaraṅgo'mekaśeṣaḥ subutpatteḥ prāgeva pravartate| yadyetannārabhyeta tarhi pratyekaṃ vibhaktiḥ syāt, dvandvaśca pravarteta| ārabdhe tvekaśeṣe'nekasubantavirahād dvandvasyāprāptireva phalitā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| sarūpāṇyeveti| etaccottarasūtrasthaivakārasyehānukarṣaṇāllabhyate| tena mātṛśabdayorjananīvāciparicchettṛvācinornaikaśeṣaḥ| mātṛbhyāmityādau sārūpye'pi aujasādiṣu vairūpyāt| eka eveti| etacca sahavivakṣāyāmeva pravartate| itaretarayogadvandvasya viṣaye iti yāvat| yatra hyanekasyārthasya militasyetarānvayaḥ sa tathābhūto'sya viṣayaḥ| idaṃ ca "idito num dhātoḥ" iti liṅgāllabhyate, nyāyācca| tathā hi-- yaḥ śiṣyate sa lupyamānārthābhidhāyīti sthite śrūyamāṇaikaśabdopasthitaṃ sarvamaviśeṣādaikarūpyeṇaivānvetumarhati| yadvā, pūrvasūtrād "dvandve" ityanuvartya dvandve prasakte satīti vyakhyeyam| syādetat| dvandve kṛte satītyartho'stu| maivam, "panthānau' "panthānaḥ' ityādau samāsāntāpatteḥ| "karau' "karāḥ' ityādau ekavadbhāvāpatteḥ| "sarve" "sarveṣām"ityādau "dvandve ca" "vibhāṣā jasi"ityanayorāpatteśceti dik| yattu prācā "rāma-rāma-au" iti sthite ityuktam, ekavibhaktau parata iti ca| tatretthamuktisambhavaḥ--rāma rāma ityatra avayavayoriva samudāyasyāpi prātipadikasaṃjñā'sti militenārthavattvāt| na cārthavattve'pi samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvānnaivamiti vācyam| yatra samudāye pūrvo bhāgaḥ padaṃ tadviṣayako niyama ityuktatvāt, bahupaṭava ityādyanurodhena niyamasya sajātīyaviṣayatāyā aucityācca| tathā caikājdvirvacananyāyena samudāyaprātipadikādeva dvivacanādyutpattiḥ| tāvatāpyavayavārthānāṃ saṃkhyānvayenānugrahasaṃbhavāt| nanvevaṃ rāmakṛṣṇāvityādiṣvapi dvandvaṃ vinaiva samudāyādvibhaktiḥ syāditi cet ? maivam| dvandvavidhāvanekasubantamityasyānuvṛtyā ekājdvirvacananyāyasya bādhāditi dik| itthamuktisaṃbhave satyapi samudāyādekavibhaktau parata iti pakṣaḥ kimarthamupekṣita iti cet ? śṛṇu, asminpakṣe mātṛmātarau ityādāvapyekaśeṣaḥ syāt| nanvekavibhaktāvityāvartya evakāraṃ cānukṛṣya ekavibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇyavati vyākhyeyamiti cenna| āvṛttau mānābhāvāt| vibhakterekaśeṣasya viśeṣaṇatve phalābhāvācca| na ca payaḥ payo jarayatītyādivyāvṛttiḥ phalam, sahavivakṣāyāmityasyāvaśyakatvāt, anyathā payaḥ payo nayatītyatra gauṇamukhyakarmaṇorekaśeṣāpatteḥ| devadeva ityādāvatiprasaṅgācca| pratyuta āvṛttyā ubhayaviśeṣaṇatve bhikṣāṇāṃ samūho bhaikṣamiti na sidhyet| tathā hi, bhikṣā bhikṣā bhikṣā ām a iti sthite "antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgaḥ" iti luki kṛte vibhaktiparatvābhāvādekaśeṣo na syāt| lupte pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvāt| kiṃ ca rāmāvityādau paratvānnityatvācca "vṛddhireci" ityekadeśe kṛte vibhaktiparatvābhāvādekaśeṣo na syāt| ubhayata āśrayaṇe'ntādivadbhāvābhāvāditi dik| yattu prācā vyākhyātrā pakṣāntaramupanyastaṃ-- savibhaktikānāmekaśeṣa iti| tanna| nivartamānānāṃ vibhaktyā sahaiva nivṛttāvapi śiṣyamāṇe ekavacanaśravaṇaprasaṅgāt| athocyeta yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāṃ dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāmekaśeṣaḥ| dvandvo'pyevam| tathā hi, ajahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau ekaikamanekārthābhidhāyi parasparasamabhivyāhārāt| tathā ca alaukike dvandvaikaśeṣayoḥ prakriyāvākye dvivacanabahuvacanayoreva praveśād vibhaktyantānāmekaśeṣa iti pakṣo nirbādha eveti| tadapi na, jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau tadayogāt| pakṣāntare'pi prathamapravṛttasyaikavacanasya tyāgāyogāt| anyathā ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādyukacchedāpatteḥ| tatrāpi pūrvapadasya uttarapadārthe upasaṃkrameṇa ṣaṣṭhyādyayogāt| tathā ca bhāṣyam "seyaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā duḥkhā ca durupapadā ca" iti| yadapi vyācakhyuḥ--vyaktipakṣe yāvadvyakti tattacchabdaprayoge prāpte ekasyaiva prayogo yathā syāditi sūtram| ākṛtipakṣe tu ekenaivākṛtyavinābhūtānekavyaktilābhādanarthakamiti| tanna, vyaktipakṣe'pi "na brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt" ityatra brāhmaṇaśabdenaivaikenāpi anekasya tantreṇa suvacatvāt| anyathā jātipakṣe'pi "vāsena samyakkṣamayośca tasmin" ityādinānārthānurodhena sūtraṃ vinā'nirvāhāt| tasmājjātivyaktipakṣayorubhayorapi tantreṇa prayogānnirvāhe'pi sarvatra tantreṇaiva bodhanīyamiti niyāmakābhāvātpākṣiko dvandvaḥ sūtraṃ vinā durvāraḥ| ghaṭo'yaṃ ghaṭo'yamati nānāśabdaprayogadarśanāt, tadvat ghaṭaghaṭāviti dvandvasya nyāyaprāptatvāt| na caivamapi ghaṭakalaśāviti dvandvāpattiḥ| "virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām" iti vārtikāt| rūpyate bodhyate iti vyutpatyā rūpaśabdasya arthaparatvamāśritya vārtikārthasyāpi sūtreṇaiva kroḍīkārācca| tasmād ghaṭaghaṭau ghaṭakalaśāvityādipākṣikāniṣṭavāraṇāya pakṣadvaye'pi sūtramāvaśyakamityavadheyam| evaṃ sthite sūtravaiyarthyameva hṛdi nidhāya yadiha vyācakhyuḥ-- nānenaikaśeṣo vidhīyate ityādi| yacca samudāyādekasyāṃ vibhaktāviti pakṣaṃ pratyākhyāya punarāhuḥ--rāma rāma au iti sthite iti| alaukikametatprakriyāvākyamūhyate na tu laukikam| alaukike ca vibhaktyekādeśādikāryaṃ na pravartate| prayuktānāmevānvākhyānādityādi| tatsarvaṃ sandarbhaviruddhaṃ nyāyaviruddhaṃ ca| prayuktāneva hyanvākhyātumalaukikamutprekṣyate| śāstrīyakāryaṃ ca sarvamalaukikeṣveva pravartate na tu pariniṣṭhite| "prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ" ityādīnāṃ pravṛttiṃ vinā pariniṣṭhitarūpālābhāt| pariniṣṭhite tatpravṛtterdurupapādatvāccetyāstāṃ tāvat| ami pūrvaḥ amyacīti| ami yo'c tasmin| amo'vayave'cīti yāvat| tena makārasahitasya na pūrvarūpam| evam akṣādūhinyāmityādāvapi ūhinyāṃ yo'c tasminnityādi bodhyam| "iko yaṇaci" ityajgrahaṇasyānuvṛtternirvivādatvāt| "padāsvairibāhyā--" ityādinirdeśāśceha tasmācchasaḥ tacchabdena sannihitaḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ parāmṛśyate| śasa ityavayavaṣaṣṭhī| sa cāvayavaḥ paratvena viśeṣyate-- pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt parasya śaso'vayavasyeti| tadetadāha-- paro yaḥ śasaḥ sakāra iti| paro yaḥ śas iti tu noktam, asaṃbhavāt| na hi kṛte savarṇadīrghe paraḥ śas saṃbhavati| aṭkupvāṅ raṣābhyāmiti pañcamīnirdeśādvyavahitasyāprāptau vacanamidam| atra sarvairvyavāyo'saṃbhavī, ekaikamātravyavāya ityapi nārthaḥ| kṣubhnādiṣu kṣubhnaśabdapāṭhasāmarthyāt "sarūpāṇām" ityādinirdeśāccetyabhipretyāha-- vyastairyathāsambhavaṃ militaiśceti| nanvevam "ādarśena'ityādau atiprasaṅgaḥ| na ca aḍādibhireva vyavadhāne iti niyamaḥ| aprāpte vidhirayamityuktatvāt| satyam, yogavibhāgo'tra bodhyaḥ--"vyavāye'pi" ityeko yogo vidhyarthaḥ| "aṭkupvāṅnum" ityanyo niyamārthaḥ| chāndaso bhiso luk| niṣedhaṃ bādhitumiti| tena paryāṇaddhamityatra "upasargādasamāse'pi" iti ṇatvaṃ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ| numgrahaṇamiti| tatsthānikasya svābhāvikasya cānusvāramātrasyopalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| tena "bṛhi vṛddhau' iditvānnum| tasyānusvāraḥ| "tṛṃhū hiṃsāyāṃ' svābhāviko'trānusvāraḥ| bṛṃhaṇam,
