tṛṃhaṇam| ubhayatrāpi ṇatvaṃ sidhdam| "ivi prīṇane' prenvanam| iha "kṛtyacaḥ" "ijādeḥ sanumaḥ" iti ṇatvaṃ na| yathā "nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā vācaṃ visṛjet" iti vidhau nakṣatradarśanasya kālaviśeṣopalakṣaṇatvātsatyapi divā nakṣatradarśane vāṅ na visṛjyate, upalakṣitasya kālaviśeṣasyābhāvāt| rātrau asatyapi nakṣatradarśane visṛjyate, tasya sattvāt, tathehāpi bodhyam| nanvevaṃ numgrahaṇaṃ vyartham, anusvārasyāṭtvenaiva saṃgrahāt| uraḥkeṇetyādau visargajihvāmūlīyādivyavadhāne hyeṣaiva gatiriti cetsatyamityāha-- tacceti| syādetat| uktarītyā "numvisarjanīya" iti sūtre'pi numgrahaṇaṃ tyājyaṃ syāt| tatrāpyanusvārasya lakṣaṇīyatvāt| anyathā'sambhavāt| na hi ṣatvapravṛttivelāyāṃ "sarpīṃṣi' ityadau num labhyate| ṣatvasyāsidhdatvena tataḥ prāgevānusvārapravṛtteḥ| yadyapi "suhinsu' ityatra saṃbhavatyeva, tathāpi tatraivātivyāptiṃ vārayituṃ lakṣyānurodhānnumsthānike'nusvāre lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇīyaiva, vyākhyānāt| tasya ca śartvena tadvyavāye ṣatvasya siddhatvāditi cet ? maivam, uktarītyā tatratyavisargagrahaṇasya pratyākhyānasaṃbhave'pi niyamārthaṃ numgrahaṇam| tathā hi, anusvāreṇa vyavadhāne cet ṣatvaṃ tarhi numsthānikenaiva niyamyate| tena puṃsvityādau neti dik| yasmātpratyayavidhiḥ atra prācoktam--yasmāddhātoḥ prātipadikādveti| tanna, tiṅantādīnāmapi tarabādikaṃ pratyaṅgatvāt| saṅkocasya nirmūlatvāt| āmuṣyāyaṇa ityādau vṛddhyabhāvāpatteśca| na hi prātipadikādayaṃ taddhitaḥ kintu subantāditi dik|| ato bhisa ais nanves ityevāstu| na ca "ato guṇe" iti pararūpāpattiḥ| ekāroccāraṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ|anyathā isameva vidadhyaditi cet ? satyam, edaitordvimātratvāviśeṣeṇa gauravābhāvādais kṛtaḥ| evaṃ ca pararūpaśaṅkaiva nāstīti mahallāghavam| yattvāhuḥ--aiskaraṇaṃ nirjarasairityaikāraśravaṇārthamiti| tadbhāṣyaviruddham| sannipātaparibhāṣayā jarasādeśāpravṛtternirjarairityeva bhāṣye siddhāntitatvāt| nāmi paribhāṣāvirodhāditi| etacca "rudhādibhyaḥ śnam" iti sūtre "śnānnalopaḥ" iti sūtre ca bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ spaṣṭam| ārambhasāmarthyāditi| "supi ca" ityasya tu na sāmarthyam| rāmābhyāmityādau sāvakāśatvāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca rāmaśabde "nāmi" ityasyopanyāso lekhakapramādāditi yadūcustaccintyam| ādeśapratyayayoḥ ekā'pi ṣaṣṭhī viṣayabhedādbhidyate ityāśayena vyācaṣṭe-- ādeśaḥ pratyayāvayavaśceti| yadi tu ādeśāvayavo gṛhyeta tarhi tisṛṇāmityādau doṣaḥ| yadi ca pratyayo yaḥ sakāra iti tarhi rāmeṣvityādau na syāt| yadyapyevaṃ vairūpyeṇa vyākhyāne sahavivakṣāvirahād dvandvo na yujyate, tathā'pi sautratvād bodhyaḥ| vivṛtāghoṣasyeti| yattu vadanti--sakārasya soṣmaṇo'ghoṣasyāntaratamaḥ ṣa eva mūrdhanya iti, tannyūnam, ṭhakāre'tiprasaṅgāt| tathā ca prātiśākhyam- "varge varge ca prathamāvaghoṣau yugmau soṣmāṇāvanunāsiko'ntyaḥ" iti| nanu dadhiseca ityādau prāk subutpatteḥ samāse ṣatvaṃ vārayituṃ padādādiḥ padādiriti pañcamīsamāso bhāṣye uktaḥ| tataścehāpi "sātpadādyoḥ" iti niṣedhaḥ syāditi cet ? maivam, svādiṣviti yā padasaṃjñā tāmāśrityoktaniṣedho na pravartate iti sātigrahaṇena jñāpitatvāt| yattvāhuḥ--pratyayaviṣaye nāyaṃ niṣadha iti jñāpyata iti| tanna, vyatise ityādau ṣatvāpatteḥ| nanu padasyādiriti pakṣe 'vyatise' ityatra ṣatvaṃ durvāram| na ca vyapadeśivadbhāvena se ityasyāpi tiṅantatvātpadatvaṃ śaṅkyam| pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa vihitastadādereva grahaṇāt| anyathā 'rāmeṣu' ityādāvapi ṣatvaniṣedhāpattiriti cet? satyam| na vayaṃ pratyayamātrasya tadantatāṃ brūmaḥ, kiṃ tu prakṛtipratyayasamudāye pravṛttāṃ padasaṃjñāmekadeśavikṛtanyāyena luptaprakṛtike pratyaye'pyānayāmaḥ| 'rāmau' 'rāmāḥ' ityādāvapi hi ekadeśavikṛtanyāyenaiva padatvam, ekādeśātprāgeva padasaṃjñāpravṛtteḥ| na tvekādeśe kṛte "suptiṅantam" ityasya prāptirasti| ubhayata āśrayaṇe nāntādivaditi siddhāntāt| yattu vadanti--prakṛtisannidhāne pratyayasya padatvaṃ nāsti 'mantreṣu' 'sarveṣām' ityādinirdeśāditi, tanmandam, uktarītyā padatvābhāve nyāyasiddhe jñāpanasyāsambhavādanupayogācca| sarvādīni sarvanāmāni sarvādīni iti tadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ| "hali sarveṣām" iti nirdeśāt| dvandve cetīti| sa hi samudāyasya niṣedho, natvavayavānāmiti vakṣyate| na ca tadantavidhiṃ vinā samudāye saṃjñāprasaktirastīti bhāvaḥ| nanu tadantasaṃjñāyāḥ kiṃ phalam| na ca paramasarvasmāyityādau smāyādayaḥ phalam, aṅgādhikāre tadantavidhinaiva tatsidhderityata āha--teneti| na cehāpi 'prātipadikāt' ityanuvṛtteḥ sarvanāmnāṃ tadviśeṣaṇe tadantavidhirbhavatīti vācyam, "samāsapratyayavidhau pratiṣedhaḥ" ityukteriti bhāvaḥ| akacceti| cakārātparamasarvata ityatra tasil| jasaḥ śī anekāltvāditi| na tu śittvāditi bhāvaḥ| avarṇāntāditi| avarṇāntādaṅgātparasyetyarthaḥ| ato yeṣāṃ keṣāṃ teṣāmityādau nāvyāptiḥ| sarvanāmnā vihitasyāma iti| sarvanāmnaḥ parasyeti tu noktam, dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇāmityatra suṭprasaṅgāt| "dvandve ca" iti niṣedho hi samudāyasya na tvavayavasya| na ca tasmādayamām vihitaḥ, kiṃ tu samudāyādeveti na suṭ| vihitaviśeṣaṇatvasyāśrayaṇe pramāṇaṃ tu "dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām" iti bhāṣyaprayoga eva| pañcatriṃśaditi| pañca ca triṃśacceti dvandvaḥ| pañcādhikāṃstriṃśaditi tatpuruṣo vā| yattu pratyāhārā eracatvāriṃśaditi prāco granthaṃ vyācakṣāṇairuktam-- nāyaṃ madhyamapadalopī tatpuruṣaḥ| tathā sati "rājanyabahuvacanadvandve'ndhakavṛṣṇiṣu" "saṃkhyā" iti vidhīyamānaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na syāt| tasmātsamāhāradvandva evāyam| ekaviṃśatirityādau napuṃsakatvaṃ tu na bhavati lokāśrayatvālliṅgasyeti| taccintyam, samāsabhedena svarabhede iṣṭāpatteḥ| tathā ca "bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye" iti sūtre saṃkhyāyāstatpuruṣasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ niÏstraśādyarthamanyatrādhikalopāt" iti vārtikaṃ vyācakṣāṇo bhāṣyakāra āha--ekādhikā viṃśaterekaviṃśatiḥ, dvāviṃśatiriti| ata eveti| dvayordvivacanasyaiva nyāyyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanvevaṃ sarvādiṣu pāṭho vyarthaḥ, sarvanāmakāryāṇāṃ smāyādīnāṃ dvivacane'bhāvāt| na ca ubhābhyāṃ hetubhyāmubhayorhetvorityatra "sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca" iti pākṣikatṛtīyā tatphalamiti yuktam "nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam" iti vārtikena gatārthatvāt| na ca vṛttikṛtā "sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca" iti sūtre paṭhitatvādidaṃ vārtikaṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñāsāpekṣamiti vācyam bhāṣye "hetau" iti sūtre tasya paṭhitatvāt| ata evānnena kāraṇena vasati, annasya kāraṇasyetyudāhṛtaṃ haradattenetyāśaṅkyāha- tasyeha pāṭhastviti| ayacprasaṅgāditi| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--"ubhādudātto nityam" ityatra "ubhādudāttaḥ"yogo vibhajyate| avayavavṛtteḥ saṃkhyāvācina ubhaśabdādavayavinyarthe'yac syāt| ubhayoḥ maṇiḥ| tato "nityam" | ubhaśabdād vṛttiviṣaye nityamayacsyāt svārthe| tenobhayapakṣavinītanidrā ityādau ayac yathā nityaṃ evaṃ kapratyaye'pi syāditi| nanvevamakaci kṛte'pi ayaj durvāra iti cenmaivam| yogavibhāgasyeṣṭasidhyarthatayā "ubhau sābhyāsasya" iti nirdeśena ca yatra dvivacanaṃ na śrūyate tatraivāyamiti vyākhyānāt| tathā ca vārtikam-- "anyābhāvo dvivacanaṭābviṣayatvāt" iti| akaci hi sati "tanmadhyapatitaḥ tadgrahaṇena gṛhyate"iti nyāyenobhayaśabdasya dvivacanaviṣayatvaṃ na vihanyate, kapratyaye tu vihanyataiva| taduktamiti| vārtikakṛteti śeṣaḥ| yadyapi pūrvavārtike ṭābapyuktastathā'pi nāsau vivakṣitaḥ, ṭābviṣayatvamapi dvivacanaparatva eva boddhavyamiti kaiyaṭādibhivryākhyātatvādityāśayena vyācaṣṭe-- dvivacanaparatvābhāve iti| ṭābekādeśasyāpi pūrvāntatvena grahaṇād dvivacanaparatvamastīti bhāvaḥ| yadyapyubhāvityādau dvivacanaparatvaṃ durupapādamubhayata āśrayaṇe'ntādivadbhāvavirahāt tathāpyubhaśabdādutpannaṃ dvivacanaṃ lukā nāpahṛtaṃ yatra tato'nyatrāyac itīha vivakṣito'rthaḥ| yadyapi bhāṣye kapratyayasyāpi svārthikatvenobhaśabdāt parasya dvivacanatvamastītyāśrityobhaśabdapāṭhaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ, tathā'pi prauḍhivādamātraṃ tat| kṛtrimasyaiva dvivacanasyeha grahītumucitatvāt| anyathā tratasilādāvatiprasaktatvāt| nanu kārakavibhaktyantādvihitau tratasilau svārthikatve'pi dvattvamātraṃ nābhidatta iti ced na, kapratyayasyāpyajñātārthabodhakatvāt pañcakapakṣe'dhikabodhakatvadhrauvyācceti dik|| nāstīti| anabhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ| tathā cobhayaśabdasya dvivacanānutpādādasarvavibhaktikatvenāvyayatve prāpte "taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ" iti sūtre "kṛttaddhitānāṃ grahaṇaṃ ca pāṭhe" iti bhāṣyaṃ kaiyaṭenāvataritam| astīti| pacatikalpaṃ pacatirūpamityādivāraṇena pāṭhasyopakṣīṇatvādanabhidhāne pramāṇaṃ nāstīti bhāvaḥ| tayappratyayāntasyeti| ubhayaśabdasyeti bhāvaḥ| nityaiveti| 'pare'vara ubhayā amitrāḥ' iti tu chāndasatvādbodhyam| avyutpannāviti| etacca paspaśāyāṃ kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam| eke-- kāśikākārāḥ| 'etantvaṃ manye' ityudāttasya 'utatvaḥ paśyan' ityanudāttasya ca darśanāditi bhāvaḥ| ekaḥ--prathamaḥ| saṃhitayā pāṭhe tāntatvasyāsphuṭatve'pi tāntaśchettavyo'nyathā ekaśrutyā sakṛdeva paṭhet| na ca vipratipattavyam "tvattvasamasimetyanuccāni" iti phiṭsūtrāt| tathā ca ṛṅmantraḥ-- "starīru tvadbhavati sūta u tvam" iti| vedabhāṣyakārāścetthaṃ vyācakhyuḥ-- tvaditi sarvanāmasu paṭhito'nudātto'yamanyaparyāya iti| jayadevo'pi prāyuṅkta- "tvadadharamadhuramadhūni pibantam" iti| tvatto'nyasyā adhara iti vigrahaḥ, na tu tavādhara iti| "paśyati diśi diśi rahasi bhavantam" iti pūrvavākyena sahānanvayāpatteḥ| nema iti| śrūyate ca -- "pra nemasmindadṛśe soma' iti| sama iti| tathā ca śrūyate "nabhantāmanyake same" | "māno vṛkāya vṛkye samasmai"| "uruṣyāṇo aghāyataḥ samasmāt" | "uto samasminnā" ityādi | "simaḥ kṛtsne ca śakte ca syānmaryādāvabaddhayoḥ" | śrūyate ca--"ādrātro vāsastanute simasmai"| "ucchukramatkamajate simasmāt"| ubhayatrāpi simaśabdaḥ sarvaparyāya iti vedabhāṣyam| gaṇasūtra iti| yadyapi bhāṣye aṣṭādhyāyīsthe sūtre "apuri iti vaktavyam" iti vārtikaṃ paṭhitaṃ tathāpi tadgaṇasūtrasya śeṣaḥ, na tu jasi vibhāṣāvidhāyakasya| 'ata' ityadhikṛtya jasaḥ śīvidhānāt ṭābantātprāptyabhāvāt| antarāyāmiti| prākārādbāhyāyāṃ tadantarvartinyāṃ vetyarthaḥ| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā ekādeśasya pūrvāntatvena grahaṇādvā prāptirbodhyā| tyad, tad, etau uktaparāmarśakau| tatrādyaśchāndasa iti gaṇaratnakāraḥ| tanna, "syaśchandasi bahulam" iti sūtre chandograhaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| eko'nyārtho pradhāne ca prathame kevale tathā| sādhāraṇe samāne'lpe saṃkhyāyāṃ ca prayujyate|| svābhidheyeti| svasya pūrvādiśabdasyābhidheyenāpekṣyamāṇasyāvadherniyama ityarthaḥ| 'diśaḥ sapatnī bhava dakṣiṇāyāḥ' ityādāvapi vyavasthā'styeva; prasiddhatvāttu nāvadhivācī śabdaḥ prayujyate| na ca saṃjñātvānniṣedhaḥ ādhunikasaṃketo hi saṃjñā| na ca dikṣu sā'sti iti astātiprakaraṇe kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| atra dikṣu cirantanaḥ, kuruṣu tu ādhunikaḥ saṃketa ityatra vyākhyātṛvacanameva pramāṇam| etena 'viśveṣāṃ devānām' iti vyākhyātam| vedaprasiddhatvāt| ihāmukasmāt kuśalā iti avadhyanvayasaṃbhave'pi tanniyamo nāstīti bhāvaḥ| adhare tāmbūlarāgaḥ, pratyuttare ca śakta ityapi pratyudāhartavyam| kathaṃ tarhi "tathā pareṣāṃ yudhi ca" iti kālidāsaḥ, "apare pratyavatiṣṭhate" ityādi ca? atrāhuḥ--deśavācitayā vyavasthāviṣayayoreva parāparaśabdayorupacārācchatrau prativādini ca prayogaḥ| na caivamupasarjanatā| na hi lākṣaṇikatvamupasarjanatvam, kiṃ tu svārthaviśiṣṭārthāntarasaṃkramaḥ| sa ca samāsādivṛttāveva| ata eva bhūvādisūtre "etānyapīti-- etatpratipādyāni vastūnītyarthaḥ"iti kaiyaṭoktiḥ saṅgacchate| vastutastu parāparaśabdayordeśāntaraniṣṭhatvādikamevārthaḥ, śatrutvādikaṃ tu ārthiko'rthaḥ| asaṃjñāyāṃ kim ? uttarāḥ kuravaḥ| sumerumavadhimapekṣya kuruṣūttaraśabdo vartate ityastīha vyavasthā| kiṃ tu ādhunikasaṅketo'yamityāhuḥ| svamajñātidhanākhyāyām ātmātmīyajñātidhanavācī svaśabdaḥ, tatra jñātidhanayoḥ paryudāsāt ātmā ātmīyau pariśiṣṭāvityāśayena vyācaṣṭe-- ātmīyā ityarthaḥ, ātmāna iti veti| yattvāhuḥ--ātmani svaśabdo napuṃsakaḥ, tena sve svā ityudāharaṇaṃ tatra na sambhavatīti| taccintyam| ātmanyapi svaśabdasya puṃstvāt| "vibhāṣā jasi" iti prakaraṇe "svamātmīye" ityeva vaktavye gurunirdeśaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasyaivātra pramāṇatvāt| yadapi svokte'rthe upaṣṭambhārthaṃ-- svo jñātāvātmani svaṃ triṣvātmīye svo'striyāṃ dhane| iti amarasiṃhoktimāhuḥ, tadapi cintyam| kośe hi ātmanīti pūrvānvayi| svamiti tu uttarānvayi| tathā ca hemacandraḥ- dyauḥ svarganabhasoḥ svo jñātyātmanoḥ svaṃ nije dhane|| iti| medinīkāro'pi-- svaḥ syātpuṃsyātmani jñātau triṣvātmīye striyāṃ dhane||iti| tasmāt sve svā ityasyātmāna iti vivaraṇaṃ samyageveti sthitam || jñātidhanavācinastviti| tācchīlye ṇininā jñātidhanayorapi ātmīyatvaṃ puraskṛtya pravṛttau sarvanāmatā'styeveti dhvanayati| etadarthameva hi sūtre ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| antaraṃ bahiryogopasaṃvyānayoḥ bahirityanāvṛto deśo bāhyaṃ cocyate| tatrādyamarthaṃ gṛhītvā''ha--bāhyā ityartha iti| dvitīye tu ābhyantarā ityartho bodhyaḥ | bāhyena hi ābhyantarasya yogo'sti| arthadvayamapyākare sthitam| upasaṃkhyānaśabdo'pi karaṇavyutpattyottarīyaparaḥ, karmavyutpatyātvantarīyaparaḥ| pūrvādibhyo navabhyo vā atredamavadheyam| etatsūtraṃ "jasaḥ śī" ityatrānuvartya vākyabhedena vyākhyeyam "vā cchandasi" ityetat "ami pūrvaḥ" ityatra yathā | evaṃ cāṣṭādhyāyyāṃ "pūrvapara--"ityāditrisūtrī gatārtheti mahallāghavam| ekaśabdasyāṣṭāvarthā uktāstatra viśeṣamāha-- saṃkhyāyāmiti| anyeṣu saptasu tu vacanāntaramapi syādeva, eke, ekeṣāmiti yatheti bhāvaḥ| na bahuvrīhau kṛte bahuvrīhau niṣedho vyarthaḥ 'upasarjanībhūtā na sarvādaya' iti vakṣyamāṇatvādata āha-cikīrṣite iti| samāsātprāgeveti ca| prakriyeti| na ca nimittasyānupasarjanatvasya vināśonmukhatvātprāgeva saṃjñā na bhaviṣyatīti vācyam| akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣāyā anityatvāt| tatra caitatsūtrasyaiva jñāpakatvāt| atibhavakāniti| etadeva jñāpanaphalamiti bhāvaḥ| iṣṭāpattiṃ kṛtveti| "cchvoḥ śūḍ" iti satukkagrahaṇaṃ, prakṛtipratyayāpattivacanaṃ vā anityatve jñāpakam, lakṣyānurodhādvyavastheti bhāvaḥ| yathottaramiti| tathā cādyatve bhāṣyakāroktyaiva vyavastheti bhāvaḥ| yattu prācoktam-- bahuvrīhau sarvādeḥ sarvanāmatā na syāt| priyasarvāya| sūtrakāramate bahuvrīhau na sarvanāmatā| bhāṣyakāramate gauṇatvamātre| 'tvatkapitṛko' 'matkapitṛka' ityatra samāsāvayavayoryuṣmadasmadoḥ sarvanāmatvādanaṅgakāryatvenākac syāt sa mā bhūt, kapratyaya eva syādityetadarthamidaṃ sūtramiti nyāsakṛnmatamiti| atredaṃ vaktavyam| kiṃ bahuvrīhau saṃjñā neti vivakṣitam uta tadavayavānāṃ sarvādīnāmiti? nādyaḥ| samāsāvayavayoryuṣmadasmadorityuttaragranthavirodhāt, samudāye prāptivirahācca| na ca tadantavidhinā prāptiḥ| bahuvrīhyavayavānāmupasarjanatayā sarvādibahirbhāvena tadante prāpterdūrāpāstatvāt| ata eva na dvitīyo'pi| na copasarjanānāṃ pāṭhāt paryudāso vārtikakṛtokto na tu sūtrārūḍha iti vācyam| anvarthasaṃjñābalena sūtrākṣaraireva tallābhāt| etena sūtrakāramate bahuvrīhau na sarvanāmatetyapi parāstam| bahuvrīhāveveti tasyārthaḥ| bhāṣyakāramate ityādyapi na| viśeṣopādānena hi sūtrakāravārtikakārayormatamanyādṛśamiti pratīyate| devadatto vāmenākṣṇā paśyatītyukte dakṣiṇena na paśyatītivat| tacca na| sautravārtikamate'pi gauṇaparyudāsasyeṣṭatvāt| yattu tvatkapitṛka ityādi| taditthaṃ prācā vyākhyātam-- tvaṃ pitā yasya, ahaṃ pitā yasyeti vigṛhya bahuvrīhisamāse kṛte samāsāvayavayoḥ samāsāntaḥpātinoryuṣmadasmadoḥ sarvārthavācakatvena sarvanāmasaṃjñakatvādajñātādyarthavivakṣāyām "avyayasarvanāmnām" ityakac prasajyeta| tasya smaiprabhṛtīnāmivāṅgādhikāravihitatvābhāvenāṅgasaṃjñānapekṣatvāt| tataśca tvakatpitṛka ityādyaniṣṭaṃ prasajyeteti| nyāsakṛtā'pi anvarthasaṃjñābalādeva saṃjñānirāse kṛte'kaj na bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkya samudāyo hi viśeṣe vartate, pūrvapadantu sarvārthatāyā anapetamevetyuktam| tadetatsarvaṃ prāmādikameva| tathā hi-- jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau samāsāvayavayorartha eva nāsti| ajahatsvārthāyāmapi svārthaviśiṣṭānyapadārthavṛttitvenopasarjanatvaṃ spaṣṭameva| evaṃ ca samāsāntaḥpātinoryuṣmadasmadoḥ sarvārthavācakatvenetyādi granthaḥ, samudāyo hityādinyāsagranthaśca pakṣadvaye'pi vyāhataḥ| kiṃ caivam atisarvāyetyatra smāyadeśo durvāraḥ, aṅgādhikāre tadantagrahaṇāt| tvaduktarītyā sarvaśabdasya sarvārthatānapāyāt| na hi pūrvapade sarvārthatā uttarapade tu neti yuktimat| api caivaṃ gauṇatve sarvādīnāṃ sarvārthavācakatvaṃ nāstīti svoktyā saha virodhaḥ syāditi yatkiṃcidetat| yadapi vyācakhyuḥ-- tvaṃ pitā yasyetyādau vigrahavākye prāptā saṃjñā niṣidhyate iti| tadapi na| vigrahavākyaṃ hi laukikamalaukikaṃ vā vivakṣitam ? nādyaḥ| prakriyāvākye'yaṃ niṣedho na tu laukika iti kaiyaṭagranthavirodhāt, prakṛtasanadarbhagatapūrvāparasvagranthavirodhācca| na dvitīyaḥ| tasya yuṣmad su pitṛ su ityākārakatvena tvaṃ pitetyākārakatvāyogāt| yadapi vyācakhyuḥ-- nanvatisarvādau saṃjñā na pravartate tvatkapitṛkādau tu saṃjñā pravartata ityatra kiṃ vinigamakantatrāha--anaṅgakāryatveneti| aṅgaśabdaḥ samudāyaparaḥ| tenātisarva ityatrāṅgasaṃjñā'pekṣitā sarvanāmno'ṅgāt smāyādividhānādavayavayamātrasya satyapi sarvanāmatve doṣābhāvāt| samudāye ca samudāyārthaṃ prati sarvāderupasarjanatvāt tadantasya saṃjñā na bhavatīti yuktam| iha tu avayavamātrasya sā cikīrṣitā na samudāyasya, avayavaśca svārthamātrapradhāna iti syāt prasaṅga iti vaiṣamyamastītyāśaya iti| tadapi na| aṅgādhikāre tadantavidheḥ sarvasaṃmatatvenāvayavamātre satyapi sarvanāmatve doṣo nāstītyuktevryāhatatvāt| aṅgādhikāraparibhāṣayā smai syāditi svagranthavirodhācca| athāyamāśayaḥ--prāk pravṛttā'pi saṃjñā arthāntaropasaṃkrame sati gateti| tarhi akajapi gacchatu| nanu kāryakālapakṣe smāyādyarthaṃ punaḥ saṃjñāpekṣitā, sā ca durlabhetyāśayaḥ iti cet? astvevam| na tvasau prakṛtagranthārthaḥ| nyāsagranthavisaṃvādena 'iti nyāsakṛnmatam' iti vākyaśeṣavirodhāt| nyāsagranthastvanupadamevodāhariṣyate| yadapi vyācakhyuḥ-- aṅgapradhānaṃ bādhyaṃ tadviruddhamanaṅgaṃ bādhakamityarthaḥ| tathā ca kapratyayāpavādatvādakac syadityartha iti| tadapi kliṣṭaṃ vyarthaṃ ca, nyāsagranthāsaṃmataṃ ca| tathā hi, tvatkapitṛko matkapitṛka iti vṛttigranthaṃ vyākhyāya nyāsakāra ujjagrāha-- nanu ca anvarthasaṃjñākaraṇādevātra saṃjñānirāse kṛte'kaj na bhaviṣyati| na hyatra sarvārthatā sambhavati viśeṣaviṣayatvāt| naitadasti| samudāyo hi viśeṣe vartate pūrvapadaṃ tu sarvārthatāyā anapetameva| bhavatu tarhi anayoranantarayoretatsūtraviṣayatā | priyaviśvāyetyādestu nopapadyate| na hi priyaviśvādayaḥ sarveṣāṃ nāmāni| nāpi tadavayavabhūtānāṃ viśvādiśabdānāṃ kiñcitsarvanāmakāryamupapadyate| smaiprabhṛtīnāmaṅgakāryatvāt| viśvādiśabdānāmanaṅgatvāt| evaṃ manyate--tvatkapitṛko matkapitṛka ityatrākaj mā bhūd ityetadarthaṃ tāvadetadārabdhavyam| priyaviśvāyetyādāvapi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| anena hi nyāsagranthenāṅgasaṃjñā'napekṣatvamevārtho labhyate, sa ca svotprekṣitavyākhyāyāṃ dūrotsārita eva| yadapi vyācakhyuḥ--yadyapi sūtravārtikakṛtorapyetanmataṃ tathā'pi nyāsakṛtā vivṛtatvād nyāsakṛnmatamityuktamiti| tadapi sthavīyaḥ, vārtikakṛtā asyārthasyāspṛṣṭatvāt| nyāsakṛtā samāse kṛte satītyadi vadatā tvaduktārthasya dūratyaktatvena tadvivṛtatvābhāvācca| yadapyāhuḥ- nyāsakṛcchabdena sūtrakāra eva vivakṣita ityādi| tadapi na | sūtrakāramate bahuvrīhāvityādipūrvagranthena saha virodhāt| bhāṣyakāramate tviti granthena tasya vicchinnatvācca| tasmādiha prācaḥ prakriyāgranthāstadvyākhyātṛgranthāścāpātaramaṇīyā evetyāstāṃ tāvat| yadi tu prakriyāgrantho'pi kathaṃcidbhāṣyāvirodhena vyākhyeya ityāgrahastarhītthaṃ vyākhyāyatām-- nanu priyaviśvāyeti gauṇatayā gatārtham| ato niṣkarṣamāha-- sūtrakāramata iti| bahuvrīhāviti| cikīrṣite satīti śeṣaḥ| gauṇatvamātra iti| mātraśabdo'vadhāraṇe, gauṇatve eva na tu tataḥ prāk| tathā ca sūtraṃ pratyākhyātamiti bhāvaḥ| nyāsakṛnmatasya tu atiphalgutvāt "svarūpavyākriyaiva parākriyetyāśayenāha- tvatkapitṛka ityādi"| etacca prācīnatattadgranthapariśīlanaśālibhirvibhāvanīyam| prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| saṃjñākāryamiti| sarvanāmasaṃjñāprayuktaṃ smāyādikamityarthaḥ| antargaṇakāryamiti| "adḍḍatarādibhyaḥ" "tyadādīnāmaḥ" "tadoḥ sassau" ityādikamityarthaḥ| tṛtīyāsamāsārtheti| iha "pūrvasadṛśa--" iti vihitaḥ samāso gṛhyate pratipadoktatvāt, na tu "kartakaraṇe kṛtā" iti| tena tvayakā kṛtamityatra niṣedho na| samudāyasyeti| tatraiva dvandvaśabdasya mukhyatvānna tu dvandve yāni sarvādīnīti sambandhaḥ, kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaivānvayāt| na ca dvandve vidyamānāni yānīti sambandhaḥ| vidyatikriyādhyāhāre gauravāt| niṣedhyāyā bhavatikriyāyā eva prādhānyena tadanvayasyaiva nyāyyatvācca| kiṃ ca tyadādīnāṃ dvandvo nāsti ekaśeṣeṇa bādhitatvāt| tataḥ prācīnāstvadanyāstatra kākacorna viśeṣaḥ| na ca dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇāmityatreṣṭamapi puṃvadbhāvaṃ niṣeddhuṃ kiṃ na syāditi vācyam| "sarvanāmno vṛttimātra" iti mātragrahaṇaṃ hi kvacitsarvanāmatvena dṛṣṭānāṃ samprati saṃjñā'bhāve'pi puṃvadbhāvaḥ| tasmād nyāyabalād phalabalācca samudāyagrahaṇamevocitam| yadyapi tvacchabdastānta iti pakṣe'vayavaniṣedhe'pi phalaṃ suvacam, tathāpi śāstrasyalpaviṣayatā syād nyāyaśca virudhyeteti bhāvaḥ| suṭprasaṅga iti| varṇāśrametarāṇāmityādāviti bhāvaḥ| na ca niṣedhasāmarthyam| anāṅgasya tratasilādervyāvṛttyā caritārthatvāt| jasādhāramiti| yadyapi śībhāvena jas apahyite, tathā'pi aupacārikamādhāratvaṃ bodhyam| yadvā, jasaḥ iḥ jasiḥ, tasmin| sautraḥ saptamyā luk, ityarthato vyācaṣṭe--jasādhāramiti| jarāyā jarasanyatarasyām vibhaktāviti| etacca "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" ityato'nuvartate| tena jarāyā idaṃ jāramityādau nātivyāptiriti bhāvaḥ| padeti| padamaṅgaṃ ca viśeṣyam viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhiriti bhāvaḥ| tadanusāribhiriti| inātoḥ pūrvavipratiṣedha ekasūtropāttatvāt syādeśo'pi grahītumucita iti teṣāmāśayaḥ| ata eva-- vītajanmajarasaḥ paraṃ śuci brāhṛṇaḥ padamupaitumicchatām|| iti bhāraviprayogamasamañjasaṃ matvā vītajanmajarasa iti paṭhanīyamiti tairuktam| etacceti| bhāṣyakṛtā hi "ṭāṅasi" iti sūtre inātau pratyākhyāya nādeśamadādeśaṃ ca vidhāya nādeśe pare etvaṃ yogavibhāgena sādhitam| "bahuvacane jhalyet" "osi ca"| tata "āṅi" āṅi ca pare'ta etvaṃ syāt| rāmeṇa| tata "āpaḥ sambuddhau ca" ekāraḥ syāt saṃbuddhau āṅi osi ca| na caivamanenetyatra hali lopaḥ syāditi vācyam| anādeśasya nakāre pare viśiṣya vidhānāt| tathā hi, "anāpi" nakāre āpi ca pare'n syādityarthaḥ| sūtre a iti nāntasya napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ| na ca ṅaseradādeśe kṛte pararūpaṃ syāditi vācyam| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyāddīrghasambhavāditi| tathā ca "jarāyā jarasanyatarasyām" iti sūtre uktam -- "gonardīyastvāha- atijarairiti bhavitavyaṃ sannipātaparibhāṣayā" iti| evaṃ ca pūrvavipratiṣedhenetyādi sarvaṃ bhāṣyaviruddhamityarthaḥ| "paddanno--" atra śasprabhṛtayo nimittatayopāttāḥ| te ca padādyādeśānurūpān prakṛtiviśeṣānākṣipantītyāha-- pāda-danteti| yadyapi "śīrṣaṃśchandasi" ityato'tra 'chandasi'ityanuvartate, tathā'pi bhāṣāyāmapi kvacidbhavati "māsaśchandasi" iti vārtike chandograhaṇād jñāpakāt iti vakṣyate| prāmādikamiti| tathā hi,"āsno vṛkasya vartikāmabhīke" iti mantre mukhādityarthaḥ aucityāt| "vṛkasya cidvartikāmantarāsyāt"iti mantrāntarasaṃvādācca| evaṃ "havyā juhvāna āsani" "āsanyaṃ prāṇamūcuḥ" ityādāvapi| vyākhyānaṃ ca tathaiva vedabhāṣyeṣu| ata eva haradattenāpi kāśikāyāḥ prāmādikatvamāviṣkṛtamiti dhyeyam| "allopo'naḥ" atra prāñcaḥ-- annantasya bhasyāṅgasyākārasya lopaḥ syāditi| tathā sati 'takṣṇā' ityādau takārākārasyāpi lopaḥ syāt| bhasyāṅgasyāno'kārasya iti vyākhyāne tu 'anasā, manasā' ityādau syāt| tantrāvṛttyādinā'nnantasya bhasyāno'kārasyeti vyākhyāne'pi 'anastakṣṇā' ityādau ativyāptirevāto vyācaṣṭe--aṅgāvayava ityādi| bhasyetyanenākṣiptaḥ pratyayaviśeṣo'ṅgaṃ ceti dvayamano viśeṣaṇam| an tu akārasya, ato noktadoṣa iti bhāvaḥ| etacca "ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam" iti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam| raṣābhyām pade itīyataiva sāmarthyādekapadatve labdhe'pi samānagrahaṇaṃ yatsamānameva, akhaṇḍamiti yāvat| tatra yathā syāttena samāse na bhavati| rāmanāma| yūṣṇa iti| yūṣo maṇḍaḥ| 'mudgāmalakayūṣastu bhedī dīpanapācanaḥ' iti darśanāt| iti pakṣe tviti| etena pañcamīsamāsasya pākṣikatāṃ dhvanayati| tathā hi, bhāṣye -bebhiditā, māthitikaḥ, apīpacanniti prayojanatrayamuktam| taccānyathā siddham| "ekāca upadeśe" ityatra vihitaviśeṣaṇādeva bebhiditetyatra iṇniṣedho na| mathitaṃ paṇyamasyeti vigrahe ṭhaki ṭhasyekādeśe "yasyeti ca" ityallope "isusuktāntātkaḥ" iti kādeśastu na bhaviṣyati| ṭhasyābhāvāt| na ca sthānivadbhāvena ṭhatvamalvidhitvāt| "ṭhasyekaḥ"ityatra hi sthānyādeśayorakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| apīpacannityapi ṇilopasya caṅantyakārayorekādeśasya ca sthānivadbhāvaṃ vinā'pi siddham| vidhisāhacaryādabhyastādapi laṅa eva jherjusvidhānāt| na ca sicā sāhacaryād luṅa eva kiṃ na syāditi vācyam| pūrvasāhacaryātparasāhacaryasya balīyastvāditi dik| pūrvatrāsiddhe neti| etacca nyāyasiddhamityavocāma| tripādyā asiddhatvena tatratye kārye kartavye "acaḥ parasmin" ityatideśasyāpravṛtteḥ| tasyeti| tasya 'pūrvatrāsiddhe'ityasya | tathā ca sthalatraye sthānivadbhāvo vaktavya ityarthaḥ| saṃyogādilope cakryatra| latve nigālyate| ṇatve māṣavapanī| iha "yasyeti ca" iti allopasya sthānivatvena nakārasya prātipadikāntatvābhāvād ṇatvaṃ na| yattvāhuḥ--kathaṃcitsthānivatvābhāve'pi yūṣṇa ityādau "raṣābhyām" ityasya nopayogaḥ, ṣṭutvena siddheḥ| tathā ca ṣagrahaṇamuttarārthamiti ākare sthitam| tataśca rabhasavādenaitadupanyastamiti| sa evāyaṃ rabhasavādaḥ| tathā hi, uttarārthatayā'pīha ṣagrahaṇaṃ sthitam| tataśca yūṣṇaḥ, puṣṇāti ityādau "raṣābhyām" iti ṇatvasya pravṛttiḥ kena vāryatām? ṣṭutveneti cenna| tasyāsiddhatvāt| na ca vacanāprāmāṇyātsiddhatvam| puṣṭirityādau caritārthatvāt| tasya ṣayoge ṇa ityaṃśo'caritārtha iti cenna| tasya pṛthaganukteḥ| iha ṣātparasyatyuktiracaritārthetyasyāpi tulyatvācca| ākare hi iha ṣagrahaṇaṃ vinā lakṣyāsiddhirnāsti ityevābhipretaṃ, na tu puṣṇātītyādau "raṣābhyām" ityasyāpravṛttiriti dik| nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya luptaṣaṣṭhīke iti| sautratvānna tu ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣayoḥ pūrvapade, sāpekṣatvena samāsāsambhavāt prātipadikasya padaviśeṣaṇatvācceti bhāvaḥ| tadantasyeti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| tasyānto yo nakārastasyetyarthaḥ| uktaṃ ca haradattena-- 'viśeṣyamantasyetyasya netyetadavibhaktikam, tathaiva prātipadiketyetatpadaviśeṣaṇam' iti| yattu prācoktaṃ-- prātipadikāntasya padāntasya nasyeti| yacca vyākhyātam--antasyetyubhābhyāṃ saṃbadhyate iti| tadgauravagrastam, antasyetyasyāvṛttiprasaṅgād vyadhikaraṇaṣaṣṭhīdvayāpatteśca| yadi tu abhedenaiva sambandhena prātipadikeneva netyanenāpi padaṃ viśeṣyate, tadā viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhau sautramantagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ śīti "napuṃsakācca"iti vihito na tu jaśśasoḥ śiḥ, tasmin bhatvāsambhavāt| "bhasya" ityanenāsarvanāmasthānasyaiva yajāderākṣepāttadetadāha-- asarvanāmasthāneti| ata eveti| doṣaṇī iti prayogāt| yadyapi samāhāradvandvasya ekaśeṣe kṛte'pi bhāṣyaṃ suyojyaṃ, tathā'pi kakudityasya pṛthakpadatvaṃ nyāyyam| anyathā kakuda ekatvaṃ bāhvordvitvaṃ ca na labhyeta iti bhāvaḥ| "tamupādravadudyamya dakṣiṇaṃ dorniśācaraḥ" iti raghuḥ| tatra dakṣiṇaṃ doriti udyamyetyanena karmatayā sambadhyate| doṣaṃ tasyeti| "doṣaṃ tasya tathāvidhasya bhajataścāpasya gṛhṇan guṇam"| iti śrīharṣaprayogaḥ| tatra doṣaṃ hastaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ ca bhajataścāpasya guṇaṃ maurvīmatiśayaṃ ca gṛhṇan iti sambandhaḥ| amaravyākhyātārastu-- doṣaśabdaṃ striyāmapi svīkṛtya bhāgurimatena ṭāpi doṣetyuktvā-- "dordoṣā ca bhujo bāhuḥ pāṇirhastaḥ karastathā" iti dhanañjayanighaṇṭumudājahruḥ| dvayorahnorbhava iti| "taddhitārtha" iti samāsaḥ, kālāṭṭhañ| "dvigorluganapatye" iti luk| "rājāhaḥsakhibhyaḥ" iti ṭac| "ahno'hna etebhyaḥ" ityahnādeśaḥ| ahnaḥ sāya iti| syaterghañi avasānavacanaḥ sāyaśabdaḥ| "saṃkhyāvisāya--"iti jñāpakādekadeśisamāsaḥ| || ityadantāḥ|| hāhāniti| gandharvaviśeṣavācakamavyutpannaṃ prātipadikamidam| kaumārāstu--jahātīti hāhā iti kriyāśabdaṃ vadanto viśvapāvadrūpamāhuḥ| tanmate pratyudāharaṇaṃ tu 'akāro vāsudevaḥ syāt' tena saha vartanta iti sāḥ, tān sān iti bodhyam| || ityādantāḥ|| āṅo nā'striyām puṃsīti tu noktam, amunā kulenetyatra yathā syāt| na ca numā rūpasiddhiḥ| mutvasyāsiddhatvāt "iko'ci" iti numo'prāpteḥ| nādeśe tu nāsiddhatvaṃ "namune" iti niṣedhāt| na ca "namune' iti niṣedho numyevāstu, ne ityakārasyoccāraṇārthatvāditi vācyam amuṣmai kulāyetyādyasidhyāpatteḥ| acca gheḥ "idudbhyām"iti "ṅe" iti "aut"iti ca padatrayamanuvartate ityāśayena vyācaṣṭe--idudbhyāmuttarasya ityādinā| gheruttarasyeti noktam| sūtre "gheḥ"ityasya ṣaṣṭhyantatvāt| tantrāvṛttyādau ca pramāṇābhāvāt "aut" iti pūrvasūtre idudbhyāmityuttarasya ṅeriti klṛptasambandhasya tyāgāyogācca| autsyāditi| atra vyācakhyuḥ-- autastitvaṃ svaritārtham| "na vibhaktau" itītvaniṣedhastu na bhavati, anityatvāt| anityatvaṃ ca "idamasthamuḥ" iti thamo makārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārthāduditkaraṇāllabhyata iti tatraivoktamiti| taccintyam| "vibhaktau" iti sūtre ṅerautastakāra uccāraṇārtho netsaṃjña iti svayamevoktatvena pūrvāparavirodhāt| yuktaṃ coccāraṇārthatvaṃ na tu svaritārthatvam| "stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnau" ityādau svaritatvādarśanāt| 'at' iti taparatvaṃ tu budhdāvityādāvatve kṛte striyāṃ ṭāb mā bhūd ityetadarthamityāhuḥ| tadapi cintyam|taparagrahaṇāddhi ṭāpā saha dīrgho mā bhūt| ṭāp tu syādeva, lakṣaṇadvayabādhe mānābhāvāt| ata eva "kṛnmejantaḥ" iti sūtrabhāṣyavārttikayorvivaraṇe ca sannipātaparibhāṣayā ṭāb netyuktam| ṭāpā vyavadhāne hi ānantaryavighātaḥ syāditi| tasmād auta iva ato'pi taparakaraṇamuccāraṇārthamevetyavadheyam| anaṅ sau "sorḍā" ityeva siddhe anaṅvidhānamanyato'pi syāditi jñāpanārtham| tena uśanasaḥ sambuddhau anaṅ sidhyatīti prāñcaḥ| taccintyam| sorḍetyukte hi "ṛduśanas" ityuttarasūtreṇāpi ḍā syāt| tataśca uśanetyatra "sarvanāmasthāne cā'sambuddhau" iti dīrghaḥ syāt| purudaṃsetyatra "sāntamahata" iti dīrghaḥ syāt| yadvā, 'saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti vā aṅgavṛttaparibhāṣayā vā samādhānaṃ bodhyam| halṅyābbhyo dīrghādityetanṅyāporeva viśeṣaṇam, na tu halo'sambhavāt ityāha--dīrghāviti| paramiti| na tvidaṃ vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ yā, sā, kā ityādāvavyāpteḥ| na ca tatra halantādvihitatvena nirvāhaḥ| yaḥ, sa ityādāvativyāpteḥ 'kartā' ityādāvavyāpteśceti bhāvaḥ| haliti| tasya ca sutisītyevaṃrūpatvamekadeśavikṛtanyāyena bodhyam| lupyata iti| yadyapīha "lopo vyoḥ" ityato lopa ityanuvartate| tacca tatra bhāvasādhanaṃ tathā'pīha karmasādhanaṃ haliti prathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyāditi bhāvaḥ| dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kim? atikhaṭvaḥ, niṣkauśāmbiḥ| nanu iha samastasya ṅyābantatvaṃ nāsti| na ca 'strīpratyaye tadādiniyamo nāsti' iti vācyam| anupasarjane hi tathā| iha tūpasarjanatvāt tadādiniyamo'styeva| satyam| tathā'pi uttarapadasya ṅyābantatvena sostataḥ paratvānapāyāt| na hīdaṃ vihitaviśeṣaṇamityavocāma| ata eva 'bahuśreyasī' ityatra sulopaḥ| syādetat| gaṅgīyateḥ kvip| gaṅgīḥ| ihekārasya sthānivadbhāvenāptvāddīrghatvāccātivyāptiriti cet ? satyam, ṅī ī, ā āp iti praśliṣya dīrghagrahaṇasya pratyākhyānānna kaściddoṣaḥ| sutisīti kim ? bhettā| tāsestakārasya lopo mā bhūt| na caivamapi 'abhaitsīt' ityādau sico lopāpattiḥ| sutibhyāṃ sāhacaryeṇa vibhaktereva grahaṇāt| apṛktaṃ kim? bhinatti, chanattīti pratyudāharanti| taccintyam, viśiṣṭasyāhaltvāt| sutisīnāṃ haliti kliṣṭaṃ vyākhyāyātiprasaṅgāpādanasyānucitatvāt| yadapyāhuḥ--surāṃ sunotīti surāsut, tamācaṣṭe surāsayati, tataḥ kvip, surāḥ, surāsau, surāsaḥ| iha sunoteravayavasya sasya lopaṃ vyāvartayituṃ apṛktagrahaṇamiti| tadapi na, parasparasāhacaryeṇa sutisīnāṃ vibhaktīnāmeva grahaṇāt| anyathā sico lopāpatteruktatvāt| pratyayāpratyayayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇācca| hal kim ? bibheda| nanu prathamahalgrahaṇaṃ vyartham| halantātpareṣāṃ saṃyogāntalopasambhavāt| atrāhuḥ-- saṃyogāntasya lope hi nalopādirna sidhyati| rāttu ternaiva lopaḥ syāddhalastasmādvidhīyate|| tathā hi, sakhetyatra nalopo na syāt, saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvāt| syādetat| saṃyegāntalopo nāsidhdaḥ "na ṅisambudhyoḥ" iti sūtre sambudhdigrahaṇājjñāpakāt| na caivaṃ gomānityadāvapi nalopāpattiḥ| jñāpakasya viśeṣaviṣayatvāt 'yatra hi nakāravibhaktyorānantaryantatraiva siddhatvam', vyākhyānāt| yattvāhuḥ-- he brahmanniti napuṃsakārthatvād naitajjñāpakamiti| tanna, lukā lupte pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvena "saṃbuddhau vā napuṃsakānām--" ityasyāvaśyakatayā ca sambudhdigrahaṇasya napuṃsakaviṣayatvāsambhavenoktajñāpakasya susthatvāt| tasmānnalopo na prayojanamiti cet? iha tarhi abhino'tretyatra rorutvaṃ na syāt| tadidamuktaṃ nalopādiriti| tathā 'abibharbhavān' ityatra tilopo na syāt "rātsasya" iti niyamāt| atredamavadheyam| ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ soreva viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu tisyoḥ, vyākhyānāt| asminneva sūtre 'dvihalapṛktagrahaṇaṃ tisyośca grahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati' iti bhāṣyaṃ ceha pramāṇam| yadi hi ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ tisyorapi viśeṣaṇaṃ tarhi kathaṃ tisyorgrahaṇasyākartavyatāṃ brūyāt| yattu ṅyābbhyāṃ tisyorasambhava eveti| tatra ṅyantādasambhava iti satyam| ābantāttu ācārakvibantāllaṅaḥ tipsipau sta eva| agaṅgāt, agaṅgāḥ iti yathā| na ca śapā vyavadhānam, ekādeśasya pūrvāntatvena grahaṇāt| na ca sthānivadbhāvaḥ, apūrvavidhitvāt| atrāyaṃ niṣkarṣaḥ| ṅyāpaḥ sorityeva sūtramucitam| na ca surāḥ surāsau ityādau dhātoḥ sakāre'tiprasaṅgaḥ| ṅyābbhyāṃ sāhacaryāt, 'pratyayāpratyayayoḥ' iti paribhāṣāyā ca pratyayasyaiva sorgrahaṇāt| rājetyādau nalopastu "na ṅisambuddhyoḥ" iti jñāpakena sādhita eva| kiṃ cābhino'treti utvamapi sūpapādam| 'saṃyogāntalopo rorutve' iti siddhakāṇḍe pāṭhāt| harivo medinaṃ tveti yathā| abibharbhavān ityatrāpi na doṣaḥ| "rātsasya" ityatra takārasyāpi praśleṣeṇa tsasyeti cchedāt| nanu ukhāsradityādau saṃyogādilopaḥ syāditi cet? na, datve kṛte tadaprāpteḥ| asidhdaṃ datvamiti cet ? na, siddhakāṇḍe 'vasvādiṣu datvam' iti pāṭhāt| nanvapadāntatvād datvaṃ na syāditi cet? na| sāvapi padaṃ bhavatīti pakṣāśrayaṇāt| tadbījantu "asarvanāmasthāne yaci" iti cchitvā yajādau sarvanāmasthāne padaṃ neti vyākhyānam| na caivaṃ rājetyādau nalope kṛte so rutvavisargau syātāmiti vācyam| "ito't sarvanāmasthāne" iti siddhe "pathimathi" ityākāravidhānena prathamaṃ sulopasya jñāpanāt| nanu naitajjñāpakaṃ, saṃbuddhau caritārthatvāt| he panthāḥ, manthāḥ, ṛbhukṣāḥ| tatra hi dīrghaḥ "asaṃbuddhau" iti paryudastaḥ, nalopaśca niṣiddha iti cet ? evaṃ tarhi nalopāt prāk saṃyogāntalopa ityarthe "na ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ" iti sūtrameva jñāpakamastu| tathā hi--'ṅisaṃbudhyoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī na tu saptamī, ṅerlukā luptatayā pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvāt, ṅyantasya ca prātipadikasyeti sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayaḥ| na ca prathamaṃ saṃyogāntalopaṃ vinā sambuddhyantaprātipadikaṃ labhyate | tasmānṅyāpaḥ soriti nyāse na kiñcid bādhakam| yadi tu 'vasvādiṣu datvam' iti vārtikaṃ pratyākhyāyate| adhātugrahaṇenaivokhāsradityādau dīrghābhāvasidhdeḥ| tarhi halṅyāpaḥ soriti sūtramastu| yattu yathāśrutaṃ sūtraṃ prācā vyakhyātam-- ṅyantādābantād dīrghācceti| tanna, ṅyāpau hi dīrghau, na tadantamapi| na ca dīrghād ṅyantādityāderdīrgho yo ṅī tadantādityādirartho labhyate| dīrghāt iti pañcamyā ananvayāt| samāse upasarjanayorṅyāporviśeṣaṇāyogāt| uktaṃ hi bhāṣye--"saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna" "vṛttasya ca viśeṣaṇayogo na" iti| etena anadīsaṃjñaṃ hrasvam iuvarṇāntamityapi prāco vṛttiḥ pratyuktā| sakhyurasaṃbuddhau iha "ito'tsarvanāmasthāne" ityataḥ "sarvanāmasthāne" ityanuvartate| tat "asambuddhau" ityanena viśeṣyate| "goto ṇit" iti sūtrād "ṇit" ityanuvṛttaṃ tatsāmānādhikaraṇyena saptamyāḥ prathamā kalpyata ityāha-- sambuddhivarjaṃ sarvanāmasthānamiti| sakhyurasaṃbuddhirityeva tu sūtraṃ yuktam| khyātyātparasya kṛtayaṇādeśayoḥ khikhīśabdayoranukaraṇaṃ khya iti| evaṃ titīśabdayoḥ tya iti| ubhayatrāpyakāra uccāraṇārtho na tu mukhyāpatyādiśabdaikadeśānukaraṇamidam| "sakhyuryaḥ" "patyurnaḥ" "saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca" "āpatyasya ca taddhite" ityādinirdeśāt; ityabhipretyāha--khitiśabdābhyāmityādi| parasyetigrahaṇam "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" ityadhikāranivṛtyartham| aut etacca nadīsaṃjñakeṣu "idudbhyām" iti pūrvasūtreṇa bādhyate, ghisaṃjñakeṣu "acca gheḥ" ityuttarasūtreṇa| tasmāt saṃjñādvayaśūnyo'sya viṣayaḥ| na ca tādṛśa ukāro'sti, ata āha-- ukāreti| yattu prācā ghinadīsaṃjñāvarjitābhyāmidudbhyāṃ parasyetyuktam| tanna, tādṛśokārasyāprasiddheḥ| samudāyasyeti| na ca paryudāse'pi paryudasyamānasamarpake sakhiśabde tadantagrāhakatvaṃ śaṅkyam, viśeṣyāsannidhānāt| yattviha "grahaṇavatā" ityādyupanyastaṃ haradattena, yacca khyatyātsūtre kaiyaṭena, tanna, tasya pratyayavidhiviṣayatvāt| gauṇatve'pīti| asthyādyanaṅvaditi bhāvaḥ| tathā ca "yena vidhiḥ' iti sūtre "paramasakhāyāviti bahuvrīhiḥ, tatpuruṣe hi ṭacā bhāvyam" iti kaiyaṭaḥ| tathā "dvitīyā śrita--"iti sūtre somasakheti pratīkamupādāya bahuvrīhitvānna samāsānta iti kaiyaṭaḥ| "midaco'ntyāt" iti sūtre "tṛjvatkroṣṭuḥ" "striyāṃ ca" iti sūtre ca bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ khyādhātau mādhavagranthe ca sphuṭametat| 'anudyukṣo varuṇa indrasakhā' 'āgneyā hi marutsakhā' 'tīvraṃ somaṃ pibati gosakhāyam' ityadiprayogāścaivameva saṅgacchante| tatra bahuvrīhiprayuktasya pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasya darśanena gauṇatvāt| etena ghisaṃjñāsūtre śobhanaḥ sakhā yasya susakhirityudāharantau haradattanyāsasakārau tadanugāminaścānye upekṣyāḥ| patiḥ samāsa eva evakāra iṣṭato'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| anyathā hi samāse patireveti sambhāvyeta| "dhātvādeḥ" ityādijñāpakānusaraṇe ca pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| atha kathaṃ - sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥ? parāśaraśca-- "naṣṭe mṛte pravrajite klībe ca patite patau" iti? ucyate, patirityākhyātaḥ patiḥ ṇau ṭilope "acaḥ iḥ" ityauṇādika iḥ| ayaṃ patiśabdaḥ "patiḥsamāsa eva" ityatra na gṛhyate, lākṣaṇikatvāt| etena 'kṛṣṇasya sakhirarjunaḥ' iti bhārataṃ 'sakhinā vānarendreṇa' iti rāmāyaṇaṃ ca vyākhyātam| bahugaṇa-- "bahugaṇa"|| bahagaṇau prātipadike saṃkhyāvācake gṛhyete, na tu saṃghavaipulyavācake api, saṃkhyāyate anayeti anvarthasaṃjñāvidhānāt| ata eva ḍatiripi taddhita eva gṛhyate, vatunā sāhacaryācca; na tu pāterḍatiḥ| ṣaḍbhyo ṣaḍbhyaḥ parayoriti| bahuvacananirdeśo'rthaprādhānyasūcanārthaḥ| ṣaḍarthagatasaṃkhyābhidhāyinoriti phalito'rthaḥ| pratyayalope-- sthānivatsūtreṇa siddhe niyamārthamidam| pratyayasyāsādhāraṇaṃ yatra rūpaṃ prayojakaṃ, tadeva kāryaṃ pratyayalope sati bhavati na tu pratyayāpratyayasādhāraṇamiti|tena śobhanā dṛṣado'sya sudṛṣat prāsāda ityatra "atvasantasya" iti dīrgho na| yadvā yatra pratyayaḥ prādhānyenāśrīyate tatrālvidhitve'pi vidhdyarthamidam| tena atṛṇeḍityatra halādau piti sārvadhātuke vihita im lupte'pi tasmin bhavati| 'varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇam' iti tu varṇaprādhānyaviṣayakam| tena gave hitaṃ gohitamityatra av na| asmaditi| atra prācā avyayetyapi paṭhitaṃ tattu avyayānāṃ prāyeṇa nirliṅgatvād avyayībhāvasya klībatve'pi liṅgāntarābhāvāccopekṣitam| vastutastviti| arthaprādhānyabodhakasya bahuvacanasyābhāvāt gauṇatve'pi trayādeśo nyāyyaḥ asthyādyanaṅvaditi bhāvaḥ| akāro vaktavya iti| tathā ca bahutvābhāve auḍulomiśabda ikārāntaḥ| bahutve tu akārānta uḍulomiśabdasya idantasya bahutve adantatvamiti na bhramitavyam| || || iti idantāḥ || kiditi| tena "āto lopa iṭi ca" ityālopa iti bhāvaḥ| yayīpapyādaya iti| yattu prācoktam--evaṃ devayajyatilakṣmyādaya iti| tanna, devān yajata iti vigrahe "in" ityauṇādikasūtreṇa hrasvāntasyaiva devayajiśabdasyojjvaladattādibhiḥ sādhitatvāt| "admo dvijāndevayajatīnnihanma" iti bhaṭṭiprayogasya hrasvaviṣayakatayaiva vyākhyātatvāt| na ca yajerdīrgha īpratyayaḥ pratipadokto'sti| bahulagrahaṇātkalpyata iti ced? bhavedevaṃ, yadyananyathāsiddhaṃ kalpakamupalabhyeta| vede'pi hrasva eva prayujyate--"āyajiṃ tvā manave jātavedase" iti| atilakṣmīśabdasya tu nadītvāt hrasve āḍāgame nuṭi āmi ca kṛte mahadeva vailakṣyaṇyamiti na vātapramīsāmyam| etacca mūle eva spaṣṭībhaviṣyati| kvibanteti| etaccamāṅ māne śabde ca iti dhātau mādhavagranthe spaṣṭam| bahuśreyasīti| "īyasaśca" iti na kap| nāpyupasarjanahrasvaḥ, 'īyaso bahuvrīherna' iti niṣedhāt| yū stryākhyau īdūdantāviti| iha varṇayoreva saṃjñetyapi pakṣo'sti "ācchīnadyornum" iti sūtrasvarasāt| tayostryākhyatvaṃ tu ṅyādiṣu svataḥ kvacitstrīvācakavarṇasamudāyaghaṭakatvena praveśāt| śaktiparyāptyādhikaraṇatvasyāvivakṣitatvāt| tena nadyantādityādivyavahāro na virudhyate| evaṃ ghisaṃjñāyāmapi i uvarṇau tadantaṃ vā ghisaṃjñi iti pakṣadvayaṃ bodhyam| varṇasaṃjñātve 'asakhi' ityasya sakhibhinnasyāvayava ityartho na tu sakhiśabdāvayavaṃ varjayitveti| tena 'atisakhinā' ityādi nirbādhamityavadheyam| pūrvamiti| vṛtteḥ prāgityarthaḥ| vaktavyamiti| saṃjñāyā yathoddeśapravṛttau nyāyasiddhamidaṃ, kāryakālatve tu vācanikameva| aci śnu-- iha yvoriti dhātoreva viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu śnubhruvoravyabhicārād ityāha-- ivarṇovarṇāntadhātoriti| śnuprabhṛtīnāmivarṇovarṇayoriti vyakhyāne tu iyaṅuvaṅorṅittvaṃ vyarthaṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ ca doṣaḥ| kṣipati adyutat didivatuḥ ūyatuḥ ityādau cātivyāptiḥ| tadvāraṇāya ivarṇovarṇayoracparatvena viśeṣaṇe tu kliṣṭateti bhāvaḥ| āntaratamyāditi| sthānata iti bhāvaḥ| eranekācaḥ-- "aci śnudhātu" iti sūtre dvandvanirdeśe'pi dhātureveha sambadhyate na tu śnubhruvau, tayorivarṇāsambhavāt| dhātugrahaṇaṃ cāvṛttyā ubhayorviśeṣaṇaṃ saṃyogasya cāṅgasya ceti vyācaṣṭe-- dhātvavayavasaṃyogetyādi| tatra dhātunā saṃyogasya viśeṣaṇādiha yaṇ--unnyau, unnyaḥ| aṅgaviśeṣaṇantu 'harim, harī, harīn' ityādisiddhaye| yadi hi dhātunāṅgaṃ na viśeṣyeta tarhi ihāpi 'praddhyaṃ, praddhayaḥ' ityādāviva pūrvarūpaṃ pūrvasavarṇadīrghaṃ ca bādhitvā yaṇ syāt| dhātvavayavasaṃyogapūrvako na bhavati ya ivarṇastadantatvādaṅgasya| vṛścikaśabdasyeti| bhāṣyakṛtā hi budhdiparikalpitamapāyamāśritya "bhītrārthānām" iti sūtraṃ pratyākhyātam, tataśca sambandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyeveti bhāvaḥ| sūtramate'pyāha- vṛścikasaṃbandhinīti| allopayalopāviti| na ca paratvāt "verapṛktasya" iti syaditi vācyam, 'verapṛktalopādvali lopaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena' iti vārttikakārokteḥ| kvau luptamiti| napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ| kvau lopa ityarthaḥ| idaṃ sarvaṃ kumārīmicchan kumārītyatrāpi bodhyam| ananyatayeti| gauṇatve'pi anaṅṇittvayoḥ pravṛtteruktatvācceti bodhyam| dīrghasyapīti| etadarthaṃ kṛtayaṇādeśanirdeśa iti bhāvaḥ| nanvatisakheḥ, bhūpateḥ iti guṇaviṣaye vyāvartayituṃ yaṇā nirdeśa iti cet ? astvevam, tathā'pi dīrghe pravṛtterdurvāratvāt| na hi hrasveṣu bhāvyaṃ na dīrgheṣvityatra pramāṇamasti| sautrasya vikṛtanirdeśasyāvyāptyativyāptyubhayavārakatvena tatsāravattvalābhena tathaivaucityād bhāṣyārūḍhatvācca| yattu prācā veti kecit ityuktvā sakhyuḥ ityādyuktam| yacca tadvyākhyātṛbhirubhayamapyetadbhāṣye sthitamityuktam| yaccātropaṣṭāmbhārthaṃ prasādakṛtā-- sakhyuḥ patyuḥ prasiddhyai yat khyatyādityāha pāṇiniḥ| sādhāraṇaṃ tanmanvānāḥ sukhyuḥ sutyuḥ sakhīḥ sutīḥ|| sukhīyatisutīyatyoryau kvibantau tayorviduḥ| niṣṭhādeśasya pūrvatrāsiddhatvāllūnyurādikam|| sukhya ityādi sādhvetadubhayaṃ bhāṣyagauravāt| iti vicāracintāmaṇisthaślokopanyasanaṃ kṛtaṃ, tadetatsakalaṃ bhāṣyakaiyaṭāparyālocanamūlakamiti kṛtabudhdaya eva vidāṃkurvantu| śuṣkiya iti| yattu śuṣkyuḥ, pakvyuḥ, śuṣkyaḥ, pakvyaḥ, ityādyudājahruḥ, bhāṣye sthitamiti copasaṃjahruḥ, tadatirabhasāt|| tṛjvatkroṣṭuḥ kruśa āhvāne| asmāt 'sitani' iti tunpratyaye kroṣṭuśabdaḥ, tṛci tu kroṣṭṛśabdaḥ| dvāvapi śṛgālavācinau| tatrāviśeṣeṇa dvayoḥ prayoge prāpte sarvanāmasthāne striyāṃ ca tṛjanta eva, tṛtīyādāvacyubhayam, anyatra tu tunnanta eveti, niyamārthaṃ trisūtrī ārabhyate| kroṣṭuriti tunnantāt prathamā| tṛjantāt prathamā| tṛjvaditi tṛtīyāntādvatiḥ| nimittavyapadeśatādātmyaśāstrakāryarūpaviṣayakatvenātideśasya ṣaḍvidhitve'pi prādhānyādiha rūpamevātidiśyate| tacca na pacāderyasya kasyacit kiṃ tu kruśereva, upasthitatvādarthata āntaryāccetyabhipretya phalitamāha-- kroṣṭuśabdasthāne iti| niyamārthamiti| anyeṣāṃ saṃjñāśabdānāṃ mā bhūdityetadarthamityarthaḥ| kroṣṭeti| anaṅ| halṅyadilopātparatvādupadhādīrghaḥ| sa ca "sarvanāmasthāne ca" ityanena yadyapi labhyate tathāpi paratvāt "aptṛn" ityeva nyāyyaḥ| kṛte'pyanaṅi ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvena tṛctvāt| anyathā guṇe kṛte'pi dīrgho na syāditi bhāvaḥ| rātsasya iha takāro'pi praśliṣyata iti pakṣāntaram| tena halṅyādisūtrasthāne ṅyāpaḥ soriti niṣkarṣe abibharbhavānityādi sidhyati| ajarghart ityatra tu cartvasyāsiddhatvāt talopo na| nanu kīrtayateḥ kvipi kīrt iha syāditi cet ? na "yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte" iti bhāṣyam| etenāvarvart iti vyākhyātam| paratvāditi| na ca nuṇnitya iti vācyam, tṛjvadbhāve kṛte sannipātaparibhāṣayā nuṭo durlabhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| numacireti| nanu reṇa svaviṣaye prāptaṃ sarvaṃ bādhyam, bādhyasāmānyacintāśrayaṇāt| tathā ca vakṣyate-- 'guṇadīrghotvānāmapavāda' iti | evaṃ cāviśeṣād nuḍapyanena bādhyaḥ| tatkathaṃ vipratiṣedhaḥ| utsargāpavādayostadayogāditi cet ?satyam, ata eva tadaṃśe vipratiṣedhaṃ dūṣayitvā "na tisṛcatasṛ" iti jñāpakāt nuḍiti bhāṣyakṛtoktamiti santoṣṭavyam| | || ityudantāḥ || hūhūriti| avyutpannā saṃjñeyam| aticamūśabde tviti| 'prathamaliṅgagrahaṇaṃ ca' ityukteḥ| tathā ca evamaticamvādaya iti prāco grantho bhāṣyaviruddha iti bhāvaḥ| varṣābhvaśca varṣābhūśabdasya nityastrītvāt strīliṅgaprakaraṇa eva etatsūtraṃ vaktuṃ yuktam| pulliṅge tu kriyāśabdābhiprāyeṇa kathaṃcidyojyamiti vyācakhyuḥ, tadrabhasāt| dardure hi pulliṅgo'yam-- bheke maṇḍūkavarṣābhūśālūraplavadardurāḥ| ityamarokteḥ| bhinnaliṅgānāṃ na dvandva iti tena paribhāṣitatvāt, bhekyāṃ punarnavāyāṃ strī varṣābhūrdardure pumān|| iti yādavakośācca| dardure ṣaṇīti pāṭhāntaram| ṣaṇīti pulliṅgasya prācāṃ saṃjñā| dṛbhatīti| dṛbhī granthe tudādiḥ| vyutpādita iti| yadyapyujjvaladattena dṛmphūriti pavargadvatīyaṃ paṭhitvā dṛmphernalopābhāvo nipātyate iti vyākhyātaṃ, tathā'pi vṛttyantareṣu dṛbhī granthe ityasmāt ḍūpratyaye numāgamo nipātyate ityuktam| etacca mādhavagranthe spaṣṭam| daśapādīvṛttau tu darbhaṇaṃ dṛmbhūḥ, numāgamo'nusvāraśca nipātyate ityuktam| ayamūkāro na dhātorityuvaṅo'prasaṅgāt "iko yaṇaci" iti yaṇ| sa ca ""ami pūrvaḥ" "prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ" ityābhyāṃ bādhyata ityāśayenodāharati--dṛmbhūmityādi| na ceha 'dṛnkara' iti yaṇ śaṅkyaḥ, tatra arthavata eva grahaṇāt| asya tu dṛnśabdasya bhūśabdasya ca anarthakatvāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ cāyaṃ hūhūvaditi phalitam| śrīpatimatenāha--dṛnniti| mādhavastu--'andūdṛnbhū'ityādisūtreṇa dṛḍhaśabde upapade kūpratyayaḥ, upapadasya dṛnnādeśaśca nipātyate ityāha- dṛnbhūriti| taruḥ sarpajātibheda iti kecit| kapirityanye| dṛnkareti| atra dṛnniti nāntapāṭho mukhyaḥ| māntapāṭho'pi keṣāṃcit| vaktavya iti| "varṣābhvaśca" iti| cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| anuktaṃ ca bhāṣyavārtikabalānnirṇeyamiti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca varṣābhūpunarbhvaśceti vārtikaṃ vyākhyāya bhāṣyakāra āha-- atyalpamidamucyate, varṣādṛnkārapunaḥ pūrvasya bhuva iti vaktavyamiti| vāmanena tu dṛnśabdo na paṭhita eva| evaṃ sthite yatprācā dṛkkāreti paṭhitaṃ, yacca tatpautreṇa mahābhāṣyakāravacanamarthato'nuvadati ityuktam| yaccānyairvārtikena pūritamarthamudāharatītyavatāritaṃ, tatsarvaṃ rabhasakṛtameva| na ca bhāṣye'pi dṛgityeva pāṭha iti bhramitavyam| andūdṛnbhū iti nipātita iti mādhavagranthena kaiyaṭādigranthaiścavirodhāpatteriti yatkiṃcidetat| dīrghapāṭhe iti| ayaṃ ca bhāṣyavṛttyādibahugranthasaṃmataḥ pāṭhaḥ| anusmṛtau tu hrasvaḥ paṭhyate| yattu tadvivṛttāvuktam--ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt kārapūrvasyāpi siddhamiti| tanna, tathāpyaṇpratyayaviśiṣṭasyānyatvāt| na hyaṇpratyayo'pi vikāraḥ| tasmāddhrasvapāṭhe kārapūrvakasya uvaṅeva, tathā dīrghapāṭhe karapūrvasya uvaṅiti vivekaḥ| svayambhūvaditi| prācā tu dṛnbhūkārābhūśabdau varṣābhūśabdavadudāhmatau| tannirmūlatvādupekṣyamiti bhāvaḥ| nṛ ca iha "chandasyubhayathā" iti sūtrāt 'ubhayathā' ityanuvartate| 'chandasi' iti tu nivṛttam| tena 'cintājarjaracetasāṃ bata nṛṇāṃ kā nāma śānteḥ kathā' 'nṛṇāmeko gamyastvamasi' ityādiprayogāḥ saṅgacchante| kecittu 'chandasi' ityanuvartayanti| tadayuktam, pūrvasūtreṇaiva siddhe 'nṛ ca' iti sūtrasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ| yadapi pūrvasūtre 'tisṛcatasṛ' ityanuvartayanti; tadapyayuktam, aviśeṣeṇa vikalpadarśanāt| tathā ca "dhātā dhātṛṇām" iti mantre taittirīyaihrasvaḥ paṭhyate, bahvṛcaistu dīrgha iti dik| || ityṛdantāḥ || oto ṇiditi vācyamiti| gota ityapahāya ota iti vācyamityarthaḥ| tathā ca gāmityatra paratvādvṛddhau satyāmātvaṃ na syādityāśaṅkya niravakāśatayā ātvena vṛddhirbādhyata iti "auto'mśasoḥ" iti sūtre bhāṣyakṛtoktam| kaiyaṭo'pi tatretthamāha- ota iti sūtre pāṭhyam, gota ityokāropalakṣaṇatayā vā vyākhyeyamiti| smṛtauriti| yattvāhuḥ--gośabdena auṇādikena sādṛśyād dyośabda eva lakṣyate na tvokārāntamātram| tena smṛtoḥ smṛtavau smṛtava ityeva bhavatīti, tadbhāṣyaviruddham| godyobhyāmeva parasya ṇitvābhyupagame hi 'auto'mśasoḥ' ityātvasya smṛtāmityādiravakāśaḥ syāt| tathā ca gāmityatra paratvādvṛddherdurvāratayā udāhṛtabhāṣyoktamātvasya bādhakatvaṃ niravakāśatvaṃ ca saṅgaccheteti dik| || ityodantāḥ|| rāyo hali 'artharaivibhavā api' ityamarātpuṃstvam, 'saṃrāyā bhūyasāsṛjā' ityādiprayogācca| 'rā yi chāndasaḥ' iti bhāṣyam| tacca kyajantasya raiśabdasya chāndasatvaparaṃ na tu kevalasyāpīti " vānto yi" iti sūtre kaiyaṭaḥ| kevalo'pi cchāndasa iti pākṣāntaraṃ sa evāha| || ityaidantāḥ || 'glaurmṛgāṅkaḥ kalānidhiḥ' ityamaraḥ| evaṃ janānavatīti janauḥ| "jvaratvara" ityūṭh| "etyedhati" iti vṛddhiḥ| janāvau janāva ityādi| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāmajantāḥ pum̐lliṅgāḥ|| || atha ajantastrīliṅgaprakaraṇam|| rameti| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā prātipadikatvāt svādayaḥ| yattu ābantāditi| yacca vyācakhyuḥ- pratyayāntatvādaprātipadikatve'pi pṛthaṅ ṅyāporgrahaṇāt ityartha iti tanna, ṅyābgrahaṇasyānyārthatāyāḥ prāgevoktatvāt| eṅ-hrasvāditi| paratvāt, pratipadoktatvācca "sambuddhau ca" ityetve kṛte halṅyādilopo na prāpnoti, sthānivadbhāvādāptve'pyākārarūpatvābhāvāt| āābityākāraṃ praśliṣya dīrghagrahaṇapratyākhyānāt| yathāśrute'pi "eṅ-hrasvāt" iti lopasyaiva paratvena nyāyyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| yāḍāpaḥ yadyapi yaḍityevocitam| na ca "ato guṇe" iti pararūpāpattiḥ, akāroccāraṇasāmarthyenaiva tadbādhāt, tathāpyuccāraṇārtho'kāra iti sambhāvyeta| ataḥ spaṣṭārthaṃ yāṭ kṛtaḥ| vṛddhirecīti| yattu prācā "āṭaśca" ityudāhṛtam, tanna, yāṭsyāṭoṣṭakārasya samudāyānubandhatveneha āṭo'bhāvāt| sarvanāmnaḥ syāḍḍhrasvaśca dīrghoccāraṇaṃ prāgvat| atra vadanti-- sarvanāmno'suṅ cetyeva sūtryatām| evaṃ ca yāṭi pare ṅitvādantyādeśe asuṅi sarvasyā ityādi siddham| syāṭkaraṇe hrasvavidhāne ca prayojanaṃ cintyamiti| atreyaṃ cintā-- asuṅ cetyukte'muṣmai ityādi na siddhyediti| vastutastu āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ yāṭo hrasvaśceti sūtrayituṃ yuktam| na caivaṃ yāṭa eva hrasvāpattiḥ, dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāt| hrasvoccāraṇe'pyakārasāmarthyādevāto guṇasya vārayituṃ śakyatvādityavadheyam| vibhāṣā-- gauṇatvādaprāpte vibhāṣeyam| yattvāhuḥ- "na bahuvrīhau" iti niṣedhe prāpta iti, tadāpātataḥ, tasyālaukikaprakriyāvākyāntargatasarvādiviṣayatvāt, asya ca samāsaviṣayatvāt| yottareti| yattvāhuḥ- yā pūrvā sottarā'syā uttarapūrveti, tadarabhasāt, pūrvanipātavaiparītyāpatteḥ| tīyasyeti| idaṃ hi puṃnapuṃsakayorāvaśyakam| anenaiva siddhau "vibhāṣā dvitīyātṛtīyā" iti sūtraṃ na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ|| ambārthanadyoḥ atra vārtikam-- "māturmātacputrārthamarhate" iti| mātṛśabdasya sambuddhau mātajādeśo bhavati mātrā putrasya ślāghyatve dyotye| gārgī mātā'sya gārgīmātṛkaḥ| tasya sambodhanaṃ he gārgīmāta| "nadyṛtaśca" iti samāsāntasyāpavādo'yam| yatra tu ślāghyatvaṃ na dyotyaṃ kiṃ tu svarūpakathanamātraṃ tatra kabeva-- gārgīmātṛka| ābantaṃ yadaṅgamiti| yattu "yāḍāpaḥ" iti sūtraṃ vyācakṣāṇairuktam-- atikhaṭvāyetyatra lākṣaṇikatvānna yāṭ, evamatisarvāyetyatra na syāḍiti; tadrabhasāt, na hyatideśaviṣaye lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā pravartate, atideśavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| tena yāṭ durvāraḥ| syāṭastu prasaṅga eva nāsti| saṃjñopasarjanayoḥ pāṭhāt paryudāsāt| kecittviti| pariśiṣṭakārādayaḥ| ṅiti hrasvaśca aprāptavibhāṣeyam| hrasvayoraprāptāvitarayostu "neyaṅuvaṅsthānau" iti niṣedhe prāpte ārambhāt| iheyaṅuvaṅsthānau strīśabdabhinnau nityastrīliṅgāviti trīṇi īdūtorviśeṣaṇāni, hrasvayostu striyāmityeva na tu nityastrītvaparyantam| anyathā iṣvaśaniprabhṛtīnāmubhayaliṅgānāṃ sarvaliṅgānāṃ ca strītve'pi nadītvaṃ na syāt, kaiyaṭarītyā nityastrītvābhāvāt, haradattamate'pi hrasvāṃśe nityagrahaṇavyāvartyālābhācca| ata eva ākhyāgrahaṇamapahāya strīśabdamātraṃ niṣkṛṣya sambadhyate; tadetadāha-- hrasvau ca iuvarṇau striyāmiti| autve prāpta iti| paratvāditi bhāvaḥ| yattu prācā "aut" iti sūtre ghinadīsaṃjñāvarjitābhyāmiti vyākhyātaṃ, nāsāvakṣarārthaḥ kiṃ tu pūrvottarasūtradvayalabhyaḥ| evaṃ ca "idudbhyām" iti sutrānupanyasanaṃ prācaḥ prāmādikamevaya aci ra ṛtaḥ guṇadīrghotvānāmiti| tisrastiṣṭhantītyatra "ṛto ṅi" iti guṇasya, tisraḥ paśyetyatra "prathamayoḥ" iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghasya, priyatisraḥ āgataḥ, priyatisraḥ svamityatra "ṛta ut" ityutvasya ratvamapavāda ityarthaḥ, bādhyasāmānyacintāyāṃ svaviṣaye prāptasya sarvasya bādhāditi bhāvaḥ| viśeṣacintāyāṃ tu "madhye'pavādā" iti nyāyena dīrghotvayoreva bādhaḥ syānna tu guṇasya| sāmānyaviśeṣapakṣau ca jātivyaktipakṣavallakṣyānurodhād vyavasthitau iti kaiyaṭādau spaṣṭam| yattu vyācakhyuḥ--apavādaśabdo bādhakatvopalakṣakaḥ| pūrvavipratiṣedhena guṇamapi bādhate ityāśaya iti| tannirmūlaṃ kliṣṭaṃ ca| yadapi prasādakṛtoktam-- guṇasya pūrvavipratiṣedhenetarayoḥ paravipratiṣedhena bādhaka ityartha iti| tanna, ravidheracaritārthatvāt| na ca ṭausoścaritārthatā, yaṇā gatārthatvāt| tricaturorviśeṣaṇāditi|| śrutatvāddhi tricaturorityasyaiva "striyām" iti viśeṣaṇaṃ nāṅgasyeti bhāvaḥ| priyatririti| atra vyācakṣate-- striyā anyapadārthatvena bahuvrīhirūpamaṅgaṃ tatra vartate, triśabdastu punnapuṃsakayoreveti tisrādeśo netyādi| atredaṃ vaktavyam- jahatsvārthāyāṃ triśabdo'narthakaḥ| ajahatsvārthāyāṃ tu striyāṃ vartata eva| tatkathaṃ punnapuṃsakavṛttitā saṅgacchatāmiti| atredaṃ tattvam| jahatsvārthaiva vṛttirihābhimatā, lakṣyānusārāt| tenāṅgaṃ striyāmiti samyageva| triśabdasya punnapuṃsakavācitā tu bhūtapūrvagatyā| uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ ityādisidhdāntapravādasyaivameva nirvāhyatvāt| evaṃ priyatasā pumānityatra striyāṃ vṛttirapi bhūtapūrvagatyaiva| ajahatsvārthāpakṣe tu strīniṣṭhasaṃkhyāsamarpakayostricaturoriti vivakṣito'rthaḥ| "pratyayottarapadayośca" ityetatsūtragatabhāṣyagranthasandarbhaśceha pramāṇam| anityatvāditi| "iko'ci" ityajgrahaṇaṃ ceha liṅgam| taddhi sambudhdau numaṃ vārayituṃ kṛtam| bhyāmādiṣu satyapi numi tallopasambhavāt| sambudhdiśca lukā lupteti pratyayalakṣaṇena numaḥ prāptirvācyā| pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ ca "na lumatā" iti niṣedhasyānityatāṃ vinā durlabhamityākare spaṣṭam| na cedamanityattvaṃ sambuddhiguṇamātraviṣayakamityabhiniveṣṭavyam, lakṣyānurodhenānyatrāpi kvacittadabhyupagame bādhakābhāvāt| tathā ca priyatisṛ priyatri iti rūpadvayamapi uktarītyaiva kaiyaṭena samarthitam| pūrvavipratiṣedheneti| na cātra pramāṇābhāvaḥ, priyatisṛṇi ityādibhāṣyodāharaṇasyaiva tatra pramāṇatvāt| dveratve satyābiti| vibhaktisannipātakṛtamapi tyadādyatvaṃ ṭāpo nimittam, sannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvāt "na yāsayoḥ" iti jñāpakācceti bhāvaḥ| iyādeśa iti| ajādau ya iyādeśo vihitaḥ sa upasarjanatve puṃsi vidyamānasya strīśabdasyausādiṣu caturṣveva na tvanyatra, guṇanābhāvādibhiḥ pūrvoktairbādhitatvādityarthaḥ| neyaṅuvaṅsthānāvastrī tiṣṭhato yayoriti sthānau, adhikaraṇe lyuṭ| iyaṅuvaṅoḥ sthānāviti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| phalitārthamāha-- iyaṅuvaṅoḥ sthitiryayoriti| yatreyaṅuvaṅau niṣpadyete tatraivāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ| yatra tvapavādena bādhyeta tatra na niṣedha ityetadarthaṃ sthānagrahaṇam| vāmi yadyapi prakṛto niṣedho'nena vikalpyata iti prāñcaḥ, tathā'pi niṣedhavikalpe vidhivikalpa eva phalati| tathā ca lāghavāt sa eva sūtrārtha ucita ityāśayenāha- vā nadīsaṃjñau sta iti| "ṅiti hrasvaśca" iti sūtrepyevameva| kathaṃ tarhīti| uvaṅsthānatvena nadītvābhāvāt hrasvo'nupapanna ityākṣepaḥ| bahava iti| kecittu "vāmi" ityato vāgrahaṇamihāpakṛṣya vyavasthitavibhāṣāṃ cāśritya samādadhuḥ| tanmandam| tathā satīha nañgrahaṇasya "vāmi" ityuttarasūtrasya ca vaiyarthyāpatteḥ| anye tu sāmānye napuṃsakamiti kathaṃcitsamādadhuḥ| na ṣaṭ striyāṃ yaduktaṃ tanna bhavatīti vyākhyānād anantaro ṅībiva vyavahitaṣṭābapi niṣidhyata ityāśayenāha-- ṅīpṭāpau neti| rāḥ puṃvaditi| rai śabdasya strīliṅgatayā smaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ| tathā ca kṣīrasvāmī-- rātyenaṃ rāḥ strītyeke iti| striyāṃ naustaraṇistarirityamaraḥ|| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāmajantāḥ strīliṅgāḥ|| || atha ajantanapuṃsakaliṅgaprakaraṇam|| ato'm svamoriti| amo'mvidhānaṃ lugbādhanārtham| am syāditi| etacca prācāmanurodhād vyākhyātam| saṃyogāntalopo jhala ityabhiprāyeṇa vā| vastutastu m ityeva padacchedo lāghavāt| tatra sorme kṛte jñānamiti siddham| dvitīyaikavacane tu "ādeḥ parasya" ityakārasya makāre kṛte'ntyasya masya saṃyogāntalope siddhamiṣṭam| yattu vadanti-- evaṃ sati "supi ca" iti dīrghatvaṃ syāditi| tanna, sannipātaparibhāṣāvirodhāt| yadapi dīrghavidhau sā na pravartata iti | tadapi na, "rudhādibhyaḥ śnam" "śnānnalopaḥ" iti sūtrayoḥ "supi ca" iti dīrghatve sannipātaparibhāṣāpravṛtterbhāṣyakṛtā dhvanitatvāt kaiyaṭenopapāditatvācca| yadapyāhuḥ--atijarasamiti na siddhyediti| tadapi na, dvitīyaikavacane hi "ato'm" iti bādhitvā paratvājjarasi kṛte sannipātaparibhāṣayā luko'pravṛttau rūpasiddhiḥ spaṣṭaiva, prathamaikavacane tu atijarasamityeveṣyate, sannipātaparibhāṣayā jarasādeśasyāpravṛtteḥ| ata iti takāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| bhasaṃjñāyāmiti| "suḍanapuṃsakasya" iti paryudāsenāsarvanāmasthānatvāditi bhāvaḥ| yasya-- iśca aśca yaṃ tasya| tadāha- ivarṇāvarṇayoriti| jaśśasoḥ jasā sāhacaryāt śasapi subeva gṛhyate| teneha na, kuṇḍaśo dadāti| śi śītyavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pūrvācāryānurodhāt| anyatamasya tviti| evaṃ ca "sāmānyādiṣvanyatamam" ityādiprayogāḥ prāmādikā eveti bhāvaḥ| soramādeśe iti| yattu prācoktam--svamoramādeśe vā jarasiti, tadbhāṣyavirudhdam| evaṃ ca ajarasaṃ vartate iti, he ajarasamiti cāpaśabda eva| ajarasaṃ paśyeti tu prayogaḥ sādhuḥ| kiṃ tu amādeśe kṛte jaras iti prāca uktirevāsādhvī, paratvājjaraso nyāyyatvāt pūrvavipratiṣedhe pramāṇābhāvācca| sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya sānteti pṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ saṃyogasyetyanena samānādhikaraṇamiti vyācaṣṭe-- sāntasaṃyogasyeti| upadhāyā iti| upadhāgrahaṇaṃ pūrvamātropalakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikārthasyehāsambhavāt| māsaśchandasīti| māsityasya takāraḥ syāt bhādau pratyaye chandasīti vākyārthaḥ| "mādbhiḥ śaradbhirdurodaraṃ tava" ityudāharaṇam| hrasvo napuṃsake-- iha hrasvaśrutyā "acaḥ" ityetadupasthitam| tena prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇāt tadantavidhirityāha- ajantasyeti| prātipadikasyāca iti tu na vyākhyātam, sambhavati sāmānādhikaraṇye vaiyadhikaraṇyasyānyāyyatvāt, suvāgbrāhmaṇakulamityādau ativyāpteśca| sannipāteti| avarṇamāśritya kṛto yādeśaḥ tallope nimittaṃ syāt| etacca "eoṅa" sūtre "iko guṇavṛddhī" iti sūtre ca bhāṣye dhvanitaṃ kaiyaṭena pratipāditaṃ śabdakaustubhe niṣkarṣaṃ prāpitamiti tata evāvadhāryam| evaṃ ca yādhātau śubhaṃyāśabdasya klībasya ṅayi śubhaṃya iti mādhavenodāhṛtaṃ tannādartavyamiti bhāvaḥ| svamornapuṃsakāt ayaṃ luk pūrvavipratiṣedhena tyadādyatvasya, kimaḥ kādeśasya ca bādhakaḥ| paratvāddhi tyadādyatve'mbhāvena taṃ kulamiti syāt| vṛddhyautveti| "atisakhīni kulāni" ityatra "sakhyurasambuddhau" iti ṇidvadbhāvād vṛddhiḥ prāptā, "vāriṇi" ityatra tu "acca gheḥ" ityautvam, "priyakroṣṭūni" ityādau tṛjvadbhāvaḥ prāptaḥ| nanu numnuṭoḥ ko viśeṣastatrāha-- nāmīti| numastu aṅgabhaktatvāt tasmin sati dīrgho na syāditi bhāvaḥ| tṛtīyādiṣu puṃvaditi| arthānnumhrasvayoḥ pratiṣedho'yam| pravṛttinimittabhedāditi| pīluśabdasya hi vṛkṣatvavyāpyajātirvṛkṣe pravṛttinimittam, phale tu phalatvavyāpyajātirvṛkṣa-viśeṣaprabhavatvaṃ vā| ubhayathā'pi punnapuṃsakayornaikaṃ pravṛttinimittamiti bhāvaḥ| asthidadhi-- atidadhneti| dadhi atikrāntenetyarthaḥ| yattu priyadadhneti uraḥprabhṛtiṣu "dadhimadhuśalī" iti pāṭhāt nityaḥ kap prāpto bhāṣyakāraprayogādeva priyadadhiśabde na bhavatītyāhuḥ| taccintyam| bhāṣye tādṛśapāṭhasya bahuṣu pustakeṣvanupalambhāt| striyāṃ tu priyadadhnyā, priyadadhnyai iti kecit| tanna| sannipātaparibhāṣayā bahiraṅgaparibhāṣayā ca ṅīpo'pravṛtteḥ| tasmāt puṃsīva striyāmapi atidadhnetyādikameva boddhyam| sudhinī iti| paratvānnumā iyaṅ bādhyate| sudhiyeti| puṃvattvapakṣe numo'bhāvādiyaṅ| bahvyaḥ śreyasyo yasya tat bahuśreyasī kulam| atra napuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ na, "īyasā bahuvrīherna" iti hrasvamātrasya pratiṣedhāditi śrīpatipuruṣottamaviśvarūpādayaḥ| anye tu upasarjanahrasva eva niṣidhyate, napuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ tu syādeva, bahuśreyasi bahuśreyasinī ityādyāhuḥ| snuḥ prasthaḥ sānurastriyāmityubhayaliṅgaḥ sānuśabdaḥ| tasya napuṃsakatve rūpamāha-- snūnī sānūnīti| puṃsi śambhuvat| priyakroṣṭūnīti| yattu prācā priyakroṣṭṝṇītyuktam| tatpūrvavipratiṣedhaparabhāṣyavārtikaviruddham| yattu vyācakhyuḥ "vibhāṣā tṛtīyādiṣvaci" ityetadviṣayako vipratiṣedhaḥ| bhāṣye priyakroṣṭune araṇyāyetyasyaivodāhmatatvāditi; tanna, udāharaṇasya saṅkocakatve mānābhāvāt| yadāhuḥ-- na codāharaṇamādaraṇīyamiti| kiṃ ca pūrvavipratiṣedhasya vaikalpikatṛjvadbhāvamātraviṣayakatve tatra tṛjvadbhāvagrahaṇaṃ vyarthameva syāt| priyakroṣṭunetyādervipratiṣedhaṃ vināpi pakṣe susādhatvāt| na ca priyakroṣṭretyādinivṛttistatphalam| puṃvadbhāvapakṣe tasya durvāratvāt, svayamapi tathodāhṛtatvācca| na ca samāhāradvigau pañcakroṣṭunetyādau puṃvadbhāvābhāvāt tatra tṛjvadbhāvanivṛttiḥ phalamiti vācyam| evamapi bhāṣyodāharaṇāsāmañjasyāt| upalakṣaṇaṃ taditi cet, hantaivaṃ priyakroṣṭūnītyevopalakṣyatāṃ bhāṣyodāhṛtaprātipadikāṃśānugrahāyeti dik| sulveti| puṃvatpakṣe numabhāvādyaṇ| suluneti| "oḥ supi" iti yaṇaṃ bādhitvā paratvānnum| yadigantamiti| etacca rā dāne iti dhātau atiri brāhmaṇakulamiti prakramya mādhavena spaṣṭīkṛtam| anye tu sudyośabdo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ| sa evedānīmigantaḥ, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt; ataḥ puṃvadbhāvo bhavatītyāhuḥ| tathā ca rūpamālādau puṃvadbhāva udāhṛtaḥ| tasmādejanteṣu klībeṣu puṃvadbhāvo mādhavamate nāsti, matāntare tvasti| ataḥ pradyavā, prarāyā, sunāvetyādi prācodāhṛtamapi nātīva duṣyati| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāmajantā napuṃsakaliṅgāḥ|| || atha halantapum̐lliṅgaprakaraṇam|| liḍiti| liha āsvādane kvip| liṭsu, liṭtsviti| ḍhasya jaśtvena ḍaḥ, tasya "khari ca" iti cartvena ṭaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvāt "ḍaḥ si" iti dhuṭ, cartvam takāraḥ| "na padāntāṭṭoḥ" iti ṣṭutvaniṣedhaḥ| 'cayo dvitīyā' iti tu neha pravartate, cartvasyāsiddhatvāt| etena te ca pratyāhārā ekacatvāriṃśaditi prāco granthaṃ vyācakṣāṇairyaduktaṃ liṭsu liṭhsviti ṭaṭhabhyāṃ rūpadvayamiti, tat pratyuktam| tathā ca prātiśākhye'pi "ūṣmodayaṃ prathamaṃ sparśameke dvitīyamāhurapadāntabhājam" iti śloke'padāntetyādiviśeṣaṇaṃ saṅgacchate| dāderdhātordhaḥ dhātorityāvartate| tatraikamatiricyamānamupadeśakālaṃ lakṣayatītyāśayenāha-- upadeśa iti| āvṛttiphalaṃ pṛcchati--upadeśe kimiti| avyāptyativyāptiparihāraḥ phalamityāha--adhogityādinā| ekāco baśo bhaṣ-- jhaliti nivṛttamiti| yattu prācoktam-- prātipadikasaṃjñasya tu jhali parataḥ padānte ceti| tatprāmādikameva, adhok adhog ajarghā ityādyasiddhyāpatteḥ, prātipadikagrahaṇasyāprakṛtatvācca, tatra jhalo nimittatvānupayogācca| dhugbhyāṃ dhukṣu ityādau padānta ityeva siddheḥ| yadapi tatpautreṇa vyākhyātam- jhali pare prātipadikasaṃjñasyaivetyādi; tadapi nirmūlaṃ niṣphalaṃ cetyupekṣyam| bhaṣbhāva iti| jaśtvacartvayorasiddhatvāttābhyāṃ prāgeveti bhāvaḥ| ṣatvacartve iti| cartvasyāsiddhatvāt pūrvaṃ ṣatvaṃ, tataścartvamiti bhāvaḥ| vā druha druherdāditvāt nityaṃ prāpte'nyeṣāmaprāpte ubhayatra vibhāṣeyam| nanu druhādayo divādiṣu anenaiva krameṇa paṭhyante, tatra vā druhādīnāmityevāstu, divādyantargaṇasya puṣādyantargaṇo radhādiḥ, tadantargaṇo druhādirastu| maivam| tathā hi sati yaṅluki na syāt, 'nirdiṣṭaṃ yadgaṇena ca' iti niṣedhāt| dodhruk, dodhruṭ| igyaṇaḥ yaṇaḥ sthāne iti| vidhipradeśeṣu sūtraśāṭakavadbhāvisaṃjñāśrayaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| vāha ūṭh "vasoḥ samprasāraṇam" ityato'nuvṛttaṃ samprasāraṇamūṭho viśeṣaṇam| tena "alo'ntyasya" iti na| yattu prācā vāśabdasyetyuktam| nāsau sūtrārthaḥ, kintu kathaṃcitphalitārthakathanaparatayā neyam| chandasyeveti| "chandasi sahaḥ" "vahaśca" iti sūtre chandasītyanuvṛtteriti bhāvaḥ| yattu ūṭhi kṛte savarṇadīrghaḥ bhūhaḥ, bhūhetyādi prācoktaṃ, tadbhāṣyaviruddham| tathā hi| ūṭhgrahaṇaṃ māstu| samprasāraṇameva vidhīyatām| tasya laghūpadhaguṇe kṛte "vṛddhireci" iti vṛddhau siddhaṃ viśvauha ityādi| evaṃ sthite kriyamāṇaṃ bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāṃ jñāpayati| satyāṃ hi tasyāṃ bahiraṅgasya samprasāraṇasyā'siddhatvādantaraṅgo guṇo na syāditi bhāṣye sthitam| nanvanakārānte'kārāntopasarge copapade rūpe viśeṣaḥ syāditi cet? maivam, bhāṣyakāroktajñāpakabalenaiva tādṛśasthale ṇvipratyayābhāvasyānumānāditi kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| etena vāryūhaḥ prauha ityādiprayogā api parāstāḥ| athavā ūhateḥ kvip ityavadheyam| vasruṃsu "vasusraṃsu"|| vasuḥ pratyayaḥ| tena tadantaṃ grāhyam| "sasajuṣo ruḥ"iti sūtrāt 'sa'ityanuvartate| tacca vasoreva viśeṣaṇam, na tu sraṃsudhvaṃsvoḥ, avyabhicārāt| nāpyanaḍuhaḥ, asambhavādityabhipretyāha--sāntavasvantasyeti| padānte iti| jhalīti tu prācaḥ pramādaḥ, srastamityādāvativyāpteḥ| saheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ "saheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ"|| saheriti kim ? saha ḍena vartata iti saḍaḥ| yasya nāmni ḍaśabdo'sti| yathā mṛḍa iti| saḍasyāpatyaṃ sāḍiḥ| || iti hāntāḥ || diva aut prātipadikasyeti| avyutpannasya, 'diverḍiviḥ' iti nyāsohitasūtreṇa vyutpannasya vā, na tu 'divu krīḍādau' iti dhātoḥ, "niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasye"ti paribhāṣayā| tenākṣadyūrityādau na bhavati| autastakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| sudyubhyāmiti| ukārasya samprasāraṇatvāt "halaḥ" iti dīrghaḥ prāpta 'ut' ititaparatvasāmamarthyānna bhavati| yattu prācoktam--'divo vā ātvamami' iti; tadupekṣitam, munitrayānukterniṣphalatvācca| dyāmiti rūpaṃ tu dyośabdasyaiveti bodhyam|| || iti vāntāḥ || ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca bahuvacananirdeśādarthaprādhānyaṃ vivakṣitam|arthāccāmaḥ paratvaṃ śabdadvārakam| tena tadantavidhau satyapi paramacaturṇāmityadāveva bhavati, na tu bahuvrīhau| tadetadvakṣyati--'gauṇatve tu nuṭ neṣyate' ityādinā| dvitvamiti| "aco rahābhyām" ityanena| || rāntāḥ|| kamalā lakṣmīḥ || iti lāntāḥ|| mo no dhātoḥ padānta iti| jhalīti tu yadyapi prācā'nuvartitaṃ, tathā'pi kāśikādāvabhāvāt, niṣphalatvāccopekṣyam| kimaḥ kaḥ nanu ima ityeva sūtryatām| tyadādīnāmimo aḥ syād iti vyākhyāsyate| kiṃśabdaśca dveḥ prāk paṭhiṣyate| 'nānarthaka' iti niṣedhādārambhasāmarthyāccālo'ntyavidhirna bhaviṣyati, tat kiṃ kādeśenetyāśaṅkyāha-akacsahitasyāpīti| ṭeratve kaka iti syāt| "ku tuhoḥ" ityādyatha ca kima ityavaśyaṃ vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ| nanvevaṃ gaṇakāryatvābhāvādupasarjanatve'pi syāt ? maivam, tyadādīnāmityanuvartya vacanavipariṇāmena tyadādeḥ kima iti vyākhyānāt| anuvṛttisāmarthyācceha sūtre dviparyantānām iti niyamasya tyāgāt| utsarga iti| tena "tadoḥ saḥ sau" iti sūtre'nantyayoriti kim ? 'he sa' iti bhāṣyaṃ 'bho acyuta bhavannacyuta' iti ca na viruddhyata iti bhāvaḥ| nāstītyatra mūlaṃ tu pracuraprayogādarśanameva| yattvāhuḥ-- idamastu sannikṛṣṭaṃ samīpataravarti caitado rūpam| adamastu viprakṛṣṭaṃ taditi parokṣe vijānīyāt||1|| iti vacanādevaṃvidhasyārthasyābhinukhīkaraṇānarhatvāditi; tadāpātataḥ, sannikṛṣṭādiśabdānāmiva idamādīnāmapi sambodhyasamarpakatve bādhakābhāvāt| viprakṛṣṭasyāpi buddhyā sannidhāpitasya bahuśaḥ sambodhanadarśanācca| tathā ca bhaṭṭiḥ- 'hāpitaḥ kvāsi he subhru bahvevaṃ vilalāpa saḥ' iti| anāpyakaḥ pratyāhāra iti| na tu ṭāp, vibhaktāviti viśeṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ| anabhyāsavikāra iti| tena "bhṛñāmit' "artipipartyośca"itītve'lontyavidhirastyeva| bibharti, piparti| nanu smāyādeśātparatvādanādeśaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāha-- nityatvāt ḍeḥ smai iti| kāryaṃ vidhātumiti| apūrvaṃ bodhayitumityarthaḥ| 'īṣadarthe kriyāyoge' iti śloke tu īṣadarthādayo na vidhīyante, kintvanūdyante| tena enādeśo na| etena-- naktaṃ bhīrurayaṃ tvameva tadimaṃ rādhe gṛhaṃ prāpaya| ityapi vyākhyātam, bhīrutvasyānuvādyatvena vivakṣitatvāt|| || māntāḥ || sugāṇiti|| "anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ" iti dīrghaḥ na ca tasmin kartavye'llopaṇilopayoḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ śaṅkyaḥ| dīrghavidhau tanniṣedhāt, kvau vidhiṃ prati niṣedhācceti bhāvaḥ| etena sugaṇṇīśa iti prāco granthaṃ gaṇayateḥ kvibiti vyācakṣāṇā upekṣyā iti dhvanayati| tadīyo grantho'pi samarthanīya ityāgrahe tu itthaṃ samarthyātām-- sarvalopitvena kvibivācaratīti kvip| kvapśabdādācārakvibantāt kartari kvip, tena vijityarthaḥ|| || iti ṇāntāḥ || upadhādīrgha iti| "sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau" ityanena| ṅau sambuddhau ceti| prācāmanurodhenetthaṃ vyākhyātam| ṅyantasya sambudhdyantasya ca padasyeti ṣaṣṭhyantatayā vyākhyānaṃ tūcitam| evaṃ hi pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ sulabhamiti tadarthaniṣedhasāmarthyānusaraṇakleśo na kartavyaḥ| pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivattvamāśaṅkyāha-- na ceti| ṣāṣṭhīmiti| "vāha ūṭh" ityatra jñāpitatvena taddeśasthatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ityasiddhatvāditi| niyamasūtrāṇāṃ vidhirūpeṇa pravṛttiḥ sāmānyaśāstratātparyasaṅkocakatayā ceti pakṣasya "dyudbhyo luṅi" iti sūtre bhāṣyakṛtā dhvanitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| niṣedharūpeṇa pravṛttiriti pakṣe tu "pūrvatrāsiddham' ityaneneti bodhyam| subvidhimudāharati--ātvamityādinā| svaravidhau tu --pañcārmam| "diksaṅkhye saṃjñāyām" iti samāse nalope kṛte avarṇāntaṃ pūrvapadaṃ jātamiti "arme cāvarṇaṃ dvyactryac" iti pūrvapadādyudattatvaṃ prāptaṃ nalopasyāsiddhatvānna bhavati| saṃjñāvidhau- 'pañcetyatra nalope kṛte'pi' ityādinā strīpratyayeṣu vakṣyati| kṛti tugvidhau tu--vṛtrahabhyām| "hrasvasya piti" iti tug na| kṛti kim ? vṛtrahacchatram| "che ca" iti tuk syādeva| pratidiveti| "kaninyuvṛṣitakṣirājidhanvidyupratidivaḥ" iti kanin| "hali ca"|| yattu prācā "upadhāyāṃ ca" ityupanyastam; tanna, divervakārasyānupadhatvāt| inhanpūṣāryamṇāṃ śau , 6|4|12 "inhan"|| upadhāyā iti| upadhādīrghasyaivāyaṃ niyamaḥ| tena 'vṛtrahāyate' ityatra "akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ" iti dīrgho bhavatyeva| tathā 'vṛtrahaṇī' ityatra "anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ" iti yo dīrghaḥ so'pi niyamena vyāvartyate, upadhādīrghamātrāpekṣayā niyamavijñānāditi bhāvaḥ| "hanteratpūrvasya" iti sūtraṃ yogavibhāgena vyācaṣṭe--"hanteḥ"| prasaṅgādasyodāharaṇamāha--prahaṇyāditi| prakṛtopayuktamaṃśamāha- atpūrvasya|| ekājuttareti| na cāllope kṛte ekāctvaṃ nāstīti vācyam| pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivattvāt| na ca 'pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' iti vācyam| 'tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu' ityukteḥ| yattu- "aṭkupvāṅ" iti sūtre 'vṛtraghnaḥ, srughnaḥ' iti bhāṣyamupādāya kaiyaṭena vyākhyātam-- "prātipadikānta" iti ṇatvaprasaṅga iti, tat pañcamīsamāso māstvityāśayena, tasya doṣa ittyatra ṇatvagrahaṇaṃ māstvityāśayena vā bodhyam| ṇatvagrahaṇapratyākhyānaṃ tu bhāṣye dhvanitaṃ kaustubhe prapañcitam| vastutastu "kumati ca" iti nityaṃ ṇatvamiha nyāyyam| sarvathā'pi vaikalpikaṃ nityaṃ vā prāptaṃ ṇatvaṃ niyamena nivartyata iti siddham| bhāṣye tu-- 'kuvyavāye hādeśeṣu pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ'| kiṃ prayojanam ? vṛtraghnaḥ, srughnaḥ, prāghāni| "hanteratpūrvasya" iti atpūrvagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati' ityuktam| etacca vārtikāśayavarṇanamātraṃ, na tu vastusthitiḥ| vārtikena sūtrāvayavapratyākhyānā'pekṣayā yogavibhāgamāśritya vārtikārthopasaṅgrahasyaiva nyāyyatvāditi dik| mādhavenoktamiti| itthaṃ hi tadīyo granthaḥ 'bhasajñāyāmallope uttarapadamanacakaṃ syāt| sthānivadbhāvaścā'lvidhitvānneti ekājuttarapadatvā'bhāvāt "prātipadakāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca" iti vikalpo bhavati-- vṛtraghno vṛtraghṇa iti| tadbhāṣyeti| kiṃ cā'lvidhitvānnetyasaṅgatam| alvidhyarthameva "acaḥ parasmin" ityasyā''rambhāt, tasyā'prāptau yuktyantarasyaiva vācyatvāt| vikalpa ityapyasaṅgatam, "kumati ca" sūtrasya durvāratvādityavadheyam| maghavā bahulam "arvaṇastrasāvanañaḥ" iti sūtrāt tṛ ityanuvartate| tadapekṣayā ca maghaveti ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā| tadāha-- maghavanśabdasyeti| adhātoriti| adhātubhūtapūrvasyāpītyarthaḥ| añcatigrahaṇaṃ hi niyamārtham--dhātoścedbhavati tarhyañcatereveti| evaṃ ca gomānivācarati gomānityādau samprati dhātutve'pi vidhyarthamadhātugrahaṇam| etacca mūle eva sphuṭībhaviṣyati| nanu kurvan ityādāviva saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvena nāntatvābhāvāddīrghatvaṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha-- iheti| bahulagrahaṇāditi| kvacidanyadevetyarthakādityarthaḥ| nipātanāditi| maherhakārasya ghakāraḥ avugāgamaḥ kanipratyayaścetyasya tritayasya nipātanādityarthaḥ| pratyākhyātamiti| tathā ca "chandasīvanipau"ityatra kaiyaṭenoktam--"maghavā bahulam"ityetanna kartavyaṃ śvānnukṣanniti nipātanānmaghaśabdānmatupā ca bhāṣāyāmapi śabdadvayasya siddhatvāditi| yattvatra vārtikakṛtoktam-- arvaṇastṛ maghonaśca na śiṣyaṃ chāndasaṃ hi tat| matubvanyorvidhānācca chandasyubhayadarśanāt ||1|| iti, yacca tadvyākhyānāvasare kaiyaṭena bhāṣāyāmasādhutetyuktam, tadvanibantamaddhyodāttamaghavan-śabdaviṣayakam| chandasyeva vanibvidhānāt| ato na kaiyaṭasya pūrvā'paravirodha iti dhvanayannāha-- chandasītyādi| antodāttaṃ tviti| yadyapi śvannukṣannityatra kaninantā ete ityujjvaladattādigranthamahimnā ādyudāttatvaṃ labhyate, tathāpi "ukṣā samudro aruṇaḥ suparṇaḥ, pūṣā tveto nayatu, agnirmūrdhā, nirmajvānaṃ na parvaṇo jabhāra, tvamaryamā bhavati yat" ityādau tatsūtropāttānāmukṣannādīnāmantodāttatvasya nirvivādatayā kanipratyaya evocita iti bhāvaḥ| "maghavā bahulam" iti sūtre maghona iti pratīkamupādāya maghaśabdasyākārasya "yasya" iti lopamāśaṅkya 'naitadasti, anyadeva hīdamavyutpannaṃ prātipadikam, tathā hi- bhāṣāyāmapyasya prayogo dṛśyate' iti vadannyāsakāro'pi maghavanśabdasyāntodāttatve bhāṣāyāmapi sādhutve cā'nukūlaḥ| evaṃ sthite matupamāśritya trādeśaṃ pratyācakṣāṇau bhāṣyavārtikakṛtau maghavānityatra trādeśapakṣe'pi dīrghaṃ svīkuruta eva| phalabhede pratyākhyānāsambhavāt| ato bahulagrahaṇānnā'siddhatvamiti yaduktaṃ tadbhāṣyādisaṃmatameva| yattvāhuḥ, matuppakṣe'pi chāndasatvānna dīrgha ityeva bhāṣyasyā''śaya iti; tanna| matubantasya chāndasatve mānābhāvāt| udāhṛtabhaṭṭikaiyaṭavirodhācceti dik| etena śvānnukṣannityatra nipātitasya maghavannityasya trādeśe dīrghābhāvāt maghavanniti kṣīrasvāmigranthaḥ pratyuktaḥ| tathā ca kātantrasūtraṃ 'sau maghavān maghavā ca' iti| vicāracintāmaṇāvapi 'maghavāneva maghavā' ityuktam| kāśikāyāmapi dīrgha eva dṛśyate ityalaṃ bahunā| arvaṇastṛ ṛdhātorvici guṇe ca ariti rūpam, tasmānmatupi arvantāvityādi setsyati| 'chandasīvanipau' iti vanipi vede arveti| loke tu ṛdhātoreva vanipi setsyati| rūḍhiśabdaścāyam| 'vājivāhārvagandharvahayasaindhavasaptayaḥ' ityamarakoṣāt| ato'rtho'pi na bhidyate| tathāpi nāntatāntayoḥ sarvatra prayoge prāpte vyavasthārthamidaṃ sūtraṃ, "tṛjvatkroṣṭuḥ" iti trisūtrīvat| yattu haradattenoktam- 'arvanmaghavanśabdayordvayorapi bhāṣāyāmasādhutvameva 'arvaṇastṛ maghonaśca' ityādi bhāṣyāditi; tadāpātataḥ| bhāṣyasya viśeṣaviṣayatāyāḥ prāgevoktatvāt| tathā ca śrīharṣaḥ-- 'vāhairalupyata sahasradṛgarvagarvaḥ' iti prāyuṅkta| nanu 'guṇā abhedakā' iti pakṣe sūtre'nanunāsikoccāraṇe'pi āntaratamyādanunāsikaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāha--ā āditi| yattvāhuḥ-- ihānunāsiko na| anaṇtvena savarṇagrahaṇābhāvāt| na ca "taparastatkālasya" iti anaṇi vidhyarthamiti vācyam| 'bhāvyamānaḥ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti' iti niṣedhāt| guṇānāmabhedakatve'pi śuddhaikavyakteḥ sūtre nirdeśānnātiprasaṅga iti| atredaṃ vaktavyam-- anaṇi vidhyarthamiti śaṅkāyāṃ 'bhāvyamāna' ityādyuttaramasaṅgatam| tasyāṇviṣayatvāt| yadāhuḥ- bhāvyamāno'ṇityādi| anyathā "coḥ kuḥ" ityādāvapi niṣedhāpatteḥ| tatroditkaraṇasāmarthyānna niṣedha iti cet ? kimanena bakabandhanaprayāsena| "taparastatkālasya" iti sūtre'pratyayagrahaṇasya bhāṣyakṛtā'nanuvartitatvācca| kiñca śuddhaikavyakterityasaṅgatam| abhedakatve doṣasya duruddharatvāt| ekā vyaktirgṛhyate ityuktyā hi vyaktyantaraṃ na nirdiṣṭamityarthaḥ phalitaḥ| sa ca guṇānāṃ bhedakatve satyeva saṅgacchate nānyathetyāstāṃ tāvat| etena 'bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti' iti niṣedhādākāro nānunāsika iti prasādagrantho'pi prayuktaḥ| dīrghasyānaṇtvena mūlaśaithilyāt| tho nthaḥ sthānyadeśau dvāvapyanackau| therntha ityeva siddhe " ito't" vacanaṃ ṛbhukṣinnartham| nthādeśa iti| kecittu anthādeśamāhuḥ| tatrā'kārapraśleṣo vyarthaḥ| yattu nyāsakṛtā prācā coktamanekāltve'pi thakāramātrasyāyamādeśo 'nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' iti nyāyāditi ; tanna| tadviśiṣṭasyāprasaṅgenoktaparibhāṣāyā iha viṣayābhāvāt| prasaṅgādāha--striyāmiti| supathīti| "inaḥ striyām" iti tu kab na kṛtaḥ; samāsāntavidheranityatvāt, "yuvoranākau" iti sūtre supathīti bhāṣyācca| "na pūjanāt' iti niṣedhasya tu nāyaṃ viṣayaḥ| ṣacaḥ prācīneṣveva sa iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| pathimathītyātvaṃ tho nthaśca liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā prāptaṃ vibhaktau liṅgaviśiṣṭāgrahaṇānna bhavati| śāviti| yattu prācā "ito'tsarvanāmasthāne" "tho nthaḥ" iti sūtradvaye suṭīti vyākhyātaṃ, tadasat| nirbījalakṣaṇā''patteḥ| klībe auṅaḥ śyāṃ supathī ityatrā'tivyāpteḥ| sapanthāni paśyeti śasi rūpasyā'siddhiprasaṅgācceti bhāvaḥ| atredamavadheyam| panthānamātmana icchati pathīyati| tataḥ kvip| alopaḥ| yalopaḥ| ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt "pathimathi" ityātvam| tho nthaḥ| panthāḥ| "ito'tsarvanāmasthāne" ityatvaṃ na bhavati, ita iti taparakaraṇāt| "eranekāca" iti yaṇaṃ bādhitvā paratvānnityatvācca "tho nthaḥ"| saṃyogapūrvakatvānna yaṇ| panthiyau, panthiyaḥ, panthiyam, panthiyau| bhasya ṭerlopaḥ| pathaḥ, pathībhyām, pathībhiḥ| ityādi| etena "ito'tsarvanāmasthāne' ityatra sthāninyādeśe ca taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārthamiti haradattagranthaḥ pratyuktaḥ| yattu nyāsakārastadanusāriṇo'nye ca sukhīḥ, sutīritivat 'pathīḥ, pathyau, pathya ityādyudājahrustaccintyam| sāvātvasya durvāratvāt| yattu pathimathyṛbhukṣāmiti nāntaprakṛtyanukaraṇametaditi; tadapyanarthakam| ekadeśavikṛtanyāyasya durvāratvāt| panthāḥ ityatrāpi nityatvādviśeṣavihitatvācca pūrvamāttve kṛte'nāntatvena nthādeśāprasaṅgācca| yadapyāhuḥ-- allopasya sthānivattvānnātvādi| 'kvau luptaṃ na sthānivat' iti nehāśrīyate iti; tadapi cintyam| tathā sati yaṇprasaṅgāt| "khyatyāt" iti sūtre sukhīḥ sutīrityādinirvāhāya 'kvau luptaṃ na sthānivat' ityasya kaiyaṭādibhirāśritatvāt| "ito't" ityatra taparakaraṇaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakṛto'pi ihā'nukūlatvācca| tasmādātvaṃ nthādeśaśca nyāyya eveti sthitam| etena mathīḥ, mathyau, mathyaḥ ityādyapi pratyuktam| manthāḥ,manthiyau, manthiyaḥ ityādereva nyāyyatvāt| yadapi ṛbhukṣīḥ, ṛbhukṣyau, ṛbhukṣyaḥ ityādi; tatra sāvātvaṃ durvāramityuktameva| auṅādiṣu yaṇ tu durlabhaḥ saṃyogapūrvakatvāt| tasmādṛbhukṣāḥ,ṛbhukṣiyau, ṛbhukṣiyaḥ ityādi bodhyam| ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ strīliṅganirdeśaḥ saṃkhyāṃ viśeṣayitum| tatsāmamarthyācca pūrvatra saṃjñāparamapi saṃkhyāgrahaṇamiha saṃjñiparaṃ sampadyata ityāśayenāha-- saṃkhyeti| yattu prācā upadeśakāla ṣāntā nāntā cetyuktam| tatpañcetyatra nalope kṛte'pītyādisvagranthaviruddham| sampratyanāntatve'pi upadeśe nāntvamāsīditi kimasiddhatvena? nanvayaṃ pūrvāparavirodhaḥ kāśikāyāmapi tulya iti cet kiṃ tataḥ| "bādhe dṛḍhe'nyasāmyāt kiṃ dṛḍhe'nyadapi bādhyatām" iti nyāyāt| yattu vyācakhyuḥ-- upadeśakāle yau ṣakāranakārau tadantetyarthaḥ| devadattasya gurukulamitivat samudāyena sambandhānnāsamarthasamāsa iti; tadāpātataḥ| avayavena sambandhaṃ vyākhyāya samudāyena sambandhādityukteḥ parasparavyāghātāt| kiṃ ca yatropasarjanapadārthaḥ sasambandhikastatra dvayī vidhā| sāpekṣo'pi samasyata ityekā| pradhānapadārthasyaiva kulādergurvādineva devadattādinā'pi sambandhaḥ| sa ca guruṇā saha utpattigarbhaḥ| devadattena saha tu tadīyagurūtpādyatvarūpo gurughaṭita iti dvitīyā vidhā| uktaṃ ca hariṇā-- sambandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ samasyate| vākyavatsā vyapekṣā hi vṛttāvapi na hīyate|| iti|| samudāyena sambandho yeṣāṃ gurukulādinā| saṃspṛśyāvayavāṃste tu yujyante tadvatā saha|| iti ca|| atra upasarjanaṃ na sasambandhikam| yena dvayī vidhā'vakāśamāsādayet| nanvihāpyantaśabdaḥ sasambandhikārtho'stīti cet ? upadeśakāle yau ṣakāranakārāviti vadadbhistadanvayasya tyaktatvāt| anyathā hi upadeśakāle'ntau yasyeti vaktavyaṃ syāt| vastutastu tadapi na| antaśabdo hi avayavini sākāṅkṣo na tu yatra kutracit| anyathā ṛddhasya rājapuruṣa iti syāt| rājño'pi īśiturīśatavyaṃ prati sākāṅkṣatvāt| "rājā prabhau nṛpe candre yakṣe kṣatriyaśakrayoḥ" iti koṣāt| yadi tu ṛddhaṃ pratyanākāṅkṣateti brūṣe tarhi samaṃ prakṛte'pi| saṃnipāteti| tathā copadeśakāla iti vyākhyānaṃ niṣphalamapīti bhāvaḥ| yattvāhuḥ--paribhāṣāyā anityatvālluk syāditi; tat sāhasamātram| iṣṭasthale'pyapravṛttau paribhāṣāyā niṣphalatvāpatteḥ| kiñcopadeśa iti nirmūlamapi| yattu vadanti--antagrahaṇasāmarthyādaupadeśikatvaṃ labhyate iti; tadapi na| saṃkhyetyasyā''karṣaṇena saṃjñiparatvasampādanena ca sāmarthyopakṣayāt| nopadhāyāḥ neti luptaṣaṣṭhīkamaṅgasya viśeṣaṇam| gauṇatve tviti| bahuvacananirdeśasyārthaprādhānyārthatvāditi bhāvaḥ| priyapañcāmiti| ñakāradvayamadhye cakāraḥ| aṣṭana ā halādāviti| "rāyo hali" ityuttarasūtrāddhalītyapakṛṣyate, tacca vibhakterviśeṣaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| tenā'ṣṭānāmityatra nuṭaḥ paścādeva sannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvādātvaṃ, na tu prāk| anyathā aṣṭan āmiti sthite paratvānnityatvācca ātve kṛte'nāntatve ṣaṭsaṃjñābhāvānnuṭ na syāt| na ca yathoddeśapakṣe'ntaraṅgatvāt prāgeva kṛtā ṣaṭsaṃjñā ekadeśavikṛtanyāyena kṛtātve'pi sulabheti vācyam| alvidhau uktanyāyā'yogāditi bhāvaḥ| aṣṭābhya auś kṛtākārāditi| nanu halītyapakṛṣyata ityuktam, tatkathaṃ kṛtākāratetyata āha-aṣṭabhya iti| kṛtātvasyedamanukaraṇaṃ, na tu lakṣaṇavaśasampannamātvam| tathā hi sati vakṣyamāṇajñāpakena tasya vaikalpikatayā lāghavārthamaṣṭabhya ityeva brūyāditi bhāvaḥ| idamiti| śrutamanumitaṃ cetyarthaḥ| aṣṭano dīrghāditi| dīrghāntādaṣṭanaḥ parā asarvanāmasthānavibhaktirudāttā syāt| aṣṭābhiḥ| dīrghāt kim ? aṣṭabhiḥ| madhyodāttamidam| "ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādi"riti bādhitvā "jhalyupottama"mityasya pravṛtteḥ| "ṣaṭtricaturbhyo yā jhalādirvibhaktistadante pade upottamamudāttaṃ syāditi tasyārthaḥ| evaṃ sthite hrasvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ kriyamāṇamātvasya nityatve vyarthaṃ syādityarthaḥ| pūrvasmādapīti| evañca priyāṣṭṇa iti haradattenodāhṛtaṃ ṣṭutvaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| na ca 'pūrvatrāsiddhīye na sthānivat' iti niṣedhaḥ, tasya doṣa iti sāpavādatvāt| nanu " raṣābhyām" iti pratipadoktaṃ ṇatvaṃ tatra grahīṣyāmaḥ, na tu ṣṭutvavidhilabhyamiti cet ? maivam| bhāṣyamate tadayogāt| tathā hi--"raṣābhyām" iti sūtre "apadāntasya mūrdhanyaḥ" iti sūtramanuvartya ṇagrahaṇaṃ; "padāntasya" iti niṣedhasūtraṃ ca bhāṣye pratyākhyātam| na ca mūrdhanyaśabdena ṣṭutvaśabdena vā nirvartyamāne ṇakāre vaiṣamyaṃ suvacam; yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyamiti sthānivadbhāva evocitaḥ| śabdakaustubhe 'tasya doṣaḥ' ityatra ṇatvagrahaṇaṃ māstvati niṣkarṣaḥ kṛtastadrītyāpyāha-- kāryakāla pakṣa iti| na ca yathoddeśamāśritya ṣṭutvamastviti vācyam| phalabhede pratyākhyānāsambhavena kāryakālapakṣasyaiveha nyāyyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ata eva pañcamīsamāsasya pratyākhyānopaṣṭambhenāpi ṣṭutvaṃ pratyāśā na kāryā| phalaikyāya kāryakālapakṣasyaiva nyāyyatvenāsiddhatvasya durvāratvāt| "niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi" iti seḍgrahaṇājjñāpakāt pūrvasmādvidhau sthānivadbhāvasyā'nityatayā neha pravṛttiriti tu anityatvapuraskāro'nucita evetyāstāṃ tāvat| jaśśasoriti| auśtvaṃ hi lugnuṭāviva gauṇatve na bhavati| aṣṭābhya iti bahuvacananirdeśāt| anyathā hi kṛtā''tvānukaraṇe'pi ekavacanenaiva nirdiśet- aṣṭā auśiti, aṣṭa iti vā| etacca "ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ" iti sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ spaṣṭam| tathā ca auśtvavidhau kṛtātvanirdeśabalenānumīyamānamātvamapi prādhānye evocitam| tathā ca jasi priyāṣṭāna ityeva syānna tu priyāṣṭā ityāśaṅkyoktaṃ bhāṣye 'yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte' iti| na bhavatyevātrātvamityartha iti kaiyaṭaḥ| vāmano'pi "aṣṭābhya auś" iti sūtre tadantagrahaṇātparamāṣṭāvityuktvā priyāṣṭāna ityatrā''tvasyābhāvādauśtvaṃ na bhavatītyāha| haradattastu--tatraiva 'priyāṣṭāna ityatra' iti vṛttigranthamupādāya yathā punargauṇatāyāmātvaṃ na bhavati
