tathā tadvidhāveva vakṣyata iti pratijñāya "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" iti sūtre ekavacananirdeśādupasarjane'pyātvam, bhaviṣaye āto lopaḥ priyāṣṭaḥ paśyetyādi vadan pūrvapratijñātārthaviparītaṃ bhāṣyavṛttyādiviruddhaṃ kathamabhihitavāniti sa eva praṣṭavyaḥ| halādāveveti| yadyapi halītyasyāpakarṣaṇamakṛtvā'pi vyākhyānaṃ bhāṣye pratīyate| tathā'pi tasyā'paritoṣagrastatvaṃ prapañcitamanyatreti bhāvaḥ| priyāṣṭā iti prathamaikavacanam| uktaṃ saṃgṛhṇāti priyāṣṭna iti|| nāntāḥ || bhuditi| budhyateḥ kvip|| dhāntāḥ || ṛtvigdadhṛk kiṃciditi| ṛtāvupapade yajeḥ kvin| dhṛṣṇoterdvivacanamantodāttatvaṃ ca | sṛjeḥ karmaṇi kvin amāgamaśca| diśeḥ karmaṇi| utpūrvāt sniheḥ kvin upasargāntalopaḥ ṣatvam| añceḥ supyapapade kvin cetyarthaḥ| yujeriti| kuñcerapyevam| nalopābhāvastvadhikaḥ| kanāviti| ikārastūccāraṇārtha iti bhāvaḥ| sannihite iti| yattu prāñcastṛtīye dhātvadhikāre iti; tanna, sanvidhau dhātugrahaṇasya uttaratrānuvṛtterabhāvenādhikāratrayābhāvāt| yujerasamāse sarveti| yattu prācoktaṃ- suṭīti; tanna, sarvanāmasthāne ityasyaiva prakṛtatvāt, lakṣaṇāyāṃ bījābhāvāt, klībe yujī iti dvivacane'tivyāpteśca| yattu vadanti- napuṃsake śasi yuñjītyatra num na syāditi ; tanna, "napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ" iti numaḥ sambhavāt| sulopa iti| kutvasyā'siddhatvāt paratvādādau num| tato halṅyādilopa iti bhāvaḥ| kvinpratyayasya kuḥ padānte iti| yattu prācoktaṃ jhalīti; tanna, jhalītyasyā'sannihitatvāt niṣphalatvācca| yattu tatpautreṇa vyākhyātam-- "jhalo jhali" ityato maṇḍūkaplatyā jhalītyasminnanuvartamāne'pi na kaściddoṣa iti; tanna, spaṣṭa ityadāvativyāpteḥ| khan iti| khañjatīti khan| khaji gativaikalye| "parau vrajeḥ"| dīrghaśceti| yattu prācā vyākhyātaṃ viṇ, ṇittvādupadhāvṛddhiriti; tanna, pañcapādyāṃ daśapādyāñcānena kvibdīrghayoreva vidhānāt| skoḥ saṃyogeti luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ jhalantābhyāṃ viśeṣyate iti vyācaṣṭe-- padānta ityādinā| bhṛjjatīti bhṛṭ| kvip| sasyeti| jaśtvasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃ ścutvamityarthaḥ| etena prāco viparītoktiḥ pratyuktā| ūrgiti| ūrja balaprāṇanayoḥ| asmāccurādiṇyantāt "bhrājabhāsa" ityādinā kvip| ṇilopaḥ| sa ca coḥ kutve na sthānivat, padāntavidhitvāt pūrvatrāsiddhatvācca| iha jānteṣvavayā iti nodāhṛtam| mantre śvetavahoktheti prakṛtya "ave yajaḥ" iti vihitasya ṇvinastadapavādasya padānte ḍasaśca chāndasatvāt| yattu-- śvetavāḍukthaśāspuroḍāśāvayajāṃ ḍasiti prācoktam; tanna, ḍasaḥ prakṛtibhūtayayorvahiyajyordīrghābhāvāt| yadapi avayā iti pratīkamupādāya ṇviniti prācā vyākhyātam| tanna, apavādasya ḍaso viṣaye utsargasya ṇvino'pravṛtteḥ| tadoḥ saḥ sāvanantyayoḥ anantyayoḥ kim ? he sa | paratvāt tyadādyatvaṃ bādhitvā satvaṃ syāt| tato halṅyādilope rutvavisargau syātām| kiṃ ca striyāṃ seti na syāt| vastutastu anantyagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| na coktadoṣaḥ, punaḥprasaṅgavijñāne tyadādyatvasambhavāt| sakṛdgatāviti pakṣe'pi "tadoḥ saḥ sau" ityasyānantaramadasa iti yogaṃ vibhajyā'dasa eva satvaṃ nānyasya dasyeti vyākhyātuṃ śakyatvācca| nanu yathānyāse dvīyateḥ kvipi sva iti prāpnoti, niyame tu dva iti syāditi cet ? maivam| gauṇe atvasatvayorasambhavena dvīrityasyaiva nyāyyatvāt| ṅe prathamayoram ṅe iti pṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkam| prathamāśabdaḥ prathamādvitīyayoḥ samudāye gauṇa iti vyācaṣṭe-- ṅe ityasyetyādinā| ṅe suṭoram iti suvacam| adhikaraṇatvavivakṣayeti| yadi tu śeṣe iti vibhaktiviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt tarhi vyarthameva tat| ātvayatvābhyāṃ viśeṣavihitābhyāṃ svavaviṣaye lopasya bādhasambhavāt| na caivamantyalopa iti pakṣasya nirālambanatvāpattiḥ| "sāma ākam" iti sasuṭkanirdeśena tasyāpi jñāpitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| yuvaṃ vastrāṇīti| śeṣe lopaḥ| yattu kāśikāyāmuktam-- pañcamyāśca caturthyāśca ṣaṣṭhīprathamayorapi| yānyadvivacanānyatra śeṣe lopo vidhīyate|| iti, tadbhāṣāpekṣayā| chandasi tu prathamādvivacanamapi śeṣe lopasya viṣaya eveti bodhyam| maparyantasya kimiti| adhikārasūtraṃ kimarthamiti praśnaḥ| aṅgakārye iti| etena 'aṅgavṛtte punarvṛttāvavidhiḥ' iti paribhāṣā arthata upanibaddhā| aṅge-aṅgādhikāre vṛttaṃ-vartanaṃ-yasya tadaṅgavṛttaṃ- śāstraṃ, tasmin kṛte sati-pravṛtte sati punaranyasya pravṛttau-prāptāyāmavidhiriti hi tasyā arthaḥ| eṣā ca paribhāṣā "jyādādīyasaḥ" "jñājanorjā" iti sūtradvaye'pi jñāpiteti bhāṣye sthitam| anyathā hi jyādāditi ākāraṃ na brūyāt| "bahorlopa" ityato lopamevānuvartayet| "akṛtsārva" iti dīrghe siddhaṃ jyāyāniti| jñājanośca jaṃ vidadhyāt| "ato dīrgho yañi" iti dīrgho bhaviṣyatīti| na caivaṃ dvābhyāmityatra tyādādyatve kṛte "supi ca" iti dīrgho na syāditi vācyam? dvayorekasyetyādinirdeśenoktaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanāt| yattu kecit-- pariniṣṭhitasyeti paṭhanti; dvābhyāmiti tu dīrghaṃ vinā na pariniṣṭhitamiti ca vadanti| tadbhāṣyaviruddham| jyāyān, jānāti, jñāyate ityeteṣāmapi dīrghaṃ vinā'pariniṣṭhitatvena bhāṣyoktajñāpanasyāpi śithilamūlatvāpatteḥ| yadi tu "bhyaso'bhyam" iti sūtre bhāṣye'pi pariniṣṭhitasyetyeva pāṭhastarhi vācanikatāmevāśritya pakṣāntaraparatayā yojyaḥ| anityatvabalaphalitārthakathanaṃ tat, na tu jñāpyāṃśapraviṣṭamiti vāstu | evaṃ tu kāśikādigrantho'pi kathaṃcinnetuṃ śakya iti dik| makārāntaramityupalakṣaṇam| " jasaḥ śī" ityatra jasaḥ s iti sakāraṃ praśliṣya sāntasya jasa iti vyākhyānād "ato'm" iti sūtrādamgrahaṇamanuvartya am ameveti vyākhyānādveti bodhyam| avibhaktikamiti| tathā ca "ṅe prathamayoḥ" iti pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasyā'maḥ pratiṣedho'yamiti bhāṣye śaṅkitam| na ca tathaiva kiṃ na syāditi vācyam ? strīnapuṃsakayornatvāprāpteḥ- yuṣmān brāhmaṇīḥ kulāni vā, aliṅgatve yuṣmān brāhmaṇānityāderasiddhiprasaṅgācca| yo'ci aci kim ? yuvābhyām| yadi tu "yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe" ityatra "rāyo hali" ityato halītyanuvartate tadā ihācīti mā'stu pariśeṣādeva siddheḥ| yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe halādāviti| yo'cītyajgrahaṇātpariśoṣātsiddhamidam| rāyo halītyato'nuvṛttyā labdhaṃ vā| nanvevaṃ kimanādeśagrahaṇena na tvādeśo halādirasti ? maivam| bhyasaḥ satvāt| abhyaspakṣe tu yo'cītyatrānuvṛttyarthamanādeśagrahaṇaṃ bodhyam| pakṣadvaye'pīti| na cāntyalopapakṣe pararūpaṃ bādhitvā savarṇadīrghaḥ syādakāroccāraṇasāmamarthyāditi vācyam ? etvanivṛttyā'kāroccāraṇasya caritārthatvāt| yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅaso'ś śittvaṃ sarvādeśārtham| anyathā hi "ādeḥ parasya" iti syāt| na ca vaiyarthyam, ādeśavyapadeśena yatvanivṛttyarthatvāt| na cāvayavasyādeśe satyapi vibhakteranādeśatā'styeveti vācyam ? 'sarve sarvapadādeśā' iti siddhāntāt| idameva śittvaṃ 'sarve sarvapadādeśā' iti| arthavatyeva sthānyādeśabhāvaviśrāntirityarthaḥ| siccaṅādayastu vacanasāmamarthyādanarthakasyāpi bodhyāḥ| itthaṃ tvavadheyam- antyalopapakṣe aśaḥ syādeśaḥ prapto'ṅgavṛttaparibhāṣayā vāraṇīyaḥ| yadi tvaṅgasya yatkāryaṃ tadviṣayiṇyeva sā paribhāṣā, na tvaṅgādhikāramātrapareti durāgrahastarhi aśityatra "ato guṇe" iti pararūpeṇākārāntaraṃ praśliṣyā'kārarūpa eva aś bhavati, na vikriyate iti vyākhyeyam| yattu syādeśasyāpavādo'śiti; tanna, aśādeśapravṛttikāle śeṣe lopābhāvena syādeśasyāprasakteḥ|| bhāvina iti| kṛte hi śeṣe lope'kārāntatvātprāptaḥ suṭ sasuṭkasya sthānitvena nirdeśasāmamarthyānnivartata iti bhāvaḥ| śeṣe lopaṣṭilopa iti pakṣe tu suḍgrahaṇaṃ vyarthameva| ākami dīrghoccāraṇaṃ savarṇadīrghārtham| anyathā pararūpaṃ syāt| na cā'kāroccāraṇasāmarthyam| etvanivṛttyā'bhyama iva caritārthatvāt| iha "yuvāvau dvivacane" "tvamāvekavacane" iti sūtradvaye dvivacanaikavacanaśabdau na pratyayaparau, kiṃ tvarthaparāviti vyākhyātam| tatphalaṃ darśayati-- samasyamāne ityādinā| dvyekatveti| pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣe saṅkhyāyā api prātipadikārthatvāditibhāvaḥ| samāsārtho-- mukhyaviśeṣyam| anyasaṅkhyaścet--yuṣmadasmadarthagatasaṅkhyetara-saṅkhyaścedityarthaḥ| sta iti| arthaparatvāśrayaṇasāmarthyādeva bhūtapūrvagaterapi svīkārāt| pratyayaparatve tu na syātāmityavyāptiḥ syādityarthaḥ| evaṃ caturthaśloke'pi-- yuvāvau tvamau na cetyuktyā pratyayaparatve'tivyāptirdhvanitā| evañcāvyāptyativyāptiparihārāyārthaparatvamāśritamiti phalitam| na ca kṛtrimākṛtrimanyāyavirodhaḥ? vacanagrahaṇasāmamarthyādeva tadbādhāt| anyathā hi dvitve ekatve ityeva brūyāt| dvitve ekatve ca yā vibhaktistasyā''miti vyākhyānasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| atitvākamatimākamiti| yattu "sāma ākam" ityatra yadyapi suḍgrahaṇaṃ na sthāniviśeṣaṇaṃ, bādhāt; tathā'pi upalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| tena yasyāmaḥ suḍagre bhāvī tasyaiva āma ākamā bhavitavyam| na caitad gauṇatve sambhavati ityākam na pravartate| na ca samudāyanirdeśe viśeṣaṇatvamupalakṣaṇatvaṃ vā vihāya tṛtīyaḥ pravartate| na ca suḍāmoḥ pṛthak sthānitvamiha nirdiśyate| caśabdasya dvivacanasya ca abhāvāt| yadi tu s ca ām ceti samāhāradvandvo vyākhyāyeta, yogyatābalācca s-śabdena suḍeva gṛhyeta, tathāpi yadi suḍgrahaṇamanvācayaśiṣṭaṃ tataḥ samāso na syāt| anyatra tu sāhityavivakṣayā kevalasyāmo'prasakterita| atredaṃ vaktavyam| yasyāmaḥ suḍagre bhāvītyādi tāvat bādhitam| ākamā'pahṛtasya suḍanvayābhāvāt| ākamaḥ suḍ bhavatīti cet ? tarhi tamevopalakṣayet| ādeśadvārakeṇa paramparāsambandhena sthāninamupalakṣayati cet? hantaivaṃ yuṣmākamityādau suṭ śrūyeta| sāma iti nirdeśasāmarthyānna śrūyate iti cenna| nirdeśasya gauṇavyāvṛtyā caritārthatvena sāmamarthyābhāvāt| yadapi samāhāradvandvaṃ prakramyānvācayaśiṣṭatve dūṣaṇābhidhānaṃ, tadapyasambhavaduktikam| sāhityavivakṣayā kevalasyāprasaktiriti paramavaśiṣyate| tadapi na| prakriyadaśāyāṃ sthitasyā''ma uttarakālabhāvitvenotprekṣitasya suṭaścaikabudhdyupāreheṇaiva sāhityābhyupagamāt| atītā'nāgatayorayaṃ draṣṭetivat| tatrobhayorekasmin darśane sambandha iti cedihāpyekasminnādeśe iti tulyam| tathā ca "irayoḥ" iti sūtre dadhre ityādau dhāño jhasya ireci āto lope rebhāve tasya kṛsṛbhṛprabhṛtiṣu caritārthatayā iṭi kṛte "irayoḥ" iti dvivacananirdeśāllākṣaṇikasyā'pi rebhāvaḥ punaḥ kriyate iti sthitamākare| irayorityekaśeṣaḥ| sāma iti tu dvandvaḥ| sahavivakṣā tūbhayatra tulyaiva| vastutastu "sāma ākam" iti sūtre kevalo'pyām tantreṇa nirdiṣṭaḥ| tasyā'kamiti sthānivadbhāvenāmtvāt sasuṭkatvācca "sāma " iti pravartate| gauṇatve tu prathamapravṛttyaiva paryavasānam| ata eva śeṣe lopaṣṭilopa iti pakṣeṇa saha phalaikyamapi siddhyati| sarvathā'pi atitvayāmatimayāmiti kaiścidutprekṣitaṃ samarthayituṃ nābhiniveṣṭavyam| atitvākamatimākamityādeḥ bhāṣyakṛtaivodāhṛtatvāditi dik|| ṣaṣṭhayādiviśiṣṭayoriti| etacca sarvasya "padasya" ityadhikārāllabhyate| sthagrahaṇaṃ tu vibhaktau śrūyamāṇāyāmeva yathā syānna tu luptāyāmityetadarthamiti vakṣyati| vedairaśeṣairiti| yuṣmān rakṣatu govindo'smān kṛṣṇaḥ sarvadā'vatu| iti tu prācaḥ pāṭhastyaktaḥ, asmānityasya samānavākyasthatvābhāvādevā'prāpteḥ| sthagrahaṇāditi| tiṣṭhatirihā'hānau vartate| yathā- samaye tiṣṭha sugrīveti, samayaṃ mā hāsīriti gamyate| tena ṣaṣṭhyādīnajahatorevādeśā ityarthaḥ| iti yuṣmatputra iti| yuvayoryuṣmākaṃ vā putra iti vigrahaḥ| padāt paratvaṃ sampādayitumiti śabdaḥ| prācā tu nāsau prayuktaḥ| tatra padāt paratvābhāvādevādeśo na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ sthagrahaṇena|| na cavā cādipañcaketi| pañcānāṃ madhye'nyatamena yoga ityarthaḥ|| yukta iti| "napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ"|| paśyārthai ata eva nipātanād bhāve śaḥ| darśanaṃ paśyaḥ| tacceha jñānamātram| "adarśanaṃ lopaḥ" ityatra yathā| na tu cākṣuṣajñānameva, " anālocane" iti niṣedhāt| tadatadāha- acākṣuṣajñānārthairiti| bhakta ityādi| atra vyācakhyuḥ--yena harestvaṃ bhaktastenaiva kāraṇenā'hamapi bhakta iti yojyam| yadi tu tenetyanena bhaktatvaṃ trāṇe heturnirdiśyate, tataḥ sāpekṣavidhāne tvameva tadimamitivadanvādeśo na syāditi| atredaṃ vaktavyam- sāpekṣavidhāne'nvādeśatvaṃ nāstīti tāvadasaṅgatam| ādeśo hi vidhiḥ| kiñcidvidhāya paścāditaravidhiścānvādeśo, na tu nirapekṣatvagarbho'śabdārthatvāt, śāstre tathā aparibhāṣitatvācca| na ca prayogadarśanādeva tathā kalpyata iti vācyam? vanyadvipanonmathitā tvagasya, athainamadrestanayā śuśoca|| ityādiṣu sāpekṣatve'pi enādeśadarśanāt| tatra hetutvaṃ na śabdenopāttamiti cenna, tadenamullghitaśāsanaṃ vidhervidhehi kīnāśaniketanātithim|| ityādimāghaprayogavirodhāt| naktaṃ bhīrurayamiti tu nāyaṃ vidhiḥ kiṃ tvanuvādaḥ| atastadimamiti na virudhyate| evaṃ sthite yena tvaṃ bhakta iti yacchabdādhyāhārakleśo vyarthaḥ| kiṃ tu tena trāyata ityeva sambandhaḥ| prakrāntārthatvācca na yacchabdāpekṣeti dik| atra teneti vidyamānaṃ padaṃ, tato haririti prathamāntaṃ, tataḥ parasyā''deśaḥ| tathā trāyata ityasmāt paraṃ sa iti prathamāntam| na ca trāyata iti bhinnavākyasthamiti bhramitavyam, sa haristvāṃ mā trāyata iti tantreṇā'nekakārakasambandhāt| anuṣaṅgābhyupagame'pi 'ekatiṅ vākyam' iti paribhāṣitaikavākyatvānapāyācca| sāmantritam saṃjñāvidhāvapi mahāsaṃjñākaraṇasāmamarthyāttadantagrahaṇam| āmantraṇamāmantritam| upacārāttatsādhane vṛttiḥ| vibhaktyantena cāmantryate na tu kevalayā vibhaktyetyāśayenāha- tadantamiti| āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat yattu prācoktam-- viśeṣyapūrvaṃ sambodhanetarapūrvaṃ ca sambodhanaṃ hitvā'nyasmāt sambodhanāt parayornaite ādeśā iti keciditi| tatra kecidityanucitam, uktārthasya prakṛtadvisūtrīsiddhatvāt| yacca vyācakhyuḥ-trisūtryā ayamartha iti tanna, tṛtīyasūtrārthasya tenā'saṃsparśāt| pādaḥ pat tadavayavasyeti| "nirdiśyamānasyādeśā' iti paribhāṣayedaṃ labhyate|| agniṃ manthatīti| mathnātermanthateśca kvipi etadeva rūpam| iditastu nalopābhāvāt| agniman, agnimanthau, agnimanthaḥ|| ṅakāra iti| āntaratamyāditi bhāvaḥ| hrasvavyañjanayoriti| vyañjanasya hi hrasva īṣatsadṛśo, dīrghastu visadṛśa iti bhāvaḥ| uktaṃ ceti| vārtikakṛteti śeṣaḥ| kecittu pūrvasyaiva mutvādamudryaṅityudāharanti| tadbhāṣyā''dau noktamityupekṣitam| uda īt aca ityasyāpavādaḥ|| cāntāḥ|| atvasantasya cādhātoḥ ihā'dhātoriti yogo vibhajyate| tatsāmamarthyādanantarasyā'santasyaiva pratiṣedho, nā'tvantasyeti kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| tadetaddarśayati--dhātubhinnā'santasyeti| ubhe abhyastam dve ityanuvṛttyaiva siddhe ubhegrahaṇaṃ yadyarthe| caṇ ayaṃ cedarthe ṇit| samuccayādau tvananubandhaḥ| kacciditi iṣṭapraśne| yatretyanavaklṛptyamarṣagarhāścaryeṣu| nāvakalpayāmi na marṣaye garhe āścarye vā yatra bhavān vṛṣalaṃ yājayet| neheti pratyārambhe| hanteti harṣe viṣāde anukampāyāṃ vākyārambhe ca| mākiḥ mākiṃ nakiriti trayo'pi varjane| māṅnañau svarādiṣu uktau| iha pāṭhastu nipātatvārthaḥ| tena ādyudāttatvaṃ siddhyatīti prāñcaḥ; taccintyam| phiṭsvareṇāpīṣṭasiddheḥ| yadapyāhuḥ-- satvavacanānāmapi avyayasaṃjñārthaḥ svarādipāṭha iti; tadapi cintyam| lakṣmīvācakasyāpi māśabdasyāvyayvāpatteḥ| tasmādubhayatra pāṭhe phalaṃ cintyam| yāvat tāvat etau sākalyāvadhimānāvadhāraṇeṣu| sākalye-- yāvat kāryaṃ tāvat kṛtam| avadhau-- yāvat gantavyaṃ tāvattiṣṭha| māne-- yāvaddattaṃ tāvadbhuktam| avadhāraṇe--yāvadamatraṃ brāhmaṇānāmantrayasva| tvai viśeṣavitarkayoḥ| dvai vitarke| nvai iti pāṭhāntaram| rai dāne anādare ca| rai karoti, dadātītyarthaḥ| tvaṃ rai kiṃ kariṣyasi| śrauṣaṭ vauṣaṭ etau havirdāne| svāhā devatābhyo dāne| svadheti pitṛbhyaḥ| śrauṣaḍādīnāmanekācāmubhayatra pāṭhaḥ svarabhedārthaḥ| tumiti tuṅkāre| guruṃ tuṅkṛtya--huṅkṛtya| tathāhi nidarśane| khalu niṣedhe vākyālaṅkāre niścaye ca| kileti vārtāyāmalīke ca| atheti maṅgalānantarārambhapraśnakārtsnyādhikārapratijñāsamuccayeṣu| ayaṃ svarādirapi| tena maṅgalavācakasya sattvārthatve'pyavyayatvaṃ siddhyati| tathā ca śrīharṣaḥ-- udasya kumbhīratha śātakumbhajāścatuṣkacārutviṣi vedikodare| yathākulācāramathāvanīndrajāṃ purandhrivargaḥ snapayāmbabhūva tām|| atra hi snapayāmbabhūvetyasya maṅgalaṃ snapanaṃ cakāretyarthaḥ| nipātastu svarūpeṇaiva maṅgalaṃ mṛdaṅgadhvanivat| suṣṭhu svarabhedārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| smetyatīte pādapūraṇe ca| ādahetyupakramahiṃsākutsaneṣu| avadattamiti| ihānupasargatvāt "aca upasargāttaḥ" iti na bhavati| ahamiti subantapratirūpakam| etena 'geye kena vinītau vām' iti vyākhyātam| yuvāmarthe hi vāmityavyayam| astīti tiṅantapratirūpakam| evamasmītyahamarthe tvāmasmi vacmi| āhetyuvācetyarthe| āseti babhūvetyarthe ityādi| a iti sambodhane adhikṣepe niṣedhe ca | ā iti vākyasmaraṇayoḥ| i iti sambodhanajugupsāvismayeṣu| ī u ū e ai o au sambodhane| paśu samyagarthe| paśu manyamānāḥ| śukaṃ śaighrye| yathākathācetyanādare| pāṭ pyāṭ aṅga he hai bho aye ete sambodhane| dyeti hiṃsāprātilomyapādapūraṇeṣu| viṣu nānārthe| ekapade ityakasmādityarthe| yut kutsāyāṃ hetau| āta ito'pītyarthe| ākṛtigaṇa iti| tadyathā-- yat tat iti hetau| āhosvit vikalpe| sima sarvatobhāve| kaṃ pādapūraṇe| sukamatiśaye| anukaṃ vitarke| śamvaṭ antaḥkaraṇe ābhimukhye ca| va pādapūraṇe ivārthe ca| diṣṭyā ityā''nande| caṭu cāṭu priyavākye| humiti bhartsne| iveti sādṛśye| adyatve idānīmityarthe ityādi| atredamavadheyam| svarādicādyorākṛtigaṇatvā'viśeṣe'pi yeṣāṃ nipātasvaro dṛśyate cādiṣu| anye svarādiṣu| svaradvayabhājastūbhayatra bodhyāḥ| yathā- utaśabdaḥ svārādiṣu- 'īḍyo nūtanairuta' ityantodāttaprayogāt| yattu utaśabdasya svarāditāmuktvā nipātasvaramāśaṅkyāntodāttanipātanamāśritya samādadhustadrabhasāt| svarāderanipātatvāt, antedāttatvanipātavaiyarthyāpatteśca| yadapi kāśikāyāmuktam| svar śanais ṛdhak divā vṛthā naktamityādayo'ntodāttā iti| yacca, sanat sanāt evamādaya ādyudāttā iti; tatsarvaṃ prāmādikam| lakṣyavisamvādānnirmūvatvācceci śabdakaustubhe prapañcitam| taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ sarveti| vacanatrayātmiketyarthaḥ| neti| kiṃ tu ekavacanamevotpadyate iti bhāvaḥ| taddhitaḥ kim? ekaḥ, dvau, trayaḥ| asarvetyādi kim? aupagavaḥ| kṛnmejantaḥ jīvase iti| "tumarthe sesen" iti ase pratyayaḥ| pibaddhyai iti| tenaiva śadhyai pratyayaḥ "pāghrā" iti pibādeśaḥ| yattvāhuḥ--kartari śabiti, tadrabhasāt| 'avyayakṛto bhāve' iti siddhāntāt| antagrahaṇamaupadeśikatvapratipattyartham| teneha na| ādhaye| cikīrṣave| lakṣaṇapratipadokta-sannipātaparibhāṣābhyāṃ siddhyaitayoranityatvajñāpanārthamidam| ktvātosunkasunaḥ udetoriti| utpūrvādiṇo "bhāvalakṣaṇe stheṇkṛñvadicarihutamijanibhyastosun"| visṛpa iti| "sṛpitṛdoḥ kasun"| ābgrahaṇamiti| tathā ca vārtikam--'avyayādāpo lugvacanānarthakyaṃ liṅgābhāvāt' iti| sūtrasyoktisambhavastu "striyām" iti sūtre strīsamānādhikaraṇāditi pakṣaṃ gṛhītvā bodhyaḥ| sa ca na sthitaḥ, bhūtamiyaṃ brāhmaṇītyādāvivyāpteḥ| aliṅgatve ātharvaṇavidyāgataśrutivirodhamāśaṅkyāha-- sadṛśamiti| liṅgakāraketi| vibhaktivacanaśabdau kārakasaṃkhyāparāviti bhāvaḥ| yathā vāceti| parigaṇanamidamityeke|anye tūdāharaṇamātramityāhuḥ| vagāha iti| ādirevākāro lupyate nāntyaḥ, apinā sāhacaryāt| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāmavyayāni|| || atha strīpratyayaprakaraṇam|| khaṭveti| "aśūpruṣulaṭikhaṭikaṇiviśibhyaḥ kvan"| pañcājīti| na ca tadantavidhivirahādeva ṭābneti vācyam? amahatpūrvagrahaṇenā'nupasarjanādhikāreṇa ca strīpratyayeṣu tadantavidhijñāpanāt| mūṣiketi| "vṛścikṛṣoḥ kikan' ityadhikāre "muṣerdīrghaśca' iti kikani ikāramaddhyo mūṣikaśabdaḥ| yastu mūṣa steye iti dīrghopadhātsaṃjñāyāṃ kvuni mūṣakaśabdo mādhavenoktastato'pyayaṃ ṭāp| "pratyayasthāt" itītvamiti tu viśeṣaḥ| yattu kvunnanto'sau ajādigaṇe pāṭhaṃ na prayuṅkte, tasya jātilakṣaṇaṅīṣvidhānārthatvāt saṃjñāyāścā'jātitvādityāhuḥ; taccintyam, vyāghrītyādivat saṃjñātve'pi jātitvā'napāyāt| bhastraphaleti| bhastreva phalāni yasyā iti vigrahaḥ| ṅyāporiti| etacca phala niṣpattāviti dhātau mādhavagranthe sthitam| bhāṣye tu prāyeṇa dīrgha eva paṭhyate| pratyakpuṣpeti| "pākakarṇa" ityādisūtrasthabhāṣyavārtikaparyālocanayedamuktam| tena satprākkāṇḍeti pāṭho nādartavyaḥ| śūdrā ceti| śūdraśabdaṣṭāpamutpādayati jātiścet| mahatpūrvastu na| jātiśceditīhāpi sambadhyate| puṃyoge tviti| puṃyogo dāmpatyarūpa eveti na niyamaḥ, kintu janyajanakabhāvo'pi| tena-- "vaiśyāśūdryostu rājanyānmāhiṣyograu sutau smṛtau' iti siddham| mahāśūdrīti| "ābhīrastu mahāśūdrī jātipuṃyogayoḥ samā' ityamaraḥ| atredamavadheyam| ajādigaṇe śūdretyeva pāṭhyam| jātiriti vyartham| mukhye kāryasampratyayājjātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣeva bādhiṣyate| puṃyoge hi gauṇī vṛttiḥ| amahadityādyapi vyartham| mahāśūdraśabdo hi viśiṣṭa eva jātyantare vartate| tatrāvayavasyā'narthakatayā śūdraśabdārthasamavetastrītvābhāvāt ṭāpaḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti| yā tu mahatī śūdrā tatra mahāśūdretīṣyata eva| kruñcetyādi| trayo'mī halantā ityeke| "kruñcānālabheta' "uṣṇihakakubhau' ityādiprayogamudāhṛtyā'dantā api bhāṣye svīkṛtāḥ| puṃyoge'pīti| yadā jyeṣṭhādayaḥ prathamajātādau vartante tadā adantatvādeva ṭāp siddhaḥ| yadā tu jyeṣṭhasya strītyādivivakṣā tadā puṃyogalakṣaṇo ṅīṣ prāptaḥ so'nena bādhyata iti sūcayitumapiśabdaḥ| mūlānnañaḥ| nañaḥ kim, śatamūlī| amūleti| oṣadhijātirayam| ugitaśca bhavatīti| sarvādiṣu bhavatu ityuditpaṭhito "bhāterḍavatuḥ' iti vyutpāditaśca| śatrantāttu ṅīpi "śapśyanoḥ" iti nityo num| vano ra ca sutvānamiti| śṛdhātorvanip| guṇe kṛte haśantātparatve'pi haśantādvihitatvābhāvād ṅībrayorniṣedho na| avāveti| nyāsakārastu prāyiko'yaṃ niṣedhastena avāvarītyāha| na tvetadbhāṣyādau dṛṣṭam| pakṣe ḍābiti| tathā ca dvivacane bahudhīvaryau, bahudhīvānau, bahudhīve iti rūpatrayambhavatīti bhāvaḥ| ṭābṛci pūrveṇa prāptasya ṅīpo'pavādaḥ| asiddhatvāditi| kāryakālapakṣeṇedam| yadi tu yathoddeśaṃ ṣaṭsaṃjñā, yadi vā upadeśakāle ṣṇānteti vyākhyānaṃ tadā asiddhatvopavarṇanaṃ nopayujyata ityāhuḥ| vastutastu yathoddeśapakṣe'pi asiddhatvamupayuktameva ekadeśavikṛtasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ hi sthānivatsūtre paṭhyate| ādeśagrahaṇasāmarthyāt "sarve sarvapadādeśā' ityāśritya ānumāniko'pyādeśaḥ sthānivaditi vā vyākhyāyate| ubhayathā'pi alvidhau na tatpravṛttiḥ| etacca ākare spaṣṭam| bahuyajvānāviti| "na saṃyogāt' iti niṣedhānnāyamupadhālopī tena "ana upadhālopinaḥ" iti na pravartate| ṅābubhābhyām nanu niṣedhaḍāporvacanasāmarthyāt paryāyaḥ siddhaḥ, satyam| "anyatarasyām" iti yogo vibhajyate| tatra "manaḥ" iti nivṛttam| ano bahuvrīherḍāb vā syāt| ṅīpā saha vikalpalābhārthamidam| "ana upadhālopina" iti sūtrantu niyamārtham| ano yo'sau vikalpaḥ sa upadhālopina eveti| tathā ca suparvetyādau anupadhālopini niṣedhārthamidam| bahurājñītyādau tu "ṛnnebhya" ityeva ṅīp| tena bahudhīvarīti siddhyati| "ṛnnebhya" iti hi ṅīpamanūdya tatsanniyogena vidhīyamāno rephaḥ| prakaraṇāntarasthena ṅīpi kṛte na siddhyet| nanu "vano ra ca" iti sūtrameva ṅībrau vidhattāmiti cenna, ubhayavidhau gauravāt| kiñcaivamapi ṅīpi niṣiddhe ro'pi durlabhaḥ, sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt| bhāṣye tu sūtrabhaṅgena samāhitam| tadyathā-- "ano bahuvrīheḥ" ityasyānantaramupadhālopino veti sūtramastu| "ana upadhā" ityādipradeśāntarasthaṃ sūtraṃ, ḍāpsūtre "anyatarasyāṃ" grahaṇaṃ ca māstu iti| ana upadhā "bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ" ityato bahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ "saṃkhyāvyayāderṅīp" ityato ṅīp cānuvartate ityāśayenāha-- annantādityādi| niyamārthamidamityuktam| na caivaṃ pūrveṇa vikalpasiddhau ihānyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ vyarthamiti vācyam| asati hi tasmin nityārtho vidhirevāyaṃ syānna tu niyamaḥ| pratyayasthātkātpūrvasya kādityakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| vyañjanamātraṃ vivakṣitam| viśiṣṭavivakṣāyāṃ tu etikāścarantītyādau akaci na syādityāśayenāha-- kakārāditi| varṇanirdeśe hi kārapratyayo vihitaḥ| kvacitsamudāyāt prayogastu "uccaistarāṃ vā vaṣaṭkāraḥ" iti nirdeśarūpayatnasādhya iti bhāvaḥ| āpi para iti| etacca akārasya viśeṣaṇam| tatra sāmarthyāt kakārā'kārābhyāṃ vyavāye'pi bhavati| na tu rathakaṭyetyādau tricaturādivyavāye| ata eva sarvikādau ādyā'kārasya na bhavati| tadetaduktam-- akārasyekāraḥ syādāpi para iti| kakāraviśeṣaṇatve tu vivakṣite āpparātkakārāt pūrvasyāta ityavakṣyat| yattu prāñcaḥ-- āpīti kakāraviśeṣaṇaṃ sarviketyādau tu ekādeśasya sthānivadbhāvādakāreṇa vyavadhāne'pi vacanasāmarthyādbhaviṣyatīti; tanna, rathakaṭyādāvatiprasaṅgāt, vyavahitasyāpi paratvānapāyāt| na ca nirdiṣṭaparibhāṣayā nistāraḥ, anuvāde paribhāṣāṇāmanupasthiteḥ| anūdyamānasya viśeṣaṇeṣviti hi tadarthaḥ| atra ca "udīcāmāta" iti sūtre sthānegrahaṇaṃ liṅgam| phalaṃ tu vṛddhasaṃjñāyāmikparibhāṣānupasthānāt śālīyadisiddhiḥ| yadapyāhuḥ-- āpīti vidhīyamānasyeto viśeṣaṇamiti; tatsthavīyaḥ| āpītyasyā'ṅgaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tu nā''śaṅkyameva, rathakaṭyā putrakāmyetyatrātiprasaṅgāt| śaketi| pacādyac| sthagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| kakāramātrasya pratyayasyābhāvādeva tātsthyalābhāt| pūrvasya kim| sarviketyādau ṭābekādeśaṃ bādhitvā kātparasya mā bhūt "tasmādityuttarasya" iti paribhāṣaṇāt| yattu - "vārṇādāṅgam' iti paribhāṣayā ekādeśo bāddhyetetyāhuḥ| tanna apavāde paratvasyeva uktaparibhāṣāyā api niṣphalatvāt| vastutastu "pratyayasthe ki" iti saptamīnirdeśa evocitaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇaṃ ca sutyajam| ata iti taparaḥ kimॽ "kṛdādhārārcikalibhyaḥ kaḥ"| dhākā| rākā| māmiketi| "kevalamāmaka" ityādinā saṃjñācchandasoreveti niyamānna ṅīp| tyaktyaporiti| "udīcāmātaḥ sthāna" iti vikalpasyāpavādaḥ| dākṣiṇātyiketi| dakṣiṇasyāmadūre dakṣiṇā ājantaḥ| dakṣiṇā bhaveti vigrahaḥ| yattu-- dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi bhaveti prācā vigṛhītam; tanna, tyagvidhāvavyayasāhacaryādājantasyaiva dakṣiṇāśabdasya grahaṇāt| anyathā-- "sarvanāmno vṛttimātre' iti puṃvadbhāvāpatteśca| yattu- samāse eva puṃvaditi tanneti vakṣyate| tyaki "kiti ca" ityādivṛddhau ṭāp, tato'jñātādyarthe kaḥ| "ke'ṇaḥ" iti hrasvaṣṭāp| ihatyiketi| "avyayātyap"| na yāsayoḥ atra nyāsakāraḥ| yā ityetasya "udīcāmātaḥ sthāne" iti vikalpe prāpte niṣedho'yamiti; tanna, "ātaḥ sthāne' ityaṃśasyehābhāvāt| yā seti yattadorupalakṣaṇamityāśayenāha-- yattadoriti| svarūpasyāvivakṣāyāṃ phalamudāharati- yakāṃ, takāmiti| yāsayorityapahāya yattadorityeva vaktumucitam| upatyaketi| "upādhibhyāṃ tyakannāsannārūḍhayoḥ" iti| "kṣipakādīnāṃ ca'| netyanuṣajyate| kṣipaketi| kṣiperigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ| tato'jñātādau kaḥ| caṭa bhedane| pacādyac| tataḥ kaḥ| tāraketi| taraterṇvul| jyotirnakṣatraṃ, netrakanīnikā ca| varṇakā- prāvāraviśeṣaḥ| tantūnāṃ vikārastāntavam| "orañ"| anyatra varṇiketi| granthaviśeṣasya vyākhyā stotrakartrī ca| vartayatīti vartakā- śakunau ittvaṃ vā| anyatra nityameva| pitaraśca tāḥ devatāśca pitṛdevatāstadarthaṃ karma pitṛdevatyam| "devatāntāttādarthye yat" iti yat| aśnanti brāhmaṇā yasyāṃ sā aṣṭakā| "iṣyaśibhyāṃ takan'| aṣṭikānyeti| aṣṭau parimāṇamasyāḥ "saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan"| arthagataṃ strītvamākāre'ddhyāropya "yakapūrvāyāḥ" iti strīliṅganirdeśaḥ| tena strīpratyayo labhyata ityāśayenāha--strīpratyayākārasyeti| sāṅkāśyiketi| saṅkāśena nirvṛttaṃ sāṅkāśyam "vuñchaṇ" ādisūtreṇa saṅkāśādibhyo ṇyaḥ| tato bhavārthe "dhanvayopadhād vuñ" akādeśaḥ| sa ca sāṅkāśyabhavāṃ striyamāheti tadakārasyāpi ittvaṃ vikalpyeta; tasmādāta ityuktam| nanu yathāyamakāro nākārasthānika evaṃ strīpratyayasthāniko'pi neti dvyaṅgavikalametat| atrāhuḥ-- sati hyāta ityetasmin strīliṅganirdeśabalāt strīvācaka ākāraḥ strīpratyaya eveti labhyate| asati tu tasmin strīvācakasya yo'kāra ityetāvallabhyeta tataḥ sāṅkāśyiketyatrāpi prasajyeteti| atredaṃ vaktavyama| yakapūrvāyāḥ sthāne, iti sthāneśabde jāgarūke kathamavayavaṣaṣṭhītvaṃ gamyatām| na ca vuñaḥ sthāne'yamiti vācyam, aketi samudāyasya tathātve'pi akārarūpāvayavasyā'tathātvāt, vuño yakapūrvatvābhāvācca| na hi tasyāmavasthāyāṃ "yasya" iti lopo'pi labhyate| kiṃ ca pratipadoktasya strīpratyayasya lābhe bhavārthe vihitasya vuñādeḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti| tasmādāta iti spaṣṭārthameva| aśviketi| kaumārāstu bhastrādivākye'śvaśabdamapi paṭhanto'syāpi ittvavikalpamicchanti| śubhamiti mānto nipātaḥ| suṣṭhu nayo yasyāḥ sā sunayā| tataḥ kaḥ| ॥ bhastraiṣā tadanteti| āṅgatvāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ceti| uktaṃ ca haradattena-- atrātaḥ sthāna ityetatsvaśabdasya viśeṣaṇam| sambhavavyabhicārau hi tatra staḥ kākacoḥ satoḥ|| dvaiṣayoḥ sambhavo nāsti, nānyatra vyabhicāritā| sarvanāmnaḥ svaśabdasya tena nā'yaṃ vidhirbhavet|| iti|| iha svaśabdasyetyasyā'nantaramata iti śeṣo bodhyaḥ| etacca iha mūle'pi dhvanitam| evaṃca- haṃsaṃ tanau sannihitaṃ carantaṃ munermanovṛttimiva svikāyām| iti śrīharṣaśloke "bhastraiṣā" iti vaikalpikamitvamiti vyācakṣāṇā upekṣyā iti bhāvaḥ| ātmīyāyāmiti| ātmajñātidhaneṣu tu strītvameva nāstīti bhāvaḥ| yattu-- jñātidhanayoḥ svakā, svikā, iti rūpadvayamākare sthitamityāhuḥ; taccintyam| tādṛśasyā''karasyā'prasiddheḥ, liṅgānuśāsanavirodhācca| yattu- svakā, svikā, iti kāśikāyāmudāhṛtaṃ, tatsaṃjñāviṣayakaṃ, na tu jñātiviṣayakam| yadapi "svārthikāḥ kvacitprakṛtito liṅgavacanānyativartante' iti parijahruḥ| tadapi cintyam, uktarītyā kapratyayāntāṭṭāpsambhave'pi prakṛterastrīliṅgatayā "ātaḥ sthāne' ityaṃśasya durupapādatvāt| pratyudāharaṇānyuktvā udāharaṇānyāha- nirbhastriketyādi| niṣkrāntā bhastrāyā nirbhastrā| upasarjanahrasvaḥ, ṭāp, tato'jñātādau kaḥ| kṛtaṣatveti| sūtre vikṛtanirdeśo vivakṣitaviṣayo na tu "na yāsayoḥ" itivadupalakṣaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| strīliṅganirdeśādajādayaḥ strīliṅgā eva gṛhyante| teneha na, śubhro'jo'syāḥ śubhrājikā| jānātīti jñaḥ| priyo jño'syāḥ priyajñikā iti| abhāṣita-- vihitaviśeṣaṇatayā vyākhyāyāḥ phalamāha-- bahuvrīheriti| nityamiti| asya vikalpasyāpravṛtteḥ "pratyayasthāt" ityutsarga eva pravartata ityarthaḥ| paraviśeṣaṇatve tvayaṃ vikalpaḥ syādeveti bhāvaḥ| bahuvrīherityupasarjanopalakṣaṇam| tenā'tikhaṭvikā, niḥkhaṭviketyādāvapi nityameva| śaiṣike kapīti| "āpo'nyatarasyām" iti hrasvapakṣe iti bhāvaḥ| abhivyāpyeti| ata eva bahuyuvā śāletyatra "yūnastiḥ" upasarjanatvānneti prāñca āhuḥ| ṭiḍḍhā" iha vṛttikṛtā sūtre khyun prakṣiptaḥ| autsīti| utse bhavā, "utsādibhyo'ñ"| na ca "śārṅgaravādyañ" iti ṅīnā siddhamidamiti vācyam, tatra jāteḥ ityanuvartate| anyathā puṃyoge'pi syāt| etena iha añgrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārthamiti prāco granthaḥ pratyuktaḥ| ihānekaṃ vākyaṃ, tatra anupasarjanamaṇ yo'kārastadantāditi vyakhyānānneha-- āpiśalamadhīte āpiśalā brāhmaṇīti| atra hi proktārthe'ṇ upasarjanam, adhyetraṇ tu luptaḥ, varṇaprādhānyānna pratyayalakṣaṇam, ataṣṭābeva bhavati| tācchīlike iti| ayaṃ bhavaḥ-- "śīlam" "chatrādibhyo ṇaḥ" iti yo ṇastasmin aṇkāryaṃ bhavati , "kārmastācchīlye" iti jñāpakāt| anena hi "an" iti aṇi vihitaṃ prakṛtibhāvaṃ bādhituṃ ṭilopo nipātyate| caurīti| curā śīlamasyāḥ| halastaddhitasya upadhābhūtasyeti| nanu "yasyeti ca" iti yaño'kāralope kṛte yakārasya īkāraparatvamastyeva kimupadhāgrahaṇānuvṛttyā? na cāllopasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ, yalope tanniṣedhāt; maivam, yalope kārye allopasyā''bhīyatvenā'siddhatvāt| anapatyeti| yadyapi "āpatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam' iti vārtikantathā'pi apatyādhikāravihitaparaṃ tat| tādṛśaśca gargādiyañeva, na tu devādyañ| tasyāpatyādhikārāt prāgeva pāṭhāt| ata eva bhāṣyakṛtā "kañkvarapo'yañañca' iti "gargādibhyo yañ' iti ca akāraḥ praśliṣṭaḥ| "yaskādibhyo gotre'yañañośca" iti sūtre'pyevam|| prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñārtham| nanu tāṃ vināpi ṣitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva ṅīṣ bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tarhi taddhitagrahaṇamiñantādapi kvacit ṣpha iti jñāpayati| yañante savarṇadīrgheṇāpi rūpasiddhau "yasyeti" lopasyā'nāvaśyakatvāt| tena "āsurerupasaṃkhyānam' iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ siddhyati| āyane-- phakārādiṣkāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| āyanīnornakārasya nettvam, phino nitkaraṇasāmarthyāt| kauravya-- kathaṃ tarhi "yadyasau kūpamāṇḍūki tavaitāvatikaḥ smaya' iti bhaṭṭiḥ| atrāhuḥ-- kauravyasāhacaryādapatyapratyayāntasyaiva māṇḍūkasyeha grahaṇam| iha tu maṇḍūkasyeyaṃ bhāryeti "tasyedam" ityaṇ| kumārīti| prathamavayovācī eva śabdo na tvanūḍhatvaprayuktaḥ| vṛddhakumārīti tu gauṇaḥ prayogaḥ| tryanīketi| trayāṇāmanīkānāṃ samāhāraḥ, atrājāderākṛtigaṇatvāt ṭābiti tryanīkādhikaraṇe mīmāṃsakāḥ| pañcāśveti| nanvatra "dvigoḥ" iti ṅīṣ mā bhūt| ṭhagantatvāttu syādeveti cet ? na "ṭhako yo'kāra" iti vyākhyānāt| dvibisteti| "suvarṇabistau hemno'kṣe' ityamaraḥ| "ācito daśa bhārāḥ syuḥ'| dvikambalyeti| dvābhyāṃ kambalyābhyāṃ krītā| kambalyamūrṇāpalaśatam| "kambalācca saṃjñāyām" iti yat| krītārthasya ṭhaño luk| dvyāḍhakīti| dvāvāḍhakau pacatīti "āḍhakācitapātrāt kho'nyatarasyām" "dvigoṣṭham̐śca" iti kha-ṭhanbhyāṃ mukte prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ, tasya luk| etena dvyācitā vyākhyātā| kāṇḍāntāt ṣoḍaśahastapramāṇo daṇḍaḥ kāṇḍam| yadyapi viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhiḥ siddhastathā'pi antagrahaṇe asati kṣetre ityetat śrutatvātkāṇḍasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ syānna tadantasya| tataścehāpi syāt| dvābhyāṃ kāṇḍābhyāṃ-- kāṇḍapramitābhyāṃ kṣetrābhyāṃ krītā dvikāṇḍī vaḍaveti| iha tu na syāt-- dvikāṇḍā kṣetrabhaktiriti| ato'ntagrahaṇam| mātraca iti| yattu prācoktaṃ dvayasaco lugiti; tanna, "prathamaśca dvitīyaśca ūrdhvamāne matau mama|" iti siddhāntāt| dvikāṇḍī rajjuriti| nanviha parimāṇāntāditi pūrveṇa niṣedhaḥ syāt, kāṇḍaśabdasyā''yāmaparatayā aparimāṇārthatvāt| paritaḥ- sarvataḥ ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca yena mīyate taddhi parimāṇamāḍhakakuḍavādi| na tu yathākathañcitparicchedakamātram| yadāhuḥ- ūrdhvamānaṃ kilonmānaṃ parimāṇaṃ tu sarvataḥ| āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syāt saṃkhyā bāhyā tu sarvataḥ|| iti|| ata eva dvihastā bhittirityatra ṅīb na| atrāhuḥ-niyamārthamidam| kṣetre eva niṣedho yathā syāditi| ato dvikāṇḍī rajjurityatra ṅībeva sūtrasya phalamiti| puruṣātpramāṇe-- yadyapi puruṣaśabdo jātivacanastathāpi dvau puruṣau pramāṇamasyā iti vākye pramāṇe vartata eva, pramāṇaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt| vṛttau tu tatsvabhāvādeva| tathā ca śulbasūtram-- "pañcāratniḥ puruṣaḥ" iti| dvipuruṣīti| atra nyāsakāraḥ "pramāṇe lo dvigornityam' iti dvayasaco lugityāha; tanna, puruṣaśabdasya pramāṇavācitvābhāvena "pramāṇe lo' iti ślokavārtikasya tatrāpravṛtteḥ| ye hi śamādivat pramāṇatvena prasiddhāstatraiva tatpravartate na tu puruṣaśabde'pi| anyathā puruṣadvayasamityatrāpi luk syāt| spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ "puruṣahastibhyāmaṇ ca" iti sūtre padamañjaryām| na caivaṃ dvayasajdaghnacāvapi nāsmātsyātāmiti vācyam? "ūrdhvamāne matau mama' iti vacanāt| evaṃ "puruṣātpramāṇe" ityasyāpi sāmarthyādeva pravṛttiḥ| yattu tatraiva sūtre "dvigornityaṃ luk' iti vṛttigranthamupādāya haradattenoktaṃ "tasmādaprāpta evātra lugvidhīyate' iti; tadapi cintyama, munitrayānuktasya vidhānoktervyāhatatvāt| yadapi prācīnaprakriyāṃ vyācakṣāṇairuktaṃ "puruṣahastibhyām" ityatra paṭhyamānena vārtikāntareṇa lugiti; tadapi rabhasoktimātram udāhṛtasūtrasya bhāṣyavārtikakārābhyāmaspṛṣṭatvādityāstāṃ tāvat| vastutastu "puruṣātpramāṇe" iti sūtre dvigostaddhitaluki ityanuvartate| tatsāmarthyāllugapyākṣipyate| haradattoktirapi kathaṃcidevaṃparatayaiva neyeti sahṛdayairākalanīyam| pramāṇe kim ? dvābhyāṃ puruṣābhyāṃ krītā dvipuruṣā gauḥ| taddhitalukītyeva| samāhāre pañcapuruṣī| ūdhaso'naṅ nādeśenaiva siddhe'naṅkaraṇaṃ "dhanuṣaśca" ityetadartham| dāma-- bahuvrīhiviśeṣaṇatvādeva siddhe antagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| saṃkhyāderiti| svaritatvabalādekadeśa evānuvartata iti bhāvaḥ| kevalamāmaka-- ityādīti| addhyasyāṃ māmakī tanū| mitrāvaruṇayorbhāgadheyī| aniṣevyāstanvaḥ santu pāpīḥ| utāparibhyo maghavā vijigye| samānīva ākūtiḥ | āryakṛtī| sumaṅgalī| śivā rudrasya bheṣajī| pratyudāharaṇaṃ tviti| yattu prācā'ntarvatī pativatīti pratyudāhṛtam, tadayuktamiti bhāvaḥ| vyaste kathamiti cediti| yattu prācā samaste'pyupacāra iti varṇitaṃ, tanmudheti bhāvaḥ| pūtakratorai ca aikāra ādeśo na tu pratyayaḥ, uttarasūtre udātta ityukteḥ| na tviti| anyathā-- vṛṣākapiśabdo "laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' iti madhyodātta udāttatvaṃ prayojayati| agnyādiṣu triṣu "sthāne'ntaratama" ityeva siddhamiti prācāṃ granthā virudhyeranniti bhāvaḥ| udāttaikāra iti| manuśabdo hyādyudāttaḥ "śṝsvṛsnihi' ityādau manerupratyayavidhāyake sūtre "dhānye nit' ityadhikārāt| samāsanirdeśenaitaddarśayati-- udātta ityanuvartamānaṃ sambandhānuvṛtteraikāreṇaiva sambadhyate na tvaukareṇāpīti| tataśca yaduktaṃ prācā aikāraukārāvudāttau sta iti, tadupekṣyaṃ vṛttipadamañjaryādivirodhāditi bhāvaḥ| manāyīti| madhyodāttam| itaraddvayamādyudāttam| etā- karburā| varṇānāmiti| etaḥ, śoṇaḥ, śitiḥ, pṛśniḥ, pṛṣat ityudāharaṇāni| tryeṇyeti| atra uttarapadasyopasarjanatve'pi samastasya anupasarjanatvamiti bhāvaḥ| saṃjñātvāṇṇatvaṃ chāndasatvād vā| knameke iti| atra chandasīti bhāṣyokterloke "gato gaṇastūrṇamasiknikānām' ityādiprayogāḥ prāmādikā iti prāñcaḥ| vastutastu chandasyeke ityanvayāt bhāṣāyāmapi iti bhāṣyābhipretam| anyathā ekagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt| na hi chandasi "paliknīridyuvataya' ityādiprayogeṣu kaścidvipratipadyate| viśuddhavācīti| daip śodhane iti smaraṇāt| "avadāttaḥ sito gaura' iti kośe tu viśuddhatvasādharmyāt prayoga upanibaddha iti bhāvaḥ| laghāviti| ante ekasmin laghau, dvayośca laghvoḥ parato bahvaṣo- bahvackasya gururudāttaḥ syāt| aṣ iti acaḥ prācāṃ saṃjñā| kṛṣṇeti| "kṛṣeśca' iti napratyaye "kapeśca' iti sautrāddhātorauṇādike ilaci ca kṛṣṇa-kapilāvantodāttau| ṣidgaurādibhyaśca śvanśabdo'tra paṭhyate| tena "ṛnnebhyo ṅīp" ityatra yatprācā śunītyudāhṛtaṃ tatprāmādikam| yattu vyācakṣate- śvānamācaṣṭe śvevācaratīti vā'rthe ṇicaḥ kvipo vā kvau upasarjanatvāt ṅīṣabhāve niḥśunītyādivat ṅībiti; tanna, ṇici samprasāraṇaṭilopayoruktaṃ rūpaṃ mukhyamate durlabham| anyatra tu āstāṃ kathaṃcit| āvapanaṃ cediti| opyate nikṣipyate dhānyaṃ yasmin| goṇānyeti| yasyā yādṛcchikaṃ nāma| akṛtrimeti| yathā--"saiṣā sthalī yatra vicinvatā tvām" iti| sthalānyeti| kṛtrimā- puruṣeṇa saṃskṛtā| yathā- sthalayodakaṃ parigṛhṇanti| śrāṇā-pakvā| ayovikāra iti| phāla iti prasiddhaḥ| kuśānyeti| chandogāḥ stotrīyagaṇanārthān audumbarān śaṅkūn kuśā iti vyavaharanti, "ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa" iti sūtre, "hānau tūpāyaneti" vyāsasūtre, "kuśā vānaspatyā stha tā mā pāta" iti śrutau ca prasiddha evāyam| patiṃvareti| tathā ca pāṇigrahaṇotkaṇṭhābhidhāyitvād guṇavacano'yamiti bhāvaḥ| bahvādibhyaśca bahuśabdasya guṇavācitvāt pūrveṇa siddhe uttarārthaṃ grahaṇamityāhuḥ| vastutastu bahuśabdo "nityaṃ chandasi" ityuttarasūtraṃ ceti dvayamapi vyarthameva, sarvavikalpānāṃ chandasi vyavasthitatvāt| puṃyogāditi | tathā ca gauṇī vṛttiriti bhāvaḥ| yadā tu mukhyārthāt "tasyedam" ityaṇ tadā "gopī'ityeva bhavati| puṃyogaśceha dāmpatyabhāva eva gṛhyata ityeke| vastutastu saṅkoce mānābhāvājjanyajanakabhāvo'pi gṛhyate| tathā ca bhaṭṭiḥ-- "kausalyayā'sāvi sukhena rāmaḥ prākkekayīto bharatastato'bhūt||" iti| kekayasya duhitā kekayī| "janapadaśabdāt" ityapatyapratyaye añi tu kaikeyīti syāt| na ca tasya "ataśca" iti luk, "na prācyabhargādi" iti niṣedhāt| tathā ca kālidāsaḥ- "kaikeyi kāmāḥ phalitāstava|" iti| etena devakī vyākhyātā| duṣṭo yavo yavānīti| jātyantaramevānenābhidhīyate| ayameva asya doṣaḥ-- yaduktayavatvajāterabhāve'pi tadākārānukṛtiḥ| ṅīṣ vācya iti| idañca tṛtīye bhāṣye "iṅśca" iti sūtre sthitam| kathamiti| yattu vadanti-- dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyād ā anuk iti padaṃ vibhajyate| tatrendrādīnāmānukaiva siddhe ākārādeśavidhānasāmarthyāt kvacidanyato'pi vidhānamanumīyate| tena brahmāṇīti siddhamiti; taccintyam, anuki kṛte "ato guṇe" iti pararūpaprasaṅgāt| nanvakāroccāraṇasāmarthyāt dīrgho bhaviṣyati, anyathā hi nukameva kuryāditi cet? "allopo'naḥ" ityasya bādhena caritārthatvāt| "patyurno" ityādivadādeśe kartavye āgamaliṅgakakāroccāraṇasāmarthyādevāllopo na bhaviṣyatīti cet? na, śarvaśabde kakārasya cāritārthyāt| na hi tatra lopo'sti, "na saṃyogāt" iti niṣedhāt| tasmāt kakārākārayoḥ sāmarthyaviraho pararūpabādhanārthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇamāvaśyakamiti| etenānuk hrasvādireva lāghavādvaktavya iti haradattoktiḥ parāstā| karmaṇyaṇiti| tadantānṅīp| "pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām" iti ṇatvam| vastrakrītīti| vastra bhis krīta ityavasyāmavasthāyāṃ prāk subutpatteḥ samāse'dantatvān ṅīṣ| kvacinneti| "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā" iti sūtre bahulagrahaṇāt kvacitsubantena samāsaḥ| tatra ca supaḥ prāgevāntaraṅgatvāt ṭāp| tato'dantatvābhāvānna ṅīṣ iti bhāvaḥ| tena bahviti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-- "bahornañvaduttarapadabhūmni" "nañsubhyām" "jātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanātkto'kṛtamita-pratipannāḥ" iti hyantodāttatāvidhāyakāni| tatra jātipūrvādityukterbahvādipūrvakasyārthād vyudāsa iti| asvāṅgapūrvapadādvikalpasya vakṣyamāṇatvādiha svāṅgapūrvapadamevodāharaṇamityāha--ūrubhinnīti| jātāntāditi| "varṇādanudāttāt" itivad "bahuvrīherudāttāt' ityeva siddhe'ntagrahaṇaṃ nityatvapratipattyartham| "vā jāte" iti tu vaikalpika udātto na tu nitya iti bhāvaḥ| sumukhā śāleti| evaṃ ca phalamukhī kāraṇamukhī cānavasthetyādiprayogāḥ prāmādikā iti bodhyam| uraḥkroḍeti| strīliṅgo'yamiti haradattādayaḥ| tatropasarjanahrasvatve kṛte'dantatvād ṅīṣaḥ prāptiḥ| amarastu-- "na nā kroḍaṃ bhujāntaram' ityāha| ratnamatistu puṃstvamāha| gaṇe ca kroḍeti prātipadikamātraṃ paṭhyate na tu ṭābantamiti gaṇaratnamahodadhikāraḥ| evaṃ cāviśeṣālliṅgatraye'pyudāharaṇaṃ bodhyam| mādhavastu tudādigaṇe kruḍa nimajjane iti dhātāvāha- kroḍaḥ| ghañ| kroḍā- aśvānāmuraḥ| ṭābanto'yaṃ svabhāvato viśeṣaviṣayaḥ, kroḍādiṣu ṭābantasyaiva pāṭhāt| bhujāntaramātraviṣayasya kroḍaśabsya bahuvrīhau svāṅgalakṣaṇo ṅīṣvikalpo bhavatyeva| kalyāṇakroḍī, kalyāṇakroḍā mayūrīti| ṅīṣo ṅībādeśa iti| "dikpūrvapadāt" iti pañcamyā ṅīṣiti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyata iti bhāvaḥ| yadi tu svatantro ṅīp syāt tarhi prāggulphādāvapi prasajyeta| tatparihārāya pūrvoktaparyudāsasya prasajyapratiṣedhānāṃ vā'nuvṛttau gauravamiti bhāvaḥ| vṛṣalīti| ekasyāṃ vyaktau vṛṣalatve kathite tadapatyatatsahodarādau kathanaṃ vinā'pi tasya sugrahatvāditi bhāvaḥ| aupagavīti| aṇṇantalakṣaṇaṃ ṅīpaṃ paratvādayaṃ bādhate| evaṃ cāpatyādhikāre aupagavīti pratīkamupādāya "ṭiḍḍhāṇañ" iti ṅībiti vyācakṣāṇā upekṣyā iti bhāvaḥ| brāhmaṇītyatreti| evaṃ ca prācī ṅīṣudāharaṇaṃ prāmādikamiti bhāvaḥ| kurūriti| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā prātipadikatvātsvādayaḥ| prācā tu "antādivacca' iti sūtramupanyasyā''divadbhāvatsvādaya ityuktam| atredaṃ vaktavyam- paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvo vidhīyate| tathā cehā'pratyaya iti niṣedha eva syānna tu svādayaḥ| yattu vyācakhyuḥ-- ādiḥ- ūṅapekṣayā pūrvaḥ, prātipadikaṃ, tadvadbhāvāt tadavayavatvena grahāt pūrvantavadbhāvāditi yāvaditi; tadapi kliṣṭaṃ svaparagranthaviruddhaṃ ca| uktarītyā hi kāṇḍe kuḍye ityādāvapi "ekavacanamutsargataḥ' iti suḥ pravarteta| tadvāraṇāya cā'pratyaya iti prasajyapratiṣedhābhyupagame prakṛte doṣaḥ| śvaśrūrityatraikādeśā'bhāvena liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyā āvaśyakatvācca| yattu- tatra "śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā" iti nirdeśātsvādaya iti; tanna, nirdeśasya śabdaparatvāt| "viparābhyāṃ jeḥ" "ṅeryaḥ" itivat| śvaśurasyeti| puṃyogalakṣaṇe ṅīṣi prāpte ūṅ| tatsanniyogena ca vidhīyamāno lopaḥ sannihitatvādantyasyaivā'kārasya, na tvādeḥ| etacca vacanaṃ "śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā"iti nirdeśasiddhārthakathanaparam| ato'pi prathamā'kārasya lopo na śaṅkyaḥ| upamānavācipūrvapadamiti| "dhātrīkarābhyāṃ karabhopamoruḥ' ityatra tu na, karabhaśabdasyopamānavācitve'pi pūrvapadatvābhāvāt| śaphau khurāviti| yadyapi "śaphaṃ klībe khuraḥ pumān' ityamarastathāpi śaphaśabdasya puṃstvamapi bahusammatam, śaphāviva jarbhurāṇeti śrutau "grāmyapaśusaṅgheṣu" iti sūtrasya vyākhyāvasare nyāsaharadattādigrantheṣu, vācaspatyādinibandheṣu ca pracuraprayogāt, "liṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya" iti bhāṣyācca, "śapho bhujo gudaṃ ghoṇā' iti gaṇaratnamahodadhau kroḍādigaṇe pāṭhācca, "śaphaḥ khure gavādīnāṃ mūle viṭapināmapi' iti hemacandrakośācca| viśvakośe ca punnapuṃsakatoktā| vāmau sundarau ūrū yasyā iti vigrahaḥ| iha sarvatra upamānābhāvādaprāpte vidhiḥ| kathaṃ tarhi "pīvaroru pibatīva barhiṇa' iti kumāraḥ? pramāda evāyam| saṃjñāpūrvakatvātsambuddhiguṇo netyeke| hitena saheti| "samo vā hitatatayoḥ' iti vyutpāditaḥ sahitaśabdastu neha gṛhyate, ekadeśavikṛtatayā saṃhitagrahaṇādeva siddheriti bhāvaḥ| año yo'kāra iti| añā akāraviśeṣaṇaṃ kim ? śūrasenī| "janapadaśabdāt" ityaño "ataśca" iti luki jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ| śārṅgaravīti| śṛṅgaruśabdādapatyārthe aṇ| nṛnarayoriti| nṛśabdād "ṛnnebhya" iti ṅīpi, naraśabdājjātilakṣaṇe ṅīṣi prāpte vacanam| nanu naraśabde alo'ntyasya vṛddhiḥ syāt| yattvāhuḥ-- antyasya "yasyeti" lopenāpahārādanantyasyāpyakārasya vṛddhirbhavatyāntaratamyāt| "guṇe tvanyāyyakalpanā' ityalontyaparibhāṣābādhasyaiva nyāyyatvāditi; tanna, pratyayasanniyogaśiṣṭāyā vṛddherantaraṅgatvena paramapi "yasyeti" lopaṃ bādhitvā pravṛttyaucityāt | kiṃ cāstu kathaṃcillopastathā'pi rephasyaiva vṛddhiḥ syānna tvakārasya, antaratamaparibhāṣāpekṣayā'lontyaparibhāṣāyāḥ paratvāt| api cāntaratamaparibhāṣā'sadṛśamādeśaṃ vyāvartayati, na tu sthāninaṃ niyacchati, tatkathaṃ rephasya sthānitvavyāvṛttiḥ| kiṃ ca "guṇe tvanyāyya' iti nyāyopanyasanaṃ sthavīya eva, paribhāṣayoḥ parasparaṃ guṇaguṇibhāvāyogāt| atredaṃ tattvam| "nara" iti rāntaluptākārānukaraṇaṃ naraḥ aḥ naraḥ| nā ca naraśca tayoriti vyākhyeyam| yadvā narasya aḥ naraḥ, katantavat pararūpam| nā ca naraśca tayornṛnarayoḥ| narasya ca prathama eva akāro gṛhyate na tu dvitīyaḥ, praśleṣasāmarthyāt| adhikaṃ śabdakaustubhe bodhyam| putraśabdo'tra paṭhyate| śailaputrī, "putrīva harṣaṃ hṛdaye tanoti', "kurve tadurvīpatiputri sarvam' | na ca putraśabdaḥ kanyāyāṃ nāstīti bhramitavyam, ātmajastanayaḥ sūnuḥ sutaḥ putraḥ striyāṃ tvamī| āhurduhitaraṃ sarve|| ityamarokteḥ| ata eva "pratyayasthāt" itītvaprakaraṇe "vā sūtakāputrikāvṛndārakāṇām' iti vārtikaṃ tadbhāṣyādikaṃ ca saṅgacchate| yattvatra haradattenoktam- kevalaputraśabdaḥ striyāṃ na vartate iti; tadbhāṣyādivirodhādupekṣyam, itvaprakaraṇasthasvagranthavirodhācca| idaṃ tu cintyam-- "kāre satyāgadasya" iti sūtre "sūtograrājabhojakulamerubhyo duhituḥ putraḍvā' iti vārtikaṃ kimarthamiti| yattu vadanti svarārthamiti, tanna, ṭittvān ṅīpi kṛte udāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodātte ṅīnantena tatpuruṣe'pi samāsasvareṇāntodātta eveti svare bhedābhāvāt| yadapi śārṅgaravādau putraśabdaḥ prakṣipto na tu sāmpradāyika iti; tadapi na, udāhṛtaprayogavirodhāt, "vā sūtakā' ityādivārtike kaiyaṭaharadattādikṛtā'kārapraśleṣavirodhāccetyāstāṃ tāvat| āmbaṣṭhyeti| "vṛddhetkosalāt" iti yaṅ| kārīṣagandhyeti| karīṣasyeva gandho'sya karīṣagandhiḥ| "upamānācca" iti gandhasyedantādeśaḥ| tasya gotrāpatyaṃ strī, aṇ| "aṇiñoḥ" iti ṣyaṅādeśaḥ| sa ca yadyapi striyāmeva vihitastathā'pi ṅitkaraṇasāmarthyāttadantādapyayaṃ cāp| pautimāṣyeti| pūtimāṣaśabdo gargādiḥ| taddhitāḥ bahuvacanamanuktānāmupasaṃkhyeyānāṃ saṅgrahārtham| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ ca tebhyaḥ prayogebhyo hitāstaddhitā ityanvarthatvāya| tena yathā'bhidhānameva syuḥ| syādetat| ṭāpaḥ prāgayamadhikāro'stu ṣphavidhau taddhitagrahaṇaṃ, yasyeti lope īdgrahaṇaṃ ca māstviti cet ? maivam, paṭvītyatra orguṇaprasaṅgāt| śatrantāditi| yauti miśrīkaroti patyeti vyutpatteḥ| kecittu bāhulakāt yauterauṇādikaṃ katipratyayaṃ vadanti| ubhayathā'pi yuvatīnāṃ samūho yauvatam| tyantāttu aṇi puṃvadbhāvāt yauvanamityeva| bhikṣādipāṭhasāmarthyānna puṃvaditi vṛttistu bhāṣyaviruddhā, bhāṣye tatpāṭhasya pratyākhyānāditi dik|| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāṃ strīpratyayaprakaraṇam || || atha kārakaprakaraṇam|| mātraśabdasyeti| tasya cāvadhāraṇamarthaḥ| "mātraṃ kārtsnye'vadhāraṇe' ityamaraḥ| prātipadikārthādīnyeva tanmātramityevakāreṇāsvapadavigrahaḥ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ| kṛṣṇa iti| yadyapi nīlarūpavatparo'yamaniyataliṅgastathā'pi vāsudeve bhagavati niyataliṅga eveti bhāvaḥ| jñānamiti| bhāve lyuṭ| droṇa iti| na ca prātipadikamātre prathamehā'stviti vācyam? tathā sati paricchedyaparicchedakabhāvasya saṃsargavidhayā bhānāyogānnāmārthayorabhedasaṃsarga eveti vyutpatteḥ| na cāṣaṣṭhyarthabahuvrīhau vyabhicāraḥ, ekārthībhāvābhyupagamāt| nāpi nipātārthe, teṣāṃ dyotakatā'bhyupagamāt| na ca siddhānte'pi prakṛtipratyayārthayorabhedānvayo durlabhaḥ, anyatrādṛṣṭatvāditi vācyam? devatārthakataddhitādau dṛṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ| vacanaṃ saṃkhyeti| tathaiva prācāṃ vyavahārāt| iha sūtre'rthe liṅge ca prathametyetāvadeva suvacam| itaratsarvaṃ tyaktuṃ śakyam| tathā hi-- arthe prathametyukte kasyārthe ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ yasmātsvādividhistasyeti labhyata eva| svādayaśca prātipadikālliṅgapratyayaviśiṣṭācca vidhīyante| tadarthatvañca tato niyatopasthitikatvameva| evaṃ ca mṛḍānītyādau puṃyogamahattvāderapi ṅyantānniyatabhānena prathamā siddhyatītyaparamanukūlam| yathānyāse tu sā na syāt| yadi tu-- arthaśabdo vṛttiviṣayaparaḥ, vṛttistu śaktirlakṣaṇā ca, gauṇī tu lakṣaṇāntarbhūtā, pṛthagvāstu; trikaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ- tadā liṅgetyapi māstu| lakṣyāṇāṃ vicitratve'pi na kṣatiḥ, niyamāṃśatyāgāt| tathā ca arthe prathametyeva sāram| droṇo vrīhirityapi droṇaśabdasya tatparimite upacārātsiddham, gaurvāhīka itivat| eko dvāvityādyapi "na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā' iti niṣedhādeva siddham, ananvitārthakaprayogāpekṣayā anuvādakamātraprayogasya nyāyyatvāt| evaṃ mātragrahaṇamapi vyartham, "sambodhane ca" iti jñāpakena karmādyādhikye prathamāyā apravṛtteḥ| yattu prācoktam-- prātipadikārthaḥ satteti| yacca vyākhyānaṃ- yo'rthaḥ sannityeva kevalaṃ bhāsate na jātyādirūpe na liṅgasaṃkhyākārakayogī, sa vivakṣitaḥ| yathā'vyayārthaḥ| avyayārtho hi kevalamastīti śakyate vaktuṃ, na punarīdṛśastādṛśa itīti cet? na, uccairnīcairityādiśabdānāṃ sannityākārakapratītijanakatvasya sarvatantraviruddhatvāt, astyādisāmānadhikaraṇyasyāpi asattvārthakeṣu durlabhatvāt, na liṅgasaṃkhyākārakayogīti tvaduktivirodhācca| padāntaropasthāpitasya astisāmānādhikaraṇyamastīti cet? na, tasya avyāvartakatvāt, na punarityādivākyaśeṣavirodhācca, kṛṣṇaḥ śrīrityādāvavyāpteśca| na ca liṅgagrahaṇāttatsiddhiḥ, mātraśabdenā'dhikavyavacchedāt| yadapi prācā vyākhyātaṃ- yatrārthāntārānapekṣayā śabdapravṛttiḥ, sa sarvaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ, śabdapravṛttinimittamiti yāvat| yathā uccairnīcairiti| aliṅgasaṃkhyāvetau kevalaṃ jātyādinirapekṣaṃ svārthamāhaturiti; tadapi na, pravṛttinimittamiha prakārībhūya bhāsate| tathā ca tanmātrabodho'sambhavī| yadi so'pīṣṭastarhi ghaṭādiśabdebhyo'pi syāditi saṃkhyākārakādyananvaya eva syāt| yadapi droṇaparimite vrīhyādau droṇaśabdaḥ so'yamityabhisambandhātpravartate| tatra gauṇamukhyanyāyānna prāpnotīti parimāṇagrahaṇamiti; tanna, padakāryeṣvayaṃ nyāyo na prātipadikakāryeṣviti siddhāntāt, anyathā siṃho māṇavaka ityādyasiddhiprasaṅgācca| yadapyāhuḥ-- droṇādayaḥ śabdā lauhaṃ dārumayaṃ vā parimāṇameva na vyabhicaranti, parimeyaṃ tu vyabhicarantyeva| atastasya prātipadikārthatvābhāvādaprāpteḥ parimāṇagrahaṇamiti; tadapi na, gauṇalākṣaṇikeṣu "siṃho māṇavakaḥ' "mañcāḥ krośanti' ityādiṣvavyāptyāpatteḥ| tatra viśeṣyasya māṇavakāderbhede'pi siṃhasadṛśa ityartho gauṇyāṃ niyatopasthitika eveti yadi, tarhi vrīhyāderbhede'pi droṇaparimito niyatopasthitika eveti tulyam| sambodhane ca mātragrahaṇātsaṃbodhanādhikye na prāpnotītyārambhaḥ| iha saṃbodhanaṃ prakṛtyarthaṃ prati viśeṣyaṃ, kriyāṃ prati viśeṣaṇamiti siddhāntaḥ| uktaṃ ca-- sambodhanapadaṃ yacca tat kriyāyāṃ viśeṣaṇam| vrajāni devadatteti nighāto'tra tathā sati|| iti| evaṃ ca "rāma māṃ pāhi' iti vākyasya rāmasaṃbandhisaṃbodhanaviṣayo matkarmakaṃ rakṣaṇamarthaḥ|| || iti prathamā || karturīpsitatamaṃ karma karturiti "ktasya ca vartamāne" iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī| āpnoteḥ sannantāt "matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca" iti vartamāne ktaḥ| matiricchā na tu buddhiḥ, punarbuddhigrahaṇāt| evaṃ ca kartrā āptumiṣyamāṇaṃ karmetyarthaḥ| kartā ca dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayaḥ| sa ca kenā''ptumicchatītyākāṅkṣāyāṃ viśeṣaṇībhūtena vyāpāreṇetyarthāllabhyate| tadetadāha-- kriyayeti| ktapratyayenopasthitaṃ vartamānatvaṃ neha vivakṣitam| tena "kaṭaṃ kṛtavān' "kaṭaṃ kariṣyati' ityādi siddhyati| kārakamiti| etacca "kārake" ityadhikārāllabhyate| tatra hi vyatyayena prathamārthe saptamī| pratisūtraṃ vākyaṃ bhittvā kārakasaṃjñā vidhīyate| tadyathā- apāye dhruvaṃ kārakasaṃjñaṃ syāt| tataḥ "apādānam" uktaṃ kārakamapādānasaṃjñaṃ syāt| punaḥ kārakaśabdānuvṛttisāmarthyāt viśeṣasaṃjñābhiḥ saha samāveśaḥ| anvarthā ceyaṃ saṃjñā-- karotīti kārakamiti| tena kriyā'nanvayino na bhavati-- brāhmaṇasya putraṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchatīti| iha hi brāhmaṇaḥ putraviśeṣaṇaṃ na tu kriyānvayi| yadvā kārakaśabdaḥ kriyāparaḥ, karoti kartṛkarmādivyapadeśāniti vyutpatteḥ| tathā ca apādānādisaṃjñāvidhau kriyāyāmityasyopasthityā kriyānvayināmeva tattatsaṃjñā vidhīyante| "kārakāddattaśrutayoḥ" ityādau tu kārakaśabdaḥ svaryate| tenaitadadhikāroktaṃ kartrādiṣaṭkameva gṛhyate| asmin pakṣe vṛttāvapi kārakamityasya kriyānvayītyarthaḥ| ādyapakṣe tu kārakasaṃjñā syāt| tacca kārakaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ syāditi vyākhyeyam| anabhihite nanu bahupaṭurityādau bahucā uktārthatvādyathā kalpabādayo na, evaṃ kriyate kaṭaḥ ityādāvapi tiṅādibhiruktārthatvād dvitīyā na bhaviṣyati, kiṃ ca kaṭaṃ karotītyādau sāvakāśā dvitīyā "kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ' ityādiṣu prathamayā bādhiṣyate, niravakāśatvāt| na ca vṛkṣa ityādiravakāśaḥ, tatrāpi pratīyamānāmastikriyāṃ prati kartṛtvena tṛtīyāprasaṅgāt| atha nīlamidaṃ na tu raktamityādau viśeṣaṇāntaranivṛttitātparyake astikriyāyā anāvaśyakatvāt prathamāyā avakāśaṃ brūṣe, tarhi vipratiṣedhāt prathamāstu| evaṃ cānabhihitādhikāro vṛtheti cet? maivam, saṃkhyā vibhaktyartha iti pakṣe sūtrārambhāt| tathā cā'nabhihite karmaṇi yadekatvaṃ tatra dvitīyaikavacanamamityarthaḥ| sūtrānārambhe ca karmaṇi yadekatvaṃ tatra dvitīyaikavacanamam iti hi vākyārthaḥ| tathā sati "kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ' ityādau ca ktena karmamātroktāvapi tadekatvasyānuktatayā am durvāraḥ| paratvātprathametyapi na, "kartavyaḥ kaṭaḥ' ityādau tato'pi paratvena kṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgāt| kārakaṃ vibhaktyartha iti pakṣe sūtraṃ pratyākhyātamākare| hariṃ bhajatīti| bhajanakriyayā harau prīterutpādāt prītiviśiṣṭatayā kriyāvyāpyatvena hariḥ karma| tadviśiṣṭaṃ bhajanaṃ vākyārthaḥ| "hariḥ sevyate' ityatrāpyevameva, "kriyāpradhānamākhyātam' iti siddhāntāt| dhātūpasthitā kriyā tiṅarthaṃ prati viśeṣyā, na tu kṛdarthaṃ pratīva viśeṣaṇamiti hi tasyārthaḥ| ata eva pācako vrajati itivat pacati vrajatīti naikaṃ vākyam| pākakartṛkartṛkaṃ gamanaṃ hi pācaka ityāderarthaḥ| ekakartṛkā pacikriyā gamikriyā ca pacativrajatyoḥ pṛthagevārthaḥ| evaṃ ca prathamāntaviśeṣyako bodha iti naiyāyikodghoṣo bhāṣyādyanusāribhirnādartavyaḥ| yāsko'pyāha- "bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ, sattvapradhānāni nāmāni'| paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyādau tu mṛgakartṛkaṃ gamanaṃ dṛśikriyāyāṃ karma, pradhānaṃ dṛśikriyaiva| uktaṃ ca-- subantaṃ hi yathā'nekaṃ tiṅantasya viśeṣaṇam| tathā tiṅantamapyāhustiṅantasya viśeṣaṇam|| iti| evaṃ pacati bhavatītyasya pacikriyā bhavatītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ-- tiṅantopasthitāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kriyāntaraṃ prati viśeṣaṇatve'pi śabdādhyāhāravāde karmatvaṃ saṃsarga eva, na tu prakāraḥ; apadārthatvāt| arthādhyāhāravāde tu prakāratve'pīṣṭāpattiḥ| pacatītyādau dhātūpāttaphalasyāpītthameva matabhedena vyavasthā| ata eva tatsamānādhikaraṇe "śobhanaṃ pacati' ityādau dvitīyaikavacanotpattiḥ, "agniṣṭomena yajeta' ityādau tṛtīyotpattiprasaṅgaśca saṅgacchate| na ca dṛṣṭānte viśeṣyasamarpakāddārṣṭāntike viśeṣaṇasamarpakācca karmatvādivacikāyāḥ subvibhakteḥ prayogo'stviti vācyam? dhātutiṅantayoraprātipadikatvāt| naiyāyikānāṃ tu syādeṣa doṣaḥ| tathā hi dhāvantaṃ mṛgaṃ paśyetivat dhāvati mṛgamityapi syāt| na cāprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇye śatṛśānacornityatvānnaivaṃ prayoga iti vācyam? evamapi dvitīyānutpatterdurupapādatvāt| nanu tatra vākyabheda eva, paśyetyatra tamiti karmādhyāhārāt| pacati bhavatītyādi tu pāko bhavatītyādyarthe'niṣṭameveti cet? maivam, adhyāhāre gauravāt, tasya ca munivacanavirodhenāprāmāṇikatvāt, tvadīyānicchāmātrasyākiñcitkaratvāt| api ca "apakṣīddevadatto'vehi' ityādau śatrādeḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti| ekavākyatvaṃ ca bhāṣyavārtikādisakalasammatam| na ca tiṅantasthale kriyāviśiṣṭakriyāntarabodhe jāyata eveti vācyam? tathaiva vyutpannānāṃ tādṛśabodhasya durvāratvāt| īdṛśe'rthe sādhutvaṃ neṣṭamityapi na, sādhutvānuśāsanārthaṃ pravṛttaireva tasya svīkārāt, dhātusambandhādhikaravyutpādite "purīmavaskanda' ityādau tasyāvaśyakatvācca| nanu siddhānte ākhyātavācyakriyāyā api kartṛtvakarmatvasvīkāre tasyā asattvarūpatvaṃ bhajyeteti cet? na, liṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ kartṛkarmetarakārakasya cābhāvamātreṇa tathātvopapatteḥ, karmatvasya prakāratayā'nabhyupagamādvetyanyatra vistaraḥ| abhihite tviti| nanvevaṃ "pakvamodanaṃ bhuṅkte' ityatrāpi dvitīyā na syāditi cet ? maivam, iha hi pacibhujinirūpite dve karmatvaśaktī, tatra pradhānakriyānirūpitāmanabhihitāṃ śaktimādāya dvitīyotpatteḥ| uktaṃ ca hariṇā-- pradhānetarayoryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthak| śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanurudhyate|| pradhānaviṣayā śaktiḥ pratyayenābhidhīyate| yadā guṇe tadā tadvadanuktā'pi pratīyate|| iti| ata eva "paktvaudano bhujyate' ityatra bhujipratyayenābhihite prathamaiva, paceraprādhānyāt| vastutastu "paktvā bhujyate' ityādau karmaṇaḥ pacibhujibhyāṃ yugapacchābdo'nvayaḥ, kiṃ tvanyatareṇa śābdo'pareṇārthaḥ| tatra ca prathamādvitīye vyavasthite eva| tadyathā--paktvā bhujyate odanaḥ| kiṃ paktvā ? arthādodanam| yadā tu odanaṃ paktvā bhujyate iti prayujyate tadā bhujyata ityatrārthādodana iti gamyate| evaṃ ca vivakṣābhedena "pūjayituṃ śakyate harirhariṃ vā' ityubhayaṃ sādhu| prāptānanda iti| ānandakartṛkaprāptikarmībhūta ityarthaḥ| yaduktaṃ prāyeṇeti, tasya phalamāha-- kvaciditi| viṣavṛkṣa iti| yadi tu vardhicchidyoranyatareṇa saha karmatayā'nvayo vivakṣyate, tadā dvitīyā syādeveti dhyeyam| tṛṇaṃ spṛśatīti| yathā spṛśyamānasya gaṅgāderīpsitasya kriyayā yogastajjanyasaṃyogādiphalādhāratvāt tathaivānīpsitasya tṛṇāderapīti bhāvaḥ| syādetat dhātūpasthāpyaphalaśāli karmetyevā'stu, kimīpsitānīpsitayoḥ pṛthakkathaneneti cet? maivam, agnermāṇavakaṃ vārayatītyatra "vāraṇārthānām" iti sūtreṇa māṇavakasyāpādānatvaṃ prāptaṃ tadbādhanāya "karturīpsitatamam" iti vaktavyameva| evaṃ ca dveṣyodāsīnayoḥ saṃgrahārthaṃ "tathāyuktam" ityasyāpyāvaśyakatvāt| anīpsitagrahaṇaṃ tu spaṣṭārthameva na tvāvaśyakam| idaṃ tvavadheyam| īpsitānīpsitayoḥ śābdabodha ekarūpa eva, īpsānīpsāderadhiśīṅādivatsaṃjñāpravṛttāvupayoge'pi dvitīyāvācyakoṭāvapraveśāt, ananyalabhyasyaiva śabdārthatvāt| "karmaṇi dvitīyā" iti sūtre hi tattatsūtrairyāvatāṃ karmasaṃjñā vihitā, te sarve tena rūpeṇopasthitāsteṣu ca vidhīyamānā dvitīyā ādhāravācikā, lāghavāt, kriyāyā dhātunā kartuśca devadattādiśabdairlābhāt, iṣṭatamatvādestu bhānābhāvāt| prakṛtipratyayārthayoścābhedena iha saṃsargaḥ| tathā ca haryādhārikā yā prītistadanukūlo vyāpāro vākyārthaḥ| yadyapi karmaṇi kartari adhikaraṇe ca vihitānāṃ dvitīyādīnāmādhārārtha iti tulyam; tathā'pi tannirūpakaṃ phalaṃ, vyāpāraḥ, svāśrayadvārā tadubhayaṃ ceti phalabhūte śābdabodhe vailakṣaṇyaṃ saṅgacchate| na cādhārataiva vācyeti mantavyam, tanniṣṭhadharmasya vācyatāvacchedakatāpattyā'tigauravāt "karmaṇi dvitīyā" ityādisūtrasvarasabhaṅgāpatteśca| ata eva bhāṣyakāra āha-- supāṃ karmādayo'pyarthāḥ, saṃkhyā caiva tathā tiṅām| iti| na ca tiṅo'pi dharmamātramarthaḥ, "kartari kṛt" "laḥ karmaṇi ca" "tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ" iti sūtrāṇāṃ vairūpyāpatteḥ, pācako devadattaḥ, pakva odana ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhena dharmivācakatāsvīkārācca| tasmādiha ghaṭādiśabdānāmiva viśiṣṭameva vācyam| ākṛtyadhikaraṇābhyupagame tu kṛtsvapi dharmamātraṃ, sarvathā'pi naiyāyikamīmāṃsakādyabhyupetamardhajaratīyaṃ heyameva| na hi tiṅkṛtorvailakṣaṇyaṃ sūpapādam| prapañcitañcaitacchabdakaustubhe'smābhirityalamiyatā| parigaṇanamiti| tena naṭasya śṛṇoti ityādau nātiprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| gāṃ dogdhīti| gosambandhi payaḥkarmakaṃ dohanamarthaḥ| syādetat, "karturīpsitatamaṃ karma" "tathā yuktaṃ cānīpsitam" iti sūtrābhyāṃ gatārthametat| tathā hi, tyajanopasarjanaṃ tyājanaṃ duherarthaḥ, dāpanamaṅgīkaraṇaṃ ca yāce, vikledanaṃ nivartanaṃ ca pacerityādi| evaṃ ca dhātūpāttavyāpāraviṣayībhūtaṃ yat tyajanadānāṅgīkārādi, tadāśrayatvaṃ gavādīnāṃ spaṣṭameva| ata eva hi aṇau karturṇau karmatvasya nyāyasiddhatayā gatyādisūtraṃ niyamārthamiti prācāṃ siddhāntaḥ| ata eva cākaḍārasūtre "apādānamuttarāṇi gāṃ dogdhi paya ityatra paratvātkarmasaṃjñā" iti bhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate| pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣe tvavadhitvaphalāśrayatvayoryugapad vivakṣāyāṃ cedam, avadhibhūtā yā gaustanniṣṭho yaḥ payaḥkṣaraṇānukūlo vyāpārastadviṣayiṇī gopaniṣṭhā preraṇetyarthāt| tathā ca "akathitaṃ ca" iti sūtraṃ vyarthamiti cet? atrocyate, karmaṇaḥ śeṣatvena vivakṣāyāṃ "na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāt' itivat ṣaṣṭhī prāptā, tāṃ bādhitumidaṃ sūtram| tathā ceha ṣaṣṭhīvatsambandhamātraṃ dvitīyārtha iti sthitam| apādānatvamātravivakṣāyāṃ tu pañcamyeva| goḥ kṣīraviśeṣaṇatve tu ṣaṣṭhī| tena goḥ payo dogdhītyapi prayogaḥ sādhureva| evamagre'pyūhyam| yattu prācoktam- duhyācyartharudhipracchicibrūśāsujikarmayuk| nīhṛkṛṣmanthavahadaṇḍgrahamuṣpacakarmabhāk|| iti| atredaṃ vaktavyam| graheḥ pāṭho nirmūlaḥ| jagrāha dyutaruṃ śakramityudāharaṇamapyayuktam| itareṣāṃ tu dvikarmakatvaṃ yadyapi prāmāṇikaṃ tathā'pi saṃdarbhaśuddhiḥ| tathā hi-- duhyādīn nyādīṃśca dvairāśyeneha paṭhitvā bhāvakarmaprakriyāśeṣe "lakṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ kiṃ dvikarmakebhyo mukhye karmaṇi syurgauṇe vā" ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ svayameva paṭhitam-- nyādayo ṇyantaniṣkarmagatyarthā mukhyakarmaṇi| pratyayaṃ yānti duhyādirgauṇe'nye tu yathāruci|| iti| evaṃ ca daṇḍimanthibhyāmapi mukhye syāt| tathā ca gargāḥ śataṃ daṇḍayantām iti bhāṣyaṃ virudhyeta| śataṃ hyatra pradhānaṃ, na gargāḥ "arthinaśca rājāno hiraṇyena bhavanti" iti vākyaśeṣāt| daṇḍiśceha grahaṇārtho na tu nigrahārthaḥ| ata eva mantherapi pradhāne syāt| iṣyate tu gauṇe| tathā ca bhāraviḥ-- yenāpaviddhasalilasphuṭanāgasadmā devāsurairamṛtamambunidhirmamanthe|| iti| atrā'mṛtaṃ mukhyam, uddeśyatvāt, ambunidhistu gauṇaḥ| yadapi vyākhyātāraḥ āhuḥ-- dvikarmakeṣu paceraprāmāṇikaḥ pāṭhaḥ iti, tadrabhasāt| tathā hi- "karmavatkarmaṇā" iti sūtre "duhipacyorbahulaṃ sakarmakayoḥ" iti vārtike tadbhāṣye ca pacerdvikarmakatā labhyate| kaiyaṭaharadattābhyāṃ tatraiva sphuṭīkṛtā| mādhavo'pyāha- jayateḥ karṣatermanthermuṣergaṇḍayateḥ paceḥ| ityādi| udājahāra ca- taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacatīti| yattu --"akathitaṃ ca" iti sūtre haradattenoktam-- akathitaśabdo yadyapradhānārtho gṛhyeta tadā "pāṇinā kāṃsyapātryāṃ dogdhi payaḥ' ityatra pāṇi-kāṃsyapātryorapi syāt, karaṇādhikaraṇayostu pacatyādiravakāśaḥ, na hi tatrāsya prasaṅgo duhādiparigaṇanāditi; tanmatāntarābhiprāyeṇa| anyathā udāhṛtasvaparagranthavirodhādisyāstāṃ tāvat| śataṃ jayatīti| ji abhibhave| yattu ji jaye iti vyākhyātaṃ, tanna, tasyākarmakatvāt| yadyapi jayatyādayo bhāṣye na paṭhitāstathā'pi cakāreṇa saṅgṛhyanta iti kaiyaṭaḥ| arthanibandhaneti| na tu svarūpāśrayā, "ahamapīdamacodyaṃcodye" iti "tadrāja'sūtrabhāṣye pṛcchiparyāyasya cuderapi dvikarmakatvadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ| tathā ca bhaṭṭiḥ-- sthāsnuṃ raṇe smeramukho jagāda mārīcamuccairvacanaṃ mahārtham| kālidāso'pi- śiloccayo'pi kṣitipālamuccaiḥ prītyā tamevārthamabhāṣateva| bhāraviśca-- udāracetā girimityudārāṃ dvaipāyanenābhidadhe narendraḥ| evaṃ ca nāthatyādayo bahavo dvikarmakāḥ boddhyāḥ| deśa iti| kurupañcālādireva gṛhyate, tena "adhiśīṅsthāsām" ityāderna vaiyarthyam| godoha iti| na ceha kālatvātsiddhiḥ, loke kālatvena prasiddhasya māsādereva grahaṇāt| tena "ghaṭamāste' ityādi na bhavati| yattu prācoktam--"akarmakadhātubhiryoge deśakālādhvabhāvebhyo dvitīyā' iti kecit, nadīmāste, ityādi| atredaṃ vaktavyam| karmasaṃjñāyā anuktatvātkarmaṇi lādayo na syuḥ| āsyate māsa iti yathā| kecidityapyasaṅgatam, "grāmasamūhakurvādareva deśo na tu pradeśamātram| tena grāmaṃ svapitītyatra na bhavati" ityākarāt| adhveti ca nyūnam, adhvānaṃ svapitīti prasaṅgāt| ata evā''kare adhvā gantavyatvena viśeṣitaḥ| gantavyatvena prasiddho niyatapariṇāmaḥ krośādiriti vyākhyātam| gutibuddhi-- pratyavasānaṃ bhakṣaṇam| śabdakarmakāṇāmiti| śabdaḥ karmakārakaṃ yeṣāṃ, teṣāmityarthaḥ| na tviha "kartari karmavyatihāre" itivat karmaśabdaḥ kriyāparaḥ, kṛtrime kāryasampratyayāt, karmagrahaṇasāmarthyācca| anyathā "gatibuddhipratyavasānaśabdārthakarmakāṇām" ityevāvakṣyat| niyamārthaṃ caitatsūtramiti prāñcaḥ| ṇijarthenāpyamānasya yadi bhavati tarhi gatyādyarthānāmeva karturiti| tena pācayati devadatto yajñadattenetyatra prayojye prakṛtyarthaṃ prati kartṛtvasyaiva nirapavādatvenāvasthānāt tṛtīyā siddhyati| uktaṃ ca-- guṇakriyāyāṃ svātantryāt preraṇe karmatāṅgataḥ| niyamātkarmasaṃjñāyāḥ svadharmeṇābhidhīyate|| iti| kartuḥ svadharmeṇa- tṛtīyayetyarthaḥ| nanu ṇijarthaṃ prati karmatvaṃ bādhitvā prakṛtyarthaṃ prati kartṛtvaṃ paratvādeva siddham, antaraṅgatvācca| svakārakaviśiṣṭā hi kriyā ṇijarthena sambaddhyate hetumati ṇijvidhānāt, kartṛprayojakasya hetutvāt| ata evopajīvyā'pi kartṛsaṃjñā| evaṃ ca-- paratvādantaraṅgatvādupajīvyatayā'pi ca| prayojyasyāstu kartṛtvaṃ; gatyādervidhitocitā || iti cet? astvevaṃ, lakṣyasya nirbādhatvāt| niyamasūtramidamiti granthānāṃ kā gatiriti cet? śṛṇu, ṇijarthasya śābdaṃ prādhānyaṃ puraskṛtya prādhānānurodhinyāḥ karmasaṃjñāyāḥ prābalyād vipratiṣedha eva nāsti, antaraṅgopajīvyatve api pradhānaṃ prati na prābalyaṃ prayojayata ityāśayena granthānāmuktisambhavaḥ| arthaprādhānyapuraskāre tu vidhāyakatvamevocitamiti dhyeyam| śatrūniti| svargakarmakaṃ śatruniṣṭhaṃ yad gamanaṃ tadanukūlo yanniṣṭho vyāpāraḥ, sa śrīharirme gatirityarthaḥ| nanviha kathaṃ svargasya karmatvaṃ, karturīpsitatamaṃ hi karma, na ca śatravaḥ kartāraḥ, teṣāṃ gatyādisūtreṇa karmatvāditi cet? maivam, karmasaṃjñāyāṃ hi kartṛgrahaṇaṃ svatantropalakṣaṇam| svātantryaṃ ca dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatvameva| tacca prayojakasannidhāne'pi prayojyasyāstyeva| na copalakṣaṇatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ, "pradhānakarmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhurdvikarmaṇām| apradhāne duhādīnāṃ|' ityuktvā "ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ' iti vadato bhāṣyakṛta eva tatra pramāṇatvāt| na hi lakṣaṇāṃ vinā ṇijantānāṃ dvikarmakatā labhyate, yena "ṇyante kartuḥ' iti vacanaṃ sāvakāśaṃ syāt| nanu svatantre saṅketitasya tatraiva lakṣaṇā kathamiti cet? sañjñāntarānupahite saṅketitasya tadupahitasādhāraṇe svatantramātre setyavadhehi| nīvahyoriti| yadyapyanayoḥ prāpaṇamartho na gatistathā'pi gatirapi viśeṣaṇībhūya prāpaṇamadhye praviṣṭetyetāvanmātreṇa prāptiṃ matvā pratiṣedha uktaḥ| niyantriti| niyantā paśuprerako na tu sārathireva | tena "vāhayati balīvardān yavān' iti siddhyati| aniṣedha iti| prayojyaḥ karmeti vaktavyamiti phalito'rthaḥ| sūta iti| niyantā prājitā yantā sūtaḥ kṣattā ca sārathiḥ| ādayatīti| akartrabhiprāye phale 'śeṣātkartari" iti parasmaipadam| kartrabhiprāye tu "ṇicaśca" ityātmanepadameva, tadapavādasya "nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca" ityasya "adeḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti niṣiddhatvāt| sasyamiti| kṣetrasthānāṃ yavānāṃ bhakṣyamāṇānāṃ hiṃsā draṣṭavyā, tasyāmavasthāyāṃ teṣāṃ cetanatvāt| smārayatīti| yattu-- "ṇeraṇau" iti sūtre "smarayatyenaṃ vanagulmaḥ svayameva' ityudāhriyate; tatra bhāṣyaprayogādeva karmatvaṃ bodhyam| śabdāyateriti| śabdaṃ karotītyarthe "śabdavaira" ityādinā kyaṅ, tato hetumaṇṇic| dhātvartheti| etena "śabdāyayati sainikairipūn' iti karma prayuñjānāḥ parāstāḥ| yattu prācā-- "aya-kranda-śabdāya-vheñāṃ na' ityuktam| tatrā'yateruktistāvannirmūlaiva| kranda-hveñostu śabdakriyātvamātreṇa prāptisambhāvanā| vastutastu nāsau sūtrārtha ityuktam| yadapi "śrugrahadṛśām' iti karmatvamuktam| tatra dṛśigrahaṇaṃ prāmāṇikameva| śṛṇotestu śabdakarmakatvātsiddham| grahestu dvikarmakatvaṃ yadyapi sudhākarādīnāṃ saṃmataṃ tathā'pi bahūnāmasammatam| ata eva "ajigrahattaṃ janako dhanustad' iti bhaṭṭiprayogamajigrahat bodhitavāniti vyācakhyuḥ| tathā-- ayācitāraṃ na hi devadevamadriḥ sutāṃ grāhayituṃ śaśāka|| ityatra grāhayitum-- udvāhyatvena bodhayitumiti| yuktaṃ caitat| grāherdvikarmakatve hi jāyāpratigrāhitagandhamālyāmityatra ktena prayojyāyā dhenorabhidhānaṃ syāt, "ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ' ityukteḥ| tataśca jāyayā gandhamālye pratigrāhitāmiti syāt| siddhānte tu pratigrāhite gandhamālye yayeti vigrahaḥ| jāyāniṣṭhapreraṇaviṣayībhūtaṃ gandhamālyakarmakaṃ yatpratigrahaṇaṃ tatkartrīmityarthaḥ| anyapadārthāntarbhāveṇa viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavaiparītyenaivaikārthībhāvakalpanāt| abhivādidṛśoriti| abhivādayateraprāpte dṛśestu prāpte vibhāṣeyam| abhini-- neralpāctaratvena pūrvanipāte kartavye viparītoccāraṇaṃ tādṛśasamudāyavivakṣārthamityāha--saṃghātapūrvakasyeti| teneha na- "niviśate yadi śūkaśikhā pade' iti| kvacinneti| "eṣvartheṣvabhiniviṣṭānām" iti bhāṣyaprayogaśceha mānam| upapadavibhaktimāha- ubhasarvatasorityādinā| ubhasarvayostasau ubhasarvatasau, tadantayoryoge dvitīyā kāryetyarthaḥ| atra prāñcaḥ-- ubhaśabdenobhayaśabdo lakṣyate, anyathā taso'sambhavādityāhuḥ| vastutastu vṛttiviṣaye ayacpravṛttāvapi ubhaśabdādvihato yastas tadantamastyeveti yathāśrutaṃ sādhu| dhigityavibhaktiko nirdeśo gavityayamāhetivaditi prāñcaḥ| tanna, tathā sati apadāntatayā dṛṣṭānte "lopaḥ śākalyasya" ityasyeva dārṣṭāntike jaśtvasyāpi apravṛttiprasaṅgāt| na cāyaṃ gakārānta eveti bhramitavyaṃ, "kasya ca daḥ" iti sūtre dhakidityudāharaṇasyāsaṅgatiprasaṅgāt| tasmād dhigiti vibhaktyantameva| "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam' ityatideśātsupo luk| ubhayata kṛṣṇamiti| kṛṣṇasya pārśvadvaye'pītyarthaḥ| ādyāditvāttasiḥ| ṣaṣṭhyarthe dvitīyā| evamupapadavibhaktau sarvatra bodhyam| nāmnordvidhaiva sambandhaḥ sarvavākyeṣvavasthitaḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyena ṣaṣṭhyā vā'pi kvacidbhavet|| iti vṛddhoktau ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇaṃ tadapavādavibhakterapyupalakṣaṇam| dvidhetyuktiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyavaiyadhikaraṇyābhyāṃ nirvāhyā, ṣaṣṭhītadapavādayorekakoṭitayā vā| dhik kṛṣṇābhaktamiti| tasya nindyatetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ dhiṅ mūrkheti? sambodhanapadasya kriyānvaya iti prāgevoktatayā dhikśabdayogābhāvāt| kriyāpadaṃ ca kvacicchrutaṃ kvacidākṣiptamityanyadetat| tathā ca mūrkhasambodhyakaṃ niṣiddhācaraṇādi nindyata iti vākyārthaḥ| etena "hā tāta' "hā devi dhīrā bhava' ityādi vyākhyātam| yattvāhuḥ-- "upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti sambodhane prathamaiva bhavati sambodhanapadasya kartṛkārakavācitvāditi; tanmandam, saṃbodhanapadasya kartṛkārakatve uktisambhavābhāvat| deva prasīdetyādau vastugatyā deva eva karteti cet? naitāvatā kārakavibhaktitvaṃ labhyate| kiṃ ca deva tvāṃ bhaje, tvāṃ bhajantītyādau saṃbodhyasya vāstavamapi na kartṛtvamityāstāṃ tāvat| uparyuparīti| kathaṃ tarhi "uparyuparibuddhīnāṃ carantīśvarabuddhayaḥ' ? ucyate, uparibuddhīnāmuttānabuddhīnāmupari carantītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ca āmreḍitatvābhāvānna dvitīyā| yadvā- pratipadoktasya "uparyadhyadhasaḥ sāmīpye" iti kṛtadvitvasyātra grahaṇam, tena vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacane sati nāsya pravṛttiḥ| "anyatrāpi dṛśyate" ityuktaṃ, taddarśayati-- abhitaḥ parita iti| pratibhātīti| eṣa pratiśabdaḥ kriyāviśeṣakatvādupasargo na tu karmapravacanīyaḥ| antarā tvāṃ māmiti| tava mama ca madhye ityarthaḥ| sāmarthyāditi| ata eva hetutvaparyantamapi śābdabodhe viṣaya iti svīkriyata iti bhāvaḥ| nadīmanviti| dvitīyāyāḥ sambandho'rthaḥ| sa ceha sāhityarūpa ityanunā dyotyate| lakṣaṇettham-- vṛkṣaṃ pratīti| vṛkṣasambandhi dyotanamityarthaḥ| saṃbandhaśca lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāva iti pratyādayo dyotayanti| bhakto viṣṇuṃ pratīti| viṣṇorbhakteśca viṣayaviṣayibhāvaḥ pratyādidyotyaḥ| lakṣmīriti| lakṣmīrūpasya bhāgasya hariṇā saha svasvāmibhāvaḥ| vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣamiti| iha vīpsā dvirvacanenaiva dyotyate, pariśabdastu kriyayā saṃbadhyate, karmaṇi dvitīyā| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayā upasargasaṃjñāyā bādhāt ṣatvaṃ na | etadarthameva lakṣaṇādayo viṣayatayopāttā iti vyākhyātamākare| "pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ" iti tu na bhavati, varjanārthenāpetyanena sāhacaryāt| mamābhiṣyāditi| mama bhāgaḥ syādityarthaḥ| māmabhiṣyādityapi prāñcaḥ pratyudāharanti| tatra māṃ prāpnuyādityarthaḥ| upasargavaśena asteḥ sakarmakatvānmāmiti dvitīyā, atra ca mama bhāga ityarthataḥ paryavasānāt| abhāge iti karmapravacanīyatve niṣiddhe "upasargaprādurbhyām" iti ṣatvam| pūjāyāṃ ceti| "suḥ pūjāyām" iti pūrvasūtrāt pūjāgrahaṇamanukṛṣyate| kālādhvanoḥ-- antaṃ- virāmamatikrānto'tyantaḥ sa cāsau saṃyogo nirantarasannikarṣaḥ ityarthaḥ| dvitīyā syāditi| śrutatvāt kālādhvavṛttibhyāmeva| māsasyeti| "kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe" iti ṣaṣṭhītyāhuḥ, tanna, tatra śeṣagrahaṇānuvṛttyā "dvirahno bhojanam' iti kṛdantena saha samāsāpravṛttereva phalatvāt| tasmādiha "ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe" iti sūtreṇaiva ṣaṣṭhīti tattvam| || iti dvitīyā|| svatantraḥ kartā pradhānībhūtadhātvarthaṃ prati āśrayatvaṃ svātantryam| āha ca- dhātunoktakriye nityaṃ kārake kartṛteṣyate || iti| sādhakatamaṃ karaṇaṃ prakṛṣṭeti| yadvyāpārādanantaraṃ kriyāniṣpattistatprakṛṣṭam| uktaṃ ca-- kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpattiḥ yadvyāpārādanantaram| vivakṣyate yadā yatra karaṇaṃ tattadā smṛtam|| iti| vivakṣyate ityanena sthālyādīnāmapi vaivakṣikakaraṇatvamastīti dhvanayati| āha ca-- vastutastadanirdeśyaṃ na hi vastu vyavasthitam| sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vivakṣā dṛśyate yataḥ|| iti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ- kārakatvaṃ tadvyāpyakartṛtvādiṣaṭkaṃ ca vastuviśeṣe viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavanna vyavatiṣṭhate| na hi gaussarvaṃ prati gaureva na tu kiṃcitpratyagauritivad viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇameveti suvacam| tathā ca kayācid dhātuvyaktyā upasthāpite'rthe kiṃ kartrādikamiti praśne prakṛtavyaktyupāttavyāpārāśrayatayā vivakṣitaḥ kartā, vyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalāśrayaḥ karma, kartṛkarmadvārakasambandhenāśrayo'dhikaraṇam| pacyartho vyāpāraścānekadhā| evaṃ ca paceradhiśrayaṇataṇḍulāvapanaidhopakarṣaṇāditātparyakatve tadāśrayo devadattaḥ kartā, jvalanatātparyakatve edhāḥ kartāraḥ, taṇḍuladhāraṇādiparatve sthālī kartrī, avayavavibhāgādiparatve taṇḍulāḥ kartāraḥ| sthālyā pacatītyatra tṛtīyopāttavyāpārāśrayā'pi sthālī karaṇameva, na tu kartrī, devadattādivyāpārasyaiva taddhātūpāttatvāt| tathā--ādikhādibhyāmupātte'rthe prayojyaḥ kartā| tasminnevārthe bhakṣayatinopātte karma| adhipūrvaiḥ śīṅādibhirupātte'rthe ādhāraḥ karma, kevalairupātte adhikaraṇamityādi| etena jñānasya svaprakāśatve kartṛkarmavirodha ityādi parāstam, śabdaviśeṣopādhikasya kartṛtvādeḥ pratyakṣādau uktisambhavābhāvāt| etena parasamavetakriyājanyaphalaśālitvaṃ karmatvaṃ ced apādāne'tivyāptimāśaṅkya dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśāli karmeti pariṣkurvanto'pi pratyuktāḥ, grāmaṃ gamayati devadattamityādau gantaryavyāpteḥ| tanmate gamanasya prakṛtyarthatve'pi tattvānavacchedakatvāt| tatra ṇico vyāpārārthakatvaṃ na prakṛteḥ| tattve vā pācayatyādiprayojyakartaryativyāpteḥ| pāribhāṣikamanuśāsanopayogi karmatvaṃ vacanabalāt vyavasthitamiti ced? apādāne'pi tarhi tannāstītyavadhehi, ekasaṃjñādhikāre'navakāśayā sāvakāśāyā bādhāt| ata eva "ātmānamātmanā hanti' ityādau parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā karmasaṃjñābādhamāśaṅkyāhaṅkārādiviśiṣṭātmabhedamāśritya samāhitaṃ bhāṣye| rāmeṇeti| iha yadyapi vibhaktyupasthitānāṃ kārakāṇāṃ kriyāṃ prati viśeṣaṇataiva tathā'pi kṛdupasthitānāṃ viśeṣyataiva, 'sattvapradhānāni nāmāni" ityukteḥ| dhātūpasthāpyayoḥ phalavyāpārayorapi karmakṛtsamabhivyāhāre viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsaḥ| tathā ca rāmamiṣṭho yo vyāpārastadviṣayībhūtabāṇavyāpārasādhyaprāṇaviyogāśrayo vālīti vākyārthaḥ| yattu vājapeyādhikaraṇe mīmāṃsakairuktaṃ--"kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ' ityapi syāditi, tadiṣṭāpattigrastam| "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam" "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti" ityādisūtrāṇāṃ kṛtprakṛtyarthena kārakānvayaṃ vinoktisaṃbhavasyaivābhāvāditi sudhībhirākalanīyam| anabhihite kim ? hariḥ karoti| jīvantyanena jīvanaḥ| śābdikaḥ| "śabdarduraṃ karoti" iti ṭhak| kṛtaṃ viśvaṃ yena kṛtaviviśvāḥ, viśvakarmakakṛtyāśraya ityarthaḥ; aṣaṣṭhyarthabahuvrīhau vyutpattyantarasvīkārāt| yathā caitattathā vakṣyate| prakṛtyādibhya iti| ākṛtigaṇo'yam| tena "nāmnā sutīkṣṇaścaritena dāntaḥ' ityādi bodhyam| dvayordroṇayoḥ samāhāro dvidroṇam| pātrāditvātstrītvābhāvaḥ| droṇadvayasambandhi dhānyamityarthaḥ| cāditi| karaṇaśabdānuvṛttyā "parikrayaṇe sampradānam" ityuttarasūtrasthānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇāpakarṣaṇena vā saṃjñayoḥ paryāye labdhe samāveśārthaścakāraḥ| tena "manasādevaḥ' ityatra karmaṇyaṇ, karaṇe tṛtīyā cetyubhayaṃ siddhyati| "manasaḥ saṃjñāyām" ityaluk| kiṃ cākṣairdevayate yajñadattenetyatra sakarmakatvādaṇi karturṇau karmatvaṃ na, "aṇāvakarmakāt" iti parasmaipadaṃ ca neti siddhāntaḥ| yattu prācā karmasaṃjñaṃ vā syāditi vyākhyātam, tadākaravirodhādupekṣyam| syādetat, karaṇasaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ devanā akṣāḥ, karaṇe lyuṭ| karmasaṃjñāyāstu- dīvyante akṣāḥ, karmaṇi laṭ| "akṣairdīvyati' ityatra saṃjñādvayaprayuktakāryadvayaprasaṅge paratvāt tṛtīyaiva syānna tu dvitīyeti cet? atrāhuḥ- kāryakālapakṣe "karmaṇi dvitīyā" ityatra yadasyopasthānaṃ tasyānavakāśatvād dvitīyeti| nanu "dīvyante akṣāḥ' ityatra karmaṇyabhihite'pi karaṇatvasyānabhidhānāt tṛtīyā syāt tathā "devanā akṣāḥ' ityatra lyuṭā karaṇasyābhidhāne'pi karmaṇo'nabhidhānāt dvitīyā syāt? maivam, ekaiva hyatra śaktiḥ saṃjñādvayopayoginī| tathā ca ubhayatrāpyabhidhānameva na tvanabhihitatvam| sahayukte-- putreṇeti | pituratra kriyāsaṃbandhaḥ śābdaḥ, putrasya tu ārtha iti tasyāprādhānyam| apradhānagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| na caivaṃ piturapi tṛtīyāpattiḥ| tatra prātipadikarthamātre antaraṅgatvātprathamotpatteḥ| "piturāgamanam' ityādau kārakavibhakteḥ prābalyācca| yenāṅgavikāraḥ aṅgaśabdo'rśaādyajantastadāha-- aṅgina iti| yeneti sarvanāmnā prakṛtyarthabhūto'vayava eva gṛhyate, sannidhānāt| sa cārthād vikṛta eva, na hyavikṛtenāvayavena śarīrasya vikāraḥ saṃbhavati| tadetadāha-- yenāṅgena vikṛteneti| saṃjānīta iti| "sampratibhyāmanādhyāne" iti taṅ| kṛdyoge paratvāt ṣaṣṭhī pituḥ saṃjñātā| yattu haradattenoktam- ādhyāne paratvād "adhīgartha" iti ṣaṣṭhī "mātuḥ saṃjānāti' iti; tanna, tatra śeṣādhikārāt| dravyādīti| uktaṃ ca-- dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ, karaṇaṃ niyatakriyam|| iti| anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimittaṃ heturiṣyate || iti ca| phalamapīti| etacca "pratyaya' iti sūtre kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam| evaṃ ca tādarthyacaturthyā saheyaṃ tṛtīyā vikalpyate| adhyayanāya vasati| ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ--adhyayanasya phalena sahābhedaḥ saṃsargaḥ, upakārakatvena saha tu nirūpakateti| gamyamāneti| na tu śrūyamāṇaivetyāgraha iti bhāvaḥ| sādhaneti| sādhyamityatra prakṛtibhāgasyārthaṃ pratīti bhāvaḥ| "mā cāpalāyeti gaṇān vyanaiṣīt' ityatra tu yatadhvamiti śeṣaḥ| aśiṣṭeti| etacca "dāṇaśca sā ceccaturthyarthe' ityanena jñāpyate|| || iti tṛtīyā|| anvarthasaṃjñābalenāha- dānasyeti| tena "ajāṃ nayati grāmam' "hastaṃ nidadhāti vṛkṣe' ityādau nātiprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| dānaṃ cāpunargrahaṇāya svasvatvanivṛttipūrvakaṃ parasvatvotpādanam| ata eva "rajakasya vastraṃ dadāti' ityādau na bhavati; tatra hi dadātirbhāktaḥ| etacca vṛttikṛnmatam| bhāṣyamate tu nānvarthatāyāmāgrahaḥ, "khaṇḍikopādhyāyaḥ śiṣyāya capeṭāṃ dadāti' iti prayogāt| "rajakasya vastraṃ dadāti' iti tu śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ bodhyam| na caivam "ajāṃ nayati grāmam' ityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ "yamabhipraiti' ityuktyā hi yamiti nirdiṣṭasya śeṣitvaṃ, karmaṇaśca śeṣatvaṃ labhyate| grāmasya ajāṃ prati śeṣitvaṃ nāsti| dānīya iti| bāhulakāt sampradāne anīyar| rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ prīñ tarpaṇe| asmāt karmaṇi laṭ| haraye rocate iti| karmasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| prīyamāṇaḥ kimॽ devadattāya rocate modakaḥ pathi| atra patho mā bhūt| ślāghahnuṅ-- ślāghā stutiḥ| kṛṣṇāya ślāghate| kṛṣṇaṃ stautītyarthaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ--kṛṣṇāyātmānaṃ paraṃ vā ślāghyaṃ kathayatītyartha iti| tatrādye pakṣe karmatve prāpte, dvitīye tu kārakaśeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| hanute iti| sapatnībhyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ hnuvānā tamevārthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bodhayatītyarthaḥ| yasya kasyacit hnute iti vā| tiṣṭhate iti| sthityā svābhiprāyaṃ bodhayatītyarthaḥ| "prakāśana-stheyākhyayośca" iti taṅ| dhāreruttamarṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| spṛherīpsitaḥ-- paratvāditi| tena "paraspareṇa spṛhaṇīyaśobham' "spṛhaṇīyaguṇairmahātmabhiḥ' ityādi siddham| yadā tu śeṣatvavivakṣā tadā ṣaṣṭhī| tena -- "kumārya iva kāntasya trasyanti spṛhayanti ca'| iti siddham| etacca sarvaṃ haradattādirītyoktam| vākyapadīyahelārājagranthayostu "spṛhayatiyoge karmasaṃjñāyāḥ śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāśca bādhikeyaṃ sampradānasaṃjñā iti sthitam| tanmate spṛhaṇīyamityatra dānīya itivat sampradāne kṛtyaḥ| kumārya ivetyatra tu vibhaktivipariṇāmena kāntāya spṛhayantīti vyākhyeyam| krudhadruha-- krudha kope, druha drohe, īrṣya īrṣyāyām| asūyeti kaṇḍvādiyagantaḥ| eṣāmartha ivārtho yeṣāṃ dhātūnāmityarthaḥ| tatra krodho'marṣaḥ, droho'pakāraḥ, īrṣyā asahanam, asūyā tu guṇeṣu doṣāropaḥ| krudhadruhorakarmakatvāttadyoge ṣaṣṭhī prāptā, anyayoḥ sakarmakatvād dvitīyā prāptā| rādhīkṣyoḥ kārakamiti| karmakārakamiti tu prācaḥ pramādaḥ, ekasaṃjñādhikārāt| na ca prāthamikaprāptimātrābhiprāyeṇa karmatvavyapadeśaḥ, kṛṣṇasambandhi śubhāśubhaṃ paryālocayatītyarthābhyupagamena ṣaṣṭhyā eva prāpteḥ| anuprati-- gṛṇa iti śnāntasyānukaraṇāt ṣaṣṭhī| hotre iti| karmatve prāpte| parikrayaṇe krayo-- dhanādyarpaṇenā''tyantikasvīkaraṇam, tasya samīpaṃ pariśabda ācaṣṭe| tacca niyatakālaṃ tato nyūnatvāditi vyācaṣṭe-- niyateti| bhṛtyā-- vetanādinā| tādarthye iti| tasmai kāryāyedaṃ tadartham-- kāraṇam, tasya bhāvastādarthyam| ṣyañā upakārakatvarūpaḥ sambandho'bhidhīyate, "kṛttaddhitasamāsebhyaḥ sambandhābhimānaṃ bhāvapratyayena' iti siddhāntāt| upakārakatvaṃ cānekadhā| tena brāhmaṇāya dadhītyādāvapi bhavati| bhaktirjñānāyeti| jñānātmanā pariṇamata ityarthaḥ| prakṛtivikṛtyorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ vikṛtivācakāccaturthī, abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu paratvātprathamaiva, bhaktirjñānaṃ kalpata iti| yadā tu "janikartuḥ" iti bhakterapādānatvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā jñānasyābhihitakartṛtvātprathamaiva, bhakterjñānaṃ kalpate| "klṛpī'tyarthagrahaṇamityāśayenāha-- sampadyata ityādi| utpāteneti| prāṇināṃ śubhāśubhasūcako bhūtavikāra utpātaḥ, tena jñāpite'rthe vartamānācturthītyarthaḥ| vātāyeti| vātasya jñāpiketyarthaḥ| hiteti| samāsavidhānājjñāpakāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ sukhayoge'pi bodhyam| "tumunṇvulau kriyāyām" iti sūtramahimnā kriyārthakamupapadaṃ kriyāvācyeva phalatītyāśayenāha- kriyeti| kriyāphalakaṃ kriyāvācakaprakṛtikamityarthaḥ| "tumun' iti ṇvulo'pyupalakṣaṇam| phalebhyo yātītyasya phalānyāharaka ityapi vivaraṇe bādhakābhāvāt| karmaṇīti| tathā ca dvitīyāpavādo'yamiti bhāvaḥ| yattu prācā vyākhyātamaprayujyamānasyaiva karmaṇi yathā syāt, prayujyamānasya mā bhūditi niyamāya sūtramiti, tanna, aprāptasya niyamāyogāt| na ca "tādarthya' iti prāptiḥ| na hi phalārthā yānakriyā, kiṃ tvāharaṇārthā| āharaṇaṃ tu phalakarmakamityanyadetat| tumuno bhāva eva vidhānāttadarthasya bhāvavacanatve siddhe punarbhāvavacanagrahaṇaṃ sūtraviśeṣaparigrahārthamityāha- iti sūtreṇeti| na ca tādarthye ityeva gatārthatā śaṅkyā, bhāvavacanenaiva tumuneva tādarthyasya dyotitatayā prātipadikārthamātre prathamāprasaṅgāt| yattu prācoktam-- bhāvavacanādeva yathā syāt, pācako vrajatīti ṇvulantāt mā bhūditi niyamārthamidaṃ sūtramiti; tanna, ṇvulante kartuḥ prādhānyāt kartāraṃ prati ca tādarthyābhāvāt, guṇībhūtayānasya ca vibhaktyarthānanvayāt| nanu ṣaṣṭhyapīti kutaḥॽ ṣaṣṭhyevāstu, alaṃśabdastu paryāptītarārthaka eva gṛhyatāmityāśaṅkyāha-- tasmai prabhavatīti| na tvāṃ tṛṇamityādi| nanu tṛṇādivad yuṣmacchabdādapi pakṣe caturthyā bhāvyam| maivam, "anādare' iti hi karmaṇo viśeṣaṇam-- anādaradyotakaṃ yatkarmeti| tādṛśaṃ tṛṇameva na tu yuṣmadarthaḥ| || iti caturthī| dhruvamiti| dhru gatisthairyayoḥ, asmātkuṭādeḥ pacādyac| dhruva sthairye iti pāṭhe tu igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ| dhruvaṃ--sthiram, prakṛtadhātūpāttagatyanāviṣṭatve sati tajjanyavibhāgāśrayaḥ| taccārthādavadherevetyāha-- avadhibhūtamiti| dhāvata iti| iha kriyāviśiṣṭasyāpyaśvāsya prakṛtadhātūpāttakriyāṃ pratyavadhitvaṃ na viruddhyate | "parasparasmānmeṣāvapasarataḥ' ityatra tu sṛdhātunā gatidvayasyāpyupādānād ekaniṣṭhāṃ gatiṃ pratītarasyāpādānatvaṃ na virudhyate| uktaṃ ca-- apāye yadudāsīnaṃ calaṃ vā yadi vā'calam| dhruvamevātadāveśāttadapādānamucyate|| patato dhruva evāśvo yasmādaśvātpatatyasau| tasyāpyaśvāsya patane kuḍyādi dhruvamiṣyate|| meṣāntarakriyāpekṣamavadhitvaṃ pṛthak pṛthak| meṣayoḥ svakriyāpekṣaṃ kartṛtvaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak|| iti| parvatātpatato'śvātpatatītyatra tu parvatāvadhikapatanāśrayo'śvastadavadhikaṃ devadattādiniṣṭhapatanamityarthaḥ| pañcamyarthe'vadhau abhedena saṃsargeṇa prakṛtyartho viśeṣaṇam, pratyayārthastu
