kriyāyāṃ, sa ca dharmī na tu dharmamātram, vibhaktyarthe vihitasya bahuvrīherdharmiparatāyā nirvivādatvāt| uddhṛtaudanā sthālītyatra hi odanakarmakoddharaṇāvadhibhūtetyarthaḥ| jugupseti| bhāṣyakārastu jugupsādīnāṃ tatpūrvakanivṛttilakṣakatāmāśritya sūtreṇa tatsiddhimāhuḥ| evamuttarasūtreṣvapi | bhītrā-- kathaṃ tarhi-- "kasya bibhyati devāśca jātaroṣasya saṃyuge" iti rāmāyaṇam? atrāhuḥ- kasya saṃyuge iti | na caivaṃ saṃyugasyaivāpādānasañjñāpattiḥ, parayā'dhikaraṇasaṃjñayā bādhāt| adhikaraṇatvāvivakṣāyāṃ tviṣṭāpattiḥ| adhyayanāditi| adhyayanasambandhinī glānirityarthaḥ| janikartuḥ-- jananaṃ janirutpattiḥ| "iñajādibhyaḥ' iti janerbhāve iñ, "janighasibhyāmiṇ' ityuṇādisūtreṇa iṇ vā| "janivadhyośca" iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| tasyāḥ karteti śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ| tathā ca dhātvantarayoge'pi bhavati| "aṅgādaṅgātsambhavasi' iti yathā| tadetadāha- jāyamānasyeti| etena "ikśtipau dhātunirdeśe' iti ikā nirdeśo'yamityāśritya "gamahana" ityupadhālopaprasaṅgamarthāsaṅgatiṃ samāsānupapattiṃ codbhāvayanto mīmāṃsāvārtikakārāḥ samāhitā iti bhāvaḥ| iha sūtre prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ hetumātraparamiti vṛttikṛnmatam, "putrātpramodo jāyate" ityudāharaṇam| upādānamātraparamiti tu bhāṣyakaiyaṭamatam| tadubhayasādhāraṇamudāharaṇamāha-- brahmaṇa iti| brahmā- hiraṇyagarbhaḥ| sa ca hetureva, na tūpādānam| kiṃ ca brahma- māyāśabalam, taddhi sarvakāryopādānamiti vedāntasiddhāntaḥ| bhuvaḥ bhavanaṃ bhūriti| sampadāditvādbhāve kvip| pūrvasūtre samāsanirdiṣṭamapi kartṛgrahaṇamanuvartate, svaritatvādityāha-- bhūkarturiti| prabhavatyasmāditi prabhavaḥ| lyablopa iti| lyabantasya gamyamānārthakatvādaprayoge ityarthaḥ| yataśceti| yadavadhitvenāśrityādhvanaḥ kālasya vā nirmāṇaṃ paricchedaḥ pratipādyate tasmādityarthaḥ| tena pañcamyantārthenā'rthadvārā prayuktānnirmīyamāṇā'dhvavācinaḥ prathamāsaptamyau staḥ| kālāditi| tadyuktādityapekṣyate| prapañcārthamiti| na ca "itarastvanyanīcayoḥ" ityamarokternīcārthakasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti vācyam, "asmāttāro mandro vā" ityādāviva "pañcamī vibhakte' ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| yattu itara iti nirdiśyamānapratiyogika eva prayujyate | tadyathā-- caitraḥ śūraḥ, itaraḥ kātara iti| ato nāyamanyārtha iti; tanmandam, pratiyogyā''kāṅkṣāyā ubhayatra tulyatvāt udāhṛtakośavirodhācca| ṛte kṛṣṇāditi| kathantarhi "puruṣārādhanamṛte' iti? pramādo'yamityeke| anye tu "ubhasarvatasoḥ' ityatra dṛśigrahaṇāt "caitraṃ yāvacchītam' ityādāviva ṛteyoge dvitīyāpi sādhurityāhuḥ| yuktaṃ caitat, "ṛte dvitīyā ca' iti cāndrasūtrāt| prabhṛtyarthayoga iti| prabhṛtyarthairyoga ityarthaḥ| tathā ca "kārtikyāḥ prabhṛti" iti bhāṣyaṃ vivṛṇvan kaiyaṭaḥ prāyuṅkta-- tata ārabhyetyarthaḥ iti| vacanagrahaṇāditi| sāmarthyādavadhimātraṃ vivakṣyate| tena vineti viśeṣaṇāṃśastu neti bhāvaḥ| yadvā-- maryādeti śabda ucyate'smiṃstanmaryādāvacanam-- "āṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ" iti sūtram, tatra ya āṅ dṛṣṭaḥ sa uktasaṃjña ityarthaḥ| pari hareriti| "parervarjane vā vacanam' itivārtikātpakṣe dvirvacanābhāvaḥ| pariratreti| atra pañcamīvidhau varjanārthenāpena sāhacaryāditi bhāvaḥ| pratinidhipratidāne ca-- asmādeva nirdeśādābhyāṃ yoge pañcamītyāhuḥ| mukhyasyā'bhāve tatsadṛśa upādīyate sa pratinidhiḥ| dattasya pratiniryātanaṃ pratidānam| akartari-- pañcamī syāditi| tṛtīyāpavādo'yam| śateneti| śatamiha uttamarṇāya dhāryamāṇatvādṛṇam| "tatprayojako hetuśca" iti cakāreṇa kartṛsaṃjñā ca| yogavibhāgāditi| etacca "hetumanuṣyebhya" iti sūtre haradattagranthe spaṣṭam| striyāṃ ceti| "bāhulakaṃ prakṛtestanudṛṣṭeḥ' iti vārtikanirdeśo'pīha jñāpakaḥ| pṛthagvinā-- samuccayārthamiti| nipātānāmanekārthatvāditi bhāvaḥ| pañcamīti| tatra maṇḍūkaplutyā pañcamī| dvitīyā tu sannihitaiva| dūraṃ, dūrāt, dūreṇa veti| iha saptamyapi vakṣyate| kiṃ ca "dūrāntikārthebhya" iti sūtrasyottaratrāpyanuvartanādadhikaraṇe'pyebhyo vibhakticatuṣṭayaṃ bodhyam| tathā ca prayujyate--"dūrādāvasathānmūtram' iti| āvasathasya dūre ityarthaḥ| asattveti| sattvavacanatvaṃ ca tadviśeṣyakatvam| evaṃ ca sāmānādhikaraṇyena prātipadikārthaviśeṣyakaṃ vyudasyate| tadāha- dūraḥ panthāḥ iti| etena "karaṇe ca stoka" iti sūtre "karaṇe kimॽ kriyāviśeṣaṇe karmaṇi mā bhūt-- stokaṃ pacati, kriyā na dravyam' iti prācāṃ grantho vyākhyātaḥ| yattu-- tamanūdya kriyāyā viśeṣyatvena dravyatvā'vaśyambhāvāccintyamityūcustadeva cintyam, dhātuvācyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ asattvarūpasyā''kare prasiddhatvāt| na ca viśeṣyatve tadanupapattiḥ, kṛdabhihitabhāvavalliṅgasaṅkhyādyayogitvamātreṇa tadupapatteḥ| yadyapi "hataśāyikāḥ śayyante' ityādau bhāṣye saṃkhyānvayaḥ svīkṛtaḥ, "pacati bhavati' ityādau kartṛtvakarmatvānvayaśca, tathāpi liṅgasya kārakāntarasya cā'bhāvo nirbādha eva| uktaṃ ca-- kriyā na yujyate liṅgakriyānādhārakārakaiḥ| asattvarūpatā tasyā iyamevāvadhāryatām|| || iti pañcamī|| rājña puruṣa iti| pratyayārthasya prakṛtyarthaṃ prati prādhānyādapradhānādeva ṣaṣṭhī, tadarthaśca puruṣe viśeṣaṇam| prādhānāttu na ṣaṣṭhī, uktanyāyavirodhāt, śeṣābhāvācca| puruṣaśabdo hi yathāyathaṃ prātipadikārthamātravṛttiḥ, kārakārthako vā| yadā tu naivaṃ tadā puruṣaśabdāpi ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeva| yattvapradhānaṃ śeṣa iti, tanna, pratipadikārthamātre śuklo ghaṭa ityādau viśeṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgāt| na ca prathamāyā bādhaḥ, tasyāḥ prādhānye caritārthatvāt| karmādīnāmapīti| yathā viśeṣāvivakṣāyāṃ rūpavānitīti, tadvivakṣāyāṃ tu nīlaḥ, pītaḥ ityādi prayujyate tathedamapi nyāyasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ| satāmiti| evaṃ ca "napuṃsake bhāve ktasya yoge śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ce"ti "tṛptyarthānāṃ karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī ve"ti ca prācāṃ granthe paṭhyamānaṃ nāpūrvaṃ vacanamiti bhāvaḥ| sarpiṣa iti| jño'vidarthasya karaṇe, adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi, kṛñaḥ pratiyatne, rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvareḥ, āśiṣi nāthaḥ, jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām, vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ, kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe ityaṣṭasūtrī tu neha vyākhyātā, tasyāḥ samāsanivṛttiphalakatvāt| tathā hi- tatra śeṣa ityanuvartate| śeṣatvena vivakṣite ca karaṇādau ṣaṣṭhī siddhaiva| tadayamarthaḥ| iha ṣaṣṭhyeva na tu talluk| tathā ca lukaḥ prayojakībhūtaḥ samāsa eva neti| tathā ca vārtikam- pratipadavidhānā cetyādi| hariścāha- kārakairvyapadiṣṭaṃ ca śrūyamāṇakriye punaḥ| proktā pratipadaṃ ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya nivṛttaye|| iti| tena śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ sarpiṣo jñānaṃ, mātuḥ smaraṇamityādīnyasamastānyeva sādhūni| harismaraṇamityādīni tu śeṣatvāvivakṣāyāṃ kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhyā samāse bodhyāni| tatra ca kārakapūrvakatvāt kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, śeṣaṣṭhyā samāse tvantodātattvaṃ syāttaccāniṣṭam| tathā ca svarārtheyamaṣṭasūtrīti paramaniṣkarṣaḥ| kiṃ ca mātuḥ smṛtamityādau samāsābhāvo'pi phalam| na hi tatra kārakaṣaṣṭhī labhyate, "na loke"ti niṣedhāt| āha ca- niṣṭhāyāṃ karmaviṣayā ṣaṣṭhī ca pratiṣidhyate| śeṣalakṣaṇayā ṣaṣṭhyā samāsastatra neṣyate|| iti| evaṃ sthite vṛttyādigrantheṣu iha prakaraṇe udāharaṇaṃ, pratyudāharaṇaṃ ca yadyat tiṅantaṃ tat sarvamupalakṣaṇatayā neyamiti haradattādayaḥ| sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca iha sarvanāmna iti ṣaṣṭhī, tadāha- sarvanāmnaḥ prayoge iti| pañcamyāṃ tu hetuśabdāt ṣaṣṭhītṛtīye na syātāmiti bhāvaḥ| nimittaparyāyeti| paryāyagrahaṇasya phalamudāharati-- evamityādinā| prācā tu "kimartham' ityudāhṛtam| tatra kimaḥ klībatvaṃ durlabham| sāmānye napuṃsakatāṃ, samāsaṃ cāśritya kathaṃcidvā neyam| asarvanāmna iti| "nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam' iti vārtikaṃ hi vṛttikāreṇa yadyapīhoktaṃ, tathā'pi bhāṣyakṛtā "hetau" ityatra paṭhitam| tena sarvanāmā'prayoge api pravartate| kiṃ tu prāyagrahaṇāttatra tṛtīyādaya evetyarthaḥ| vardhamānastu prathamāmapīcchati| ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena pañcamyā iti| kathaṃ tarhi tataḥ paścāditi| tataḥ paścāt sraṃsyate, dhvaṃsyate ceti bhāṣyaprayogāt paścād yoge pañcamyapi| pratyayagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam| enapā dvitīyā kathaṃ tarhi "tatrāgāraṃ dhanapatigṛhāduttareṇāsmadīyam' iti? uttareṇeti tṛtīyāntatoraṇenetyanena samānādhikaraṇaṃ boddhyam| dūrāntikārthaiḥ anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ samuccayārtham| tena ca viprakṛṣṭāpi pañcamī samuccīyate vyākhyānāt, na tu ṣaṣṭhīdvitīyātṛtīyāḥ| tadetadāha-- pañcamī ceti| divastadarthasya tacchabdena vyavahṛpaṇau parāmṛśyete, tau ca dyūte, krayavikrayavyavahāre ca tulyārthau pūrvasūtre gṛhītau, ityāśayenāha-- dyūte iti| karmaṇīti| iha "śeṣe' iti na sambadhyate uttarasūtradvayārambhāditi bhāvaḥ| ata eveha trisūtryā tiṅantamudāharati-- śatasya dīvyatīti| preṣyabruvoḥ-- iṣyaterdaivādikasya gatyarthasya loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanaṃ "preṣya' iti, tatsāhacaryāt bruvirapi tathābhūta eva gṛhyate| ata eveha śeṣagrahaṇaṃ na sambadhyate tiṅantena saha samāsasyā'prasaktatvāt| kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti guṇeti| taduktam-- pradhāne niyatā ṣaṣṭhī guṇe tūbhayathā bhavet|| iti| kṛtapūrvīti| kṛtaṃ pūrvamaneneti vigrahaḥ| pūrvaṃ kṛtavānityarthaḥ| avivakṣitakarmakatayā bhāve ktaḥ| "supsupā" iti samāsaḥ| "pūrvādiniḥ" "sapūrvācca" iti kartari iniḥ| tadvidhau "śrāddhamanena" iti sūtrādanenetyanuvṛtteḥ| atha kathaṃ "dhāyairāmodamuttamam" iti bhaṭṭiḥ ? atrāhuḥ-- anityamidam, "tadarham" iti nirdeśāt| strīpratyayayoriti| kathaṃ tarhi "suṭtithoḥ" iti sūtre "suṭā siyuṭo bādho na' iti vṛttiḥ| karaṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīyeti gṛhāṇa| na lokāvyayaniṣṭhā-- uśca ukaśca ūkau, laśca ūkau ceti vigrahaḥ| ukāreṇa kṛto viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhistadāha- hariṃ didṛkṣuralaṃkariṣṇurveti| śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī tviti| etena "ikṣvākūṇāṃ durāpe'rthe tvadadhīnā hi siddhayaḥ' "api vāgadhipasya durvacaṃ vacanaṃ tadvidadhīta vismayam' ityādi vyākhyātam| yadvā ikṣvākūṇāṃ siddhaya ityanvayo na tu ikṣvākūṇāṃ durāpa iti| tathā vāgadhipasya vismayamityanvayo na tu vāgadhipasya durvacamiti| tulyārthaiḥ kathaṃ tarhi "tulāṃ yadārohati dantavāsasā' iti kālidāsaḥ, "sphuṭopamaṃ bhūtisitena śambhunā" iti māghaśca? ucyate, "sahayukte'pradhāne" iti tṛtīyā| "svabālabhārasya taduttamāṅgajaiḥ samaṃ camaryeva tulābhilāṣiṇaḥ' ityatra yathā| uktaṃ hi-- vināpi tadyogaṃ tṛtīyeti| vyākhyānāditi| sūtre'rthaśabdo'pi pṛthaṅnimittam| tathā ca dvandva eva| na tu arthaśabdena bahuvrīhiriti bhāvaḥ| || iti ṣaṣṭhī || ādhārastridheti| etacca "saṃhitāyām" iti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam| catasra iti| prātipadikārthamātra iti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca "dūrāntika" iti sūtrasya ihāpyanuvartanādadhikaraṇe'pyetā bodhyāḥ| ktasyeti| in- innantaḥ śabdo viṣayo- vṛttibhūmiryasya ktasyetyarthaḥ| hetau tṛtīyeti| tādarthye caturthītyapi boddhyam| sīmetyādi| etacca durgavākyaprabodhe kulacandreṇoktam| medinīkāro'pyāha-- sīmā ghāṭasthitikṣetreṣvaṇḍakośeṣu ca striyām| iti| atha puṣkalako gandhamṛge kṣapaṇakīlayoḥ|| iti ca| haradattādayastu puṣkalakaḥ- śaṅkuḥ, sīmni- sīmajñānārthaṃ, hato- nihato nikhāta ityāhuḥ| yasya ca-- nirjñātakālā kriyā anirjñātakālāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kālaparicchedakatvāllakṣaṇam| tadāśrayayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇorbodhakādiyaṃ saptamī| tatra brāhmaṇeṣvadhīyāneṣu gata iti kartaryudāharaṇam| karmaṇyāha-- goṣviti| iha adhīyānānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ duhyamānānāṃ gavāṃ ca pratīyamānalakṣakatvaṃ viśeṣaṇībhūtayoradhyayanagodohanakriyayorviśrāmyati| bheda eveti| na tu śabdāntaropāttasāmānyarūpākrāntateti bhāvaḥ| māthurā iti| na hyatra gavāṃ kṛṣṇetyādāviva sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ, kiṃ tu śabdopāttayordharmayorvirodha eva| nipuṇo rājña iti| sādhuśabdaprayoge tvarcāṃ vinā'pi saptamī bhavatyeva, "sādhvasādhuprayoge ca" iti vārtikāt| prasita iti| tatpare prasitāsaktāvityamaraḥ| mūleneti| "nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ" ityaṇo "lubaviśeṣe" iti lup| paryāyeṇeti| īśvaraśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ| yasya svāmina īśvaratvamucyate ityekaṃ vyākhyānam| yasyeti svaṃ nirdiśyate| yasya svasya īśvara ucyate ityaparam| evaṃ ca vyākhyābhedātparyāyeṇa vibhaktiḥ| sā ca viśeṣaṇāt ṣaṣṭhīvaditi bhāvaḥ| || iti saptamī|| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāṃ kārakaprakaraṇam|| || atha avyayībhāvasamāsaprakaṇam|| samarthāśrita iti| sūtre samarthaśabdo lākṣaṇika iti bhāvaḥ| katipayeti| yadyapi udāttavatā, gatimatā ca tiṅā gateḥ samāso nityādhikāre vārtikakṛtoktastathā'pi nāsau niyataḥ, "ya ānayat" "abhiprabharadhṛṣate" ityādau samāsādarśanāt| ata eva bhāṣyakṛtā "saha" iti yogavibhāgenā'yaṃ sādhitaḥ| yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyamiti bhāvaḥ| sa ceti| etadapi yogavibhāgasyeṣṭasiddhyarthatvādeva labhyate| etacca sampradānasaṃjñāsūtre padamañjaryāṃ spaṣṭam| yadi hi loke'pi syāt tarhi "abhipraiti" ityādau samāsātsvādayaḥ syuḥ, pacatikalpamityādau taddhitāntādyathā| na ca liṅgasarvanāmanapuṃsakatā'bhyupagamena nirvāhaḥ, "prakurute" ityādau hrasvāpatteḥ, "prakurvīran" ityatra nalopāpatteśca| nirdeśāditi| anyathā hi prathamānirdiṣṭatvā'viśeṣe'pi upasarjanasaṃjñāyā anvarthatvena pūrvaśabdasyaiva pūrvanipātaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| iveneti| ayamapi samāsaḥ pūrvavatkvācitka eva| tena "jīmūtasyeva" ityādau taittirīyāṇāṃ pṛthakpadatvena pāṭhaḥ "udbāhuriva vāmanaḥ" ityādau vyastaprayogo'pi saṅgacchate| gostriyorupasarjanasya upasarjanaṃ ya iti| yattu prācā-- go'nta-strīpratyayāntayorupasarjanayorityuktam; tanna, citragurityādau gośabdasyopasarjanatve'pi tadantasyāthātvād, gaurīpatirityādau atiprasaṅgācca| kathaṃ sugokulaṃ rājakumārīputra iti cet? śṛṇu, upasarjanasya sasambandhikatayā yasya prātipadikasya hrasvo vidhīyate tadarthaṃ prati uttarapadabhūtayorguṇībhāvastadaiva hrasvatvam| diśayoriti| diśoriti halantena vigrahe'pyetadeva rūpam| diśśabdasya śaradāditvāṭṭac| vacanasāmarthyāditi| vibhaktītyanena hi yena subantena saha samāsastadghaṭakībhūtaiva vibhaktirgṛhyate, sannidhānāt| tadarthadyotakaścā'dhiriti bhāvaḥ| pariśiṣṭe tu prathamāntenāyaṃ samāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantena vetyapi pakṣadvayaṃ sthitam| yattu prācoktam-- harau adhikṛtyeti vigrahe harāvadhīti sthite iti; tanna, nityasamāsatvena vigrahāyogāt| yadāhuḥ--"avigraho nityasamāsaḥ" iti| nanvasvapadavigraho'pi svīkriyate kumbhaṃ karotīti yathā, ayamapi tathā'stu, adhikṛtyeti lyabantasya samāsāpraviṣṭasya sattvāditi cet? na, samāsārthaleśamapi abodhayatastasya vigrahe praveśasyaivāsaṃbhavāt| yattu vyācakhyuḥ-- vigraha iva vigrahaḥ arthakathanamātram| tenāvigrahatvānnityasamāsatvamaviruddham| ata eva samāsaprakṛtibhūtamalaukikaṃ vākyāntaraṃ darśayati-- harau adhīti sthita itīti| atredaṃ vaktavyam--vigraha ivetyasaṅgatam, arthakathanavākyasyaiva vigrahatvena tato bhedābhāvāt| arthakathanamātramityapi na, lyabantena samāsārthā'saṃsparśāt| yacca harau adhīti alaukikamityuktam; tadapi na, tatra hari ṅi ityasyaiva praveśāt, "antaraṅgānapi" iti nyāyāt| anyathā samāse hariśabdekārasya durlabhatvāpatteśca| yadapi vyācakhyuḥ-- alaukikatvādevā'dhiśabdenā'bhihite'pi saptamī, anyathā sā na syāt anabhihitādhikārāditi; tadapyāpātataḥ, alaukikatvaṃ hi "nityavidhyantaraprāptiviṣayatvenā'pariniṣṭhitatvam" na tvetāvanmātreṇā'nanuśiṣṭāyāḥ saptamyāstatra praveśaḥ sūpapādaḥ, atiprasaṅgāt| yattu tatpautreṇa vyākhyātam-- tiṅkṛttaddhitasamāsairiti parigaṇanādadhinā'bhihite'pi saptamīti, tanna, parigaṇanasyākare pratyākhyātatvāt, "karmaṇi dvitīyā" iti sūtre svayamapi tathaivoktatvāt, "kramādamuṃ nārada ityabodhi saḥ" ityādi prayogavirodhācca| dvitīyāpañcamyoriti| etacca rakṣitagranthe spaṣṭam| yattu vadanti-- caitrasya vanādārādityādau sāpekṣatvādasamāse caritārthatvādvidhānasāmarthyaṃ nāstīti; taccintyam, nityasamāsasya nyāyyatve sati caitrasyetyādiviśeṣaṇaprayogasyaivāsambhavāt| uktaṃ hi bhāṣye-- "vṛttasya viśeṣaṇayogo na" iti| nanu "saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna" ityapi bhāṣye uktamiti cet? satyam, anityasamāsaviṣayaṃ tat| nityasamāsasyāpi saviśeṣaṇeṣvapravṛttau mahataḥ kumbhasyopa ityādyāpadyeta| yattu prācā kṛṣṇasyopetyuktam, yacca vyācakhyurīdṛśe prakriyāvākye sthite iti, tadubhayamapi prāguktarītyā prāmādikameva| samprati neti| sampratītyavyayamidānīmityarthe| etarhi sampratīdānīmadhunā sāmprataṃ tathā|| ityamaraḥ| taccā'dhikaraṇaśaktipradhānatvātkriyāpadenaivānvayārham| niṣedho'pi kriyāyā eva| tadātadāha-- yujyate iti| asampratīti| samāsavṛttau tu yujikriyā'ntarbhavati "dadhyodana" ityatra sekakriyā yathā| yattu prācoktam-- asampratīti sampratyabhāva ityarthaḥ| anenopabhogyavastuno yo vartamānaḥ kālastasyaiva niṣedhaḥ kriyate iti; tanna, adhikaraṇasya niṣedhaṃ prati pratiyogitvenānvayasya sarvatantraviruddhatvāt| na hi bhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyanena bhūtalaṃ niṣidhyata iti kaścidabhyupaiti, na vā yuktisahamityastāṃ tāvat| itiharīti| svarūpapareṇa ṣaṣṭhyantena hariśabdena saha prakāśārthasyetiśabdasya samāsaḥ| pratiśabdasyeti| yattvāhuḥ-- grāmasya vṛkṣaṃ pratītyatra sāpekṣatvena samāsābhāve dvitīyāvidhānaṃ sāvakāśamiti tatprāgeva dūṣitam| haradattastvāha- arthamarthaṃ pratīti bhāṣyakāraprayogād vākyamapi sādhu| yadvā nātrāvyayaṃ vīpsāvṛtti kiṃ tarhi karmapravacanīyatvāt sambandhamavacchinatti| vīpsā tu dvirvacanadyotyeti| sahapūrvāhṇamiti| sākalye'vyayībhāvaḥ| guṇabhūte'pīti| yadi sādṛśya iti nocyeta tato yatra sādṛśyaṃ pradhānaṃ tatraiva syāt, avyayārthaprādhānyasyāvyayībhāve autsargikatvāditi bhāvaḥ| anta iti| idānīmetāvānpradeśe'dhyetavya iti yāvataḥ pradeśasya parigrahaḥ kṛtastadapekṣayā samāptirihānto vivakṣitaḥ| sa cāsakale'pyadhyayane bhavatīti sākalyāt pṛthagucyate| agniśabdastadarthe granthe vartate sa tṛtīyāntaḥ samasyate| yadyapyagninā saheti prayogārhameva tathā'pisāhityamātre tathā| antatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu samaso nityaḥ| ata evāgnigranthamityasvapadavigraho darśitaḥ| yattu agniranto'syeti prathamāntenāgnerantatvamiti ṣaṣṭhyantena vā vigraha iti prathamāntena ṣaṣṭhyantena vā samāsa iti; tanna, sahaśabdasyāntavācakatvābhāvāt| antatvasya tu sutarāmalābhāt| tasyādhyayane'nanvayācca| sahayukte tṛtīyāyā nyāyatvācca| satṛṇamattītyatra sākalyasyeva sāgnītyatrāntatvasyāpi sāhityadyotyatayā tatra tṛtīyāntena samāsaṃ svīkṛtyeha tatparityāgasya nirmūlatvācca| yāvacchlokamiti| yāvadityavyayaṃ samasyate| vigrahastu taddhitenetyasvapadatvaṃ boddhyam| vibhāṣā etaditi| nyāyasiddhe'rthe liṅgadarśanamidam| ṭighubhādisaṃjñānāmiva samāsasaṃjñāyā api nityaprāptatvādvacanaṃ vinā viddhyantarāṇāmiva saṃjñānāmapi vikalpā'lābhāt| syādetat| "supsupā" ityapi tarhi nityaṃ syāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, apasiddhāntāt| tathā hi-- caraṭsūtre vṛttikṛtoktaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ, supsupeti samāsa iti| tathā śākalasūtre "sinnityasamāsayoḥ śākalapratiṣedha ityatra nityagrahaṇena nārtha idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati vāpyāmaśvo vāpyaśvaḥ" iti bhāṣyaṃ kaiyaṭo vyākhyāt-- "vāpyaśva iti supsupeti samāsaḥ| "saṃjñāyām" iti samāsasya nityatvātsiddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ" iti| tathā "anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam" "asiddhavadatra" ityādisūtreśaṣvapi kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam| ata āha-- supsupetīti samāseti| yogavibhāgenaiva siddhe samāse uttarasūtraiḥ punarvidhānaṃ prācīnasya kvācitkatāṃ jñāpayati| evaṃ ca ivena samāsasyāpi kvācitkatvādudbāhuriva vāmana ityādi siddham| iveneti vārtikaṃ tu yadyapi "kugati" ityatra paṭhyate tathā'pi supsupetyatratyameva nityādhikāre smāritamita kaiyaṭaḥ| evaṃ sthite ivena samāsasya chāndasatvaṃ kalpayantaḥ pratyuktāḥ| jīmūtasyevetyatra bahvṛcaiḥ samāsābhyupagame'pi taittirīyairvyastasyaiva pāṭhāditi dik| apaparibahiḥ ata eva jñāpakādbahiryoge pañcamī| jñāpakasiddhaṃ na sarvatra| tena "karasya karabho bahiḥ" iti siddham| ābālamiti| yattu-- ā paramāṇoḥ, ā ca bhūgolakamiti kiraṇāvalyāṃ prayuktaṃ tatprāmādikam, samāsamadhye cakāraprayogāsambhavāt| ābhūgolakāditi tu pāṭhyam| yaṃ padārthamiti| sūtre yaditi sāmānye napuṃsakam| "avyayaṃ vibhakti" ityanena siddhe vibhāṣārthaṃ sūtram| tena pakṣe vanasyānu ityudāhāryam| anugaṅgamiti| ihā'yāmo lakṣaṇatvaṃ cānunā dyotyate| lakṣyaṃ tu samāsārthaḥ| ata eva vārāṇasyāḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam| evaṃ sthite phalitamāha- gaṅgādairghyeti| vārāṇasīti| varaṃ ca tadanaśca varānaḥ śreṣṭhodakaṃ, tasyādūrabhavā| "adūrabhavaśca" ityaṇ, ādivṛddhiḥ, "pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām" iti ṇatvam, aṇantatvānṅīp| nadībhiśca svarūpasya saṃjñāyā nadyāśca neha grahaṇaṃ bahuvacananirdeśāt| kiṃ tvarthasya| na ca tasya samāsaḥ saṃjñā bhavati| atastadvācināmayaṃ samāsaḥ| te ca na kevalaṃ viśeṣaśabdā eva kiṃ tu sāmānyaśabdo'pi| nityasamāsa iti| etacca vṛttau spaṣṭam| śākalasūtre kaiyaṭasvaraso'pyevam| nanvevaṃ nyāyasāmyāt bahuvrīherapi nityasamāsatvaṃ syāditi cenmaivam, yasyetyādipadāntarasamabhivyāhāreṇānyapadārthapratīteḥ| ata eva saṃjñānavagamāt ityuktaṃ na tvanyapadārthā'navagamāditi| saṃjñāyāṃ kimॽ śīghragaṅgo deśaḥ| athāvyayībhāve'sādhāraṇān samāsāntānāha- avyayī-- samāsānta iti| samāsasya samāsārthottarapadasya vā caramāvayava ityarthaḥ| tenopaśaradamityatra "nāvyayībhāvāt" ityam dvipurītyādau "dvigoḥ" iti ṅīp ca siddhyati| jarāyā iti| gaṇasūtram| pratipareti| akṣṇaḥ paramiti| aviṣaya ityarthaḥ| vṛttiviṣaye'kṣiśabda indriyamātraparaḥ| samakṣamiti| akṣṇoḥ yogyam| nadī-- iha svarūsyaiva grahaṇaṃ na saṃjñāyāḥ paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇyoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇāt| upanadīti| ṭajabhāve napuṃsakahrasvaḥ| idaṃ tvavadheyam- "nadībhiśca" iti sūtre viśeṣāṇāmiva svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ, viśeṣāṇāmevetyatra mānābhāvādityuktam| tena pañcanadamiti siddhyati| atra ca nityo'c| taduktam- godāvaryāśca nadyāśca saṃkhyāyā uttare yadi|| iti| etacca "acpratyanvava" ityatrājiti yogavibhāgāt siddham| pūjārthamiti| anyatarasyāṅgrahaṇasya prakṛtatvāditi bhāvaḥ|| || iti śrīmadbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ prauḍhamanoramāyāmavyayībhāvasamāsaprakaraṇam||
